items.eng_text: In the beginning of God's creating, 𝄓 the heavens and the earth,
when the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the face of the abyss, 𝄓 and the wind of God brooded over the face of the waters,
then said God: Let there be light. 𝄓 And there was light.
And God saw the light, that it was good. 𝄓 And God differentiated, between the light and between the darkness.
And God called the light day, and the darkness he called night. 𝄓 And it was evening and it was morning, day one. P
And God said, Let there be an expanse in the midst of the waters. 𝄓 And let it be a differentiation, between waters and waters.
And God constructed the expanse, and it differentiated between the waters that are under the expanse, and between the waters that are over the expanse. 𝄓 And it was so.
And God called the expanse heaven. 𝄓 And it was evening and it was morning, the second day. P
And God said, Let the waters under the heavens shirr into one place and let the dry land appear. 𝄓 And it was so.
And God called the dry land earth, and the shirring of the waters he called seas. 𝄓 And God saw that it was good.
And God said, Let the earth be verdant with vegetation, herb seeding seed, fruit tree constructing the fruit of its species whose seed is in itself on the earth. 𝄓 And it was so.
And the earth brought forth vegetation, herb seeding seed of its species, and tree constructing fruit whose seed is in itself of its species. 𝄓 And God saw that it was good.
And it was evening and it was morning, the third day. P
And God said, Let there be lights in the expanse of the heavens, to differentiate between the day and between the night. 𝄓 And let them be for signs and for appointed times, and for days and years.
And let them be for lights in the expanse of the heavens, to give light upon the earth. 𝄓 And it was so.
And God constructed, the two great lights, 𝄓 the greater light to govern the day, and the lesser light to govern the night, and the stars.
And God gave them in the expanse of the heavens, 𝄓 to give light upon the earth,
and to govern in the day and in the night, and to differentiate, between the light and between the darkness. 𝄓 And God saw that it was good.
And it was evening and it was morning, the fourth day. P
And God said, Let the waters teem, with teeming being that has life, 𝄓 and fowl flying over the earth, over the face of the expanse of the heavens.

And God created, the great dragons, 𝄓 and all the being of the life of those that creep, with which the waters teemed of their species, and all winged fowl of its species. And God saw that it was good.
And God blessed them and said, 𝄓 Be fruitful and increase and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl increase in the earth.
And it was evening and it was morning, the fifth day. P
And God said, Let the earth bring forth being that has life of its species, cattle, and creeper, and its earthly animal of its species. 𝄓 And it was so.
And God constructed the animals of the earth of its species and the cattle of its species, and all that creep of the ground of its species. 𝄓 And God saw that it was good.

And God said, Let us construct humanity in our image according to our likeness, 𝄓 and let them rule among the fish of the sea and among the fowl of the heavens and among the cattle and in all the earth, and among every creeper that creeps upon the earth.
And God created the human in his image, In the image of God he created it, 𝄓 male and female he created them.

And God blessed them and God said to them, Be fruitful and increase and fill the earth and control it. 𝄓 And rule among the fish of the sea and among the fowl of the heavens, and among every living creeper upon the earth.
And God said, Behold, I have given to you every herb, seeding seed that is on the face of the whole earth, and every tree in which is the fruit of a tree seeding seed. 𝄓 To you they will be for food.
And to all the living of the earth, and to all the fowl of the heavens, and to all creepers upon the earth that have in it the being of life, every foliage of herb for food. 𝄓 And it was so.
And God saw all that he had constructed, and behold it was very good. 𝄓 And it was evening and it was morning, the sixth day. P
And finished were the heavens and the earth and all their hosts.
And God finished on the seventh day, his affairs that he constructed. 𝄓 And he ceased on the seventh day, from all his affairs that he constructed.
And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it. 𝄓 For on it he ceased from all his affairs, that God created for construction. P
These are the successions of the heavens and the earth when they were created, 𝄓 on the day Yahweh God constructed earth and heaven.
And every shrub of the field, ere it was in the earth, and every herb of the field ere it grew. 𝄓 For Yahweh God had not made it rain on the earth, and there was no human, to serve the ground.
And a humidity ascended from the earth, 𝄓 and gave drink to all the surface of the ground.
And Yahweh God fashioned the human, dust from the humus, and exhaled into its nose the breath of life, 𝄓 and the human to itself became alive.
And Yahweh God planted a garden in Eden from the east, 𝄓 and he set up there, the human that he had fashioned.
And Yahweh God made grow from the ground, every tree attractive to see and good to eat, 𝄓 and the tree of the living in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
And a river goes out from Eden, to irrigate the garden, 𝄓 and from there, separates and becomes four headwaters.
The name of the first is Pishon. 𝄓 It surrounds all the land of the one who brings to birth, where there is gold.
And the gold of that land is good. 𝄓 There is bdellium and onyx stone.
And the name of the second river is Gihon. 𝄓 It surrounds, all the land of Cush.
And the name of the third river is Hidkel. It meanders east to Ashur. 𝄓 And the fourth river is Euphrates.
And Yahweh God took the human, 𝄓 and he allowed him into the garden of Eden, to serve it and to guard it.
And Yahweh God gave command, to the human and said, 𝄓 From every tree of the garden, for food you will eat.
But from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you will not eat from it, 𝄓 for in the day of your eating from it, for death you will die.
And Yahweh God said, It is not good that the human is itself alone. 𝄓 I will construct its help as conspicuous to it.

And Yahweh God fashioned from the ground every living thing of the field and all the fowl of the heavens, and had them come to the human, to see what it would call to it. 𝄓 And all that the human called it, the self that has life, that was its name.
And the human called the names of all the cattle and of the fowl of the heavens, and to all the living of the field, 𝄓 but for the human was not found help as conspicuous to it.
And Yahweh God made a trance fall on the human and it slept, 𝄓 and he took one from its ribs, and he stitched up the flesh under it.
And Yahweh God built the rib that he took from the human into woman. 𝄓 And he had her come to the human.
And the human said, This pulse is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. 𝄓 This one will be called woman. For from man this one was taken.
Therefore a man will forsake, his father and his mother, 𝄓 and stay close to his woman, and let them be of one flesh.
And the two of them were naked, the human and his woman, 𝄓 and they were not ashamed.
But the snake was crafty, among all the living of the field, that Yahweh God constructed, 𝄓 and it said to the woman, Indeed that God said, You will not eat, from every tree of the garden.
And the woman said to the snake, 𝄓 From the fruit of the tree of the garden, we eat.
But from the fruit of the tree that is in the midst of the garden, God said, You will not eat from it and you will not touch it, 𝄓 lest you die.
And the snake said to the woman, 𝄓 Not death you will die.
Because God knows, that in the day you eat from it, your eyes will be given sight, 𝄓 and you will become as God, knowing good and evil.

And the woman saw that good was the tree to eat and that desirable it was to the eyes and attractive was the tree to have insight, and she took from its fruit and she ate, 𝄓 and she gave even to her man with her and they ate.
And the eyes of the two of them were given sight, and they knew, that they were naked, 𝄓 so they sewed together fig leaves, and they made for themselves attire.

And they heard the voice of Yahweh God walking in the garden in the wind of the day, 𝄓 and they camouflaged themselves, the Adam and his woman, from the face of Yahweh God in the midst of the tree of the garden.
And Yahweh God called to the Adam, 𝄓 saying to him, Where are you?
And it said, I heard your voice in the garden, 𝄓 and I feared because I am naked so I camouflaged myself.
And he said, Who made it clear to you that you are naked? 𝄓 From the tree that I commanded you not to eat, did you eat?
And the Adam said, 𝄓 The woman that you have given to stand with me, she gave to me from the tree and I ate.
And Yahweh God said to the woman, What is this that you have done? 𝄓 and the woman said, The snake lured me and I ate.

And Yahweh God said to the snake, Because you have done this, cursed you will be above all cattle, and above all the living of the field. 𝄓 On your stomach you will walk, and dust you will eat all the days of your life.
And I will impose enmity between you and between the woman, and between your seed and between her seed. 𝄓 It itself will bruise you in the head. But you, yourself will bruise it in the heel. S

To the woman he said, Thoroughly I will increase your hardship and your pregnancy. In hardship you will give birth to children, 𝄓 and to your man you will have aspiration, but he himself will govern in you. S

But to Adam he said, Because you heard the voice of your wife, and ate from the tree, that I commanded you, saying, You will not eat from it, 𝄓 cursed is the ground on your behalf. In hardship you will eat from it ,all the days of your life.
So brambles and thistles she will grow for you, 𝄓 and you will eat the herb of the field.
In the sweat of your anger you will eat bread, till you return to the ground, for from it you were taken, 𝄓 for dust you are, and to dust you will return.
And the Adam called the name of his wife, Eve, 𝄓 for she became the mother of all living.
And Yahweh God made for Adam and his wife coats of skin, and he clothed them. P
And Yahweh God said, Lo, the human has become as one among us knowing good and evil, 𝄓 so now lest he reach out his hand and take likewise from the tree of the living and eat and live forever, ...
so Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, 𝄓 to serve the ground, which he was taken from.
And he expelled the human, 𝄓 and roosting at the east of the garden of Eden, the cherubim, and the blazing sword always changing, to guard the way to the tree of the living. S
And the one from the humus, knew Eve his wife, 𝄓 and she became big and she gave birth to Cain, and she said, I have acquired someone with Yahweh.
And she again gave birth to his brother, to Abel. 𝄓 And Abel was a shepherd of sheep, but Cain was a servant of the ground.
And it happened at the end of days, 𝄓 that Cain brought from the fruit of the ground, a gift for Yahweh.
And Abel brought also himself from the firstborn of his flock and its choicest. 𝄓 And Yahweh had respect, to Abel and to his gift.
But to Cain and to his gift he did not have respect. 𝄓 And for Cain, he burned much with anger and his face fell.
And Yahweh said to Cain, 𝄓 Why is it for you to burn with anger, and why has your face fallen?
Will it not be that if you do well you will be lifted up? And if you do not do well, sin reclines at the opening, 𝄓 and its aspiration is against you, but you yourself will govern in it.
And Cain talked to Abel his brother. 𝄓 And it happened when they were in the field, that Cain arose against Abel his brother and slew him.
And Yahweh said to Cain, Where is Abel your brother? 𝄓 And he said, I do not know. Am I my brother's guardian?
And he said, What have you done? 𝄓 The voice of the blood of your brother, cries out to me from the ground.
So now cursed are you, 𝄓 from the ground that parted open her mouth, to receive the blood of your brother from your hand.
For though you serve the ground, she will not again yield her power to you. 𝄓 A vagabond and aimless you will be in the earth.
And Cain said to Yahweh, 𝄓 Greater is my iniquity than I can bear.
Lo, you expel me today from the surface of the ground, and from your face I will be hid, 𝄓 and I will be a vagabond and aimless in the earth, and it will happen that anyone who finds me will slay me.
And Yahweh said to him, Therefore all who slay Cain seven-fold he will be avenged. 𝄓 And Yahweh set up for Cain a sign, lest anyone finding him should strike him.
So Cain went forth from the presence of Yahweh, 𝄓 and settled in the land of the aimless east of Eden.
and Cain knew his wife and she became pregnant, and she gave birth to Enoch, 𝄓 and he was building a city, and he called the name of the city like the name of his son, Enoch.
And to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad had Mehujel, 𝄓 and Mehujel had Methusael, and Methusael had Lamech.
And Lamech took for himself two wives. 𝄓 The name of the first, Adah, and the name of the second Her-Shadow.
And Adah gave birth to Jabal. 𝄓 He is, the father of those who sit in a tent and acquire.
And the name of his brother is Jubal. 𝄓 He is, the father of all who take up harp or pipe.
And Zillah [her shadow] also herself gave birth to Tubalcain [She-will-be-brought-to-Cain], one who hones every edged tool of brass and iron. 𝄓 and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah [pleasure].
and Lamech said to his wives Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice, wives of Lamech, give ear to what I say, 𝄓 for I have slain someone for inflicting wounds on me, a juvenile for my stripes.
For seven times vengeance for Cain, 𝄓 and Lamech seventy and seven.
And Adam knew still his wife, and she gave birth to a son, and she called his name Seth, 𝄓 for God imposed for me another seed instead of Abel, [futility], for Cain slew him.
And to Seth also himself was born a son, and he called his name Enosh [mortal]. 𝄓 Then began entreaty: to call in the name of Yahweh. S
This is the record, of the successions of Adam, 𝄓 in the day of God's creating Adam, in the likeness of God's constructing him.
Male and female he created them, 𝄓 and blessed them and called their name Adam, in the day they were created.
And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and had in his likeness in his image, 𝄓 and he called his name Seth.
And the days of Adam after Seth was born, were eight hundred years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Adam that he lived, were nine hundred, and thirty years, 𝄓 and he died. S
And Seth lived a hundred and five years, 𝄓 and he had Enosh.
And Seth lived after Enosh was born, seven years,and eight hundred years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Seth, were twelve years, and nine hundred years, 𝄓 and he died. S
And Enosh lived ninety years, 𝄓 and he had Cainan.
And Enosh lived after Cainan was born, eight hundred, and fifteen years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Enosh, were nine hundred, and five years, 𝄓 and he died. S
And Cainan lived seventy years, 𝄓 and he had Mahalaleel.
And Cainan lived after Mahalaleel was born, eight hundred, and forty years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Cainan, were nine hundred, and ten years, 𝄓 and he died. S
And Mahalaleel lived, sixty five years, 𝄓 and he had Jared.
And Mahalaleel lived after Jared was born, eight hundred, and thirty years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Mahalaleel, were eight hundred, and ninety five years, 𝄓 and he died. S
And Jared lived a hundred and sixty two years, 𝄓 and he had Enoch.
And Jared lived after Enoch was born, eight hundred years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Jared, were two and sixty years, and nine hundred years, 𝄓 and he died. S
And Enoch lived, sixty five years, 𝄓 and he had Methuselah.
And Enoch walked with God after Methuselah was born, three hundred years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Enoch, 𝄓 were three hundred, and sixty five years.
And Enoch walked with God, 𝄓 and he was not for God took him. S
And Methuselah lived, a hundred and eighty seven years, 𝄓 and he had Lamech.
And Methuselah lived after Lamech was born, seven hundred, and eighty two years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Methuselah, were nine hundred, and sixty nine years, 𝄓 and he died. S
And Lamech lived a hundred and eighty two years, 𝄓 and he had a son.
And he called his name Noah and said, 𝄓 This one will comfort us from our deeds and from the hardship of our hands, from the ground, which Yahweh cursed.
And Lamech lived after Noah was born, five hundred, and ninety five years, 𝄓 and he had sons and daughters.
And all the days of Lamech, were seven hundred, and seventy seven years, 𝄓 and he died. S
And Noah was a child of five hundred years, 𝄓 and Noah had Shem, Ham and Japhet.
And it happened that humanity started, to multiply over the face of the ground, 𝄓 and daughters were born to them.
And the sons of the gods saw the daughters of humanity, that they were good, 𝄓 and they took for themselves wives, from all whom they chose.
And Yahweh said, My spirit will not make the case for a human forever, in that it also is flesh, 𝄓 so let its days, be a hundred and twenty, years.

The fallen were in the earth in those days, and moreover after such that the sons of the gods came to the daughters of humanity, and they gave birth for them. 𝄓 These are the valiant that are from of old, the men of repute. P
And Yahweh saw, that abundant was the evil of humanity in the earth, 𝄓 and all the fashioning of the devisings of its heart, was solely evil all the day long.
And Yahweh sighed, that he had made humanity in the earth, 𝄓 and it caused him pain in his heart.
And Yahweh said, I will wipe out humanity that I created from off the surface of the ground, from human to beast to creeper and to the fowl of the heavens, 𝄓 for I regret that I made them.
But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahweh. P
These are the successions of Noah. Noah, a righteous man, was complete in his generations. 𝄓 With this God walked Noah.
And Noah had three children, 𝄓 Shem, Ham, and Japhet.
And impaired was the earth in the face of this God, 𝄓 and the land was filled with violence.
And God saw the earth and behold it was impaired, 𝄓 for all flesh had impaired its way upon the earth. S
And God said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come into my presence, for the earth is full of violence from their presence, 𝄓 so behold me impairing them with the earth.
Construct for yourself a barge of the trees of pitch. Cubicles you will make with the barge. 𝄓 Cover her over on the inside and on the outside an over-covering.
And this is how you will construct her: 𝄓 three hundred cubits the length of the barge, fifty cubits her breadth, and thirty cubits her height.
A porthole you will construct for the barge and to a cubit you will finish her from her ascent, and you will put a door for the barge in her side. 𝄓 Lower decks second and third, you will construct.
As for me, note me well, I will bring the deluge of waters on the earth to impair all flesh that has in it a living spirit from under the heavens. 𝄓 All that is in the earth will expire.
But I will place my covenant with you. 𝄓 And you will come to the barge, you and your children and your wife and the wives of your children with you.
And from all the living, from all flesh, two from all you will bring to the barge to keep alive with you. 𝄓 Male and female they will be.
From fowl of its species and from the cattle of its species, from all that creep of the ground of its species, 𝄓 two from all will come with you to keep alive.
And you, take for yourself from all food that is eaten, so you will gather with you. 𝄓 And it will be for you and for them for food.
And Noah constructed. 𝄓 Everything that God commanded him, so he constructed.
And Yahweh said to Noah, You come, you and all your house into the barge, 𝄓 for you I have seen righteous in my presence in this generation.
From all the clean beasts you take for yourself seven by seven each and its mate, 𝄓 and from the beast that is not clean, it, by two each and its mate.
Likewise of the fowl of the heavens, seven by seven, male and female, 𝄓 to keep alive seed over the surface of all the earth.
For in yet seven days I will cause rain upon the earth, a forty day, and forty night span. 𝄓 I will wipe out all that was placed that I constructed, from off the surface of the ground.
So did Noah, 𝄓 according to everything that Yahweh had commanded.
And Noah was a child of six hundred years, 𝄓 when the deluge was, of waters on the earth.
And Noah entered and his children and his wife and the wives of his children with him to the barge, 𝄓 from the face of the waters of the deluge.
From the beast that is clean, and from the beast, that is not clean, 𝄓 and from the fowl, and all that creep over the ground,
Two by two they entered, to Noah, into the barge, male and female, 𝄓 as God commanded Noah.
And it happened on the seventh of the days, 𝄓 and the waters of the deluge, were upon the earth.

In the six hundredth year, a year of the life of Noah, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, 𝄓 on this day all the springs of the abyss were split to excess, and the slits of the heavens were set wide open.
And the heavy rain was upon the earth, 𝄓 a forty day, and forty night span.
In this selfsame day, entered Noah and Shem and Ham and Japhet, the children of Noah, 𝄓 and the wife of Noah, and the three wives of his children with them, into the barge.
They, and all the living of its species, and every beast of its species, and every creeper that creeps upon the earth of its species, 𝄓 and all the fowl of its species, every bird of every wing.
And they came to Noah into the barge, 𝄓 two by two from all the flesh, that has in it a living spirit.
And they that entered, male and female from all flesh, entered as God commanded him, 𝄓 and Yahweh placed the bar from within.
And the deluge was a forty day span upon the earth. 𝄓 And the waters increased and they lifted up the barge, and it was exalted above the earth.
And the waters prevailed and were much increased upon the earth, 𝄓 and the barge meandered upon the face of the waters.
And the waters prevailed very much upon the earth, 𝄓 and covered all the haughty hills, that were under all the heavens.
Fifteen cubits from her ascent, the waters prevailed, 𝄓 and they covered the hills.
And all flesh expired that creeps upon the earth, of fowl and of beast and of life, and of all that teem, that teem upon the earth, 𝄓 and all humanity.
All in whose nose is the breath of a living spirit, all that were in the desert, they died.

And wiped out was all that was placed that is on the face of the ground, from human to beast to creeper and to the fowl of the heavens and they were wiped out from the earth, 𝄓 and the residue was but Noah and those who were with him on the barge.
And the waters prevailed upon the earth, 𝄓 a hundred and fifty day span.
And God remembered Noah and all the living, and all the cattle, that were with him on the barge, 𝄓 and God made a wind pass through over the earth, and the waters subsided.
And stopped were the springs of the abyss, and the slits of the heavens, 𝄓 and restrained was the heavy rain from the heavens.
And the waters turned from over the earth, meandering and turning, 𝄓 and the waters waned, from the limit, a hundred and fifty day span.
And the barge came to rest in the seventh month, the seventeenth day of the month, 𝄓 upon the mountains of Ararat.
And the waters were meandering and waning, till the tenth new moon. 𝄓 In the tenth, on the first of the month, appeared the tops of the hills.
And it happened at the end of forty days, 𝄓 and Noah opened, the window of the barge that he had constructed.
And he sent the raven. 𝄓 And it went forth. It went forth and returned endlessly while the waters from over the earth were drying up.
And he sent the dove from him, 𝄓 to see the dwindling of the waters, from off the surface of the ground.

And the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned to him into the barge, for waters were on the face of the whole earth, 𝄓 and he extended his hand and received her, and had her come to him into the barge.
And he endured the birth yet, seven days following, 𝄓 and again he sent out the dove from the barge.
And the dove came to him at the time of evening, and behold a torn leaf of the olive in her mouth. 𝄓 And Noah knew, that the waters had dwindled from over the earth.
And he endured the birth, yet seven days following, 𝄓 and he sent the dove, and she did not again return to him any more.

And it happened in the six hundred and first year in the first, on the first of the month, the waters drained from over the earth. 𝄓 And Noah put aside the covering of the barge and he stared, and behold the surface of the ground was drained.
And in the second month, on the twenty seventh day of the month, 𝄓 the earth was dried up. S
And God spoke to Noah, and said,
Go forth from the barge, 𝄓 you and your wife and your children and the wives of your children with you.

All the living that are with you, from all flesh of fowl and of beast, and among every creeper that creeps upon the earth, bring out with you, 𝄓 and let them teem in the earth, and be fruitful and multiply over the earth.
So Noah went forth, 𝄓 and his children and his wife and the wives of his children with him.
All the living, every creeper, and all the fowl, all creepers upon the earth, 𝄓 of their families, came forth from the barge.
And Noah built an altar to Yahweh, 𝄓 and took from all the clean beasts and from all the clean fowl, and he offered up burnt offerings on the altar.

And Yahweh smelled a restful fragrance and Yahweh said to his heart, Not again will I slight any more the ground on behalf of the human, for the heart of the human is trouble, evil from its youth. 𝄓 And not again will I strike any more all the living, as I have done.
For all the days of the earth, 𝄓 seed and harvest, and cold and warmth, and summer and autumn, and day and night will not cease.
And God blessed Noah, and his children, 𝄓 and said to them, Be fruitful and increase and fill the earth.

And the fear of you and dismay of you will be, over every living thing of the earth, and over all the fowl of the heavens, 𝄓 all that creep of the ground and on all of the fishes of the sea. Into your hand they are given.
Every creeping organism that is alive, to you they will be for food. 𝄓 Like the herb's foliage, I have given everything to you.
But flesh in its integrity, its blood, you will not eat.

And surely your blood for your integrity I will search out. From the hand of all that has life I will search it out. 𝄓 And from the hand of the human, from the hand of each person's kin, I will search out the integrity of the human.
One shedding the blood of the human, by the human its blood will be shed, 𝄓 for in the image of God, he made the human.
But you, be fruitful and increase. 𝄓 Teem in the earth and multiply in her. S
And God said to Noah and to his children with him, saying,
And I, note me well, I am placing my covenant with you, 𝄓 and your seed after you.
And with all living beings that are with you, of the fowl and of the cattle, and of all the life of the earth with you, 𝄓 from all who came forth, from the barge of all the life of the earth.
But I will place my covenant with you, and all flesh will not be cut off any more from the waters of the deluge, 𝄓 and there will not be any more a deluge to impair the earth.

And Abraham raced to the herd, 𝄓 and he took of the herd, one tender and good, and he gave to a lad, and he was swift to deal with it.
And he took clotted cream and milk, and the child of the herd that was dealt with, and he put forth before them, 𝄓 and he stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
And they said to him, Where is Sarah your wife? 𝄓 And he said, Behold, in the tent.
And he said, To return, I will return to you as is the time of life, and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son. 𝄓 And Sarah heard at the door of the tent, and it was behind him.
And Abraham and Sarah were old, having come into a plurality of days. 𝄓 Sarah had been given relief, from the path according to women.
And Sarah made sport within her, saying, 𝄓 After I am worn out, will there be enthrallment for me? And my lord is elderly.
And Yahweh said to Abraham, 𝄓 Why this making sport from Sarah, saying, Indeed, truly will I give birth? And myself, I am old.
Will a wonder from Yahweh be something? 𝄓 At the appointed time I will return to you, as is the time of life, and Sarah will have a son.
And Sarah dissimulated, saying, I did not make sport. (Because she feared.) 𝄓 And he said, No, but you did make sport.
And from there the men arose, and looked down on the face of Sodom, 𝄓 and Abraham, went with them to send them on.
But Yahweh said, 𝄓 Will I blindfold from Abraham, what I am doing.
For Abraham, will become a great nation and numerous, 𝄓 and in him will be blessed, all the nations of the earth.

For I know him, in order that he will command his children and his house after him, and keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and judgment, 𝄓 in order that Yahweh may bring over Abraham, what he spoke concerning him.
And Yahweh said, For the appeal of Sodom and Gomorrah is abundant, 𝄓 and their sin, for it is very heavy.
I will go down now and I will see, whether according to her outcry that has come to me, they do all of it. 𝄓 And if not, I will know.
And the men faced from there, and went towards Sodom, 𝄓 and Abraham, yet stood in the presence of Yahweh.
And Abraham came close and said, 𝄓 Indeed will you snatch, a righteous one with one who is wicked?
Perhaps there are fifty righteous ones in the midst of the city, 𝄓 Indeed will you snatch, and not bear the place for the sake of the fifty righteous ones that are within her?

Far be it from you to do such a thing as this, to execute a righteous one with one who is wicked, and that a righteous one should be as one who is wicked. 𝄓 Far be it from you. Will not the judge of all the earth, do judgment?
And Yahweh said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous ones in the midst of the city, 𝄓 then I will bear the whole place on their behalf.
And Abraham answered and he said, 𝄓 Behold if you will, I have attempted to speak to my Lord, and I am dust and ashes.
Perhaps there will lack of the fifty righteous ones, five. Will you destroy for five all the city? 𝄓 And he said, I will not destroy, if I find there forty five.
And again further to speak to him, he said, Perhaps forty will be found there. 𝄓 And he said, I will not act, on behalf of the forty.
And he said, Please do not let my Lord burn, and I will speak. Perhaps thirty will be found there, 𝄓 And he said, I will not act if I find there thirty.
And he said, Behold if you will, I have attempted to speak to my Lord. Perhaps twenty will be found there. 𝄓 And he said, I will not destroy on behalf of the twenty.
And he said, Please do not let my Lord burn, and I will speak but this one time. Perhaps ten will be found there. 𝄓 And he said, I will not destroy on behalf of the ten.
And Yahweh went, when he finished, speaking to Abraham. 𝄓 And Abraham returned to his place.
And two messengers came towards Sodom in the evening, and Lot was seated at the gate of Sodom, 𝄓 and Lot stared and arose to encounter them, and he prostrated himself, nostrils earthward.

And he said, Behold, if you will, my Lord. Turn aside, if you will, to the house of your servant, and stop over and wash your feet, and rise early and go your way. 𝄓 And they said, No. For in the plaza, we will stop over.
And he urged them much, and they turned aside to him, and they came to his house. 𝄓 And he made for them a party. Unleavened bread he baked, and they ate.
Before they lay down, the men of the city, the incurables of Sodom, surrounded the house, from youngster and to the elderly, 𝄓 all the people from the extremes.
And they called out to Lot, and they said to him, Where are the persons that came to you tonight? 𝄓 Bring them out to us, to know them.
And Lot went out the door to them, 𝄓 and the gateway he latched after him.
And he said, 𝄓 Please, my kin, do not do evil.

Behold, if you will, to me are two daughters who have not known a man. Let me please bring them out to you and do to them as is good in your sight. 𝄓 Certainly to the men, the God, you will not do a thing, for so they came into the shadow of my rafters.

And they said, Come close here. And they said, The first is come to reside and be judge and judging, now we will do injury to you from them. 𝄓 And they urged much on the man, on Lot, and they came close to breaking the gateway.
But the men extended their hands, and they brought Lot to them towards the house. 𝄓 And the gateway they latched.
And the persons that were at the door of the house they struck with bewilderment, from the least and to the greatest, 𝄓 and they were exasperated to find the door.
And the men said to Lot, who of yours is yet here, in-laws or your sons or your daughters or any that are yours in the city? 𝄓 Bring them out from the place.
For to destroy are we, this place, 𝄓 for great is their outcry before Yahweh, and Yahweh sent us to destroy.

And Lot went out and he spoke to his in-laws that had taken his daughters, and he said, Arise. Go forth from this place, for Yahweh is about to destroy the city. 𝄓 But he was as one making sport in the eyes of his in-laws.
And as the dawn came up and the messengers importuned Lot, and said, 𝄓 Arise. Take your wife and your two daughters that have been found, lest you be snatched in the iniquity of the city.

And he was lingering, and the men were resolute by his hand and by the hand of his wife and by the hands of his two daughters, with the pity of Yahweh upon him, 𝄓 and they brought him out and they left him outside of the city.

And it was when they had brought them out, them outside, that he said, Escape for your self. Do not let yourself take note behind you, and do not stand anywhere in the basin. 𝄓 Towards the hill escape, lest you be snatched.
And said Lot to them, 𝄓 No, please, my Lord,

Behold may your servant find grace in your eyes. You have magnified your mercy in what you have done for me to keep me alive, 𝄓 but myself I will not endure the escape to the hill, lest the evil cling to me and I die.
Behold, if you will, this city is near to withdraw to. There, and it is small. 𝄓 Let me escape, if you will, there. (Is it not small?) And I will continue to live.
And he said to him, Behold I will lift up your face, also in this matter, 𝄓 so I will not overturn the city of which you speak.
Swiftly escape thereto, for I am not able to do a thing, until your coming there. 𝄓 Therefore he called the name of the city Small.
The sun came out over the earth, 𝄓 and Lot came towards Small.
But Yahweh made it rain over Sodom and over Gomorrah, pitch and fire, 𝄓 from Yahweh, from the heavens.
And the God overturned the cities, and all the basin, 𝄓 and all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew on the ground.
And his wife took note what was behind him, 𝄓 and she became a monument of salt.
And Abraham rose up early in the morning, 𝄓 to the place, where he stood before Yahweh.

And he leaned over to look in the face of Sodom and Gomorrah, and over all the face of the land of the basin. 𝄓 And he stared, and behold, burning smoke went up from the land, as the burning smoke of a kiln.

And it happened when God destroyed the cities of the basin, that God remembered Abraham, 𝄓 and he sent Lot out of the midst of the overturning, when he overturned the cities, where seated in them was Lot.
And Lot went up from Small and settled on the hill and his two daughters with him, for he feared to settle in Small, 𝄓 so he settled in the cave, he and his two daughters.
And the firstborn said to the smaller, Our father is elderly, 𝄓 and there is no one else in the earth to enter into us, in the way of all the earth.
Come, let us assault our father with wine, and we will lie together with him, 𝄓 and we will keep alive seed from our father.
And they assaulted their father with wine in that night. 𝄓 And the firstborn came and lay down with her father, and nothing he knew of her lying down or her arising.

And it happened afterwards, that the firstborn said to the smaller, Lo I lay down last night with my father. 𝄓 Let us assault him with wine also tonight, and you go in and lie down with him, and we will keep alive seed from our father.
And they assaulted also in that night their father with wine. 𝄓 And the smaller arose and lay down with him, and not did he know of her lying down or her arising.
So the two daughters of Lot became pregnant from their father.
And she gave birth to the firstborn, a son, and she called his name Moab. 𝄓 He is the father of Moab until today.
And the smaller also herself gave birth to a son, and she called his name a Son of My People. 𝄓 He is the father of the children of Ammon until today. S
So Abraham migrated from there toward the land of south, and settled between Qadesh and Shur, 𝄓 and he resided in Gerar.
And Abraham said about Sarah, his wife, My sister she is. 𝄓 And Abimelek, the king of Gerar, sent and he took Sarah.
But God came to Abimelek in a dream by night, 𝄓 and said to him, Behold, you are dead by the woman that you have taken, for she is married to a husband.
But Abimelek had not come near to her, 𝄓 and he said, My Lord, the righteous nation will you also slay?
Did he not say to me, My sister she is? And she, even she herself said, My brother, he is. 𝄓 In the completeness of my heart and in the innocence of my palms, I have done this.

And God said to him in the dream, Even I myself know that in the completeness of your heart you have done this, for even I myself kept you back from sinning against me, 𝄓 so I did not permit you to touch her.

So now, return the wife of the man, for a prophet he is, and he will intercede for you, then you will live. 𝄓 And if it is not in you to restore, know that to die, you will die, you and all that are yours.
And Abimelek rose up early in the morning, and he called for all his servants, and spoke all these words in their ears, 𝄓 and the men feared much.

And Abimelek called to Abraham and said to him, What have you done to us? and how have I sinned against you that you brought on me and over my kingdom a great sin? 𝄓 Deeds that should not be done, you have done against me.
Then Abimelek said to Abraham, 𝄓 What have you seen, that you have done this thing?
Then Abraham said, For I said, Certainly there is no fear of God in this place, 𝄓 and they will slay me over the matter of my wife.
And moreover, truly my sister, the daughter of my father himself, but not the daughter of my mother, 𝄓 and she became my wife.

And it happened that as gods made me wander from the house of my father, that I said to her, This is your kindness that you will do about me. 𝄓 At every place where we are come, say of me, My brother he is.
And Abimelek took sheep and oxen and servants and handmaids, and he gave to Abraham, 𝄓 and restored to him, Sarah his wife.
Then Abimelek said, Behold my land is before you. 𝄓 In its goodness in your eyes, settle.
And to Sarah he said, Behold, I have given a thousand pieces of silver to your brother. Behold, he is for you a covering of eyes, for all that are with you. 𝄓 And with all, so she was reproved.
And Abraham interceded to this God, 𝄓 and God healed Abimelek and his wife and his maidservants, and they gave birth.
For Yahweh had contained, contained almost every womb of the household of Abimelek, 𝄓 over the matter of Sarah the wife of Abraham. S
And Yahweh visited Sarah as he promised, 𝄓 and Yahweh did for Sarah as he had spoken.
And Sarah became pregnant and gave birth to a child for Abraham in his old age, 𝄓 at the appointed time that God had spoken to him.
And Abraham called the name of his son, born to him, whom Sarah gave birth to, for him, Yitschaq.
And Abraham circumcised Yitschaq his son, a child of eight days, 𝄓 as God commanded him.
And Abraham was a child of a hundred years, 𝄓 when born to him, was Yitschaq his child.
And Sarah said, God has made sport of me. 𝄓 All who hear will make sport of me.
And she said, Who makes a speech to Abraham about Sarah suckling children? 𝄓 For I have begotten a son in his old age.
And the boy grew and it was weaned, 𝄓 and Abraham made a great party, in the day Yitschaq was weaned.
And Sarah saw the child of Hagar the Egyptian, which she gave birth to for Abraham, making sport.
And she said to Abraham, Expel this maidservant and her child, 𝄓 for the child of this maidservant will not possess with my child, with Yitschaq.
And the matter was very irritating in the eyes of Abraham, 𝄓 concerning the topic of his son.

And God said to Abraham, Let it not be irritating in your eyes concerning the lad or concerning your maidservant. All that Sarah said to you, hear with her voice, 𝄓 for in Yitschaq, your seed will be called.
And moreover, the child of the maidservant as a nation I will render, 𝄓 for your seed it is.

And Abraham rose up early in the morning and took bread and a flask of water that he gave to Hagar. He set it up over her backside, and the boy, and he sent her away. 𝄓 And she went, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-Sheva.
And the water from the flask was consumed, 𝄓 and she cast the boy, under one of the shrubs.

And God heard the voice of the lad, and the messenger of God called to Hagar from the heavens, and he said to her, What is with you, Hagar? 𝄓 Do not fear, for God hears the voice of the lad, in that he is there.
Arise, lift up the lad and hold him resolutely with your hand, 𝄓 for a great nation I will render him.
And God gave her eyes sight, and she saw a well of waters, 𝄓 and she went and she filled the flask with water, and gave the lad drink.
And God was with the lad and he grew, 𝄓 and inhabited the wilderness, and became skilled with a bow.
And he inhabited the wilderness of Paran, 𝄓 and his mother took for him a woman from the land of Egypt. P
And it happened at that time that Abimelek and Phykol, chief of his host, said to Abraham, saying, 𝄓 God is with you, in all that you do.

So now swear to me in God here, that you will not be false to me, nor my posterity, nor my descendants, 𝄓 according to the kindness that I have done with you, you will do with me, and with the land in which you have resided.
Then Abraham said, I myself will swear.
But Abraham reproved Abimelek, 𝄓 over the topic of a well of water, that the servants of Abimelek had ravaged.
And Abimelek said, I did not know. Who has done this thing? 𝄓 And also you yourself did not make clear to me, and moreover I myself had not heard but today.
And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and he gave them to Abimelek, 𝄓 and they cut, both of them, a covenant.
And Abraham laid out seven young lambs of the flock alone.
Then Abimelek said to Abraham, 𝄓 What are these seven young lambs, these which you have laid out alone?
And he said, Because seven young lambs, you will take from my hand, 𝄓 so that they will be for me a testimony, that I have excavated this well.
Therefore he called place that Beer-Sheva [well of the seven, of the oath], 𝄓 for there they both swore.
And they cut a covenant in Beer-Sheva. 𝄓 And Abimelek arose and Phykol, chief of his host, and they returned to the land of the Philistines.
And he planted a tamarisk in Beer-Sheva. 𝄓 And he called there in the name of Yahweh, the One everlasting.
And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines many days. P
And it was following these things, that this God, tempted Abraham, 𝄓 and said to him, Abraham. And he said, Here am I.

And he said, Take please your child, your unique one that you love, Yitschaq, and go you to the land of Moriah, 𝄓 and bring him up there for a burnt offering, on one of the hills, that I will indicate to you.

And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and he saddled his ass, and he took two of his lads with him, and Yitschaq his child, 𝄓 and he split the wood for a burnt offering, and he arose and he went, to the place that the God had indicated to him.
On the third day, when Abraham lifted up his eyes, and he saw the place in the distance,
Then Abraham said to his lads, Sit yourselves here with the ass, and I and the lad will go further thus. 𝄓 And we will worship, and we will return to you.
And Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering that he put on Yitschaq his child, and he took in his hand, the fire and the knife, 𝄓 and they went, the two of them as one.
And Yitschaq said to Abraham his father, saying, My father. And he said, Here am I, my child. 𝄓 And he said, Behold the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?
And Abraham said, God sees him, the lamb for the burnt offering, my child. 𝄓 And they went, the two of them as one.

And they came to the place that this God had indicated to him, and there Abraham built the altar, and he arranged the wood, 𝄓 and he trussed Yitschaq, his child, and he put him on the altar above the wood.
And Abraham reached out his hand, and he took the knife, 𝄓 to butcher his child.
And the messenger of Yahweh called to him from the heavens, and said, Abraham, Abraham. 𝄓 And he said, Here am I.
And he said, Do not reach out your hand to the lad and do not do to him anything whatever, 𝄓 because now I know that you fear God and you did not keep back your child, your unique one, from me.

And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and he saw, and behold a ram following, held fast in a thicket by its horns, 𝄓 and Abraham went and he took the ram, and brought him up for a burnt offering instead of his child.
And Abraham called the name of that place, Yahweh Sees. 𝄓 As is said today, On the hill of Yahweh, it will be seen.
And the messenger of Yahweh called to Abraham, 𝄓 a second time from the heavens,
And said, By myself I have sworn, an oracle of Yahweh. 𝄓 For because that you have done this thing, and you have not kept back your child, your unique one,

That blessing, I will bless you, and increasing, I will increase your seed, as the stars of the heavens, and as the sand that is by the bank of the sea, 𝄓 and your seed will possess, the gate of its enemies.
And in your seed will be blessed, all the nations of the earth, 𝄓 inasmuch as you heard with my voice.
And Abraham returned to his lads, and they arose and they went as one by Beer-Sheva, 𝄓 and Abraham settled in Beer-Sheva. P
And it was after these things, that it was announced to Abraham, saying, 𝄓 Behold Milcah has given birth, even she, children for Nahor, your brother,
Uz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, 𝄓 and Qemuel, the father of Aram.
And Kesed, and Chazo, and Pildash, and Yidlap, 𝄓 and Bethuel.
And Bethuel had Rebekah. 𝄓 These eight Milcah gave birth to for Nahor, brother of Abraham.
And his courtesan, (and her name was Reumah), 𝄓 and she gave birth, even she, to Teba and Gacham and Tachash and Makah. P
And the life of Sarah, was a hundred years and twenty years and seven years, 𝄓 the years of the life of Sarah.
And Sarah died in Qiryath-arba. (This is Hebron in the land of Canaan), 𝄓 and Abraham came, to wail for Sarah and to weep for her.
And Abraham arose, from facing his dead, 𝄓 and he spoke to the children of Heit [dismay], saying,
A guest and immigrant I am with you. 𝄓 Give me to hold fast a tomb with you, and I will entomb my dead away from my face.
And the children of Heit answered Abraham, saying to him,
Hear us, my lord. A principal of God you are among us. In the choice of our tombs, entomb your dead. 𝄓 None of us his tomb will restrain from you, from entombing your dead.
And Abraham arose and he prostrated himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heit.
And he spoke to them, saying, 𝄓 If it is with your group to entomb my dead away from my face, hear me and intervene for me to Ephron, child of Tsochar,
that he give me the cave of Makpelah, that is his that is toward the end of his field. 𝄓 For full silver he will give it to me to hold fast among you as a tomb.
And Ephron sat among the children of Heit, 𝄓 and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the ears of the children of Heit, of all that enter at the gate of his city, saying,
No, my lord, hear me. The field I have given to you and the cave that is in it. To you I have given it. 𝄓 In the sight of the children of my people, I have given it to you. Entomb your dead.
And Abraham prostrated himself, before the people of the land.
And he spoke to Ephron in the ears of the people of the land, saying, But if you are for it, hear me. 𝄓 I give silver for the field. Take from me and I will entomb my dead there.
And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
My lord, hear me. The land, four hundred shekels of silver. Between me and you, what is that? 𝄓 So let your dead be entombed.
And Abraham paid heed to Ephron and Abraham weighed for Ephron, the silver that he had designated in the ears of the children of Heit, 𝄓 four hundred shekels of silver, transferred to the vendor.

And upheld was the field of Ephron that is in Makpelah, that is before Mamre, 𝄓 the field and the cave that is in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about,
for Abraham, as purchased in the sight of the children of Heit, 𝄓 among all that enter at the gate of his city.
And after such, Abraham entombed Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of the Makpelah before Mamre. (This is Hebron, 𝄓 in the land of Canaan.)
And the field was upheld, and the cave that is in it for Abraham to hold fast as a tomb, 𝄓 from the children of Heit. S
And Abraham was old, when it comes to days, 𝄓 and Yahweh blessed Abraham in everything.
And Abraham said to his servant, the eldest of his house, the governor of all that was his, 𝄓 Set, if you will, your hand under my thigh.
And I will have you swear, in Yahweh the God of the heavens, and the God of the land, 𝄓 that you will not take a wife for my son, from the daughters of the Canaanite, among whom I have settled.
For to my land and to my kindred you will go, 𝄓 and take a wife for my son, for Yitschaq.
And the servant said to him, Perhaps the woman, would not consent to walk after me to this land, 𝄓 must I have your son return, to the land from which you came forth?
And Abraham said to him, 𝄓 Keep watch for yourself, lest you return my son there.

Yahweh, the God of the heavens, who took me from the house of my father and from the land of my kindred, and who spoke to me and who swore to me, saying, To your seed I will give this land, 𝄓 he will send his angel before you, and you will take a wife for my son from there.
And if the woman will not consent to walk after you, then you will be exempted from this oath. 𝄓 Certainly my son, do not bring back there.
And the servant put his hand, under the thigh of Abraham his master, 𝄓 and swore to him, concerning this matter.
And the servant took ten camels from the camels of his master and he went. (For all the good of his master was in his hand). 𝄓 And he arose and he went to the Aramaean rivers, to the city of Nahor.
And he made the camels kneel outside of the city by a well of the waters, 𝄓 at the time of evening, at the time to emerge to draw water.
And he said, Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, let it transpire, if you will, in my presence today, 𝄓 and do kindness with my master Abraham.
Behold I will take a stand over the spring of water, 𝄓 and the daughters of those of the city, will emerge to draw water.

And let it be the lass to whom I say, Stretch out please your pitcher that I may imbibe, and she says, Imbibe, and also I will let your camels drink. 𝄓 Let her be the one who is correct for your servant, for Yitschaq, and in her I will know that you have done kindness with my master.
And it happened before he finished speaking, and behold Rebekah emerged, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, wife of Nahor, brother of Abraham, 𝄓 and her pitcher over her backside.
And the lass was very good of appearance, a virgin, and no man had known her, 𝄓 and she came down toward the spring and filled her pitcher, and came up.
And the servant raced to encounter her, 𝄓 and he said, Let me gulp, please, a little of the water from your pitcher.
And she said, Imbibe my Lord, 𝄓 and she was swift and brought down her pitcher onto her hand and gave him to drink.
And when she finished letting him drink, 𝄓 she said, Also for your camels I will draw, till even they have finished imbibing.
And she was swift, and she upended her pitcher into the flume, and raced further to the well to draw, 𝄓 and she drew for all his camels.
And the man in a commotion for her, 𝄓 kept silent to know, Did Yahweh prosper his way or not.
And it happened that as the camels finished imbibing, that the man a took gold earring, a bekah its weight, 𝄓 and two circlets for her hands, ten shekels weight of gold.
And he said, Whose daughter are you? Tell me please. 𝄓 Is there in the house of your father a place for us to lodge?
And she said to him, I am the daughter of Bethuel, 𝄓 son of Milcah, to whom she gave birth for Nahor.
And she said to him, both straw, and also silage in abundance, we have, 𝄓 also a place to lodge.
And the man bowed his head, and prostrated himself to Yahweh.

And he said, Blessed is Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his kindness and his truth with my master. 𝄓 I, on the journey, Yahweh guided me to the house of the brother of my master.
And the lass raced, and she told the household of her mother, 𝄓 about these things.
And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban, 𝄓 and Laban raced to the man outside, to the spring.

And it happened when he saw the earring, and the circlets on the hands of his sister, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spoke the man to me, 𝄓 that he came to the man, and behold, he stood by the camels, by the spring.
And he said, Come in, blessed of Yahweh. Why stand outside? 𝄓 And I, I have before me the house, and a place for the camels.
And the man came towards the house, and untied the camels, 𝄓 and he gave straw and silage for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the feet of the persons that were with him.
And food was set before him, but he said, I will not eat until without fail I speak my words. 𝄓 And he said, Speak.

And in dressing of stone, to fill and to incise timber, 𝄓 to undertake in all lines of work.

The tent of engagement, and the ark for the testimony, and the ark-cover that is over it, 𝄓 and all the vessels of the tent,
And the table, and its vessels, and the lustrous lamp stand and all its vessels, 𝄓  and the altar of incense,
And the altar of the burnt offering, and all its vessels, 𝄓 and the laver and its base,
And the pleated garments, 𝄓 and the garments of the sanctuary, of Aaron the priest, and the garments of his children for the priesthood,

And Yahweh said to Moses, saying,
And you speak to the children of Israel, saying, But my Sabbaths you will keep, 𝄓 for a sign she is between me and you for your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh, who sanctifies you.
And you will keep the Sabbath, for holy she is to you. 𝄓 Whoever profanes her will be put to death, for all doing trade in her will be cut off, this group from near her peoples.
Six days trade will be done, and on the seventh day is the Sabbath of Sabbaths, holy to Yahweh. 𝄓 All doing trade on the day of the Sabbath will be put to death.

Between me and the children of Israel a sign she is forever, 𝄓 for six days Yahweh constructed the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he ceased, and regrouped. S

And the people saw that Moses was reticent to descend from the hill. 𝄓 And the people convened against Aaron, and they said to him, Arise. Make for us a God who will walk before us, for this Moses, the man, who brought us up from the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.

And all the people rent the golden earrings that were in their ears, 𝄓 and they came to Aaron.
And he took from their hand, and fashioned them with an engraver, and he made a calf, a molten image. 𝄓 And they said, These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.

And they rose up early on the morrow, and they offered up a burnt offering, and they made overture with peace offerings, 𝄓 and the people sat down to eat and imbibe, and arose to make sport. P
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, 𝄓 Go. Descend, for your people have impaired themselves, that you have brought up from the land of Egypt.

And Moses entreated before Yahweh, his God, 𝄓 and he said, Why, Yahweh, would you let your anger burn in your people that you brought forth from the land of Egypt in great power and with a courageous hand?

And Moses said to Aaron, What did this people do to you, 𝄓 that you brought upon them great sin?
And Aaron said, Do not let the anger of my lord burn. 𝄓 Yourself, you know the people, that they are into evil.
And they said to me, Make for us a God who will walk before us, 𝄓 for this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.
And I said to them, To whom is gold, let them rend it and give it to me. 𝄓 And I cast it in the fire and out came this calf.

And Moses said, Fill your hands today for Yahweh, but each in its child, and in its kin, 𝄓 that he may give upon you, today, a blessing.
And it happened afterwards that Moses said to the people, You, yourselves, have sinned a great sin, 𝄓 so now I will ascend to Yahweh. Maybe I will make a cover-price concerning your sin.

And Yahweh spoke to Moses, Go and ascend from this, you and the people whom you have brought up from the land of Egypt, 𝄓 to the land that I swore to Abraham, to Yitschaq, and to Jacob, saying, To your seed I will give it.

And Moses took the tent and stretched it out outside the camp, far from the camp, and called it the tent of engagement, 𝄓 and it happened that anyone seeking Yahweh came out to the tent of engagement that was outside the camp.

So Betsalel and Aholiab constructed, and every person wise of heart in whom Yahweh gave wisdom and acumen, to know how to do all the lines of work of the service of the sanctuary, 𝄓 for all that Yahweh commanded.

And every wise of heart among those doing the lines of work constructed the dwelling-place. 𝄓 Ten curtains of fine twined linen and amethyst and purple and crimson scarlet, cherubim to interleave with a damask, he constructed them.

And he partnered five of the curtains one to another. 𝄓 And five curtains he partnered one to another.

Fifty loops he made in the one curtain, and fifty loops he made in the selvage of the curtain that is the partner of the second. 𝄓 The loops received, one to another.
And he made fifty knobs of gold, 𝄓 and he partnered the curtains, one to another, with the knobs, and it became one dwelling. P
And he made curtains of she-goat hair for the tent over the dwelling-place, 𝄓 eleven curtains. He made them.

And he partnered five of the curtains alone, 𝄓 and six of the curtains alone.
And he made fifty loops on the lip of the curtain at the extremity in the partnering, 𝄓 and fifty loops, he made on the lip of the curtain partnering the second.
And he made fifty knobs of brass, 𝄓 to partner the tent to become one.
And he made the covering for the tent from the skin of rams dyed red, 𝄓 and the covering of skin dyed indigo to be above it. S
And he made the planks for the dwelling, 𝄓 lumber of acacia, standing.
Ten cubits the length of the plank, 𝄓 and a cubit and a half the cubit, the breadth of the one plank.

And he made planks for the dwelling, 𝄓 twenty planks for the south quarter, the right side.
And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty planks, 𝄓 two sockets under one plank for its two tenons and two sockets under each other plank for its two tenons.
And for the rib of the dwelling second for the north quarter, 𝄓 he made twenty planks.
And forty sockets of silver, 𝄓 two sockets under one plank and two sockets under each other plank.

And two planks he made for the inner corners of the dwelling, 𝄓 on the two flanks.

And they were eight planks, and their silver sockets, sixteen sockets, 𝄓 two sockets, two sockets under one plank.
And he made bars of acacia lumber, 𝄓 five for the planks of one rib of the dwelling,

And he made the central bar, 𝄓 running in the midst of the planks from the endmost part to the endmost part.
And the planks he overlaid with gold, and their rings he made, gold housings for the bars, 𝄓 and he overlaid the bars with gold.
And he made the veil of amethyst and purple and crimson scarlet and fine twined linen, 𝄓 to interleave with a damask, he made her cherubim.
And he made for her the four pillars of acacia, and overlaid them with gold, their hooks gold. 𝄓 And he infused for them four sockets of silver.
And he constructed a portiere for the door of the tent, amethyst, and purple, and crimson scarlet, and fine twined linen, 𝄓 to interleave with embroidery.
And its five pillars and their hooks. And he overlaid their tops and their attachments with gold. 𝄓 And their five sockets were brass. P
And Betsalel made the ark of acacia lumber, 𝄓 two cubits and a half, its length, and a cubit and a half, its breadth, and a cubit and a half, its height.
And he overlaid it with lustrous gold on the inside and on the outside. 𝄓 And he constructed for it a rim of gold surrounding.
And he infused for it four rings of gold to its four footings, 𝄓 with two rings on its first rib and two rings on its second rib.
And he made shafts of acacia lumber, 𝄓 and he overlaid them with gold.
And he made the shafts come into the rings on the ribs of the ark, 𝄓 that the ark may be borne.
And he made an ark-cover of lustrous gold, 𝄓 two cubits and a half in length and a cubit and a half broad.
And he constructed two cherubim of gold. 𝄓 From hammered work he constructed them from the two extremes of the ark-cover.
One cherub from this extremity and one cherub from this extremity, 𝄓 from the ark-cover he constructed the cherubim out of both its extremities.
So the cherubim will spread their wings to the ascendant, their wings overshadowing above the ark-cover and their faces each to its kin. 𝄓 To the ark-cover are the faces of the cherubim. P
And he constructed the table of acacia lumber, 𝄓 two cubits its length and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
And he overlaid it with lustrous gold, 𝄓 and he constructed for it a rim of gold surrounding.
And he constructed for it a fringe of a hand-breadth surrounding, 𝄓 and he constructed a rim of gold for the fringe surrounding.

And he called to Moses, 𝄓 and Yahweh spoke to him, from the tent of engagement, saying,

And if his oblation is from the flock, from the young lambs or from the she-goats for a burnt offering, 𝄓 he will bring near him a complete male.
And he will butcher it on the northward flank of the altar in the presence of Yahweh. 𝄓 And the children of Aaron, the priests, will dash its blood round about on the altar.

But its entrails and its limbs he will wash in water. 𝄓 And the priest will bring it all near and will make it burn with smoke toward the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering by fire, a restful fragrance for Yahweh. P
And if a burnt offering from the fowl is an oblation for Yahweh, 𝄓 then he will bring near his oblation from the turtledoves or from the squab of the dove.

And he will put aside its crop with its plumage, 𝄓 and cast it next to the altar eastward to the place of the fat.

And he will rive it by its wings. He will not differentiate. And the priest will make it burn with smoke toward the altar on the wood that is on the fire. 𝄓 It is a burnt offering, an offering by fire, a restful fragrance for Yahweh. S
And the self that will bring near an oblation, a gift for Yahweh, his oblation will be fine flour, 𝄓 and he will infuse on it oil and daub on it frankincense.

And he will bring it to the children of Aaron, the priests, and he will extract from it a generous extraction of its fine flour and its oil with all its frankincense, 𝄓 and the priest will make its memorial burn with smoke toward the altar, an offering by fire, a restful fragrance for Yahweh.
And the remains from the gift is for Aaron and for his children, 𝄓 holy of holy things from the fire of Yahweh. S
And if you approach with an oblation, a gift baked in an oven, 𝄓 fine flour cakes, unleavened, mingled with oil and wafers of unleavened bread, anointed with oil. S
And if your oblation is a gift on the pan, 𝄓 fine flour mingled with oil, unleavened bread, this will be.

And if your oblation is a gift stirred, 𝄓 fine flour with oil you will make.

And the priest will contribute from the gift its memorial and will make it burn with smoke toward the altar, 𝄓 an offering by fire, a restful fragrance for Yahweh.
And the remains from the gift is for Aaron and for his children, 𝄓 holy of holy things from the fire of Yahweh.

And every oblation of your gifts with salt you will salt, and you will not cease to salt the covenant of your God from your gifts. 𝄓 Over all your oblations, you will come near with salt. S
