And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, a holy convocation it will be for you. All the lines of work for service you will not do, 𝄓 and you will make a festival, the feast to Yahweh, seven days.

And you will bring near a burnt offering, an offering by fire, a restful fragrance for Yahweh, thirteen young bulls of the herd, twelve rams, 𝄓 fourteen young yearling he-lambs. Complete they will be.
And their gift will be fine flour mingled with oil, 𝄓 three tenths for the first young bull, to the thirteenth of the young bulls, two tenths for the first ram to the second of the rams,
And a tenth, a tenth for the first young lamb, 𝄓 to the fourteenth of the young lambs,
And one kid of the she-goats, the sin offering, 𝄓 besides the continual burnt offering, its gift and its libation. S
And on the second day, twelve young bulls of the herd, twelve rams, 𝄓 fourteen young yearling he-lambs, complete,
And their gifts, and their libations, for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the young lambs in their count, according to the framework,
And one kid of the she-goats, the sin offering, 𝄓 besides the continual burnt offering and its gift and their libations. S
And on the third day, eleven young bulls, twelve rams, 𝄓 fourteen young yearling he-lambs, complete,
And their gifts, and their libations, for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the young lambs in their count, according to the framework,
And one kid of the sin offering, 𝄓 besides the continual burnt offering and its gift and its libation. S
And on the fourth day, ten young bulls, twelve rams, 𝄓 fourteen young yearling he-lambs, complete,
Their gifts and their libations, for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the young lambs in their count, according to the framework.
And one kid of the she-goats, the sin offering, 𝄓 besides the continual burnt offering, its gift and its libation. S
And on the fifth day nine young bulls, twelve rams, 𝄓 fourteen young yearling he-lambs, complete.
And their gifts, and their libations, for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the young lambs in their count, according to the framework.
And one kid of the sin offering, 𝄓 besides the continual burnt offering and its gift and its libation. S
And on the sixth day, eight young bulls, twelve rams, 𝄓 fourteen young yearling he-lambs, complete,
And their gifts, and their libations, for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the young lambs in their count, according to the framework.
And one kid of the sin offering, 𝄓 besides the continual burnt offering, its gift and its libations. S
And on the seventh day, seven young bulls, twelve rams, 𝄓 fourteen young yearling he-lambs, complete,
And their gifts and their libations, for the young bulls, for the rams, and for the young lambs, in their count according to their judgment.
And one kid of the sin offering, 𝄓 besides the continual burnt offering, its gift and its libation. S
On the eighth day, a conclave there will be for you. 𝄓 All the lines of work for service you will not do.
And you will bring near a burnt offering, an offering by fire, a restful fragrance for Yahweh, one young bull, one ram, 𝄓 seven young yearling he-lambs, complete,
Their gifts and their libations for the young bull, for the ram, and for the young lambs in their count, according to the framework.
And one kid of the sin offering, 𝄓 besides the continual burnt offering and its gift and its libation.

These you will do for Yahweh in your appointed times, 𝄓 besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your gifts, and for your libations, and for your peace offerings.
And Moses talked to the children of Israel, 𝄓 according to everything that Yahweh commanded Moses. P
And Moses spoke to the preeminent of branches of the children of Israel, saying, 𝄓 This is the thing which Yahweh commanded.
A man who vows a vow to Yahweh or swears an oath to bind with a bond over his very self, he will not profane his word. 𝄓 According to everything that came forth from his mouth, he will do.
And a woman who vows a vow to Yahweh, 𝄓 and binds herself with a bond in the house of her father in her youth.

And her father hears her vow and her bond that she has bound over her very self, and her father keeps silent for her, 𝄓 then all her vows will be upheld and every bond that she has bound over her very self will be upheld.

But if her father hinders her in the day he hears all her vows, then her bonds that she has bound over her very self will not be upheld, 𝄓 and Yahweh will forgive her, because her father hindered her.
And if it be she is to have a man, and her vows are over her, 𝄓 or the rash speaking of her lips that she has bound over her very self,
And her man hears in the day he hears and keeps silent for her, 𝄓 then her vows will be upheld, and her bond that she has bound over her very self will be upheld.

But if in the day her man has heard, he hinders her, then he has annulled her vow which is over her, and the rash speaking of her lips that she has bound over her very self, 𝄓 and Yahweh will forgive her.
And the vow of a widow or divorcee, 𝄓 all that she has bound over her very self will be upheld over her.
But if in the house of her man she vowed, 𝄓 or bound a bond over her very self with an oath,
And her man hears and keeps silence for her, not hindering her, 𝄓 then all her vows will be upheld and every bond that she has bound over her very self will be upheld.

But if her man has annulled them in the day he hears, all that emerged from her lips of her vows or of the bond of her very self will not be upheld. 𝄓 Her man has annulled them and Yahweh will forgive her.
Every vow or every oath binding to afflict a being, 𝄓 her man may uphold or her man may annul.

But if in silence he will be silent for her, her man from day to day, then he upholds all her vows or any bond which is over her. 𝄓 He upholds them because he kept silence for her in the day he heard.
And if he would annul them after he hears, 𝄓 then he will bear her iniquity.
These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses between a man for his woman, 𝄓 between a father for his daughter in her youth, in the house of her father. P
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Vengeance. Avenge the children of Israel from the Midianites. 𝄓 Afterwards you will be gathered to your people.
And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Ready-arm from yourselves persons for the host, 𝄓 and let them be against Midian, to give the vengeance of Yahweh in Midian.
A thousand of a branch, a thousand of a branch, 𝄓 for all the branches of Israel, you will send out for a host.
And a thousand per branch were put aside from the thousands of Israel, 𝄓 twelve thousand, a ready-armed host.

And Moses sent them, a thousand per branch, to the host, 𝄓 them and Phineas, child of Eleazar the priest, to the host, and the vessels of the sanctuary, and trumpets, the blast of triumph in his hand.
And the host went against Midian as Yahweh commanded Moses, 𝄓 and they slew every male.
And the kings of Midian they slew over their profaned, Evi, and Reqem, and Tsur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian. 𝄓 And Balaam, child of Beor, they slew by the sword.
And the children of Israel took the women of Midian captive and their little ones, 𝄓 and looted all their cattle and all their livestock and all their wealth.
And all their cities in their settlements, and all their domiciles, 𝄓 they incinerated in the fire.
And they took all the spoil and all the takings, 𝄓 among the human and among the cattle.

And they came to Moses and to Eleazar the priest, and to the assembly of the children of Israel, with the captives and the takings and the spoil to the camp, 𝄓 at the steppes of Moab that is by the Jordan, Jericho. S
And Moses and Eleazar the priest came out, and all the principals of the assembly, to encounter them, 𝄓 outside the camp.
And Moses was enraged at the officers over the force, 𝄓 the chiefs of the thousands and the chiefs of the hundreds, those coming from the host of the warriors.
And Moses said to them, 𝄓 have you kept alive all that is female?
Lo, behold, they were for the children of Israel by the word of Balaam the turning aside to trespass against Yahweh over the word of Peor. 𝄓 And there was the plague in the assembly of Yahweh.
So now slay every male little one. 𝄓 And every woman that has known a man by lying with a male, slay.
But every little one among the women who has not known lying down with a male, 𝄓 keep alive for yourselves.

And you encamp outside the camp seven days, 𝄓 all who slew a being, and all who touched the profaned. Offer a sin offering for yourselves on the third day, and on the seventh day, for you and your captives.
And any garment, and any vessel of skin, and all made of she-goats, and any vessels of wood, 𝄓 offer a sin offering. S
And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the host who went to battle, 𝄓 This is a statute of the instruction which Yahweh commanded Moses.
But the gold and the silver, 𝄓 the brass, the iron, all that is smelted, and the lead,

Every thing that is brought in the fire, you will make pass through in the fire, and it will be clean, but in the waters of segregation it will be offered for sin. 𝄓 And all that is not brought in the fire, you will make pass through in the water.
And you will scour your garments on the seventh day, and you will be clean. 𝄓 And after you will come to the camp. S
And Yahweh said to Moses, saying,
Calculate the sum of what was taken captive among the human and among the cattle, 𝄓 you, and Eleazar the priest, and the head parents of the assembly.
And distribute the takings between those occupied with the battle who came forth for the host, 𝄓 and all the assembly.
And contribute a tally for Yahweh from the warriors who came forth for the host, one being from five hundred from the humans, 𝄓 and from the oxen, and from the asses, and from the sheep.
From their half take, 𝄓 and give it to Eleazar the priest, a contribution for Yahweh.

And from the half of the children of Israel, take one holding from the fifty, from the human, from the herd, from the asses, and from the sheep, from all beasts, 𝄓 and you will give them for the Levites, those keeping the watch of the dwelling-place of Yahweh.
And Moses and Eleazar the priest did, 𝄓 as Yahweh commanded Moses.
And the surplus takings were, (the loot that the people of the host looted), 𝄓 sheep, six hundred and seventy five thousand,
And oxen, seventy two thousand,
And asses, sixty one thousand,
And a group of humanity from the women, who not had known lying down with a male, 𝄓 all the group, thirty two thousand.
And there was the half of the share of those who came forth in the host, 𝄓 the count of the sheep, three hundred and thirty seven thousand five hundred.
And the tally for Yahweh from the sheep was, 𝄓 six hundred and seventy five.
And the oxen thirty six thousand, 𝄓 and their tally for Yahweh seventy two.
And the asses, thirty thousand five hundred, 𝄓 and their tally for Yahweh, sixty one.
And a group of humanity, sixteen thousand, 𝄓 and their tally for Yahweh, a group of thirty two.
And Moses gave a tally, a contribution for Yahweh to Eleazar the priest, 𝄓 as Yahweh commanded Moses.
And from the half of the children of Israel, 𝄓 that Moses distributed from the men of the hosts,
And there was from the half of the assembly, 𝄓 from the sheep, three hundred and thirty seven thousand five hundred,
And oxen, thirty six thousand,
And from the asses, thirty thousand five hundred,
And a group of humanity, sixteen thousand.

And Moses took from the half of the children of Israel, one holding from the fifty, from the human, and from the beast, 𝄓 and gave them for the Levites, those keeping the watch of the dwelling-place of Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
And the officers that were of the thousands of the host approached Moses, 𝄓 the chiefs of the thousands and the chiefs of the hundreds.
And they said to Moses, Your servants have borne the sum of the men of the battle that were in our hands, 𝄓 and not a man was visited from us.
And we have brought near the oblation of Yahweh, each who found articles, gold, armlet and circlet, ring and hoop and brooch, 𝄓 a cover-price for our group in the presence of Yahweh.
And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, 𝄓 all constructed instruments.
And all the gold of the contribution that they contributed for Yahweh was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels, 𝄓 from the chiefs of the thousands, and from the chiefs of the hundreds.
(The men of the host had looted, each for himself.)

And Moses and Eleazar the priest took gold from the chiefs of the thousands and of the hundreds, 𝄓 and they brought it into the tent of engagement, a memorial to the children of Israel in the presence of Yahweh. P

And abundant livestock there was for the children of Reuben and for the children of Gad, very numerous. 𝄓 And they saw the land of Yazer and the land of Gilead, and behold, the place was a place for livestock.
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came, 𝄓 and they said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the principals of the assembly, saying,
Ataroth, and Dibon, and Yazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and El-Alah, 𝄓 and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
The land which Yahweh struck in the presence of the assembly of Israel, it is a land for livestock. 𝄓 And your servants have livestock. S
And they said, If we have found grace in your eyes, let this land be given for your servants to hold fast. 𝄓 Do not have us cross the Jordan.
And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, 𝄓 Will your kin go to war while you will sit here?
And why would you hinder the heart of the children of Israel, 𝄓 from crossing to the land that Yahweh has given to them?
Thus did your ancestors, 𝄓 when I send them from Qadesh Barnea to see the land.
And they went up to the wadi of Eshkol, and they saw the land, and they hindered the heart of the children of Israel, 𝄓 that they should not come into the land that Yahweh had given them.
And the anger of Yahweh burned in that day. 𝄓 And he swore, saying,
The persons who came up from Egypt from twenty years and upward will not see the ground that I swore to Abraham to Yitschaq and to Jacob, 𝄓 for they have not fully followed me.
Except Caleb, child of Jepunah the Qenizite, and Joshua, child of Nun, 𝄓 for they have fully followed me, Yahweh.
And the anger of Yahweh burned in Israel, and he made them vagabonds in the wilderness forty years, 𝄓 until completed was all the generation that did evil in the eyes of Yahweh.
And behold, you have arisen instead of your ancestors, an increase of sinful persons, 𝄓 to add further to the burning of the anger of Yahweh to Israel.
For you turn from following him, and he will yet again leave them in the wilderness, 𝄓 and you will destroy all this people. S
And they made overture to him, and they said, Fences for sheep we will build for our livestock here, 𝄓 and cities for our little ones.

And we, ready-armed, will hurry before the children of Israel, until without fail we have brought them to their place, 𝄓 and our little ones will settle in the enclosed cities, before the inhabitants of the land.
We will not return to our houses, 𝄓 until each of the children of Israel has inherited its inheritance.
For we will not inherit with them across the Jordan and yonder, 𝄓 for our inheritance has come for us across the Jordan toward the sunrise. P
And Moses to them said, If you will do this thing, 𝄓 if you will be ready-armed before Yahweh to war,
And will all pass through the Jordan for yourselves, ready-armed, before Yahweh, 𝄓 until he has dispossessed his enemies before his face,
And the land is controlled in the presence of Yahweh, and after you will return, then you will be innocent from Yahweh and from Israel, 𝄓 and this land will be for you to hold fast before Yahweh.
But if you will not do so, behold you will have sinned against Yahweh. 𝄓 Now set down this, your sins will find out you.
Build for yourselves cities for your little ones, and fences for your flock, 𝄓 and do what goes out from your mouth.
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said to Moses, saying, 𝄓 Your servants will do as my lord has commanded.
Our little ones, our wives, our acquisitions, and all our cattle, 𝄓 will be there in the cities of the Gilead.
And your servants will cross, all ready-armed as a host before Yahweh to war, 𝄓 as my lord has spoken.
And for them, Moses commanded Eleazar the priest and Joshua child of Nun, 𝄓 and the heads of the parents of the branches of the children of Israel.

And Moses said to them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will cross with you the Jordan, all ready-armed for war before Yahweh, and the land is controlled in your presence, 𝄓 then you will give to them the land of the Gilead to hold fast.
And if they will not cross ready-armed with you, 𝄓 then they will have holdings among you in the land of Canaan.
And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, 𝄓 As Yahweh has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
We ourselves will cross ready-armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, 𝄓 but our holdings, we will inherit from beyond the Jordan.

And Moses gave to them, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half band of Manasseh, child of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, 𝄓 the land of its border cities, the cities of the surrounding land.
And the children of Gad built Dibon [Bears?] and Ataroth [Crowns], 𝄓 and Aroer.
And Crown, Shaphan [Hyrax], and Help, and Yogbehah [Lofty],
And the house of Nimrah, and the house of Haran, 𝄓 enclosed cities, and fences for sheep.
And the children of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh, 𝄓 and Qiryatym,
And Nebo and Baal Meon, (name turned round), and Sibmah, 𝄓 and they called (by names), the names of the cities where they built.
And the children of Makir, child of Manasseh went to Gilead and conquered it, 𝄓 and dispossessed the Amorite that was in it.
And Moses gave the Gilead to Makir child of Manasseh, 𝄓 and he settled in it.
And Jair, child of Manasseh, went and he conquered their municipalities, 𝄓 and he called them, the municipality of Jair.
And Woof went and he conquered Qenah and its built-up areas, 𝄓 and he called it Woof in his name. P
These are the migration orders of the children of Israel who emerged from the land of Egypt with their hosts, 𝄓 by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
And Moses wrote their exeunts for their migrations at the mandate of Yahweh. 𝄓 And these are their migrations of their exeunts.

And they pulled out from Raamses in the first new moon on the fifteenth day of the first month. 𝄓 After the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a hand lifted high in the sight of all Egypt.
And Egyptians entombed those whom Yahweh struck among them, all the firstborn. 𝄓 And among their gods, Yahweh has made judgments.
And the children of Israel pulled out from Raamses, 𝄓 and they encamped in Sukkoth.
And they pulled out from Sukkoth, 𝄓 and they camped in Etham that is toward the end of the wilderness.
And they pulled out from Etham, and turned at the Mouth of the Holes that is over before Baal Tsephon, 𝄓 and they encamped before Migdol.

And they pulled out from before the Holes, and they crossed over in the midst of the sea towards the wilderness. 𝄓 And they went a journey of three days into the wilderness of Etham, and they encamped at Marah.
And they pulled out from Marah, and they came to Elim. 𝄓 And at Elim were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
And they pulled out from Elim, 𝄓 and they encamped at the sea of reeds.
And they pulled out from the sea of reeds, 𝄓 and they encamped in the wilderness Sin.
And they pulled out from the wilderness of Sin, 𝄓 and they encamped in Dophqah.
And they pulled out from Dophqah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Alush.
And they pulled out from Alush, 𝄓 and they encamped in Rephidim and there was no water for the people to imbibe.
And they pulled out from Rephidim, 𝄓 and they encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
And they pulled out from the wilderness of Sinai, 𝄓 and they encamped in Qbirot Ha-Tavah [the Tombs of Desire].
And they pulled out from Qbirot Ha-Tavah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Hazerot.
And they pulled out from Hazerot, 𝄓 and they encamped in Ritmah.
And they pulled out from Ritmah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Rimmon Perez.
And they pulled out from Rimmon Perez, 𝄓 and they encamped in Libnah.
And they pulled out from Libnah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Rissah.
And they pulled out from Rissah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Qehelatat.
And they pulled out from Qehelatat, 𝄓 and they encamped on mount Shapher.
And they pulled out from mount Shaphir, 𝄓 and they encamped in Xeradah.
And they pulled out from Xeradah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Maqhelot.
And they pulled out from Maqhelot, 𝄓 and they encamped in Taxat.
And they pulled out from Taxat, 𝄓 and they encamped in Tarach.
And they pulled out from Tarach, 𝄓 and they encamped in Mitqah.
And they pulled out from Mitqah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Xashmonah.
And they pulled out from Xashmonah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Moseroth.
And they pulled out from Moseroth, 𝄓 and they encamped among the children of Yaaqan.
And they pulled out from the children of Yaaqan, 𝄓 and they encamped the freeborn of Gidgad.
And they pulled out from the freeborn of Gidgad, 𝄓 and they encamped in Yatvatah.
And they pulled out from Yatvatah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Ebronah.
And they pulled out from Ebronah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Etsiongeber.
And they pulled out from Etsiongeber, 𝄓 and they encamped in the wilderness of Zin. (This is Qadesh).
And they pulled out from Qadesh, 𝄓 and they encamped in mount Hor at the outskirts of the land of Edom.

And Aaron the priest ascended to mount Hor at the mandate of Yahweh, and died there, 𝄓 in the fortieth year of the coming out of the children of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month on the first of the month.
And Aaron was a child of a hundred and twenty three years, 𝄓 at his death in mount Hor. S
And the Canaanite king Arad heard (and he inhabited in the south in the land of Canaan), 𝄓 of the coming of the children of Israel.
And they pulled out from mount Hor, 𝄓 and they encamped in Tsalmonah.
And they pulled out from Tsalmonah, 𝄓 and they encamped in Punon.
And they pulled out from Punon, 𝄓 and they encamped in Oboth.
And they pulled out from Oboth, 𝄓 and they encamped in the shambles of those going by into the border of Moab.
And they pulled out from Iyim, 𝄓 and they encamped in Dibon Gad.
And they pulled out from Dibon Gad, 𝄓 and they encamped in Almon Diblataim.
And they pulled out from Almon Diblataim, 𝄓 and they encamped on the hills of those going by before Nebo.
And they pulled out from the hills of those going by, 𝄓 and they encamped in the steppes of Moab at the Jordan by Jericho.
And they encamped at the Jordan from Beth-Ha-Yeshimot to Abel-Shittim, 𝄓 in the steppes of Moab. S
And Yahweh spoke to Moses in the steppes of Moab, 𝄓 at the Jordan by Jericho, saying,
Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, 𝄓 When you have crossed over Jordan toward the land of Canaan,
Then you will dispossess all inhabitants of the land before you, and eliminate all show-pieces. 𝄓 And all images of molten metal you will eliminate, and all their high places you will exterminate.
And you will possess the land and you will inhabit in it, 𝄓 for to you I have given the land to possess it.

And you will inherit the land by lot for your families. To many you will increase their inheritance, and to few you will decrease their inheritance. Where the lot goes out for them, for them it will be. 𝄓 For the branches of your ancestors, you will inherit.

And if you will not dispossess the inhabitants of the land before you, then it will be that whoever you will let remain from them will be entwined in your eyes, and barbs in your sides, 𝄓 and they will trouble you on the land that you will settle in.
And it will happen that as I was supposed to do to them, I will do to you. P
And Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
Command the children of Israel and say to them, For you are coming to the land of Canaan. 𝄓 This is the land that will fall to you to be an inheritance, the land of Canaan to its borders.
And your south quarter will be from the wilderness of Zin adjacent to Edom, 𝄓 and your south border will be from the shore of the salt sea eastward.

And your border will circle from the south to the ascendance of the scorpions, and pass through toward Zin and its going forth will be from the south to Qadesh-Barnea, 𝄓 and will go out to the Court of Excellence and pass through toward Bones.
And the border will circle from Bones toward the torrent of Egypt, 𝄓 and its going forth will be toward the sea.
And the border seaward, and it will be for you the great sea, 𝄓 and this border will be your western border.
And this will be your northern border, 𝄓 from the great sea, you will draw your line to Mount Hor.
From Mount Hor you will draw a line to the entrance to Hamath, 𝄓 and the goings forth of the border will be toward Tsadad.
And the border will go out towards Ziphron and its going forth will be Chatsor-Enan. 𝄓 This will be your northern border.
And you will draw your line to the border eastward, 𝄓 from the Court of Springs [Chatsor-Enan] towards Shepham.
And the border will descend from Shepham to Riblah from the east to Ein, 𝄓 and the border will descend and will brush past by the shoulder of the sea of Kinneret eastward.
And the border will descend the Jordan, and its going forth will be the salt sea. 𝄓 This will be for you the land to its borders surrounding.
And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, 𝄓 This is the land that you will inherit by lot, which commanded Yahweh to give to the nine branches and the half branch.

For they have received, the branch of the children of the Reubenites for the house of their ancestors, and the branch of the children of the Gadites for the house of their ancestors, 𝄓 and the half branch of Manasseh, they have received their inheritance.
Two branches and a half branch, 𝄓 they have received their inheritance from beyond Jordan by Jericho eastward toward the sunrise. P
And spoke Yahweh to Moses, saying,
These are the names of the persons that will inherit for you the land, 𝄓 Eleazar the priest and Joshua child of Nun.
And one principal, one principal per branch, 𝄓 you will take to inherit the land.
And these are the names of the persons, 𝄓 of the branch of Judah, Caleb child of Jepunah.
And of the branch of the children of Simeon, Samuel child of Ammihud.
Of the branch of Benjamin, Elidad child of Kaselun.
And of the branch of the children of Dan, principal, 𝄓 Buqi child of Yogli.
For the children of Joseph of the branch of the children of Manasseh, principal, 𝄓 Xanniel child of Ephod.
And of the branch of the children of Ephraim, principal, 𝄓 Qemuel child of Shiphtan.
And of the branch of the children of Zebulun, principal, 𝄓 Elitsaphan child of Parnak.
And of the branch of the children of Issachar, principal, 𝄓 Paltiel child of Azzan.
And of the branch of the children of Asher, principal, 𝄓 Axihud child of Shlomy.

For Yahweh your God is a compassionate God. He does not desist for you, and he will not destroy you. 𝄓 And he will not forget the covenant of your ancestors, that he swore to them.

But ask if you will of the days of former times which are before you, from the day that God created humanity over the earth, from the outskirts of the heavens and to the other extremity of the heavens, 𝄓 whether there has been as great a thing as this, or has been heard like it.
Did a people hear the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire as you have heard, you, and lived?

Or has a god ventured to come to, to receive for himself a nation, from within a nation, by temptations, from signs, and in portents, and in war, and with a courageous hand and by an arm stretched out, and by great fears, 𝄓 according to everything that Yahweh your God has undertaken for you in Egypt in your sight.
You have seen to know that Yahweh, he is the God. 𝄓 There is nothing else, he alone.
From the heavens he made you to hear his voice, to mentor you, 𝄓 and on the earth he showed you his great fire. And his words you have heard from the midst of the fire.
And under that he loved your ancestors, and he chose among his seed after him, 𝄓 and he is bringing you forth in his presence by his great power from Egypt,
To dispossess nations greater and more numerous than you from your presence, 𝄓 to bring you in to give to you their land as inheritance as on this day.
So know today and turn to your heart that Yahweh he is the God. In the heavens above, and on the earth from beneath, 𝄓 there is none else.

And you will keep his statutes and his commandments that I am commanding you today, that it may be good for you, and for your children after you, 𝄓 and so that you prolong your days on the ground which Yahweh your God has given to you, all the days. P
Then Moses will differentiate three cities, across the Jordan, 𝄓 toward the rising of the sun,

Bezar in the wilderness in the land, the level place, for the Reubenite, 𝄓 and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadite, and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

Across the Jordan in the gorge in the forefront of Beth-Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, that inhabited in Heshbon, 𝄓 which Moses struck and the children of Israel, at their going out from Egypt.

From Aroer that is over the bank of the wadi of Arnon and to the hill of Sion. (This is Hermon.)
And all the steppe across the Jordan toward the sunrise, and to the sea of the steppe, 𝄓 under the slopes of Pisgah. P
And Moses called to all Israel and he said to them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the judgments, that I speak in your ears today, 𝄓 that you may learn them, and keep watch to do them.
Yahweh our God cut with us a covenant in Horeb.
Not with our ancestors, did Yahweh cut this covenant, 𝄓 but with us. We are the ones, here, today, all we, the living.

You will not worship them and you will not serve them, 𝄓 for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous god, visiting the iniquity of forebears on children over three and over four generations to those who hate me.

You will not lift up the name of Yahweh your God to vanity, 𝄓 for Yahweh will not hold innocent, who lifts up his name to vanity. S

Six days you will serve and do all your affairs,

And remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out from there, with a courageous hand and by an arm stretched out. 𝄓 Therefore Yahweh your God, is commanding you to undertake the day of the Sabbath. S

Glorify your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God is commanding you, 𝄓 so that prolonged are your days, and so that it may be good for you, over the ground that Yahweh your God is giving to you. S
You will not murder. S
And you will not commit adultery. S
And you will not steal. S

And you will not covet the wife of your associate. S 𝄓 And you will not desire the house of your associate, his field or his manservant or his maidservant, his bull or his ass, or anything that is your associate's. S

These words Yahweh spoke to all your congregation on the hill from the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and the dark turbulence. A great voice and he did not add more. 𝄓 And he wrote them on both tablets of stone, and he gave them to me.
And it happened when you heard the voice from the midst of darkness, and the hill was kindled in the fire, 𝄓 that you came near to me, all the heads of your bands and your elders,

And you said, Lo, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and his voice we have heard from the midst of the fire. 𝄓 This day we have seen, that God will speak with the human and live.

For who of all flesh that has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
You approach and hear, all that Yahweh our God says, 𝄓 and speak to us all that Yahweh our God speaks to you and we will hear and we will do.

And Yahweh heard the voice of your words, when you spoke to me. 𝄓 And Yahweh said to me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people that they have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.
Who will yield that this their heart may be for them, to fear me and to keep all my commandments every day, 𝄓 so that it may be good for them and their children forever.
Go, say to them, 𝄓 Return yourselves to your tents.

But you here stand with me and I will speak with you all the commandment and the statutes and the judgments that you will teach them, 𝄓 and they will do in the land, that I am giving to them to possess.
And you will keep watch to do, as Yahweh your God commanded you. 𝄓 You will not turn aside right or left.
In all the way which Yahweh your God commanded you, you will walk, 𝄓 so that you will live and it will be good for you, and you will prolong days, in the land that you will possess.
And this is the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments which Yahweh your God commanded for teaching you, 𝄓 to do in the land, that you will cross over toward to possess it.

So that you will fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments which I am commanding you, you and your child, and the child of your child, all the days of your life, 𝄓 and so that your days are prolonged.

And you will hear, Israel, and you will keep watch to do, that it may be good for you and that you may increase much, 𝄓 as Yahweh the God of your ancestors spoke to you, a land gushing with milk and honey. P
Hear Israel, 𝄓 Yahweh is our God, Yahweh is one.
And you will love, Yahweh your God, 𝄓 with all your heart and with all your being and with all your capacity.
And these words which I am commanding you today will be on your heart.
And you will sharpen them for your children, and speak in them, 𝄓 when you sit in your house, and when you walk in the way, and when you lie down, and when you arise.
And you will fasten them for a sign on your hand, 𝄓 and they will be frontlets between your eyes.
And you will write them on the posts of your house and your gates. S

And it will be that when Yahweh your God will conduct you to the land that he swore to your ancestors, to Abraham, to Yitschaq, and to Jacob to give to you: 𝄓 Cities great and good that you did not build,
And houses full of all good, that you did not fill, and pits hewn that you did not hew, vineyards and olive trees that you did not plant, 𝄓 and you will eat and you will be satisfied.
Keep watch for yourself, lest you forget Yahweh, 𝄓 who brought you forth from the land of Egypt, from the house of servitude.
Yahweh your God, fear, and him serve, 𝄓 and in his name, make your oath.
You will not walk, after other gods, 𝄓 from the gods of the peoples, that surround you.
(for a jealous God, Yahweh your God, is within you), 𝄓 lest the anger of Yahweh your God burn in you, and exterminate you, from off the surface of the ground. S
You will not tempt, Yahweh your God, 𝄓 as you tempted in the temptation.
To keep you will keep, the commandments of Yahweh your God, 𝄓 and his testimonies and his statutes that he is commanding you.
And you will do what is upright and what is good in the eyes of Yahweh, 𝄓 so that it may be good for you. And you will come and you will possess the good land that Yahweh swore to your ancestors,
to evict all your enemies from before you, 𝄓 as Yahweh spoke. S
When your child will ask you afterwards, saying, 𝄓 What are the testimonies and the statutes and the judgments, that Yahweh our God commanded you.
Then you will say to your child, Servants we were to Pharaoh in Egypt, 𝄓 and Yahweh brought us out from Egypt with a courageous hand.
And Yahweh gave signs and portents, great ones and evil ones, in Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his house in our sight.
And us he brought out from there, 𝄓 so as to conduct us, to give to us, the land which he swore to our ancestors.
And Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, 𝄓 for our good every day, to make us alive as at this day.
And righteousness it will be for us, 𝄓 that we keep and do all this commandment in the presence of Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us. S

When Yahweh your God, will conduct you to the land that you are going toward to possess it, 𝄓 and has cleared out many nations from your presence, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven abundant nations, and more numerous than you.
When Yahweh your God will give them up before you, you will strike them, 𝄓 to utter destruction. Utter destruction. You are not to cut for them a covenant, and you will not be gracious to them.
And you will not intermarry with them. 𝄓 Your daughter you will not give to their son, and their daughter you will not take for your son.
For they will turn aside your son from following me, and they will serve other gods, 𝄓 and the anger of Yahweh will burn among you, and exterminate you swiftly.

In contrast, thus you will do for them: their altars you will break down, and their monuments you will shatter, 𝄓 and their fetishes you will chop down, and their graven images you will incinerate in the fire.
For a holy people are you, of Yahweh your God. 𝄓 Yahweh your God has chosen you to be for himself a people, a treasure trove, from all the peoples that are on the face of the ground.
Not because you were more than all the peoples, did Yahweh attach himself among you, or chose to be among you, 𝄓 for you are fewer than all the peoples,

But from love Yahweh is with you. And to keep the oath that he swore to your ancestors, Yahweh brought you out with a courageous hand, 𝄓 and ransomed you from the house of servitude, from the hand of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
So know that Yahweh your God, himself is the God, 𝄓 the One, the Faithful, keeping the covenant and the kindness for those who love him and who keep his commandments, to a thousand generations.
And repays one who hates him to his face, to eliminate him. 𝄓 He will not delay to one who hates him to his face. He will repay him.
And you will keep the commandment, and the statutes, and the judgments, that I am commanding you today to do them. P

And it will be, inasmuch as you will hear these judgments, and you will keep watch, and you will do them, 𝄓 that Yahweh your God will keep for you the covenant, and the kindness, that he swore to your ancestors.

And he will love you, and will bless you, and increase you, 𝄓 and bless the fruit of your belly, and the fruit of your ground, your grain, and your new wine, and your clarified oil, or the issue of your drove, or the breeding of your flock, over the ground that he swore to your ancestors to give to you.
Blessed you will be from all the peoples. 𝄓 There will not be among you male barren or female barren, or among your beasts.
And Yahweh will turn aside from you all illness, 𝄓 and all the infirmities of Egypt, evil that you know. He will not put them among you, but will permit them among all those hating you.
And you will devour all the peoples that Yahweh your God is giving to you. Your eye will not spare them. 𝄓 And you will not serve their God, for a trap it will be for you. S
But you say in your heart, Many more are these nations than I. 𝄓 How can I dispossess them.
You will not fear them. 𝄓 Remember, remember what Yahweh your God did for Pharaoh and for all Egypt:

Great temptation that your eyes have seen, and the signs, and the miracles, and the resolute hand, and the arm stretched out, by which Yahweh your God brought you forth. 𝄓 So Yahweh your God will do to all the peoples, before whom you fear.
And moreover, the hornet Yahweh your God will send among them, 𝄓 until the residue are perishing and hide themselves from your presence.
Do not panic before them, 𝄓 for Yahweh your God among you, is a God great and fearful.
And Yahweh your God will clear out these nations from before you, a few by a few, 𝄓 You will not be able to consume them impetuously, lest the animals of the field increase over you.
Yahweh your God will yield them before you, 𝄓 and discomfit them with great discomfort, until they are exterminated.
He will give their kings into your hand, and you will make their name perish, from under the heavens. 𝄓 No-one will be stationed before you, until you have exterminated them.

The graven images of their God you will incinerate in the fire. 𝄓 You will not covet their silver and gold, nor take for yourself, lest you be trapped in it, for an abomination to Yahweh your God, it is.
And you will not bring an abomination to your house, or you will become an utter destruction like it. 𝄓 Detested, you will detest it, and abhorred, you will abhor it, for utter destruction it is. P
All the commandment that I am commanding you today you will keep watch to do, 𝄓 so that you will live and increase and go in and possess the land, which Yahweh swore to your ancestors.
And remember all the way which Yahweh your God led you this forty year span in the wilderness, 𝄓 so that he afflicted you to prove you to know what is in your heart to keep his commandments or not.

And he afflicted you and he let you hunger and he fed you manna that you did not know, and your ancestors did not know, 𝄓 so that he might have you know that not on the bread alone does the human live, that on all that emerges from the mouth of Yahweh the human lives.
Your habit did not wear out on you, and your foot did not blister, 𝄓 this forty year span.
And you will know with your heart, 𝄓 that as each of you chastens his child, Yahweh your God chastens you.
And you will keep, the commandments of Yahweh your God, 𝄓 to walk in his ways and to fear him.
For Yahweh your God, is bringing you into a good land, 𝄓 a land of torrents of water springs, and abysses emerging, in the crevasse and on the hill.
A land of wheat and barley, and vine and fig tree and pomegranate, 𝄓 a land of olive oil and honey.
A land where without meagerness you will eat bread. You will not lack for anything there. 𝄓 A land whose stones are iron, and from whose hills you will mine copper.
And you will eat and you will be satisfied, 𝄓 and you will bless Yahweh your God, over the good land that he gives to you.
Keep watch for yourself lest you forget, Yahweh your God, 𝄓 so as not to keep his commandments and his judgments and his statutes, which I am commanding you today.
Lest you eat and you are satisfied, 𝄓 and you build good houses and are settled.
And your herd and your flock increase, and silver and gold increase for you, 𝄓 and all that is yours increases.
And exalted is your heart, 𝄓 and you forget Yahweh your God, who brought you forth from the land of Egypt from the house of servitude.
Who led you in the great and fearful wilderness of incinerate-snake and scorpion, and thirst where there is no water, 𝄓 who brought forth for you, water from the rock of flint.
Who fed you manna in the wilderness, that your ancestors did not know, 𝄓 so that he afflicted you and so that he would prove you, to do you good in your later time.
And you say in your heart, 𝄓 My power and the sheer numbers of my hands, have made for me this wealth.
But remember Yahweh your God, for he is the one who gives to you power to make wealth, 𝄓 so that he may uphold his covenant which he swore to your ancestors as on this day. P
And it will happen that if forgetting you forget Yahweh your God, and you walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, 𝄓 I testify among you today, that perishing you will perish.
As the nations which Yahweh made perish before your face, so you will perish, 𝄓 inasmuch as you did not hear, with the voice of Yahweh your God. P
Hear O Israel, you cross over the Jordan today, to come to possess nations greater and more numerous than you, 𝄓 cities great and fortified into the heavens.
A people great and tall, the children of the Anaqim, 𝄓 that you yourself know, and you, you have heard, Who can be stationed in the face of the children of Anaq?

So know today that Yahweh your God himself crosses over before you, a devouring fire, he will exterminate them, and he will subdue them before you, 𝄓 and you will dispossess them, and eliminate them swiftly, as Yahweh spoke to you.

Do not say in your heart, when Yahweh your God has evicted them from your presence, saying, In my righteousness Yahweh brought me to possess this land. 𝄓 For in the wickedness of these nations, Yahweh dispossessed them from your presence.

Not in your righteousness, or in the uprightness of your heart, are you going to possess their land, 𝄓 but in the wickedness of these nations, Yahweh your God is dispossessing them from before you, and so that he may place the matter that Yahweh swore to your ancestors, to Abraham to Yitschaq and to Jacob.
And you will know that not in your righteousness, Yahweh your God is giving to you this good land to possess, 𝄓 for a people of intransigent scruff are you.
Remember. Do not forget what enraged Yahweh your God in the wilderness, 𝄓 from the day that you came forth from the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you were provocative with Yahweh.
And in Horeb you enraged Yahweh, 𝄓 and Yahweh was angry among you to exterminate you.

When I had gone up towards the hill to receive the stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant which Yahweh cut with you, 𝄓 and I sat on the hill a forty day and forty night span. Bread I did not eat, nor water did I imbibe.

And Yahweh gave to me the two stone tablets, written by the finger of God, 𝄓 and on them according to all the things that Yahweh spoke with you on the hill, from the midst of the fire, in the day of the congregation.
And it happened at the end of a forty day, and forty night span, 𝄓 Yahweh gave to me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

And said Yahweh to me, Arise, go down swiftly from this, for your people have impaired themselves that you brought forth from Egypt. 𝄓 They have turned aside swiftly from the way that you commanded. They made for themselves a molten image.
And said Yahweh to me, saying, 𝄓 I have seen this people, and behold, it is a people of intransigent scruff.
Desist from me, and I will exterminate them, and erase their name under the heavens, 𝄓 and I will make you as numerous a nation, and more abundant than they.
And I faced about and I descended from the hill, and the hill was kindled in the fire, 𝄓 and the two tablets of the covenant, were in my two hands.

And I fell in the presence of Yahweh, as at first, a forty day and forty night span. Bread I did not eat nor water did I imbibe, 𝄓 over all your sins that you sinned, to do evil in the eyes of Yahweh, to grieve him.
For I was afraid from the presence of the anger and the heat, with which Yahweh raged against you to exterminate you, 𝄓 but Yahweh heard me, also in that pulse.
And with Aaron, Yahweh was very angry, to exterminate him, 𝄓 and I prayed also about Aaron at that time.

And your sin that you had constructed, the calf, I took and incinerated it in the fire, and I beat it finely ground, until stamped out in the dust, 𝄓 and I cast its dust, into the wadi that descended from the hill.
In Taberah and at Massah, and at Qbirot-ha-tavah, 𝄓 you were enraging Yahweh.

And when Yahweh sent you from Qadesh-Barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have made for you, 𝄓 you were provocative with the mandate of Yahweh your God, and you did not believe him, and you did not hear with his voice.
Provocative you were with Yahweh, 𝄓 from the day I knew you.

And I prayed to Yahweh, and I said, My Lord, Yahweh, do not destroy your people and your inheritance which you have ransomed in your greatness, 𝄓 that you brought forth from Egypt with a courageous hand.

Lest they say, the land that you brought us out from, that Yahweh was not able to bring them to the land that he spoke to them, 𝄓 but he hated them. He brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness.
But they are your people and your inheritance, 𝄓 that you brought forth in your great power, and with your arm stretched out. P
At that time said Yahweh to me, Sculpt your two tablets of stone like the first and come up to me towards the hill, 𝄓 and construct your ark of lumber.

For Yahweh your God, he is the God of gods, and the Lord of lords, 𝄓 the great God, valiant and to be feared, that will not bear preference and will not receive bribes.
Doing judgment for orphan and widow, 𝄓 and loving a guest, to permit for him bread and shawl.
And you love the guest, 𝄓 for guests you were in the land of Egypt.
Yahweh your God, fear. Him you will serve. 𝄓 And in him you will cleave, and in his name, make your oath.
He is your praise, and he your God, 𝄓 who has undertaken with you the great and the fearful, these that your eyes saw.
Of seventy, a group, your ancestors went down toward Egypt, 𝄓 and now Yahweh your God, has set you as the stars of the heavens for multitude.
And you will love, Yahweh your God, 𝄓 and you will keep his watch and his statutes and his judgments and his commandments every day.

So as not to exalt his heart over his kin, and so as not to turn aside from the commandment on the right hand or on the left, 𝄓 so that he will prolong days over his kingdom, he and his children within Israel. S
There will not be for the priests, the Levites, all the band of Levi, a share or inheritance with Israel. 𝄓 The offerings by fire of Yahweh, and his inheritance, they will eat.
So there will not be inheritance for him among his kin. 𝄓 Yahweh, he is his inheritance, as he spoke to him. S
And this will be judgment for the priests from the people, from the offerings of the sacrifice, whether bull or lamb, 𝄓 and they will give for the priest, the arm and the two cheeks and the viscera.
The first of your grain, your new wine, and your clarified oil, and the first of the fleece of your flock, you will give him.
For in him Yahweh your God has chosen from all your bands, 𝄓 to stand to minister in the name of Yahweh, he and his children, every day. S
And when the Levite comes from one of your gates from all Israel, where they reside, 𝄓 and he comes in every intense desire of his very self, to the place where Yahweh will choose,
He will minister in the name of Yahweh his God, 𝄓 as all his kin, the Levites, those standing there before Yahweh.
Share as share they will eat, 𝄓 besides what is from the revenue concerning the fathers. S
When you have come into the land, that Yahweh your God is giving to you, 𝄓 you will not learn to do, according to the abominations of those nations.
Not will be found among you, those who make his son or his daughter pass in the fire, 𝄓 soothsaying of soothsayers, fortunetellers, or augury, or sorcery,
Or a charmer of charms, 𝄓 or an inquirer of necromancy, or those who know or search out to the dead.
For an abomination to Yahweh are all doing these things. 𝄓 For in rolling with these abominations, Yahweh your God, is dispossessing them from your presence.
Complete you will be, with Yahweh your God.
For these nations whom you will possess, to fortunetellers and to soothsayers heeded, 𝄓 but you, not so did Yahweh your God permit you.
A prophet from within you, from your kin, like me, Yahweh your God will raise up for you. 𝄓 To him you will pay heed.

Everything that you have asked from Yahweh your God at Horeb, in the day of the congregation, saying, 𝄓 Not again let me hear the voice of Yahweh my God, nor let me see this great fire any longer, and I will not die.
And said Yahweh to me, 𝄓 They have done well in what they have spoken.
A prophet I will raise up for them from within their kin like you, 𝄓 and I will give my word in his mouth, and he will speak to them, all that I command him.
And it will be that the person that will not hear my word, that he speaks in my name, 𝄓 I myself will search out in him.
But the prophet that presumes to speak a word in my name that I have not commanded it to speak, or that speaks, in the name of other gods, 𝄓 that prophet will die.
And if you say in your heart, 𝄓 How do we know the word, that Yahweh has not spoken?

The prophet that speaks in the name of Yahweh, and the matter does not happen or does not come, this is the word that Yahweh has not spoken. 𝄓 With presumption the prophet has spoken it. You will not be in awe of him. S
When Yahweh your God has cut off the nations, whose land Yahweh your God ,is giving to you, 𝄓 and you dispossess them, and you have settled in their cities and in their houses,
Three cities you will differentiate for yourself, 𝄓 in the midst of your land, that Yahweh your God, is giving to you to possess.
You will establish for yourselves the way, and you will trisect the border of your land that Yahweh your God has made you inherit, 𝄓 that anyone who has murdered may withdraw there.
And this is the matter of the murderer, who will withdraw there that he might live, 𝄓 who strikes his associate without knowledge, and he had not hated him previously.

(That someone enters with an associate into the forest to dress the trees, and his hand is impelled with the adze to cut the tree, and the iron bounces from the tree and finds the associate, who then dies. 𝄓 He will withdraw to one of these cities and will live.)

Lest the one redeeming the blood pursues after the murderer, for his heart is heated, and overtakes him, because of the extent of the way, and he strikes him, 𝄓 but for him there was no judgment of death, for he had not hated him previously.
Therefore I am commanding you, saying, 𝄓 Three cities you will differentiate for yourself.
And if Yahweh your God will enlarge your borders, as he has sworn to your ancestors, 𝄓 and give to you all the land that is the word given to your ancestors,

(For you will keep all this commandment to do it which I am commanding you today: to love Yahweh your God and to walk in his ways every day, 𝄓 and you will add for yourselves three more cities beside these three),
Then innocent blood will not be poured out, within your land, that Yahweh your God, is giving to you as inheritance, 𝄓 and there be against you, blood. P
But when there is a person hating his associate, and lying in wait for him, and he arises against him, and he strikes him, and he dies, 𝄓 and he withdraws to one of those cities,
Then the elders of his city will send, and they will take him from there, 𝄓 and they will give him into the hand of the one redeeming the blood, and he will die.
Your eye will not spare him, 𝄓 and you will shrive the blood of the innocent from Israel, and good for you. S

You will not relocate the border of your associate, that they of former times set as border, 𝄓 in your inheritance that you will inherit, in the land that Yahweh your God, is giving to you to possess. S
One witness will not arise against a person for any iniquity, or for any sin in any sin that he sins. 𝄓 At the mouth of two witnesses or at the mouth of three witnesses, a word will arise.
When a violent witness arises against a person, 𝄓 to answer against him with revolt.
Then will stand, both the persons whose strife it is, in the presence of Yahweh, 𝄓 in the presence of the priests and the judges, which there will be in those days.
And the judges will search out well, 𝄓 and behold, a false witness. If the witness has answered what is false against his kin,
Then you will do to him, as he intended to do to his kin, 𝄓 and you will shrive the evil from within you.
And the residue will hear and see, 𝄓 and not again do any more as evil a thing as this among you.
Your eye will not spare, 𝄓 throat by throat, eye by eye, tooth by tooth, hand by hand, foot by foot. S

When you go out to war against your enemies, and you see horses and chariot of a people more abundant than you, you will not fear them, 𝄓 for Yahweh, your God is with you, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
And it will be when you approach the warriors, 𝄓 the priest will come close, and speak to the people.
And say to them, Hear, O Israel. You approach today to war against your enemies. 𝄓 Let not your heart be flustered. Do not fear and do not be in haste and do not be in a panic before them.
For Yahweh your God, goes with you, 𝄓 to fight for you with your enemies, to save you.

And the overseers will speak to the people, saying, Who is the man who has built a new house and not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, 𝄓 lest he die in the battle, and someone following dedicate it.
And who is the person who has planted a vineyard and not started to use it? Let him go and return to his house, 𝄓 lest he die in the battle, and someone following start to use it.
And who is the person who has betrothed a wife and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, 𝄓 lest he die in the battle, and someone following take her.

And again the overseers will speak to the people and they will say, Who is man who fears or is tender of heart? Let him go and return to his house, 𝄓 and not make the heart of his kin melt like his own heart.
And it will be, when the overseers have finished speaking to the people, 𝄓 they will conscript chiefs of the hosts at the head of the people. S
When you approach to a city, to fight against her, 𝄓 proclaim to her in peace.
And it will be, if peace she answers you, and opens to you, 𝄓 then it will be that all the people, whatever is found in her, will be for you in forced service, and they will serve you.
And if she will not make peace with you, but will make war with you, 𝄓 then you will lay siege against her.
And Yahweh your God will give her into your hand, 𝄓 and you will strike every male with the edge of the sword.
But the women and the little ones and the cattle, and all that is in the city, all its spoil, you will loot for you, 𝄓 and you will eat the spoil of your enemies, that Yahweh your God gave to you.
So you will do to all the cities, at an excessive distance from you, 𝄓 that are not from the cities of these nations.
But from the cities of these peoples, that Yahweh your God, is giving to you as inheritance, 𝄓 you will not let any breath-bearing live.
But you will utterly destroy the Hittite and the Amorite, the Canaanite and the Perizzite, the Hivites and the Jebusites, 𝄓 as Yahweh your God is commanding you.
In order that they may not teach you to do, according to all their abominations, that they do to their gods, 𝄓 and you sin against Yahweh your God. S

When you besiege a city many days, making war against her to occupy her, you will not destroy her trees, to impel against them an adze, for from them you eat, so them you will not cut, 𝄓 for the human is the tree of the field, to bring from before you into the siege.
But a tree that you know that is not a tree for food, it you may destroy and cut, 𝄓 and you will build fortification against the city that makes war with you until it is brought down. P
If there is found one who is profaned in the ground that Yahweh your God is giving to you to possess, having fallen in the field, 𝄓 (it is not known who struck him),
Then your elders and your judges will go forth, 𝄓 and they measure to the cities, that surround the profaned.
And it will be the city, nearest to the profaned. 𝄓 And the elders of that city will take a calf of the herd, that has not been in service, that has not been drawn in a shackle,
And the elders of that city will take the calf down to a perennial wadi, which has not been in service and has not been sown, 𝄓 and will break the nape there of the calf in the wadi.

And the priests, the children of Levi, will come close, (for them Yahweh your God has chosen to minister to him and to bless in the name of Yahweh). 𝄓 And by their mandate all contention and all contagion will happen.
And all the elders of that city, nearest to the profaned, 𝄓 will wash their hands, over the calf beheaded in the wadi.
And they will answer. 𝄓 And they will say, Our hands have not shed this blood, and our eyes have not seen.
Cover your people, Israel, which you have ransomed, Yahweh. And do not assign innocent blood within your people, Israel. 𝄓 And the blood will be a cover-price for them.
So you, you will shrive the innocent blood from within you, 𝄓 for you will do what is upright in the eyes of Yahweh. S
When you go out to war against your enemies, 𝄓 and Yahweh your God gives it into your hand, and you carry it away captive,
And you see among the captives, a woman, beautiful, handsome, 𝄓 and you are attached to her and would take for yourself as wife,
Then you will bring her into the centre of your house, 𝄓 and she will shave her head, and she will do her nails.

And she will put aside the habit of her captivity from over her, and she will inhabit in your house, and weep for her father and her mother a moon's days, 𝄓 and after, you will come to her and be her husband, and she will be for you as wife.

But it will happen if you do not delight in her that you will set her loose in her own integrity, and you will not sell her for silver. 𝄓 You will not make merchandise of her, in that you have afflicted her. S
If there is for a man two wives, the one loved and the other hated, and they have given children birth for him, the loved and the hated, 𝄓 and the firstborn son is of the hated,
Then it will be in the day when he makes his children inherit, what is his, 𝄓 he is not able to make firstborn the child of the loved, before the child of the hated, the firstborn.

But the firstborn child of the hated, he will recognize, by giving him a twofold proportion in all that he finds is his, 𝄓 for he is the beginning of his virility. For him is the judgment of the birthright. S

If there is for anyone a rebellious and provocative child. It is not in it to hear, with the voice of its father or with the voice of its mother, 𝄓 and they have chastened it, and it will not hear them,
Then its father and its mother will take it up, 𝄓 and bring it forth to the elders of its city and at the gate of its place,
And they will say to the elders of its city, this our child is rebellious and provocative. It is not in it to hear with our voice. 𝄓 A glutton and besotted.
And all persons of its city will pelt it with stones and it will die, and you will shrive the evil from within you. 𝄓 And all Israel will hear and fear. S
And when there is against a person, a sin of judgment of death, and it is put to death, 𝄓 and you hang it on a tree,

Its corpse will not bide on the tree, but you will entomb it in that day, for one who is hung is slighted of God, 𝄓 and you will not defile your ground, that Yahweh your God, is giving to you as inheritance. S
You will not see the bull of your brother, or his lamb enticed away. You will not obscure yourself from them. 𝄓 You will return them to your kin.

And if your brother is not near to you, or you do not know him, 𝄓 then you will gather it into the centre of your house, that it may be with you until your brother searches it out. And you will return it to him.
And so you will do for his ass. And so you will do for his habit. And so you will do for anything lost by your brother that is lost from him, and you have found. 𝄓 You can not obscure yourself. S
You will not see the ass of your brother, or his bull, fallen in the way, and obscure yourself from them. 𝄓 You will raise them up with him. S
There will not be an article of a valiant man on a woman, and a valiant man will not be clothed with the habit of a woman, 𝄓 for an abomination to Yahweh your God are all doing these things. P

When a bird's nest is encountered before you in the way, in any tree, or over the earth, the brood or eggs, and the mother laying on the brood, or on the eggs, 𝄓 you will not take the mother over the little ones.
You will set loose the mother, and the little ones you will take for yourself, 𝄓 so that it may be good for you, and you may have length of days. S
When you build a new house, then you will make a parapet for your roof, 𝄓 that you will not put blood in your house, if someone should fall from it.
You will not sow your vineyard doubly confined, 𝄓 lest the fullness of the seed that you sowed be holy, and the income of the vineyard. S
You will not plough with bull and ass together.
You will not clothe yourself with linen and wool, wool and flax together. S
Great things you will make for yourself, 𝄓 on the four hems of your cover with which you cover yourself. S
If a man takes a woman, 𝄓 and comes in to her and hates her,
And he sets her up with wantonness of words, and he brings forth against her an evil name, 𝄓 and says, I took this woman, and I came near to her, and I did not find her a virgin,
Than the father of the lass and her mother will take, 𝄓 and will bring forth the virginity of the lass to the elders of city toward the gate.
And the father of the lass will say to the elders, 𝄓 My daughter I gave to this man as wife, and he hates her.

And behold he set a wantonness of words, saying, I have not found your daughter a virgin, but these are the proof of virginity of my daughter. 𝄓 And they will spread a shawl, before the elders of city.
And the elders of city will take that man, 𝄓 and will chasten him.

And they will fine him a hundred of silver, that they will give to the father of the lass, for he brought out an evil name over a virgin of Israel. 𝄓 And his she will be as wife. He is not able to send her away all his days. S
But if true was, this matter, 𝄓 proof of virginity was not found for the lass,

Then they will bring forth the lass to the door of the house of her father, and persons of her city will engulf her with stones, and she will die, for she has done senselessness in Israel, to play the harlot in the house of her father. 𝄓 And you will shrive the evil from within you. S

If a person is found who lies down with a wife, married to a husband, then they will die, even the two of them, the man that lay down with the woman, and the woman. 𝄓 And you will shrive the evil from Israel. S
When there is a virgin lass, betrothed to a man, 𝄓 and a man finds her in the city and lies down with her,

Then you will bring out the two of them to the gate of the city, and you will engulf them, even them, with stones, and they will die, the lass over the matter that she did not cry out in the city, and the man over the matter that he has afflicted the wife of his associate. 𝄓 And you will shrive the evil from within you. S
But if in the field, the man finds the betrothed lass, and the man resolutely holds her and lies down with her, 𝄓 then the man alone will die who lay down with her.
But to the lass you will do nothing. There is no sin of death for the lass. 𝄓 For as when anyone arises against his associate and murders integrity, so is this matter.
For in the field he found her. 𝄓 The betrothed lass cried out, and there was no safety for her. S
If a man finds a virgin lass who is not betrothed, and he arrests her, and lies down with her, 𝄓 and they are found.
The man that lay down with her will give the father of the lass fifty of silver, 𝄓 and to him she will be wife in that he has afflicted her. He is not able to send her away all his days. S
A man will not take the wife of his father, 𝄓 and he will not uncover the hem of his father. S
One with a wound inflicted of castration or penis cut off will not enter the congregation of Yahweh. S
A stranger will not enter the congregation of Yahweh. 𝄓 Even tenth generation will not enter for it, the congregation of Yahweh. S
Ammonite or Moabite will not enter the congregation of Yahweh. 𝄓 Even tenth generation will not enter for them, the congregation of Yahweh, for evermore.

Over the matter that they did not precede you with bread and water, in the journey when you came out from Egypt, 𝄓 and that he hired against you Balaam, child of Beor, an interpreter of the Aramaeans of two rivers, to slight you.
But Yahweh your God did not consent to hear Balaam, and Yahweh your God changed for you the denial to blessing. 𝄓 For Yahweh your God loves you.
You will not search out their peace or their good, 𝄓 all your days forever. S
You will not abhor an Edomite, for it is your kin. 𝄓 You will not abhor an Egyptian, for a guest you were in its land.
Children who are born to them, third generation, 𝄓 will enter for them, the congregation of Yahweh. S
When an army has gone forth against your enemies, 𝄓 then you will keep, from every word of evil.
When there is among you a man, who is not clean from an event by night, 𝄓 then he will go forth outside the camp. He will not come into the midst of the camp.
And it will be, in the face of evening, he will wash in water, 𝄓 and when the sun has set, he will come into the midst of the camp.
And protection there will be for you, outside the camp, 𝄓 where you will go forth outside.
And a peg you will have with your spade. 𝄓 And it will be when you sit outside, you will dig deep with it, and will turn back and cover what comes out from you.

For Yahweh your God walks within your camp to deliver you, that he may give your enemies before you, so your camp will be holy, 𝄓 and he will not see among you something exposed, and turn from following you. S
You will not imprison a servant to its master, 𝄓 who was emancipated to you from its master.
With you it will settle. Among you in the place where it will choose in one of your gates, as is its good. 𝄓 You will not suppress it. S
No holy prostitute will be from the daughters of Israel, 𝄓 and no holy prostitute will be from the sons of Israel.
You will not bring the fee of harlotry or the price of a dog into the house of Yahweh your God, for any vow. 𝄓 For an abomination to Yahweh your God they are, even the both of them. S
You will not take interest for your kin, interest of silver, interest of food, 𝄓 interest of every thing that earns interest.

For a foreigner, you may take interest. 𝄓 But to your kin you will not take interest, so that Yahweh your God, will bless you in all that you put your hand to do, over the land that you are going toward to possess it. S
When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, do not delay to pay it, 𝄓 for Yahweh your God will search it out from you, and it will be in you as sin.
But when you refrain from a vow, 𝄓 it will not be in you as sin.
What emerges from your lips you will keep and you will do, 𝄓 as if you vowed to Yahweh your God a freewill offering, that you spoke with your mouth. S
When you come into a vineyard of your associate, then you may eat grapes for your self for your satisfaction, 𝄓 but into your vessel, you will not permit any. S
When you come into the risen corn of your associate, then you may pluck off snippets into your hand, 𝄓 but a machete you will not brandish, against the risen corn of your associate. S

If a man takes a woman and marries her, 𝄓 and it happens that she finds no grace in his eyes, for he has found in her something exposed, then let him write her a record of being cut off, to give into her hand, and let him send her from his house.
And she will go out from his house. 𝄓 And she may go and become another man's.
And the other man hates her, and he writes her a record of being cut off to give into her hand, and he sends her from his house, 𝄓 or if the other man dies who has taken her as his wife,

The first husband who sent her away can not return to take her to become his wife after she is unclean, for an abomination it is, in the presence of Yahweh. 𝄓 And you will not make the land sin, that Yahweh your God, is giving to you as inheritance. S

If a man takes a new wife, he will not go out in the host, and he will not pass through against himself for any matter. 𝄓 Exempt he will be for his house, one year, and let him make his wife glad whom he has taken.
You will not take in pledge both millstones or what they ride on, 𝄓 for that takes a group as pledge. S
If a person is found stealing anyone from its kin, from the children of Israel, and making it merchandise, and selling it, 𝄓 then this thief will die, and you will shrive the evil from within you. S
Keep watch in the contagion of leprosy, to keep especially and do, 𝄓 everything the priests, the Levites instruct you. As I commanded them, you will keep to do.
Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, 𝄓 in the journey, when you came out from Egypt. S
If you give your associate credit with usury for anything whatever, 𝄓 you will not come into his house to fetch his collateral.
Outside you will stand. 𝄓 And the person with whom you yourself contracted debt, will bring forth to you the collateral outside.
And if that person is poor, 𝄓 you will not lie down with the collateral.

You will return and restore to him the collateral at the going down of the sun, that he may lie down in his own habit, and bless you. 𝄓 And for you it will be righteousness, in the presence of Yahweh your God. S
You will not oppress a poor and needy wage-earner, 𝄓 from your kin or from your guest who is in your land, in your gates.
By day you will give his wages, and the sun will not set upon it, for he is poor, and on it he himself lifts up his very self. 𝄓 and let him not call against you to Yahweh, and it be in you, sin. S
You will not put to death fathers for children, nor will children be put to death for fathers. 𝄓 Each in his sin will die. S
You will not bend judgment for a guest, or orphan, 𝄓 and you will not take as pledge, the garment of a widow.
And remember that a servant you were in Egypt, and Yahweh your God ransomed you from there, 𝄓 therefore I am commanding you to do, this word. S

When you reap your harvest in your field, and you forget a bale in the field, you will not return back to take it. For the guest, for the orphan, and for the widow it will be. 𝄓 So that Yahweh your God, will bless you in all the deeds of your hands. S
When you beat out your olive tree, you will not comb again after you. 𝄓 For the guest, for the orphan, and for the widow it will be.
When you gather grapes from your vineyard, you will not glean grapes after you. 𝄓 For the guest, for the orphan, and for the widow it will be.
And remember, that a servant you were in the land of Egypt, 𝄓 therefore I am commanding you to do, this word. S
When there is contention between persons, and they make overture for judgment, then they will judge them. 𝄓 And they will justify the righteous one, and will condemn the wicked one.
And it will be if the wicked is straw to be struck, 𝄓 then the judge will have him fall, and he will have him struck in his presence, according to what is enough for his wickedness by the count.
To forty strikes he will not add, 𝄓 lest adding to his striking over these many, he strike and disgrace your kin in your sight.
You will not muzzle a bull when threshing. S

When brothers inhabit together and one of them dies and there is no child for him, the wife of the dead will not be for a stranger outside. 𝄓 Her husband's brother will enter over her, and will take her for his wife, and he will combine with her.
And it will be that the firstborn she gives birth to will arise from the name of his brother, the one who died, 𝄓 that his name is not wiped out from Israel.

And if the man is not delighted, to receive his sister-in-law, 𝄓 then let his sister-in-law go up toward the gate to the elders and let her say, My husband's brother is unwilling to raise up for his brother a name in Israel. He did not consent to combine.
And the elders of his city will call him and will speak to him. 𝄓 And let him stand and say, I have no delight to take her.

Then his sister-in-law will come close to him in the sight of the elders, and rescue his sandal from his foot, and spit in his presence, 𝄓 and will answer and say, Thus it will be done for each, who does not build the house of his brother.
And his name will be called in Israel, 𝄓 the house of the one whose sandal was rescued. S

When men struggle together, each with its kin, and the wife of the one approaches to deliver her man from the hand of the one who strikes him, 𝄓 and extends her hand and is resolute with his shameful parts,
Then you will sunder her palm. 𝄓 Your eye will not spare. S
There will not be for you in your cup stone and stone, 𝄓 a greater and a lesser.
There will not be for you in your house ephah and ephah, 𝄓 a greater and a lesser.

A stone for full payment and just, there will be for you. An ephah for full payment and just, there will be for you. 𝄓 So that prolonged may be your days, on the ground, that Yahweh your God is giving to you.
For an abomination to Yahweh your God are all doing these things, 𝄓 all who do injustice. P
Remember what Amalek had done to you, 𝄓 in the journey, when you came out from Egypt.
That he encountered you on the journey, and he wagged the tail among you, all who were ailing behind you, and you were exhausted and weary. 𝄓 And he did not fear God.

And it will be when Yahweh your God has given you rest from all your surrounding enemies, in the land that Yahweh your God is giving to you as inheritance to possess, you will erase the memorial of Amalek from under the heavens. 𝄓 You will not forget. P
And it will be that when you come to the land, that Yahweh your God, is giving to you as inheritance, 𝄓 and you possess it and you inhabit it.

Then you will take from the first of every fruit of the ground that you bring from your land that Yahweh your God is giving to you, and you will put it in a basket, 𝄓 and you will go to the place, where Yahweh your God will choose, for his name to dwell there.
And you will come to the priest, that will be in those days, 𝄓 and say to him, I announce today to Yahweh your God, that I come to the land that Yahweh has sworn to our ancestors to give to us.
And the priest will take the basket from your hand, 𝄓 and leave it, before the altar of Yahweh your God.
