And Joshua made for himself rock daggers, 𝄓 and he circumcised the children of Israel at the hillock of foreskins.
And this is the thing that made Joshua circumcise. 𝄓 All the people who came forth from Egypt, the males, all the warriors, died in the wilderness, in the way, in their going out from Egypt.
For circumcised were all the people who came forth, 𝄓 And all the people, those born in the wilderness, in the way, at their coming forth from Egypt they had not circumcised.

For a forty year span the children of Israel meandered in the wilderness, until all the nation was completed, the warriors who came forth from Egypt, who did not hear with the voice of Yahweh, 𝄓 to whom Yahweh had sworn that he would not show them the land which Yahweh swore to their ancestors to give to us, a land gushing with milk and honey.
And their children, he placed instead of them. Them Joshua circumcised, 𝄓 for fore-skinned they were, for they did not circumcise them in the way.
And it happened that as they completed the circumcision for all the nation, 𝄓 that they settled their nether parts in the camp, until they became alive. P
And Yahweh said to Joshua, Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. 𝄓 And he called the name of that place, Gilgal, to this day.
And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, 𝄓 and they undertook the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month, in the evening, in the steppes of Jericho.
And they ate the mature corn of the land after the Passover, unleavened bread and parched grain, 𝄓 in this selfsame day.

And the manna ceased afterwards, when they had eaten from the mature corn of the land, and there was no longer manna for the children of Israel, 𝄓 and they ate from the income of the land of Canaan in that year. S

And it happened when Joshua was in Jericho, and he lifted up his eyes, and he stared, and behold, a man standing before him, and his sword drawn in his hand. 𝄓 And Joshua went to him and he said to him, Are you for us and not for our adversaries?
And he said, No. For I am the chief of the host of Yahweh. Now I have come. 𝄓 And Joshua fell to his face earthward and prostrated himself, and said to him, What does my Lord speak to his servant?
And the chief of the host of Yahweh said to Joshua, Take off your sandal from your foot, for the place that you are standing on, holy it is. 𝄓 And Joshua did so.
Jericho was quarantined and latched in the presence of the children of Israel. 𝄓 There was no one coming out, and there was no one going in. S
And Yahweh said to Joshua, See. I have given into your hand Jericho and its king, 𝄓 the valiant of force.
And you will circle around the city, all the warriors, to encompass the city one time. 𝄓 Thus you will do six days.
And seven priests will lift up seven shophars, ram's horns, before the ark, and on the seventh day, you will circle around the city seven times, 𝄓 and the priests will sound on the shophars.

And it will be that when the ram's horn is drawn out in intense brightness, when you hear the voice of the shophar, all the people will raise a shout of great jubilation, 𝄓 and the wall of the city will fall flat and the people will go up, each in front of him.
And Joshua, child of Nun, called to the priests and he said to them, Bear the ark of the covenant. 𝄓 And seven priests will lift up seven shophars, ram's horns, before the ark of Yahweh.
And he said to the people, Pass through and circle around the city. 𝄓 And let the ready-armed pass through before the ark of Yahweh.

And it was when Joshua had talked to the people, that the seven priests bearing seven shophars, the ram's horns, before Yahweh passed through, and sounded on the shophars. 𝄓 And the ark of the covenant of Yahweh went following them.
And the ready-armed went before the priests, sounding the shophars, 𝄓 and the additional walked after the ark, walking and sounding on the shophars.

And Joshua commanded the people, saying, You will not raise a shout, nor let your voice be heard, nor let a word emerge from your mouth, 𝄓 until the day I say to you, Raise a shout. Then you will raise a shout.
And the ark of Yahweh circled around the city encompassing one time. 𝄓 And they entered the camp and lodged in the camp. P
And Joshua rose up early in the morning, 𝄓 and the priests lifted up the ark of Yahweh.

And the seven priests bearing seven shophars, the ram's horns, before the ark of Yahweh, went on walking and sounded on the shophars, 𝄓 and the ready-armed walked before them, and the additional walked after the ark of Yahweh, walking and sounding on the shophars.
And they circled around the city on the second day, one time, and returned to the camp. 𝄓 Thus they did six days.

And it was on the seventh day. And they rose up early as the dawn ascended, and they circled around the city according to this framework seven times. 𝄓 Solely on that day they circled around the city seven times.
And it was on the seventh time, the priests sounded on the shophars. 𝄓 And Joshua said to the people, Raise a shout, for Yahweh has given to you the city.
And the city will be devoted, it and all that is in it, for Yahweh. 𝄓 Solely Rakab the harlot will live, she and all that are with her in the house, for she camouflaged the messengers that we sent.
And certainly you keep yourself from the devoted, lest you be devoted if you take from the devoted, 𝄓 and set the army of Israel to the devotion and agitate it.
And all silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, holy they are to Yahweh. 𝄓 Into the treasury of Yahweh, let it come.

And the people raised a shout, and they sounded on the shophars. 𝄓 And it happened when the people heard the voice of the shophar and the people shouted in triumph, a great jubilation, that the wall fell flat, and the people went up to the city, each in front of him, and they conquered the city.
And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, of men and women, from youngster and to the elderly, 𝄓 and to bull or lamb or ass, with the edge of the sword.
And to the two persons who had surveyed the land, Joshua said, Go to the house of the woman of harlotry, 𝄓 and bring forth from there the woman and all that is hers, as you swore to her.

And the lads who had surveyed entered and brought out Rakab, and her father, and her mother, and her siblings, and all that was hers. And all her family they brought out, 𝄓 and left them outside the camp of Israel.
And the city they incinerated in the fire, and all that was in it. 𝄓 Solely the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass, and the iron, they gave to the treasury of the house of Yahweh.

And Rakab the harlot, and the house of her father, and all that was hers, Joshua kept alive, and she has settled within Israel to this day, 𝄓 for she camouflaged the messengers that Joshua sent to survey Jericho. P

And Joshua swore at that time, saying, 𝄓 Cursed is the person in the presence of Yahweh, who arises and builds this city, Jericho. On his firstborn, he will lay the foundation and on his smallest, he will lay out its gateways. S
And Yahweh was with Joshua, 𝄓 and his fame was in all the land.

And the children of Israel trespassed a trespass in the ban, 𝄓 and Akan child of Carmi child of Zavdi child of Zerach of the branch of Judah took from the ban, and the anger of Yahweh burned among the children of Israel. S

And Joshua sent men from Jericho to the Shambles, that is beside Bethaven from the east of Bethel, and he said to them, saying, Go up and survey the land. 𝄓 And the men went up and they surveyed the Shambles.

And they returned to Joshua and they said to him, Let not all the people go up. Let about two thousand men or three thousand men go up and strike the Shambles. 𝄓 Do not labour there with all the people, because they are few.
So they went up there from the people about three thousand men, 𝄓 and they withdrew before the soldiers of the Shambles.

And the soldiers of the Shambles struck them, about thirty six men, and pursued them before the gate to the Shattering, and they struck them as they went down. 𝄓 And the heart of the people melted and it became as water.
And Joshua ripped his habit, and he fell onto his face earthward before the ark of Yahweh till evening, he and the elders of Israel, 𝄓 and brought up dust on their heads.

And Joshua said, Aye yai yai, my Lord Yahweh, why have you had this people cross over the Jordan to give us into the hand of the Amorites to have us perish? 𝄓 And should we not have attempted and have settled across the Jordan?
O my Lord, 𝄓 What will I say after Israel turned tail before its enemies.
And the Canaanite will hear and all the inhabitants of the land, and they will surround us and cut off our name from the land, 𝄓 and what will you do for your great name?
And Yahweh said to Joshua, Arise for yourself. 𝄓 Why is it you are falling on your face?

Israel has sinned, and moreover they have crossed over my covenant that I commanded them, 𝄓 and moreover they took from the ban, and moreover they have stolen, and moreover they have dissimulated, and moreover they have put it in their inner pouches.

So not able were the children of Israel to arise before their enemies. They faced nape backwards, in the face of their enemies, because they were of the ban. 𝄓 I will not again be with you if you do not exterminate the ban from within you.

Arise. Sanctify the people. And you say, Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow. 𝄓 For thus says Yahweh the God of Israel, A ban is among you. Israel will not be able to arise in the face of your enemies, until you put aside the ban from within you.

So you will approach in the morning by your sceptres. 𝄓 And it will happen that the sceptre that Yahweh conquers will approach by family, and the family that Yahweh conquers will approach by house, and the house that Yahweh conquers will approach by man of valour.

And it will happen that he that is conquered with the ban will be incinerated in the fire, he and all that he has, 𝄓 because he has crossed over the covenant of Yahweh, and because he has done senselessness in Israel.
And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and he had Israel approach by its sceptres, 𝄓 and he conquered the sceptre of Judah.
And he had the families of Judah approach and he conquered the family of the Zerachites, 𝄓 and he had the family of the Zerachites approach by man of valour, and he conquered Zavdi.
And he had his house approach by man of valour, 𝄓 and he conquered Akan child of Carmi child of Zavdi child of Zerach of the branch of Judah.
And Joshua said to Akan, My son, render, if you will, the glory to Yahweh the God of Israel, and give him thanksgiving, 𝄓 and tell me please what have you done. Do not conceal from me.
And Akan answered Joshua and said, Truly I myself have sinned to Yahweh the God of Israel, 𝄓 and like this and like this I have done.

And I saw in the spoil, one good majestic cape of Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and one tongue of gold, fifty shekels its weight, and I coveted them and I took them, 𝄓 and behold them buried in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver is under it.
And Joshua sent messengers and they raced towards the tent, 𝄓 and behold, it was buried in his tent and the silver under it.
And they took them away from the midst of the tent and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel, 𝄓 and dumped them out in the presence of Yahweh.

And Joshua took Akan child of Zerach and the silver and the majestic cape and the tongue of gold, and his sons and his daughters, and his bull and his ass and his sheep, and his tent and all that he had, and all Israel with him, 𝄓 and brought them up the valley of agitation.
And Joshua said, Why have you agitated us? Yahweh will agitate you on this day. 𝄓 And all Israel pelted him with stone, and they cremated them in the fire and they engulfed them with stones.
And they placed over him a rubble of great stones to this day, and Yahweh turned from his fierce anger. 𝄓 Therefore he called the name of that place, the valley of Agitation to this day. P

And Yahweh said to Joshua, Do not fear and do not be in disarray. Take your people, all the people of the battle and arise, go up to the Shambles. 𝄓 See, I have given into your hand the king of the Shambles, and with him, both his city and his land.

And you will do to the Shambles and to her king as you have done to Jericho and to her king. Solely her spoil and her cattle you will loot for yourselves. 𝄓 Set for yourself an ambush for the city behind her.
And Joshua arose and all the people of battle to go up to the Shambles. 𝄓 And Joshua chose thirty thousand soldiers, the valiant of the force, and he sent them by night.
And commanded them, saying, See. You will lie in wait for the city from behind the city, not very far away from the city, 𝄓 and be, all of you, prepared.
And I and all the people that are with me will approach against the city, 𝄓 and it will be that when they come forth to encounter us, as at the first, that we will withdraw before them.
And they will come forth after us till we have detached them from the city, for they will say, They withdraw before us as at the first. 𝄓 And we will withdraw before them.
Then you will arise from the ambush and you will possess the city, 𝄓 and Yahweh your God will give it into your hand.
And it will be when you have occupied the city, you will char the city in the fire. According to the word of Yahweh you will do. 𝄓 See. I have commanded you.
And Joshua sent them, and they went to the ambush and they settled between Bethel and the Shambles, seaward of the Shambles, 𝄓 and Joshua lodged in that night in the midst of people.
And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and conscripted the people, 𝄓 and he went up, he and the elders of Israel before the people, to the Shambles.

And all the people for the battle that were with him went up and made overture, and they came before the city. 𝄓 And they encamped from the north of the Shambles. The gorge was between them and the Shambles.
And he took about five thousand men, 𝄓 and he set them to lie in wait between Bethel and the Shambles seaward of the city.
And they set the people in place, all the camp that were northward of the city, and those with foot firmly planted seaward of the city, 𝄓 and Joshua went in that night in the midst of the valley.

And it happened that when the king of the Shambles saw, they moved swiftly and they rose early and the soldiers of the city went forth to the call of Israel to war, he and all with him, to engage before the steppe. 𝄓 And he did not know that an ambush for him was behind the city.
And Joshua and all Israel made as if contagion before them, 𝄓 and withdrew the way of the wilderness.
And all the people were appealed to that were in the Shambles to pursue after them, 𝄓 and they pursued after Joshua and were detached from the city.
And no man was still there in the Shambles or Bethel who did not come forth after Israel, 𝄓 and they forsook the open city, and pursued after Israel. P

And Yahweh said to Joshua, Stretch out with the scale that is in your hand to the Shambles, for into your hand I will give it. 𝄓 And Joshua stretched out with the scale that was in his hand against the city.
And those lying in wait arose swiftly from their place and they raced as he stretched out his hand, and they entered the city and conquered it. 𝄓 They moved swiftly and charred the city in the fire.

When the soldiers of the Shambles faced behind them, they saw, and behold the smoke of the city ascended towards the heavens, and it was not in their hands to withdraw here or there, 𝄓 and the people withdrawing to the wilderness turned on those who pursued.
When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had conquered the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, 𝄓 then they returned and struck the men of the Shambles.

And these came forth from the city to encounter them, and they were in the midst of Israel, these from this and these from this, 𝄓 and they struck them till they were without a trace of survivor or security.
And the king of the Shambles they arrested alive, 𝄓 and brought him near to Joshua.

And it happened when Israel finished slaying all the inhabitants of the Shambles in the field, in the wilderness where they pursued them, and they were fallen all of them with the edge of the sword until their completion, 𝄓 then all Israel returned to the Shambles and struck it with the edge of the sword.
And all the fallen in that day of men and women were twelve thousand, 𝄓 all the persons of the Shambles.
And Joshua did not return his hand that he had stretched out with the scale, 𝄓 until he had put to the ban all the inhabitants of the Shambles.
Solely the cattle and the spoil of the city that Israel despoiled for themselves, 𝄓 according to the word of Yahweh that he commanded Joshua.
And Joshua incinerated the Shambles, 𝄓 and he set it a mound, forever desolate to this day.

And the king of the Shambles he hung on the tree until the time of evening, 𝄓 and as the sun set, Joshua commanded that they bring down his corpse from the tree, and they cast it to the door of the gate of the city, and they placed over him a rubble of great stones to this day. P
Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh the God of Israel, 𝄓 on the hill of Eival.

As Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the record of the instruction of Moses, an altar of whole stones over which no one has brandished iron. 𝄓 And they offered up on it burnt offerings to Yahweh and they offered peace offerings.
And he wrote there on the stones, 𝄓 a duplicate of the instruction of Moses which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

And all Israel and their elders and overseers and judges were standing from this or from that of the ark before the priests, the Levites who bear the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, as the guest as the native, half to be in the forefront of the hill of Gerizim, and half to be in the forefront of the hill of Eival, 𝄓 as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded, at the first, to bless the people of Israel.
And after such he recited all the words of instruction, the blessing and the denial, 𝄓 according to all that is written in the record of instruction.
There was no word from all that Moses commanded, 𝄓 that Joshua did not recite in front of all the congregation of Israel and the women and the little ones and the guests who walked among them.

And it happened when all the kings heard, that were across the Jordan, on the hill, and in a lowly place, and in all the ports of the great sea in the forefront of Lebanon, 𝄓 the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite,
That they collected themselves as one to fight with Joshua and with Israel, 𝄓 one mandate. P
And the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Shambles.
And they did also themselves with craftiness. 𝄓 And they went and were diplomatic and took faded sacks for their asses, and wine bottles, worn out, and split, and bagged.
And worn out shoes and patchwork was around their feet, and apparel worn out over them, 𝄓 and all the bread of their provender was dried up, speckled.
And they went to Joshua, to the camp at the Gilgal. 𝄓 And they said to him, and to anyone of Israel, From a land far off we have come, and now, cut for us a covenant.
And each of Israel said to the Hivites, 𝄓 Maybe near me you will settle, so how will I cut for you a covenant?
And they said to Joshua, Your servants we are. 𝄓 And Joshua said to them, Who are you? And where do you come from?
And they said to him, From a land very far off your servants have come to the name of Yahweh your God. 𝄓 For we have heard his fame, and all that he did in Egypt.
And all that he had done to the two kings of the Amorites that were across the Jordan, 𝄓 to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, that were in Ashtaroth.

And our elders and all the inhabitants of our land said to us, saying, Take in your hand provender for the journey, and go to encounter them. 𝄓 And you say to them, Your servants we are, and now cut for us a covenant.
This for our bread, it was hot as our provender from our houses on the day we came forth to come to you. 𝄓 And now, behold, dried up, and it is speckled.
And these, the bottles of wine that we filled, were new, and behold they are split. 𝄓 And these, our apparel and our shoes, worn out from the very excessive journey.
And the men took of their provender, 𝄓 and the mandate of Yahweh they did not ask.
And Joshua made peace with them, and cut for them a covenant to let them live, 𝄓 and the principals of the assembly swore to them.
And it happened at the culmination of three days, after they had cut for them a covenant, 𝄓 that they heard that they were nearby and they inhabited nearby.
And the children of Israel pulled out and they came to their cities on the third day. 𝄓 And their cities were Gibeon, and Kepyrah, and Beeroth, and Qiryath-Yearim.
And the children of Israel did not strike them, for to them the principals of the assembly had sworn in Yahweh, the God of Israel. 𝄓 But they were grumbling, all the assembly, against the principals.
And all the principals said to all the assembly, We ourselves have sworn to them in Yahweh the God of Israel. 𝄓 So now we are not able to touch them.
This will we do to them. We will let them live. 𝄓 And there will not be rage over us concerning the oath, for we have sworn to them.
And the principals said to them, Let live, 𝄓 and they will be dressers of trees and drawers of water for all the assembly, as the principals spoke to them.
And Joshua called them and he spoke to them, saying, 𝄓 Why did you deceive us, saying, we are very far off from you, but you inhabit among us?
And now you are cursed. 𝄓 And none of you will be cut off from service, and dressers of trees, and drawers of water for the house of my God.

And they answered Joshua and said, Because it has been evident to your servants that Yahweh your God commanded Moses his servant to give to you all the land, and to exterminate all the inhabitants of the land before you, 𝄓 and we were very fearful for our integrity before you, so we have done this thing.
And now behold us in your hand. 𝄓 What seems good and upright in your eyes to do to us, do.
And so he did for them, 𝄓 and delivered them from the hand of the children of Israel and they did not slay them.
And Joshua assigned them in that day, dressers of trees and drawers of water for the assembly, 𝄓 and for the altar of Yahweh, until this day, at the place where he will choose. P

And it happened when Adoni Zedek, the king of Jerusalem, heard that Joshua had conquered the Shambles and had utterly destroyed it, (as he had done to Jericho and to its king, so he had dealt to the Shambles and to its king), 𝄓 and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,
That they feared much, for Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, 𝄓 and because it was greater than the Shambles, and all its men were valiant.
So Adoni Zedek, the king of Jerusalem, sent to Hoham, the king of Hebron, and to Piram, the king of Yarmut, and to Yapya, the king of Lachish, and to Debir, the king of Eglon, saying,
Come up to me, and help me, and let us strike Gibeon, 𝄓 for he has made peace with Joshua and the children of Israel.

And five kings of the Amorites gathered and went up, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Yarmut, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, they and all their armies. 𝄓 and they encamped by Gibeon, and fought against it.

And the soldiers of Gibeon sent to Joshua, to the camp at Gilgal, saying, Do not let your hands slacken from your servants. 𝄓 Come up to us swiftly, and save us, and help us, for collected against us are all kings of the Amorites, the inhabitants of the mountain.
And Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the people of battle with him, and all the valiant of force. P
And Yahweh said to Joshua, Do not fear from them, for into your hand I have given them. 𝄓 Not a person will stand from them before you.
And Joshua came to them suddenly, 𝄓 all the night long ascending from Gilgal.

And Yahweh confused them before Israel, and they struck them, a great striking in Gibeon. 𝄓 And they pursued them the way of the ascent of BethHoron, and they struck them until Azeiqah and to Maqeidah.

And it happened when they withdrew from before Israel, they were on the descent to BethHoron, and Yahweh cast down on them great stones from the heavens until Azeiqah, and they died. 𝄓 Many more died in the hail stones than the children of Israel slew by the sword. S
Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh on the day Yahweh gave the Amorite before the children of Israel, 𝄓 and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun in Gibeon, be undone, and moon in the valley of Elon.

And the sun was undone and the moon stood, until nation had avenged its enemies. Is this not written in the record of the upright? 𝄓 So the sun stood in the middle of the heavens, and was not importuned to set for a complete day.
And there was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahweh heard with the voice of a man. 𝄓 For Yahweh fought for Israel. S
And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
And these five kings withdrew. 𝄓 And camouflaged themselves in the cave in Maqeidah.
And it was told to Joshua, saying, 𝄓 Five kings were found camouflaged in the cave in Maqeidah.
And Joshua said, Roll great stones to the mouth of the cave, 𝄓 and conscript persons over it to guard them.
And you, Do not stand still. Pursue after your enemies and tail them. 𝄓 Do not slumber to let them enter their cities, for Yahweh your God has given them into your hand.
And it was when Joshua and the children of Israel finished striking a very great strike until they completed. 𝄓 And the survivors who survived from them entered into the enclosed cities.
And all the people returned to the camp, to Joshua at Maqeidah, in peace. 𝄓 There was no sharpness for the children of Israel for anyone with his tongue.
And Joshua said, Open the mouth of the cave, 𝄓 and bring forth to me those five kings from the cave.
And they did so, and brought out to him, those five kings from the cave, 𝄓 the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Yarmut, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon.

And it was when they had brought out those kings to Joshua, that Joshua called to everyone of Israel, and he said to the lieutenants of the warriors who went with him, Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings. 𝄓 And they came near and they put their feet on their necks.
And Joshua said to them, Do not fear, and do not be dismayed. 𝄓 Be courageous and be assured, for thus Yahweh will do to all your enemies with whom you fight.
And Joshua struck them after this, and so put them to death, and hung them on five trees. 𝄓 And they were hanging on the trees till evening.

And it happened at the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they brought them down from the trees, and cast them to the cave where they had been camouflaged. 𝄓 And they set great stones on the mouth of the cave until this selfsame day. S

And Joshua conquered Maqeidah in that day and struck it with the edge of the sword, and its king he utterly destroyed. Of them and all the group that was in it, he did not leave a trace of a survivor. 𝄓 and he did to the king of Maqeidah as he had done to the king of Jericho. S
And Joshua crossed over, and all Israel with him, from Maqeidah to Libnah, 𝄓 and fought the people of Libnah.

And Yahweh gave it also into the hand of Israel, and its king. And he struck it with the edge of the sword and all the group that was in it. He did not leave a trace of a survivor in it. 𝄓 And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho. S
And Joshua crossed over, and all Israel with him, from Libnah towards Lachish, 𝄓 and encamped against it and fought against it.

And Yahweh gave Lachish into the hand of Israel, and conquered it by the second day and he struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the group that was in it, 𝄓 according to all that he had done to Libnah. P
Then Horam, the king of Gezer, came up to help Lachish, 𝄓 and Joshua struck him and his people, until he was without a trace of a survivor.
And Joshua crossed over, and all Israel with him, from Lachish toward Eglon, 𝄓 and they encamped against it and fought against it.
And conquered it in that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the group that was in it in that day he utterly destroyed, 𝄓 according to all that he had done to Lachish. P
And Joshua went up, and all Israel with him, from Eglon toward Hebron, 𝄓 and fought against it.

And conquered it and struck it with the edge of the sword, and its king, and all its cities, and all the group that was in it. He did not leave a trace of a survivor, according to all that he had done to Eglon, 𝄓 and he utterly destroyed it and all the group that was in it. S
And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, toward Debir, 𝄓 and fought against it.

And conquered it, and its king, and all its cities, and they struck them with the edge of the sword, and they utterly destroyed all the group that was in it. He did not leave a trace of a survivor, 𝄓 as he had done to Hebron, so he dealt to Debir and to its king, and as he had done to Libnah and to its king.

So Joshua struck all the land of the hill, and the Negev, and the lowly places, and the slopes, and all their kings. He did not leave a trace of a survivor, 𝄓 and all the breath-bearing he utterly destroyed, as Yahweh the God of Israel had commanded.
And Joshua struck them from Qadesh Barnea and to Gaza, 𝄓 and all the land of Goshen and to Gibeon.
And all these kings and their land Joshua conquered at one time, 𝄓 for Yahweh the God of Israel fought for Israel.
And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal. P
And it happened when Jabin king of Chatsor heard, 𝄓 that he reached out to Yovav king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Akshap,
And to the kings that were northward on the mountain, and on the steppe south of Harps, and in a lowly place, 𝄓 and on the elevation of Dor seaward.
The Canaanite from the sunrise and from the sea, and the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Jebusite on the mountain, 𝄓 and the Hivite under Hermon in the land toward Mizpah.
And they went forth, and all their armies with them, a people abundant as the sand that is by the bank of the sea for abundance, 𝄓 both horse and chariot very abundant.
And when all these kings had engaged, 𝄓 they came and they encamped as one, by the waters from on high, to fight the people of Israel. P

And Yahweh said to Joshua, Do not fear before them, for tomorrow about this time I am giving them all, profaned, in the face of Israel. 𝄓 Their horses you will hamstring and their chariots you will incinerate in the fire.
And Joshua came on them, and all the people of battle with him, by the waters from on high, suddenly, 𝄓 and they fell on them.

And Yahweh gave them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them and pursued them to Sidon the Plenary, and to the incinerations of water, and to the crevasse of Mizpeh toward sunrise, 𝄓 and they struck them until they were without a trace of survivor.
And Joshua did to them as Yahweh had said to him. 𝄓 Their horses he hamstrung, and their chariots he incinerated in the fire. S
And Joshua turned at that time and he conquered Chatsor and struck her king by the sword, 𝄓 because Chatsor before was the head of all these kingdoms.
And he struck anyone that was in her, utterly destroying with the edge of the sword. 𝄓 He did not let any breath-bearing remain, and Chatsor, he incinerated in the fire.
And all the cities of these kings and all their kings Joshua conquered, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them, 𝄓 as Moses, the servant of Yahweh, had commanded.
But all the cities standing on a ridge, Israel did not incinerate, 𝄓 except Chatsor alone, Joshua incinerated.

And all the spoil of these cities and the cattle, the children of Israel despoiled for themselves, but every human they struck with the edge of the sword until they exterminated them. 𝄓 They did not leave a trace of any breath-bearing.
As Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua, 𝄓 and so Joshua did. He did not put aside a word from all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
And Joshua took all this land, the mountain and all the south, and all the land of Goshen, and the lowly place and toward the steppe, 𝄓 and the mountain of Israel and her lowly place,
From the hill of the Share that goes up to Seir, and to Baal-Gad in the crevasse of Lebanon under mount Hermon, 𝄓 and all their kings he conquered, and he struck them and put them to death.
Many days Joshua made all these kings battle.
There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel except the Hivite, the inhabitants of Gibeon. 𝄓 The whole they took in battle.

For from Yahweh it was to make their heart resolute to the call of battle with Israel, in order to utterly destroy them, without there being grace for them, 𝄓 but for the sake of exterminating them, as Yahweh commanded Moses. S

And Joshua came at that time and he cut off the Anaqim from the mountain, from Hebron, from Debir, from Grapeland, and from all the mountain of Judah, and from all the mountain of Israel. 𝄓 With their cities. Joshua destroyed them utterly.
No Anaqim were left in the land of the children of Israel. 𝄓 Solely in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there was a trace.

And Joshua took all the land, according to all that Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and Joshua gave it as an inheritance for Israel, according to their divisions for their bands. 𝄓 And the land was quiet from war. S

And these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck. And they possessed their land across the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, 𝄓 from the torrent the Arnon to mount Hermon, and all toward the steppe, toward the sunrise.

Sihon, king of the Amorites, the inhabitants in Heshbon, 𝄓 governing from Aroer, that is over the bank of the wadi of the Arnon, and the centre of the wadi, and half the Gilead, and to the wadi Jabboq, the border of the children of Ammon.

And the steppe to the sea of Kinneroth toward the sunrise, and to the sea toward the steppe, the salt sea toward the sunrise, the way of the house of the wastelands, 𝄓 and from the south, under the slopes of Ha-Pisgah.
And the border of Og, king of Bashan, of what remains of the titans, 𝄓 the inhabitants in Ashtaroth and in Edrei.
And who governs on mount Hermon, and in Salkah, and in all Bashan to the border of the Geshuri and the Maachathi, 𝄓 and half the Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

Moses, the servant of Yahweh, and the children of Israel struck them. 𝄓 And Moses, the servant of Yahweh gave it, a possession to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half band of Manasseh. S

And these are the kings of the earth which Joshua and the children of Israel struck across the Jordan seaward, from Baal-Gad in the crevasse of Lebanon, and to the hill of the Share that ascends to Seir. 𝄓 And Joshua gave it to the sceptres of Israel, a possession, according to their divisions.

On the hill, and in a lowly place, and on the steppe, and on the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the Negev, 𝄓 the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. W

And Joshua was old when it comes to days. 𝄓 And Yahweh said to him, You are old when it comes to days and much abundant land is still there to possess.
This is the land that is still there, 𝄓 all the Rollers of the Philistines, and all the Geshuri,

From Blackest Dawn that faces Egypt, and to the border of Eqron northward to be reckoned of the Canaanites, 𝄓 five chieftains of the Philistines, the Gazatites, and the Ashdodites, the Eshqalonites, the Gittites, and the Eqronites, and the Avites,
From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah, that of the Sidonians, to Aphaq, 𝄓 to the border of the Amorites.
And the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon toward the rising of the sun, from Baal-Gad under mount Hermon, 𝄓 until the entry to Hamath.

All the inhabitants of the mountain from Lebanon to Firewaters. All Sidonians, I myself will dispossess in the presence of the children of Israel, 𝄓 but let the lot fall for Israel to be an inheritance, as I commanded you.
So now divide this land to be an inheritance for the nine bands, 𝄓 and the half band of Manasseh.
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, 𝄓 that Moses gave to them across the Jordan toward the sunrise, as Moses, the servant of Yahweh, gave to them.
From Aroer that is over the bank of the wadi of the Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the wadi, and all the level place of Medeba to Dibon.
And all the cities of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, 𝄓 to the border of the children of Ammon.
And the Gilead, and the border of the Geshuri, and the Maachathi, and all mount Hermon and all the Bashan to Salkah.
All the kingdoms of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei. 𝄓 He is still here of what remains of the titans. (And Moses struck them and dispossessed them).
But the children of Israel did not dispossess the Geshuri or the Maachathite. 𝄓 Geshur has settled, and Makah, within Israel to this day.
But to the band of Levi, he did not give an inheritance. 𝄓 The offerings by fire of Yahweh the God of Israel, he is his inheritance, as he spoke to him. P
And Moses gave to the branch of the children of Reuben in their families.
And their border was from Aroer, that is over the bank of the wadi of the Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the wadi, and all the level place of over Medeba,
Heshbon and all her cities that are in the level place, 𝄓 Dibon, and in the high places of Baal, and the house of Baal Meon,
And Yahatsah, and Qedemot, and Mepaat,
And Qiryatym, and Sibmah, and Tseret of Blackest Dawn, on the hill of the valley.
And the house of Peor, and Ashdod Ha-Pisgah, and the house of the desolation.

And all the cities of the level place, and all the kingdoms of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, 𝄓 whom Moses struck, and the principals of Midian, Evi and Reqem, and Tsur, and Hur, and Reba, dukes of Sihon, inhabitants of the land.
And Balaam, child of Beor the soothsayer. 𝄓 (The children of Israel slew by the sword for their profaned.)
And the border of the children of Reuben was the Jordan. 𝄓 And this border is the inheritance of the children of Reuben in their families, the cities and their villages. P
And Moses gave to the branch of Gad, for the children of Gad in their families.
And their border was Help, and all the cities of the Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, 𝄓 until Aroer, that is over before the Plenary,
And from Heshbon to the high ground of the Mizpah and Betonim, 𝄓 and from Two-Armies to the border of the Debir,

And in the valley, the house of Haram, and the house of Nimrah, and Sukkoth, and Tsaphon, the remaining of the kingdoms of Sihon, king of Heshbon, the Jordan, 𝄓 and the border to the extremity of the sea of Kinneret across the Jordan toward the sunrise.
This is the inheritance of the children of Gad in their families, 𝄓 the cities and their villages. S
And gave Moses to the half band of Manasseh, 𝄓 and it was of the half branch of the children of Manasseh in their families.
And their borders was from Two-Armies, all the Bashan, all the kingdoms of Og, king of Bashan, and all the municipality of Jair that is in Bashan, sixty city,
And half the Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdoms of Og in Bashan, 𝄓 of the children of Makir child of Manasseh, to half the children of Makir in their families.
These are what Moses gave as inheritance in the steppes of Moab, 𝄓 from beyond Jordan, Jericho, toward the sunrise. P
But to the band of Levi, Moses did not give an inheritance. 𝄓 Yahweh, the God of Israel, he is their inheritance, as he spoke to them. S

And these are what the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, 𝄓 that Eleazar the priest had them inherit, (and Joshua child of Nun, and the first parents of the branches of the children of Israel).
By lot their inheritance, 𝄓 as Yahweh commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine branches and the half branch.
For Moses had given the inheritance of two branches and a half branch from beyond Jordan, 𝄓 and to the Levites he did not give an inheritance among them.

Because the children of Joseph were two branches Manasseh and Ephraim, 𝄓 so they gave no share to the Levites in the land except their cities for settlement and their outlands for their livestock and for their acquisitions.
As Yahweh commanded Moses, so undertook the children of Israel, 𝄓 and they divided the land. P

And the children of Judah made overture to Joshua in Gilgal, and Caleb, child of Jepunah the Qenizite, said to him, 𝄓 You yourself know the thing that Yahweh spoke to Moses, the man of God, over my rationale and over your rationale in Qadesh-Barnea.
A child of a forty year span I was,when Moses sent me, the servant of Yahweh, from Qadesh-Barnea to survey the land, 𝄓 and I returned him a word as was with my heart.
And my kin who went up with me made the heart of the people dissolve, 𝄓 but I myself fully followed after Yahweh my God.

And Moses swore in that day, saying, Without fail, the land on which your foot finds its way, to you will be for an inheritance, and to your children for evermore, 𝄓 because you fully followed after Yahweh my God.

And now behold, Yahweh has kept me alive as he spoke these forty five years, ever since Yahweh spoke this word to Moses when Israel walked in the wilderness, 𝄓 and now behold I am today a child of eighty five years.
Yet I today am as resolute as in the day Moses sent me. As my power then so my power now, 𝄓 to war or to go forth or to come in.

And now give me this mount that Yahweh spoke of in that day, 𝄓 for yourself, you heard in that day that the Anaqim were there and great enclosed cities. Maybe Yahweh is with me, and I will dispossess them as Yahweh spoke.
And Joshua blessed him, 𝄓 and he assigned Hebron to Caleb child of Jepunah as inheritance.
So Hebron became for Caleb child of Jepunah the Qenizite as inheritance to this day, 𝄓 in that fully he followed Yahweh the God of Israel.
Now the name Hebron before, was 'the town of four'. Humanity magnified among the Anaqim it was, 𝄓 and the land was quiet from war. P
And this was the lot of the branch of the children of Judah in their families: 𝄓 to the border of Edom of the wilderness of Zin southward to the southern shore.
And their border southward was from the shore of the salt sea, 𝄓 from the tongue that faces southward.

And it came out from the Negev to the ascendance of the scorpions, and it passed through toward Zin, and ascended from the Negev to Qadesh-Barnea, 𝄓 and passed through Hetsron, and ascended towards Adar, and circled towards Qarqaa.
And it passed through towards Atsmon, and came out to the wadi of Egypt, and the exeunts of the border were seaward. 𝄓 This will be your border southward.
And the border eastward is the salt sea to the limit of the Jordan, 𝄓 and the border of the northward quarter is from the tongue of the sea from the limit of the Jordan.
And the border ascended to BethHoglah and it passed through from the north to the house of the steppe, 𝄓 and the border ascended the stone of Bohan, child of Reuben.

And the border ascended towards Debir from the valley of agitation, and northward facing over against the Gilgal, that is opposite to the ascent to Adummim which is from the south of the wadi, 𝄓 and the border passed through to the waters of the eye of the sun, and the exeunts were to the Surveyor's Spring.

And the border ascended the gorge of the child of Hinnom to the Jebusite shoulder from the south. (This is Jerusalem.) 𝄓 And the border ascended to the top of the hill that faces the gorge of Hinnom seaward that is toward the end of the valley of the titans northward.

And the border was formed from the top of the hill to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and it came out at the cities of the hill of Ephron. 𝄓 And the border of Baalah was formed. (This is the town of Yearim.)

And the border circled from Baalah seaward to the hill of Seir, and it passed through to the shoulder of the hill of Yearim from the north. (This is Kaselun.) 𝄓 And it descended to the house of the sun, and it passed through Timnah.

And the border came out to the shoulder of Eqron northward, and the border was formed toward Shikron, and it passed through the hill of Baalah, and came out at Yabneel, 𝄓 and the exeunts of the border were seaward.
And the border of the sea was toward the great sea. 𝄓 And this border was the border of the children of Judah surrounding their families.
And to Caleb, child of Jepunah, he gave a share among the children of Judah, by the mandate of Yahweh to Joshua, 𝄓 the town of four, the father of Anaq. (This is Hebron.)
And Caleb dispossessed from there, 𝄓 the three children of Anaq, Sheshai, and Achiman, and Talmai, the successors of Anaq.
And he went up from there to the inhabitants of Debir. 𝄓 (And the name of Debir before was the town of Sapphire.)
And Caleb said, Whoever strikes the town of Sapphire and conquers it, 𝄓 I will give to him Akesah my daughter as wife.
And Othniel conquered it, child of Qenaz, Caleb's brother. 𝄓 So he gave him Akesah his daughter as wife.
And it happened when she came, that she incited him to ask from her father a field. She put herself down from the ass, 𝄓 and Caleb said to her, What is it to you?
And she said, Give me a blessing for the land of the Negev you gave me. So give me rolling water. 𝄓 And he gave to her the upper rollers and the lower rollers. P
This is the inheritance of the branch of the children of Judah in their families.
And the cities from the extremity of the branch of the children of Judah to the border of Edom in the south were: 𝄓 Qavtseil and Eider and Yagur,
And Qinah and Dimonah and Adadah,
And Qedesh, and Chatsor and Yitnan,
Zif and Telem and Baalot,
And Chatsor-Chadatah, and the towns of Hetsron, (this is Chatsor),
Amam and Shma and Moladah,
And Chatsar-Gadah and Cheshmon and the house of Security,
and Chatsar-Shual and Beer-Sheva and Vizyotyah,
Baalah and Iyim and Atsem,
and Eltolad and Csil and Charmah,
and Tsiqlag and Madmanah and Sansanah,

Bashfeilah, 𝄓 Eshtaol and Tsarah and Ashnah,
And Zanoach and Ein-Ganim, Tappuax and Haeinam,
Yarmut and Adullam, Sokoh and Azeiqah,
And Shaaraim and Aditaim and Hagdeirah and Gdeirotayim, 𝄓 fourteen cities and their courts. S
Tsenan and Chadashah and the tower of Gad,
And Dilan and Mizpeh and Joktheel,

And Kabon and Lachmas and Kitlish,
And Gdeirot, the house of Dagon, and Naamah, and Maqeidah, 𝄓 sixteen cities and their courts. S
Livnah and Eter and Ashan,
And Yiftach and Ashnah and Ntsiv,

Eqron and its built-up areas and its courts.
From Eqron and towards the sea, 𝄓 all that was handy to Ashdod and its courts. S
Ashdod and its built-up areas and its courts, Gaza, its built-up areas and its courts to the wadi of Egypt, 𝄓 and the great sea and border. S
And on the hill, 𝄓 Shamir and Yatir and Sokoh,
And Danah and the town of Bush, (this is Debir), S
