Maon, Carmel, and Zif and Yutah,
and Jezreel and Yaqdeam and Zanoach,
The Cain, Gibeah and Timnah, 𝄓 ten cities and their courts. S
Chalchul, the house of Tyre and Gdor,
And Maarat and the house of Anot and Elteqon, 𝄓 six cities and their courts, P
The town of Baal, (this is the town of Yearim) and Harabah, 𝄓 two cities and their courts. S
In the wilderness, 𝄓 the house of the steppe, Midin and Skakah.
And the Nivshan, and the city of the salt, and Ein Gedi, 𝄓 six cities and their courts.
And the Jebusites were inhabitants of Jerusalem. The children of Judah were not able to dispossess them. 𝄓 The Jebusite has settled with the children of Judah in Jerusalem until this day. P
And the lot came out for the children of Joseph from Jordan by Jericho to the waters of Jericho toward the sunrise, 𝄓 the wilderness going up from Jericho on the hill of Bethel.
And comes out from Bethel toward Luz, 𝄓 and it passes through to the border of the Arkite Crowns.
And it descends seaward to the border of the Yaphleti to the border of BethHoron the lower part, and to Gezer, 𝄓 and its exeunts seaward.
So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, were given to inherit.
And it was the border of the children of Ephraim in their families. 𝄓 And it was the border of their inheritance toward the sunrise to the Crown of Excellence to BethHoron, the upper part.

And the border comes out toward the sea to the Mikmethah from the north and the border circles toward the sunrise to the fig tree of Shiloh, 𝄓 and it passes through it from the sunrise toward Janoxah.
And it descends from Janoxah to the Crowns and Naarath, 𝄓 and butts by Jericho and comes out at the Jordan.
From Tappuax the border seaward goes down to the wadi of Qenah, and its exeunts are toward the sea. 𝄓 This is the inheritance of the branch of the children of Ephraim in their families.
And the cities differentiated for the children of Ephraim are in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, 𝄓 all the cities and their courts.
And they did not dispossess the Canaanite that was settled in Gezer, 𝄓 but the Canaanite has settled within Ephraim to this day, and he was serving in forced service. P

And this was the lot for the branch of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. 𝄓 For Makir, the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of the Gilead, for he was a man of war, so there was for him the Gilead and Bashan.

And there was, for the children of Manasseh remaining in their families, for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Xeleq, and for the children of Asrael, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Xefar, and for the children of Shemida. 𝄓 These are the children of Manasseh child of Joseph, the males in their families.

And for Tselofexad, child of Xefar, child of Gilead, child of Makir, child of Manasseh, there were no sons for him, but rather daughters. 𝄓 And these are the names of his daughters, Maxelah, and No`ah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

And they approached before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua child of Nun, and before the principals, saying, Yahweh commanded Moses to give to us an inheritance among our kin, 𝄓 and he gave to them, by the mandate of Yahweh, an inheritance among the kin of their father.
So there fell ten territories to Manasseh, 𝄓 besides those from the land of the Gilead and the Bashan that are from beyond Jordan,
for the daughters of Manasseh inherited an inheritance among his sons, 𝄓 and the land of the Gilead, that was for the remaining children of Manasseh.
And the border of Manasseh is from the Mikmethah that is over before Shechem, 𝄓 and the border goes to the right side, to the inhabitants of the eye of the quince [Tappuax].
To Manasseh belonged the land of the quince, 𝄓 but the quince to the border of Manasseh was for the children of Ephraim.

And the border descends to the wadi of Qenah southward of the wadi. These cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh. 𝄓 And the border of Manasseh is from the north of the wadi, and its exeunts toward the sea.
Southward was of Ephraim, and northward of Manasseh, and the sea its border. 𝄓 And in Asher they come across from the north, and in Issachar from the sunrise.

And Manasseh has in Issachar and in Asher, the house of Shean and her built-up areas, Yiblam and her built-up areas, and the inhabitants of Dor and her built-up areas, and the inhabitants of Endor, and her built-up areas, and the inhabitants of Taanak and her built-up areas, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her built-up areas, 𝄓 three elevations.
And the children of Manasseh were not able to dispossess these cities, 𝄓 but the Canaanite attempted to settle in that land.
And it would be that the children of Israel were resolute and consigned the Canaanite to forced service, 𝄓 but they did not dispossess them. S

And the children of Joseph spoke with Joshua, saying, 𝄓 For what purpose have you given to me an inheritance of one lot, and one territory, when I am an abundant people in that Yahweh thus has further blessed me?

And Joshua said to them, If you are an abundant people, go up for yourselves to the forest, and create for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzite and the Titans, 𝄓 if mount Ephraim is too tight for you.

And the children of Joseph said, The mountain will not be found suitable for us. 𝄓 And iron chariot is in every Canaanite settlement in the land of the valley, those who are in Beth-Shean and her built-up areas, and those in the valley of Jezreel.
And Joshua said to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim, and to Manasseh, saying, 𝄓 An abundant people you are, and power great is yours. One lot is not for you.

For mountain is yours, because it is forest and you will create it, and it will be for you, its exeunts. 𝄓 For you will dispossess the Canaanite, though he has iron chariot, though he is courageous. P
And all the assembly of the children of Israel was convened at Shiloh, and they erected there the tent of engagement, 𝄓 and the land was under control before them.
And there remained among the children of Israel who had not divided their inheritance, 𝄓 seven sceptres.
And Joshua said to the children of Israel, 𝄓 How long, please, will you be timid to enter to possess the land that Yahweh the God of your ancestors has given to you.

Provide for yourselves three men per band, 𝄓 and I will send them, and they will arise and they will go into the land, and they will describe it according to the mandate of their inheritance, and they will come to me.
And they will divide it into seven divisions. 𝄓 Judah will stand over its border from the south, and the house of Joseph will stand over their borders from the north.
And you will describe the land, the seven divisions, and come to me here, 𝄓 and I will throw for you the dice here in the presence of Yahweh our God.

But there is no share for the Levites among you, for the priesthood of Yahweh is his inheritance. 𝄓 And Gad and Reuben and half the band of Manasseh, they have received their inheritance from beyond Jordan toward the sunrise, that Moses gave to them, the servant of Yahweh.

And the men arose and went. 𝄓 And Joshua commanded those who went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land and describe it, then return to me here. I will cast for you the lot in the presence of Yahweh in Shiloh.
And the men went and passed through in the land, and described it by cities into seven divisions in a book, 𝄓 and they came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.
And Joshua cast for them the lot in Shiloh in the presence of Yahweh, 𝄓 and there Joshua divided the land for the children of Israel according to their divisions. P
And the lot came up of the branch of the children of Benjamin for their families, 𝄓 and the border of their lot came out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

And their border of the quarter northward is from the Jordan. 𝄓 And the border ascends to the shoulder of Jericho from the north, and ascends on the hill seaward and the exeunts toward the wilderness of Bethaven.

And the border passes through from there toward Luz to the shoulder of Luz southward. (This is Bethel.) 𝄓 And the border descends to the Crown of Excellence on hill that is from the south to BethHoron, the lower part.

And the border is formed and circles the quarter of the sea southward from the hill that faces BethHoron southward, and the exeunts to the town of Baal. (This is the town of Yearim, a city of the children of Judah.) 𝄓 This is the western quarter.
And the southward quarter is to the extremity of the town of Yearim, 𝄓 and the border comes out seaward and comes out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

And the border descends to the extremity of the hill that faces the gorge of the child of Hinnom that is in the valley of the titans northward, 𝄓 and descends to the gorge of Hinnom to the shoulder of the Jebusite southward, and descends the Surveyor's Spring.
And is formed from the north, and came out to the Eye of the Sun, and comes forth to the Rollers that is opposite the ascent of Ruddies, 𝄓 and descends to the stone of Bohan, child of Reuben.
And it passes through to the shoulder of the forefront toward the steppe northward, 𝄓 and descends toward the steppe.

And the border passes through to the shoulder of BethHoglah northward, and the exeunts of the border to the north tongue of the salt sea by the extremity of the Jordan southward. 𝄓 This is the south border.
And the Jordan is its border on the eastward quarter. 𝄓 This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin for their borders surrounding their families. P
And the cities of the branch of the children of Benjamin are, for their families, 𝄓 Jericho, and BethHoglah, and the Valley of Sunders.
And the House Toward the Steppe, and Eclipses and Bethel,
And the Relics, and the Rats, and Dusty,
And Kefar Ha-Ammon, and Mouldy, and Geba, 𝄓 twelve cities and their courts.
Gibeon, Ramah, and, Wells,
And Mizpeh, and Cub, and Motzah,
And Embroiderer, and God-Will-Heal, and Staggering,
And Halt, The Thousand, and Jebusi, (this is Jerusalem), Hillock, Chance. Fourteen cities and their courts. 𝄓 This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin for their families. P
And the second lot came out to Simeon of the branch of the children of Simeon in their families. 𝄓 And their inheritance is in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
And there was for them in their inheritance, 𝄓 Beer-Sheva, and Sheva, and Moladah,
And Chatsar, Shual, and Balah, and Atsem,
And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Charmah,
And Tsiqlag, and the house of Riders, and the court of Her Horse,
And the house of Lebaoth, and Sharuxen, 𝄓 thirteen cities and their courts,
Ain, Rimmon, and Eter, and Ashan, 𝄓 four cities and their courts,
And all the villages that surround these cities, to Baal of Beer, Ramoth of the south. 𝄓 This is the inheritance of the branch of the children of Simeon in their families.

Out of the territory of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon, 𝄓 for the division of the children of Judah was too much for them, so the children of Simeon were given to inherit in the midst of their inheritance. P
And the third lot came up of the children of Zebulun in their families, 𝄓 and the border of their inheritance is to Sarid.
And their border ascends toward the sea and Stagger, and butts into Honey, 𝄓 and butts into the wadi that is over before Yiqneam.
Then it turns from Sarid eastward toward the rising of the sun to the border of the Folly of Tavor. 𝄓 And it goes out to Daberat and ascends to Shine.
And from there crosses over eastward toward the sunrise towards Gath Xefar, towards Itqtsyn, 𝄓 and comes out at Rimmon the Handsome to Ne`ah.
And the border circles it from the north to Xanathan, 𝄓 and its exeunts in the gorge of Jephthah-El.
And Qattat, and Nahalol, and Samaria, and Yidalah, and the house of bread [Bethlehem], 𝄓 twelve cities and their courts.
This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun in their families, 𝄓 these cities and their courts. P
For Issachar the fourth lot came out, 𝄓 of the children of Issachar in their families.
And their border, 𝄓 is toward Jezreel, and Kesullot, and Shunem,
And Xapharim, and Shion, and Anaxarat,
And Rabbit, and Qishyon, and Abets,
And Remet, and Ein-Ganim, and Ein-Xaddah, and the house of Patsats,
And the border butts with Tabor, and Shaxatsymah, and the House of the Sun. 𝄓 And the exeunts of their border, the Jordan, sixteen cities and their courts.
This is the inheritance of the branch of the children of Issachar in their families, 𝄓 the cities and their villages. P
And the fifth lot came out of the branch of the children of Asher in their families.
And their borders are, 𝄓 Xelqat, and Xali, and Belly, and Akshap,
And Alammelech, and Amad, and Mishal, 𝄓 and butt with Carmel toward the sea, and with the white of Blackest Dawn.
Then it turns toward the rising of the sun, the house of grain, and butts with Zebulun and the gorge of Jephthah El northward, the house of the valley, and Ni`el, 𝄓 and exits to Kabul on the left.
And Ebrun, and Rehob, and Kamon, and Qenah, 𝄓 to Sidon the Plenary.
Then the border turns to Ramah and to the enclosed city, Tyre. 𝄓 Then the border turns to Hosah and its exeunts toward the sea, from the margin toward Akzib.
And Umah, and Aphaq, and Rekob, 𝄓 twenty two cities and their courts.
This is the inheritance of the branch of the children of Asher in their families, 𝄓 these cities and their courts. P
For the children of Naphtali the sixth lot came out, 𝄓 for the children of Naphtali in their families.
And their border is from Xalep, from Elon into Tsaannym and Adami, the Hammer and Yabneel to Laqum, 𝄓 and its exeunts the Jordan.

Then the border turns seaward to the ears of Tabor and emerges from there to the Lawgiver, 𝄓 and butts with Zebulun from the Negev and butting into Asher seaward, and into Judah of the Jordan, toward the rising of the sun.
And the cities enclosed, 𝄓 Tsiddim, Tser and Hamath, Raqqat and Kinneret,
And Adamah, and Ramah, and Chatsor,
And Qedesh, and Edrei, and Ein-Chatsor,
And Yiron, and Migdal-El, Xorem and the house of Anah, and the House of the Sun, 𝄓 nineteen cities and their courts.
This is the inheritance of the branch of the children of Naphtali in their families, 𝄓 the cities and their villages. P
For the branch of the children of Dan in their families, 𝄓 the seventh lot came out.
And the border of their inheritance is, 𝄓 Tsarah, and Eshtaol, and the city of the Sun,
And Shaalbim, and Ailon, and Yitlah,
And Ailon, and Timnatah, and Eqron,
And Elteqeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalat,
And Jexud, and the children of lightning, and Gath Rimmon.
And Me-Hayirqon and Raqqon, 𝄓 with the border in the forefront of Yapho.

And the border of the children of Dan came out for them. 𝄓 And the children of Dan came up and fought with Leshem, and they conquered her, and struck her with the edge of the sword, and they possessed her, and they inhabited in her, and called Leshem, Dan, like the name of Dan their father.
This is the inheritance of the branch of the children of Dan in their families, 𝄓 these cities and their courts. S
And they finished inheriting the land for their borders, 𝄓 and the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua, child of Nun, among them.
At the mandate of Yahweh, they gave to him the city that he asked, Temanat-Sprawl, in mount Ephraim. 𝄓 And he built the city and he settled in her.

These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, and Joshua, child of Nun, and the heads of the ancestors inherited for the branches of the children of Israel by lot in Shiloh, in the presence of Yahweh, the door of the tent of engagement. 𝄓 And they finished the division of the land. P
And Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,
Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 𝄓 Assign for yourselves the cities of asylum, as I spoke to you by the hand of Moses.
To let a murderer withdraw there who struck someone inadvertently without knowledge, 𝄓 that they might become for you as an asylum from the redeemer of blood.

When such withdraws to one out of those cities, and stands at the door of the gate of the city, and speaks in the ears of the elders of that city his words, 𝄓 then they will gather him to the city to themselves, and they will assign him a place that he may settle with them.
And if the one redeeming the blood pursues after him, then they will not imprison the murderer by his hand, 𝄓 because without knowledge he struck his associate, and he had not hated him previously.

And he will settle in that city until he stands before the assembly for judgment, until the death of the great priest that will be in those days, 𝄓 then the murderer will return and will come to his city and his house, to the city where he withdrew from.
So they sanctified Qedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, 𝄓 and the town of four (this is Hebron) in the hills of Judah.

And across Jordan, Jericho toward the sunrise, they assigned Bezar in the wilderness in the level place from the branch of Reuben, 𝄓 and Ramoth in Gilead from the branch of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the branch of Manasseh.

These are the cities engaged for all the children of Israel and for the guest residing among them, to let anyone withdraw there who struck someone inadvertently, 𝄓 and he will not die by the hand of the one redeeming the blood until he has stood before the assembly. P
And the heads of the ancestors of the Levites made overture to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua child of Nun, 𝄓 and to the heads of the parents of the branches of the children of Israel.
And they spoke to them in Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, Yahweh commanded by the hand of Moses to give to us their cities for settlement, 𝄓 and their outlands for our cattle. P
And the children of Israel gave to the Levites from their inheritance by the mandate of Yahweh, 𝄓 these cities and their outlands.

And the lot of the families of the Kohathites came out, 𝄓 and it was of the children of Aaron the priest from the Levites from the branch of Judah, and from the branch of the Simeonites, and from the branch of Benjamin, by lot, thirteen cities. S
And to the children of Kohath that remained from the family of the branch of Ephraim, and from the branch of Dan, and from the half branch of Manasseh by lot, ten cities. S

And for the children of Gershon from the families of the branch of Issachar, and from the branch of Asher, and from the branch of Naphtali, and from the half branch of Manasseh in Bashan, by lot, thirteen cities. S
To the children of Meran in their families from the branch of Reuben, and from the branch of Gad, and from the branch of Zebulun, twelve cities. S
And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities and their outlands, 𝄓 as Yahweh commanded by the hand of Moses by lot. P
And they gave from the branch of the children of Judah and from the branch of the children of Simeon, 𝄓 these cities that are called by name,
And it was of the children of Aaron from the families of the Kohathites from the children of Levi, 𝄓 for to them was the beginning lot.
And they gave them the town of four, the father of Anaq. This is Hebron in the hills of Judah, 𝄓 and the outlands surrounding it.
But the field of the city and its villages, 𝄓 they gave to Caleb, child of Jepunah, for his holdings. S
And for the children of Aaron the priest, they gave the city of the asylum for the murderer, 𝄓 Hebron and its outlands, and Libnah and its outlands.
And Yatir and its outlands, and Eshtemoa and its outlands.
And Helon and its outlands, and Debir and its outlands.
And Ein and its outlands, and Yutah and its outlands, the house of the sun and its outlands, 𝄓 nine cities from these two bands. S
And from the branch of Benjamin, Gibeon and its outlands, 𝄓 Geba and its outlands.
Anathoth and its outlands, and Almon and its outlands, 𝄓 fourteen cities.
All the cities of the children of Aaron the priests, 𝄓 thirteen cities and their outlands. S
And for the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites remaining from the children of Kohath, 𝄓 there were the cities of their lot from the branch of Ephraim.
And they gave them the city of the asylum for the murderer, 𝄓 Shechem and its outlands in mount Ephraim, and Gezer and its outlands.
And Qivtsim and its outlands, and BethHoron and its outlands, 𝄓 fourteen cities. S
And from the branch of Dan, Elteqeh and its outlands, 𝄓 Gibbethon and its outlands.
Ailon and its outlands, Gathrimmon and its outlands, 𝄓 fourteen cities.
And from the half branch of Manasseh, Taanak and its outlands, and Gathrimmon and its outlands, 𝄓 two cities.
Total cities, ten and their outlands, 𝄓 for the families of the children of Kohath that remained. S

And for the children of Gershon, from the family of the Levites, from the half branch of Manasseh, the city of the asylum for the murderer, Golan in Bashan and its outlands and Be-Eshtarah and its outlands, 𝄓 two cities. S
And from the branch of Issachar, Qishyon and its outlands, 𝄓 Daberat and its outlands.
Yarmut and its outlands, the eye of Ganim and its outlands, 𝄓 fourteen cities. S
And from the branch of Asher, Mishal and its outlands, 𝄓 Abdon and its outlands.
Xelqat and its outlands, and Rekob and its outlands, 𝄓 fourteen cities. S
And from the branch of Naphtali, the city of the asylum for the murderer, Qedesh in Galilee and its outlands, and Hamath-Dor and its outlands, and Qartan and its outlands, 𝄓 thirteen cities.
All the cities of Gershon in their families, 𝄓 thirteen cities and their outlands. S
And for the families of the children of Merari, the Levites that remained from the branch of Zebulun, Yiqneam and its outlands, 𝄓 Qartah and its outlands.
Dimnah and its outlands, Nahalol and its outlands, 𝄓 fourteen cities. S
And from the branch of Reuben, Bezar and its outlands, 𝄓 and Jahats and its outlands.
Qedemot and its outlands, and Mephaath and its outlands, 𝄓 fourteen cities.
And from the branch of Gad, the city of the asylum for the murderer, Ramoth in Gilead and its outlands, 𝄓 and Two-Armies and its outlands.
Heshbon and its outlands, Yazer and its outlands, 𝄓 total cities, fourteen.
All the cities for the children of Merari in their families remaining from the families of the Levites, 𝄓 that were their lot, twelve cities.
All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the holdings of the children of Israel, 𝄓 forty eight cities and their outlands.
These cities were city by city, and their outlands surrounding it. 𝄓 Such it was for all these cities. S
And Yahweh gave to Israel all the land that he swore to give to their ancestors, 𝄓 and they possessed it and they inhabited it.

And Yahweh gave rest to them round about according to everything that he swore to their ancestors. 𝄓 And anyone in their presence from all their enemies did not keep a foothold. All their enemies Yahweh gave into their hand.
Not a word fell from all the good word that Yahweh spoke to the house of Israel. 𝄓 The whole came in. P
Then Joshua called to the Reubenites and to the Gadites, 𝄓 and to the half branch of Manasseh.
And he said to them, You, you have kept all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, 𝄓 and you have heard with my voice in all that I commanded you.
You have not forsaken your kin these many days to this day, 𝄓 and you keep the watch of the commandments of Yahweh your God.

And now Yahweh your God has given rest to your kin as he spoke to them, 𝄓 so now face about and go yourselves to your tents to the land of your holdings that Moses the servant of Yahweh gave to you across the Jordan.

But keep in full to do the commandment and the instruction that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love Yahweh your God and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to follow closely in him, 𝄓 and to serve him with all your heart and with all your being.
And Joshua blessed them, 𝄓 then he sent them away, and they went to their tents. P

And to half the band of Manasseh, Moses had assigned Bashan, and to the other half Joshua gave with their kin across the Jordan seaward, 𝄓 and also when Joshua sent them off to their tents, he blessed them.

And he said to them, saying, With material abundant wealth, return to your tents and with very abundant livestock, with silver and with gold and with brass and with iron, and with very abundant apparel, 𝄓 divide the spoil of your enemies with your kin. P

And they returned and they went, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half band of Manasseh, from the children of Israel, from Shiloh that is in the land of Canaan, 𝄓 to walk to the land of the Gilead, to the land of their holdings that they held fast in it, at the mandate of Yahweh by the hand of Moses.

And they came to the rollers of the Jordan, (that is in the land of Canaan), 𝄓 and the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half band of Manasseh built there an altar at the Jordan, a great altar to see.

And the children of Israel heard say, 𝄓 Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half band of Manasseh built the altar to be in the forefront of the land of Canaan, at the rollers of the Jordan, at the cross over of the children of Israel.
When the children of Israel heard, 𝄓 all the assembly of the children of Israel was convened at Shiloh to go up against them as a host. P
And the children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben and to the children of Gad and to the half band of Manasseh to the land of the Gilead, 𝄓 Phineas, child of Eleazar the priest.

And ten principals with him, one principal, one principal per ancestral house for all the branches of Israel, 𝄓 and each the head of the house of their ancestors themselves, to the thousands of Israel.
And they came to the children of Reuben and to the children of Gad and to the half band of Manasseh to the land of the Gilead, 𝄓 and they spoke to them, saying,

Thus says all the assembly of Yahweh, What is this trespass that you have trespassed against the God of Israel to turn today from following Yahweh, 𝄓 by building for yourselves an altar, to mutiny today against Yahweh?
Was it insignificant for us, the iniquity of Peor from which we are not cleansed to this day? 𝄓 And there was the plague in the assembly of Yahweh.
But you, you turn today from following Yahweh, 𝄓 and it is you, you mutiny today against Yahweh, and tomorrow, at all the assembly of Israel, he will rage.

And surely, if the land of your holdings is unclean, pass through for yourselves to the land of the holdings of Yahweh, where dwells the dwelling-place of Yahweh, and hold fast among us. 𝄓 And in Yahweh do not mutiny, and with us do not mutiny in building for yourselves an altar apart from the altar of Yahweh our God.
Did not Akan child of Zerach trespass? He trespassed in the ban, and against all the assembly of Israel, there was rage, 𝄓 and he one man. Did he not expire in his iniquity? S
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half band of Manasseh answered, 𝄓 and they spoke with the heads of the thousands of Israel.
The God of Gods, Yahweh, the God of Gods, Yahweh, he, he knows, and Israel, he, he knows. 𝄓 If it is in mutiny, or if in trespass against Yahweh, do not save us this day,
To build for us an altar to turn from following Yahweh, 𝄓 or if to offer up on it burnt offering and gift, or if to do on it offerings of peace offerings, let Yahweh himself demand.
And if not from anxiety about a matter we have done this, saying, 𝄓 Tomorrow your children will say to our children, saying, What is it to you and to Yahweh the God of Israel?

And Yahweh gave the border between us and you, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, at the Jordan. There is no share for you in Yahweh. 𝄓 And your children will make our children cease, so as not to fear Yahweh.
So we said, Let us make, please, for us to build the altar, 𝄓 not for burnt offerings, and not for sacrifice,

But a witness it is between us and you and our generations after us, to serve the service of Yahweh in his presence with our burnt offerings and with our sacrifices and with our peace offerings, 𝄓 and your children will not say afterwards to our children, There is no share for you in Yahweh.

So we said, And it will be that when they say to us or to our generations tomorrow, 𝄓 that we will say, You see the manner of the altar of Yahweh that our ancestors made, not for burnt offerings and not for sacrifice, but a witness it is, between us and you.

Far be it for us, from us, to mutiny against Yahweh, or turn today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for a burnt offering, for a gift, or for sacrifice, 𝄓 besides the altar of Yahweh our God that is before his dwelling-place. P

And Phineas the priest heard, and the principals of the assembly, and the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, the things that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, 𝄓 and it was good in their eyes.

And Phineas, child of Eleazar the priest, said to the children of Reuben and to the children of Gad and to the children of Manasseh, Today we know, for among us is Yahweh, that you have not trespassed against Yahweh this trespass. 𝄓 Then you have delivered the children of Israel from the hand of Yahweh.

And Phineas, child of Eleazar the priest, turned and the principals, from the children of Reuben and from the children of Gad, from the land of the Gilead to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, 𝄓 and they returned to them a word.

And the word was good in the eyes of the children of Israel, and the children of Israel blessed God, 𝄓 and did not say to go up against them as a host, to destroy the land that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had settled in.
And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar, 𝄓 But a witness it is between us that Yahweh is the God. P
And it was from many days after, that Yahweh had given rest to Israel from all their surrounding enemies, 𝄓 and Joshua was old when it comes to days.
And Joshua called for all Israel, to its elders, and to its preeminent, and to its judges, and to its overseers, 𝄓 and he said to them, I, I am old when it comes to days.
And you, you have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations from your presence, 𝄓 for Yahweh your God, he is fighting for you.

You see I have let fall to you these nations that are still here, to be an inheritance to your bands, 𝄓 from the Jordan and all the nations that I have cut off, and the great sea from the going down of the sun.
And Yahweh your God, he will evict them from your presence and dispossess them from before you, 𝄓 and you will possess their land as Yahweh your God spoke to you.
So be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the record of the instruction of Moses, 𝄓 that you not turn aside from it on the right hand or on the left.

That you do not come among these nations, these that are still here with you. 𝄓 And in the name of their God you will not remember, and you will not make an oath, and you will not serve them, and you will not prostrate yourselves to them.
In contrast, in Yahweh your God you will cling, 𝄓 as you have done to this day.
And Yahweh dispossessed from before you nations great and numerous, 𝄓 and you, no-one has stood before you to this day.
One person from you pursued a thousand, 𝄓 for Yahweh your God, he is fighting for you as he spoke to you.
So be guarded especially for your integrity, 𝄓 to love Yahweh your God.
For if to turn away, you turn and cling to these remaining nations, these that are still here with you, 𝄓 and you intermarry among them and go in among them and they among you,

to know, you will know. For Yahweh your God will not again dispossess these nations from before you, 𝄓 but they will become for you a snare, and a trap, and a scourge in your sides, and barbs in your eyes, until you perish from off this good ground that Yahweh your God gave to you.

But behold, I am going today on the way of all the earth. 𝄓 And you will know with all your heart and with all your being, that not one word has fallen from all the good things that Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. The whole has come to you. Not one word has fallen from it.

And it will happen as had come upon you all the good word that Yahweh your God spoke to you, 𝄓 so Yahweh will bring upon you all the evil word until it exterminates you from off this good ground that Yahweh your God gave to you.

When you are bypassing the covenant of Yahweh your God that he commanded you, and you go and serve other gods and prostrate yourselves to them, 𝄓 then the anger of Yahweh will burn among you and you will perish swiftly from off the good land that he gave to you. P

And Joshua gathered all the sceptres of Israel towards Shechem, 𝄓 and called for the elders of Israel, and to its preeminent, and to its judges, and to its overseers, and they presented themselves before God.

And Joshua said to all the people, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Across the river, your ancestors settled of old, Terah the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor, 𝄓 and they served other gods.
And I took your father Abraham from beyond the river, and I led him in all the land of Canaan, 𝄓 and I increased his seed, and I gave to him Yitschaq.
And I gave to Yitschaq, Jacob and Esau. 𝄓 And I gave to Esau, the hill of Seir to possess it, and Jacob and his children descended to Egypt.
And I sent Moses and Aaron and I plagued Egypt as I have done among them, 𝄓 and afterwards I brought you out.
And I brought your ancestors out from Egypt, and you came toward the sea, 𝄓 and Egypt pursued after your ancestors by chariot and by cavalry, (the sea of reeds).

And they cried out to Yahweh, and he put gloom between you and the Egyptians, and brought on them the sea, and covered it and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt, 𝄓 and you inhabited in the wilderness many days.

And I brought you to the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants across the Jordan, and they fought you, 𝄓 and I gave them into your hand, and you possessed their land, and I exterminated them from your presence.

And I delivered you from the hand of Egypt, and from the hand of all who restricted you, 𝄓 and expelled them from before you, and I gave to you their land.
And I said to you, I am Yahweh your God. You will not fear the gods of the Amorites in whose land you have settled, 𝄓 but you did not hear with my voice. P

And the messenger of Yahweh came and sat under an elm which was in Ophrah, that was of Joash Abi the Ezraite, 𝄓 and Gideon, his son, was beating out wheat by the vat, to withdraw it from before Midian.
And the messenger of Yahweh appeared to him, 𝄓 and he said to him, Yahweh is with you, O valiant one of ability.

And Gideon said to him, O my Lord, so is Yahweh with us? Then why has all this found us? 𝄓 And where are all his wonders that our ancestors have recounted to us, saying, Did not Yahweh bring us up from Egypt? But now Yahweh has abandoned us and has given us into the palm of Midian.
And Yahweh faced him, and said, Go in this your power, and save Israel from the palm of Midian. 𝄓 Have not I sent you?
And he said to him, O my Lord, with what will I save Israel? 𝄓 Behold my drove is weak in Manasseh, and I myself of little account in the house of my father.
And Yahweh said to him, But I will be with you, 𝄓 and you will strike Midian as one person.
And he said to him, If, please, I have found grace in your eyes, 𝄓 then make me a sign that you are speaking with me.
Please do not deviate from here until I come to you, and I will bring out my gifts, that I will leave before you. 𝄓 And he said, I myself will sit till you return.

And Gideon went and he did a male kid of the she-goats and an ephah of flour of unleavened bread. The flesh he put in a woven pannier, and the broth he put into a kettle, 𝄓 that he brought out to him under the elm, and he came close. P
And the messenger of God said to him, Take the flesh and the unleavened bread and leave it on this craggy rock, and the broth, pour out. 𝄓 And he did so.

And the messenger of Yahweh extended the extremity of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened bread, 𝄓 and the fire came up from the rock and it devoured the flesh and the unleavened bread, and the messenger of Yahweh went from his sight.
And Gideon saw that he was the messenger of Yahweh, 𝄓 and Gideon said, Aye yai yai, my Lord Yahweh, for so I have seen the messenger of Yahweh face to face.
And Yahweh said to him, Peace to you. Do not fear. 𝄓 You will not die.
And Gideon built there an altar to Yahweh, and called it Yahweh is peace. 𝄓 To this day it is still in Ophrah of Abi the Ezraite. S

And it was in that night that Yahweh said to him, Take the young bull of the bull that is your father's, and a young bull, the second of seven years, 𝄓 and overthrow the altar of the Baal that is your father's. And the fetish that is by it, you will cut off.

And you will build an altar to Yahweh your God on the top of this stronghold in the arranged place. 𝄓 And you will take the young bull, the second, and offer up a burnt offering with the wood of the fetish that you will cut off.
And Gideon took ten men from his servants, and he did as Yahweh spoke to him. 𝄓 And it was that he feared the house of his father and the men of the city to do it by day, so he did it by night.

And those of the city rose early in the morning, and behold, the altar of the Baal was broken down, and the fetish that was by it was cut off, 𝄓 and the young bull, the second, was offered up on the altar that was built.
And they said each to his friend, who has done this thing? 𝄓 And they searched out, and they sought, and they said, Gideon, child of Joash, he has done this thing.
And the men of the city said to Joash, Bring out your child, and he will die. 𝄓 Because he has broken down the altar of the Baal and because he has cut off the fetish that is by it.

And Joash said to all who were standing over him, You? Do you contend for Baal as if you can save him? Whoever will contend for him, let him be put to death while it is the morning. 𝄓 If he is God, let him contend for himself if someone broke down his altar.
And he called him in that day Jerubbaal, saying, 𝄓 Let the Baal contend against him. For he had broken down his altar. S
And all Midian, and Amalek, and the children of the east were gathered as one, 𝄓 and they crossed over and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.
But the spirit of Yahweh clothed Gideon, 𝄓 and he sounded the shophar, and Abiezer appealed, following him.
And messengers he sent in all of Manasseh, and he appealed also himself after him, 𝄓 and messengers he sent in Asher and in Zebulun and in Naphtali, and they came up to encounter them.
And Gideon said to God, 𝄓 If you will be saving Israel by my hand as you have spoken.

Behold, I will exhibit a fleece of wool on the threshing-floor. 𝄓 If the dew will be on the fleece only, and over all the earth is desert, then I will know that you will save Israel by my hand as you have spoken.
And it was so. And he rose up early on the morrow and closed up the fleece, 𝄓 and pressed out dew from the fleece, filling the tureen with water.

And Gideon said to God, Do not let your anger burn against me, and I will speak but this one time. 𝄓 I will prove, please, solely this one time, with the fleece. Let be, if you will, desert on the fleece only, and over all the earth, let there be dew.
And God did so in that night. 𝄓 And it was desert on the fleece only, and over all the earth was dew. P

And Jerubbaal (he is Gideon) rose up early and all the people that were with him, and they encamped by the spring of Apprehension. 𝄓 And the army of Midian was north of him from the hillock of Moreh in the valley. S
And Yahweh said to Gideon the people that are with you are too many for me to give Midian into their hands, 𝄓 lest Israel adorn themselves over me, saying, My hand has saved me.

So now call, please, in the ears of the people, saying, Who is fearful or apprehensive, let him return, and let them quit from the hill of the Gilead, 𝄓 and from the people twenty two thousand returned, ten thousand were still there. S

And Yahweh said to Gideon, Still the people are too many. Bring them down to the waters, and I will refine him for you there. 𝄓 And it will be that I will indicate to you, This will go with you. Such will go with you. And everyone that I will indicate to you, This will not go with you, such will not go.

And he brought the people down to the waters. 𝄓 And Yahweh said to Gideon, Everyone who laps with his tongue from the water, as the dog laps, you will exhibit him alone. And everyone who bows down on his knees to imbibe.
And this is the count of the lappers with their hands at their mouth, three hundred such. 𝄓 And all the remaining of the people bowed down on their knees to imbibe water. S
And Yahweh said to Gideon, With the three hundred men, the lappers, I will save you, and I will give Midian into your hand, 𝄓 and all the people will go each to his place.

And the people took victuals in their hands and the shophars, and everyone of Israel he sent each to his tent, and the three hundred men he encouraged. 𝄓 And the army of Midian was for him, beneath in the valley. P
And it was in that night that Yahweh said to him, Arise, go down into the camp, 𝄓 for I have given it into your hand.
And if you are fearful to descend, 𝄓 go down, you and Purah, your lad, to the camp.

And you will hear what they are speaking, and after, let your hands be encouraged, and descend to into the camp. 𝄓 And he descended and Purah his lad, to the limit of the groups of five that were in the camp.

And Midian and Amalek and all the children of the east were helter-skelter in the valley like the locust for abundance. 𝄓 And of their camels, there was no count, as the sand that is by the bank of the sea for abundance.

And Gideon came, and behold, a man recounting to his friend a dream. 𝄓 And he said, Behold a dream I have dreamed, and behold, quivering barley bread was overturning in the camp of Midian, and came to a tent and struck it, and it fell helter-skelter, and overturned upward, and fallen was the tent.
And his friend answered and he said, Oh no, this is nothing but the sword of Gideon, child of Joash, the man of Israel. 𝄓 God has given into his hand Midian and all the camp. P

And it happened when Gideon heard the recount of the dream, and its shattering, that he worshiped. 𝄓 And he returned to the army of Israel, and he said, Arise for Yahweh has given into your hand the army of Midian.
And he distributed the three hundred men into three gangs. 𝄓 And he gave shophars into the hand of all of them, and empty pitchers, and torches within the pitchers.
And he said to them, With me you will see, and so you will do. 𝄓 And behold I will come to the outskirts of the camp, and it will happen that what I do, so you will do.
When I sound the shophar, I and all that are with me, 𝄓 then you sound on the shophars, even you surrounding all the army, and you will say, For Yahweh and for Gideon. P

And Gideon came, and one hundred men that were with him, to the outskirts of the camp at the beginning of the central watch, (surely the guards were placed). 𝄓 And they sounded the shophars, and they smashed the pitchers which were in their hands.

And the three gangs sounded on the shophars, and they shattered the pitchers, and they were resolute in their left hand with the torches, and in their right hand, the shophars sounding, 𝄓 and they proclaimed, The sword, for Yahweh and for Gideon.
And they stood each in his space round about the camp, 𝄓 and all the army raced, and raised a shout, and withdrew.

And the three hundred shophars sounded, and Yahweh set the sword of each against his friend, and in all the camp. 𝄓 And the army withdrew to Bethshittah toward Tsererat to the bank of Abel-Mecholah by Tabbath.
The men of Israel mobilized from Naphtali, and from Asher, and from all Manasseh. 𝄓 And they pursued after Midian.

And Gideon sent messengers in all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down to encounter Midian, and catch them at the waters to Bethbarah and the Jordan, 𝄓 and every man of Ephraim mobilized, and they caught at the waters to Bethbarah and the Jordan.

And they caught the two chiefs of Midian, Raven and Wolf, and they slew Raven at Raven rock, and Wolf they slew at the wine-vat of Wolf, and they pursued to Midian. 𝄓 And the head of Raven and Wolf they brought to Gideon from beyond Jordan.
And they said to him, each of Ephraim, What is this thing that you have done to us without calling to us when you went to fight in Midian? 𝄓 And they contended with him resolutely.
And he said to them, What have I done now according to you? 𝄓 Is it not better to glean grapes in Ephraim than to gather grapes in Abiezer?
Into your hands God has given the chiefs of Midian, Raven and Wolf, and what was I able to do according to you? 𝄓 Then their spirit slackened from against him when he spoke this word.
And Gideon came to the Jordan. 𝄓 He passed beyond, and the three hundred men that were with him, exhausted but in pursuit.
And he said to the men of Sukkoth, Give please round loaves of bread for the people that are with my survey, 𝄓 for they are exhausted, and I pursue after Zebah and Tsalmuna, the kings of Midian.
And the chiefs of Sukkoth said, Is the palm of Zebah and Tsalmuna now in your hand, 𝄓 that we should give bread to your host?
And Gideon said, Therefore when Yahweh gives Zebah and Tsalmuna into my hand, 𝄓 I will thresh your flesh with the brambles of the wilderness and the briers.
And he went up from there to Penuel, and he spoke to them such as this, 𝄓 and the men of Penuel answered him as had answered the men of Sukkoth.
And he said also to the men of Penuel, saying, 𝄓 When I return in peace, I will break down this tower. P

And Zebah and Tsalmuna were in Qarqor, their armies with them, about five thousand, all that remained from all the camp of the children of the east. 𝄓 And there were fallen a hundred and twenty thousand men that drew a sword.
And Gideon went up to the way of those who dwell in tents, east to Woof and Yogbehah. 𝄓 And he struck the camp (and the camp was trusting).
And Zebah and Tsalmuna withdrew, but he pursued after them. 𝄓 And he conquered the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Tsalmuna, and all the camp was apprehensive.
And Gideon, child of Joash, returned from the battle, 𝄓 from the ascent of a hot sun.
And he caught a youth of the men of Sukkoth, and inquired of him. 𝄓 And he described to him the chiefs of Sukkoth and her seventy seven elders.

And he came to the men of Sukkoth, and he said, Behold Zebah and Tsalmuna, 𝄓 with whom you reproached me, saying, Is the palm of Zebah and Tsalmuna now in your hand that we should give bread to your tired men?
And he took the elders of city and the brambles of the wilderness, and the briers, 𝄓 and he acquainted everyone of Sukkoth with them.
And the tower of Penuel was broken down, 𝄓 and he slew everyone of the city.
And he said to Zebah and Tsalmuna, What were the persons that you slew at Tabor? 𝄓 And they said, Like you, like them. Each one like the form of the children of the king.
And he said, My kin, children of my mother they were. 𝄓 Yahweh lives. If only you had kept them alive, I would not have slain you.
And he said to Yether, his firstborn, Arise. Slay them. 𝄓 And the lad would not draw his sword, for he feared, for he was yet a youth.

And Zebah said and Tsalmuna, Arise yourself and intervene against us, as a man of his valour. 𝄓 And Gideon arose and he slew Zebah and Tsalmuna, and he took the crescents that were on the necks of their camels. P
And they said, everyone of Israel to Gideon, Govern among us, even you, even your child, even a child of your child, 𝄓 for you have saved us from the hand of Midian.
And Gideon said to them, I myself will not govern among you. And my child will not govern among you. 𝄓 Yahweh, he will govern among you.
And Gideon said to them, I have a request from you, a request that you give me each the earring of his spoil. 𝄓 (For gold earrings they had, for they were Ishmaelites.)
And they said, To give, we will give. 𝄓 And they spread a shawl, and they cast there each an earring of his spoil.

And the weight of the golden earrings that he asked for was a thousand seven hundred of gold, 𝄓 besides the crescents and the drops and the garments of purple that were on the kings of Midian, and besides the pendants that were on the necks of camels.
And Gideon made it into an ephod, and he exhibited it in his city, in Her-Dust, and all Israel prostituted themselves after it there. 𝄓 And it was for Gideon and for his house, a trap.
And Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they did not again lift up their heads, 𝄓 and the land was quiet a forty year span in the days of Gideon. P
And Jerubbaal child of Joash went, and returned to his house.
And for Gideon, there were seventy children who came forth from his thigh, 𝄓 for there were many women for him.
And his courtesan who was in Shechem gave birth to a child for him, she also. 𝄓 And he set his name, Abimelek.
And Gideon, child of Joash, died with good grey hair. 𝄓 And he was entombed in the tomb of Joash, his father, in Her-Dust of Abi the Ezraite. P
And it happened when Gideon died, that the children of Israel turned and prostituted themselves after the Baalim. 𝄓 And they set up for themselves Baal, a covenant for God.
And the children of Israel did not remember Yahweh their God, 𝄓 who had delivered them from the hand of all their enemies round about.
And they did not do kindness with the house of Jerubbaal, Gideon, 𝄓 according to all the good that he had done for the people of Israel. P
And Abimelek, child of Jerubbaal, went towards Shechem to the kin of his mother, 𝄓 and he spoke to them, and to all the families of the house of the father of his mother, saying,

Speak please in the ears of all the superiors of Shechem, How much better for you to be governed by seventy persons, all the children of Jerubbaal, than that one person govern among you? 𝄓 And remember that your bone and your flesh am I.
And the kin of his mother spoke about him, in the ears of all the superiors of Shechem, all these words. 𝄓 And their heart bent after Abimelek, for they said, Our kin he is.
And they gave to him seventy pieces of silver from the house of Baal of a covenant, 𝄓 and with them Abimelek contracted empty-headed and reckless men, and they went following him.

And he entered the house of his father at Her-Dust, and he slew his kin, the children of Jerubbaal, seventy persons on one stone, 𝄓 but Jotham child of Jerubbaal, the youngest, was left, for he camouflaged himself. S
And all the superiors of Shechem gathered and all the house of Millo, and they went and they made Abimelek to reign as king, 𝄓 by the oak monument that was in Shechem.
And they told Jotham. And he went and stood at the top of the hill of Gerizim, and he lifted up his voice, and he called, 𝄓 and said to them, Hear me, superiors of Shechem, and may God hear you.
Walking, the trees walked to anoint over them a king, 𝄓 and they said to the olive tree, Reign over us.
And to them said the olive tree, Should I set aside my sleekness, how by me they glorify God and persons, 𝄓 and go and totter over the trees?
And the trees said to the fig tree, 𝄓 Come. You be king over us.
And to them said the fig tree, Should I set aside my sweetness and my good profit, 𝄓 and go and totter over the trees?
And the trees said to the vine, 𝄓 Come. You be king over us.
And to them said the vine, Should I set aside my new wine that gladdens God and persons, 𝄓 and go and totter over the trees?
And all the trees said to the brierpatch, 𝄓 Come. You be king over us.

And the brierpatch said to the trees, If in truth you anoint me to be king over you, enter, take refuge in my shadow. 𝄓 But if there is nothing, let fire go forth from the brierpatch, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

So now, if in truth and completeness you have dealt, and have made Abimelek king, 𝄓 and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and with his house, and if for the recompense of his hands you have dealt him,
(How my father warred over you, 𝄓 and he cast his very self in front of, and delivered you from the hand of Midian),

But you, you have arisen over the house of my father today, and you have slain his children, seventy persons on one stone, 𝄓 and have made Abimelek king, child of his maidservant, over the superiors of Shechem, for your kin he is.
So if in truth and completeness you have dealt with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, 𝄓 be glad in Abimelek and let him be glad also among you.

But if there is nothing, let fire go forth from Abimelek, and let it devour the superiors of Shechem and the house of Millo, 𝄓 and let fire go forth from the superiors of Shechem and from the house of Millo, and let it devour Abimelek.
And Jotham withdrew and ran away, and went to Beer, 𝄓 and settled there away from the face of Abimelek, his brother. P
And Abimelek had influence over Israel three years.
And God sent a spirit of evil between Abimelek and the superiors of Shechem, 𝄓 and the superiors of Shechem acted treacherously with Abimelek,

That violence might come for the seventy children of Jerubbaal, 𝄓 and to set their blood against Abimelek, their kin, that he had slain them, and concerning the superiors of Shechem, who made his hands resolute to slay his kin.
And for him the superiors of Shechem set ambushes on the tops of the hills, and they robbed all that passed through by them in the way. 𝄓 And it was told to Abimelek. P
And Gaal, child of Ebed, came and his kin, and they crossed over into Shechem. 𝄓 And the superiors of Shechem trusted him.

And they went forth to the field, and gathered grapes from their vineyards, and they trod, and they played the fool, 𝄓 and they entered the house of their God, and they ate and they imbibed, and they slighted Abimelek.

And Gaal, child of Ebed said, Who is Abimelek and what is Shechem that we should serve him? Is not he a child of Jerubbaal, and Zebul, his officer? 𝄓 Let them serve the men of Hamor, the father of Shechem. Why then should we serve him ourselves?
And who will give this people into my hand, and I will put aside Abimelek. 𝄓 And he said to Abimelek, Increase your host and come out.
And Zebul the chief of the city heard the words of Gaal, child of Ebed, 𝄓 and his anger burned.
And he sent messengers to Abimelek through deceit, saying, 𝄓 Behold, Gaal, child of Ebed, and his kin are coming towards Shechem, and behold, they are fortifying the city against you.
So now, arise by night, you and the people who are with you, 𝄓 and lie in wait in the field.

And it will happen in the morning, as the sun is rising, you will rise up early and pillage the city. 𝄓 And behold, he and the people that are with him will come out to you, and you will do to him as your hand will find out.
And Abimelek arose and all the people that were with him by night, 𝄓 and they lay in wait against Shechem, four gangs.
And Gaal, child of Ebed, came out, and he stood at the door of the gate of the city, 𝄓 and Abimelek arose, and the people that were with him, from the ambush.
And Gaal saw the people, and said to Zebul, Behold, people are descending from the tops of the hills. 𝄓 And Zebul said to him, The shadow of the hills you are seeing, as if men.
And again further Gaal spoke, and he said, Behold, people are descending from the midpoint of the land, 𝄓 and the head of another comes from the way of the oak of the fortunetellers.
And Zebul said to him, Where is your mouth that said, Who is Abimelek that we should serve him? 𝄓 Is not this the people that you have refused? Go forth, if you will, now, and fight with him.
And Gaal came out before the superiors of Shechem, 𝄓 and fought with Abimelek.
And Abimelek pursued him and he withdrew before him. 𝄓 And many fell profaned, even to the door of the gate.
And Abimelek settled at Arumah. 𝄓 And Zebul expelled Gaal and his kin from settling in Shechem. S
And it happened afterwards that the people came out into the field. 𝄓 And they told Abimelek.

And he took the people and he distributed them into three gangs, and they lay in wait in the field. 𝄓 And he saw and behold, the people went out from the city, and he arose against them and struck them.
And Abimelek and the gangs that were with him pillaged. And they stood at the door of the gate of the city. 𝄓 And the two gangs pillaged over all that were in the field, and they struck them.
And Abimelek warred with the city all that day, and he conquered the city, and the people that were in it, he slew. 𝄓 And he broke down the city and sowed it with salt. P
And all the superiors of the tower of Shechem heard, 𝄓 and they came to the rookery of the house of a covenant God.
And it was told to Abimelek, 𝄓 that all the superiors of the tower of Shechem had collected themselves.

And Abimelek went up the hill of Salmon, he and all the people that were with him. And Abimelek took a wedge into his hand and cut from the entwining trees, and he lifted it up and put it on his backside. 𝄓 And he said to the people that were with him, Did you see what I have done? Be swift and do as I have.

And all the people cut also, each an entwined branch, and they went after Abimelek to put it in the rookery, and they charred them in the rookery with fire. 𝄓 And they died, even all the persons of the tower of Shechem, about a thousand, man and woman. P
And Abimelek went to Tebets, 𝄓 and encamped against Tebets and conquered it.

And a strong tower was in the midst of the city, and there all the men and the women withdrew and all the superiors of the city, and they locked it behind them, 𝄓 and they came up onto the roof of the tower.
And Abimelek came even to the tower and fought against it. 𝄓 And he made overture even to the door of the tower, to incinerate it with fire.
And one woman cast a slice of a rider-stone on the head of Abimelek, 𝄓 and damaged his skull.
And he called swiftly to the lad, his cargo bearer, saying to him, Draw your sword and put me to death, lest they say of me, A woman slew him. 𝄓 And his lad thrust him through and he died.
And the men of Israel saw that Abimelek was dead, 𝄓 and they went each to his place.
And God returned the evil of Abimelek, 𝄓 that he had done to his father, to slay his seventy brothers.
And all the evil of the men of Shechem, God returned on their heads. 𝄓 And the slight of Jotham child of Jerubbaal came to them. P
And after Abimelek, there arose to save Israel Tola, child of Puah, child of Dodo, a man of Issachar, 𝄓 and he sat in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
And he judged Israel twenty three years. 𝄓 And he died, and he was entombed in Shamir. P
And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, 𝄓 and he judged Israel twenty two years.
And he had thirty children who rode on thirty colts, and thirty cities they had. 𝄓 They are called the municipality of Jair to this day, that are in the land of the Gilead.
And Jair died, and was entombed in Qamon. P

And again the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of Yahweh, and they served Baalim and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Aram and the gods of Sidon, and the gods of Moab and the God of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, 𝄓 and they forsook Yahweh and did not serve him.
And the anger of Yahweh burned in Israel, 𝄓 and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
And they harried and damaged the children of Israel in that year, 𝄓 eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were across the Jordan in the land of the Amorites that is in Gilead.
And the children of Ammon crossed over Jordan to fight even in Judah and in Benjamin and in the house of Ephraim, 𝄓 and there was much adversity for Israel.
And the children of Israel appealed to Yahweh, saying, 𝄓 We have sinned against you, both when we have forsaken our God, and when we have served Baalim. P
And Yahweh said to the children of Israel, 𝄓 Not from Egypt? but from the Amorites? but from the children of Ammon? but from the Philistines?
And the Sidonians, and Amalek, and Maon have gripped you. 𝄓 And you cried out to me, and I saved you from their hand.
But you, you have forsaken me, and you have served other gods, 𝄓 therefore not again will I save you.
Go and appeal to the gods whom you have chosen. 𝄓 Them, let them save you at the time of your trouble.
And the children of Israel said to Yahweh, We have sinned. You do to us all that is good in your eyes, 𝄓 but deliver us, please, this day.
And they put aside the alien gods from among them, and served Yahweh, 𝄓 and reaped he was, in the misery of Israel. P
And the children of Ammon cried out and encamped in Gilead, 𝄓 and the children of Israel gathered and encamped in Mizpah.
And the people said, the chiefs of Gilead, each to his friend, Who is the man who will start to fight with the children of Ammon? 𝄓 He will be the head for all the inhabitants of Gilead. P
Jephthah of the Gilead was valiant and forceful, and he was a child of a woman of harlotry. 𝄓 And Gilead had Jephthah.

And the wife of Gilead gave birth to sons for him, 𝄓 and the children of the wife grew, and they expelled Jephthah, and they said to him, You will not inherit in the house of our father, for you are a child of another woman.
And Jephthah ran away from the face of his brothers, and settled in the land of Tov. 𝄓 And empty-headed men picked up with Jephthah and went forth with him. P
And it happened regularly, 𝄓 that the children of Ammon fought the people of Israel.
And it happened that as the children of Ammon fought the people of Israel, 𝄓 that the elders of Gilead went to lay hold of Jephthah from the land of Tov.
And they said to Jephthah, Come and be our dictator, 𝄓 that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, Did you yourselves not hate me and expel me from the house of my father? 𝄓 Why then have you come to me now when trouble is yours?
And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, Therefore now we turn to you that you would go with us and fight with the children of Ammon, 𝄓 and be our head for all the inhabitants of Gilead.
And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, If you restore me to fight against the children of Ammon, and Yahweh gives them before me, 𝄓 I myself will be your head?
And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, 𝄓 Yahweh will be the one who hears between us, if according to your word, we will not so do.
And Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead and the people set him in place over them to be head and to be dictator, 𝄓 and Jephthah spoke all his words in the presence of Yahweh in Mizpah. P
And Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, 𝄓 What have I to do with you that you come to me to fight in my land?

And the king of the children of Ammon said to the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took my land when they came up from Egypt, from the Arnon and to the Jabboq and to the Jordan. 𝄓 So now restore these in peace.
And Jephthah added yet more, 𝄓 and he sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon,
And said to him, Thus says Jephthah, 𝄓 Israel did not take the land of Moab, or the land of the children of Ammon.
But when they came up from Egypt, 𝄓 Israel went into the wilderness to the sea of reeds, and came toward Qadesh.

And Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, Let me cross over, please, through your land, but the king of Edom did not hear, and he sent also to the king of Moab, and he did not consent. 𝄓 So Israel settled in Qadesh.

Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom and the land of Moab, and came from the rising of the sun to the land of Moab, and encamped beyond the Arnon, 𝄓 but did not come into the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
And Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon, 𝄓 and Israel said to him, Let us pass through, please, in your land to my place.
But Sihon did not have faith to let Israel pass through his borders, and Sihon gathered all with him, and encamped in Jahats, 𝄓 and fought the people of Israel.
So Yahweh, the God of Israel, gave Sihon and all with him into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. 𝄓 And Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that land.
And they possessed all the border of the Amorites, 𝄓 from the Arnon and to the Jabboq, and from the wilderness and to the Jordan.
And now Yahweh, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorite before the people of Israel, 𝄓 and you would dispossess us?
What Kemosh your God has possessed for you, it, will you not possess? 𝄓 So all whom Yahweh our God has dispossessed from before us, it, we will possess.
So now, are you any better than Balak child of Zippor, the king of Moab? 𝄓 Did he strive against the people of Israel or was he at war with them,

While Israel inhabited Heshbon and her built-up areas, and Aroer and her built-up areas, and in all the cities that are adjacent to the Arnon, three hundred years? 𝄓 Why then did you not deliver at that time?
And I myself, I have not sinned against you, but you deal evil with me to fight against me. 𝄓 Let Yahweh, the judge, judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
But the king of the children of Ammon, 𝄓 did not hear the words of Jephthah that he sent to him. P

And the spirit of Yahweh happened over Jephthah, and he passed through all the Gilead and Manasseh, 𝄓 and he passed through Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed through to the children of Ammon.
And Jephthah vowed a vow to Yahweh and said, 𝄓 If giving, you will give the children of Ammon into my hand,

Then it will be that the one who emerges, who emerges from the portals of my house to encounter me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, 𝄓 it will be for Yahweh, and I will offer it up as a burnt offering. P
And Jephthah passed through to the children of Ammon to fight with them, 𝄓 and Yahweh gave them into his hand.

And they struck them from Aroer and till you come to Minnith, twenty cities, and to the Lament of vineyards, a very great strike, 𝄓 and the children of Ammon were brought to heel before the children of Israel. P
And Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house, and behold his daughter emerged to encounter him, with timbrels and with dance, 𝄓 and she was his one and only. He had from himself no other son or daughter.

And it was when he saw her that he ripped his garments and said, Aye yai yai, my daughter. Bowed down, I am made to bow down, and you have become one who agitates me, 𝄓 and I myself have set free my mouth to Yahweh, and I am not able to bring it back.

And she said to him, My father, you have set free your mouth to Yahweh. Do to me as it was brought forth from your mouth. 𝄓 After all, Yahweh has done vengeance for you from your enemies, from the children of Ammon.
And she said to her father, Let this thing be done for me. 𝄓 Desist with me two months, that I may go and come down over the hills, and weep over my virginity, myself and my friends.
And he said, Go. And he sent her away two months, 𝄓 and she went, she and her friends, and wept over her virginity on the hills.
And it happened at the end of two months that she returned to her father, and he did to her his vow that he had vowed, 𝄓 and she had not known a man. And it became a statute in Israel,
Regularly, the daughters of Israel would go to pay respect to the daughter of Jephthah of the Gilead, 𝄓 four days in the year. P

And the men of Ephraim mobilized and passed through the north, 𝄓 and they said to Jephthah, Why did you pass through to fight with the children of Ammon, and you did not call us to go with you? Your house we will incinerate over you with fire.
And said Jephthah to them, A man in much contention I was, I and my people and the children of Ammon, 𝄓 And I appealed with you, and you would not save me from their hand.

When I saw that it was not for you to save, I put my group in my palm, and I passed over to the children of Ammon, and Yahweh gave them into my hand. 𝄓 So why do you come up to me this day to fight against me?

And Jephthah collected all the men of Gilead and fought Ephraim. 𝄓 And the men of Gilead struck Ephraim, for they said, You of Gilead, secured from Ephraim, were in the midst of Ephraim, were in the midst of Manasseh.

But Gilead conquered the fords of the Jordan to Ephraim. 𝄓 And it was that when those secured from Ephraim said, Let me cross over, the men of Gilead would say to him, Of Ephraim are you? And he said, No.

Then they said to him, Say please, Stalks of grain. And he said, Socks. And he could not prepare to speak thus, then they grasped him and butchered him at the fords of the Jordan. 𝄓 And fell at that time from Ephraim, forty two thousand.
And Jephthah judged Israel six years. 𝄓 And Jephthah of the Gilead died, and he was entombed in the cities of Gilead. P
And after him, Ivtson from Bethlehem judged Israel.
And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters he sent abroad. And thirty daughters he brought for his sons from abroad. 𝄓 And he judged Israel seven years.
And Ivtson died and he was entombed in Bethlehem. P
And after him, Elon the Zebulonite judged Israel, 𝄓 and he judged Israel ten years.
And Elon the Zebulonite died, 𝄓 and he was entombed in Ailon in the land of Zebulun. P
And judged Israel after him, 𝄓 Abdon, child of Hillel, the Pirathonite.
And there was for him forty sons and thirty sons, children who rode on seventy colts. 𝄓 And he judged Israel eight years.
And Abdon, child of Hillel the Pirathonite died, 𝄓 and he was entombed in Pirathon, in the land of Ephraim, in the hill of the Amalekites. P
And again the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of Yahweh, 𝄓 and Yahweh gave them into the hand of the Philistines a forty year span. P
And there was one man of Tsarah from the family of Dan and his name was Manoax, 𝄓 and his wife was barren and had not given birth.
And the messenger of Yahweh appeared to the woman, 𝄓 and he said to her, Behold, if you will, barren one, you that have not given birth, but you will become pregnant and will give birth to a son.
So now keep watch, if you will, and do not imbibe wine or strong drink, 𝄓 and do not eat anything defiled.

For behold you are pregnant and will give birth to a son. Alteration will not come up on his head, for a Nazirite of God the lad will be from the belly, 𝄓 and he will start to save Israel from the hand of the Philistines.

And the woman came and she said to her man, saying, A man of God came to me, and his appearance was as the appearance of a messenger of God, to be much feared, 𝄓 but I did not ask him where he was from and his name he did not tell me.

And he said to me, Behold, you are pregnant, and will give birth to a son. 𝄓 So now do not imbibe wine or strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean, for a Nazirite of God the lad will be from the belly, until the day of his death. P
And Manoax petitioned Yahweh, and he said, O my Lord, let the man of God that you sent come, if you will, yet again to us, 𝄓 that he may instruct us what we should do for the lad to be born.
And God heard with the voice of Manoax, and the messenger of God came yet again to the woman, and she was sitting in the field, 𝄓 and Manoax her man was not with her.
And the woman was swift and she raced and told her man, 𝄓 and she said to him, Behold the man appeared to me, that came the other day to me.
And arose Manoax and went after his wife, 𝄓 and he came to the man, saying to him, Are you the person that spoke to the woman. And he said, I am.
And Manoax said, Now let your words enter. 𝄓 What will be the framework for the lad that we will make for him?
And the messenger of Yahweh said to Manoax, 𝄓 From all that I said to the woman, she will keep watch.
From all that emerges from the vine of wine, she will not eat, and wine and strong drink she will not imbibe, and anything unclean she will not eat. 𝄓 All that I commanded her, she will keep watch. S
And Manoax said to the messenger of Yahweh, 𝄓 Let us detain you please, and let us make before you a male kid of the she-goats.

And the messenger of Yahweh said to Manoax, Though you detain me, I will not eat of your bread, and if you will do a burnt offering, to Yahweh you will offer it up. 𝄓 For Manoax did not know that he was the messenger of Yahweh.
And Manoax said to the messenger of Yahweh, What is your name? 𝄓 When your word comes, then we will glorify you.
And the messenger of Yahweh said to him, Why is it that you ask for my name? 𝄓 For it is wonderful. P
And took Manoax a male kid of the she-goats and the gift and offered them up on the rock to Yahweh. 𝄓 And it was a wonder to do it, and Manoax and his wife saw.

And it happened as the flame came up from the altar towards the heavens, the messenger of Yahweh went up in the flame of the altar, 𝄓 and Manoax and his wife saw, and they fell onto their faces earthward.
But the messenger of Yahweh did not again further appear to Manoax and his wife. 𝄓 Then Manoax knew that he was the messenger of Yahweh.
And Manoax said to his wife, to die we will die, 𝄓 for God, we have seen.

Then his wife said to him, If Yahweh delighted to have us die, he would not take from our hands a burnt offering and a gift, and would not show us all these, 𝄓 nor at this time make us hear such as this.
And the woman gave birth to a son, and she called his name Samson, 𝄓 and the lad grew and Yahweh blessed him.
And the spirit of Yahweh started to pulse him at times in the camp of Dan, 𝄓 between Tsarah and Eshtaol. P
And Samson went down to Timnah, 𝄓 and saw a woman in Timnah from the daughters of the Philistines.
And he came up and told his father and his mother, and he said, A woman I have seen in Timnah from the daughters of the Philistines. 𝄓 And now take her for me as wife.

And his father and his mother said to him, Is there no woman among the daughters of your kin and among all my people that you would go to take a woman from the fore-skinned Philistines? 𝄓 And Samson said to his father, Take her for me, for this is upright in my eyes.
And his father and his mother did not know that this was from Yahweh, for he sought an opportunity from the Philistines, 𝄓 and at that time, the Philistines were proverbial in Israel.
And Samson went down, and his father and his mother, to Timnah. 𝄓 And they came to the vineyards of Timnah, and behold, a lion cub roared when encountering him.

And the spirit of Yahweh thrived on him, and he rived him as he would have riven a male kid, and there was nothing whatever in his hand, 𝄓 but he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.
And he went down and he spoke to the woman. 𝄓 And she was upright in the eyes of Samson.
And he returned regularly to take her, and he turned aside to see the fallen lion. 𝄓 And behold, a colony of bees was in the body of the lion, and honey.

And he ruled it into his palms, and he went meandering and eating. And he went to his father and his mother, and he gave to them, and they ate. 𝄓 But he did not tell them that from the body of the lion, he had ruled the honey.
And his father went down to the woman. 𝄓 And Samson made a party there, for so youths in their prime will do.
And it was as they saw him, 𝄓 that they took thirty associates, and they were with him.

And Samson said to them, I have a riddle now for you, a riddle. 𝄓 If you will make it clear to me in the seven days of the party, and you find out, then I will give you thirty linen sheets, and thirty renewed garments.
And if you are not able to tell me, then you will yourselves give to me thirty linen sheets and thirty renewed garments. 𝄓 And they said to him, Riddle your riddle, and we will hear it.
And he said to them, From the eater emerged food, and from the strong emerged sweetness. 𝄓 But they were not able to tell the riddle, three days.

And it was on the seventh day, and they said to the wife of Samson, Cajole your man, and let him make clear for us the riddle lest we incinerate you and the house of your father in fire. 𝄓 Have you called us to dispossess us? Is it not?

And the wife of Samson wept over him, and she said, Certainly you hate me, and you do not love me. Have you riddled a riddle for the children of my people, and to me you have not told it? 𝄓 And he said to her, Behold, my father and my mother I did not tell. To you will I tell?
And she wept over him the seven days that was their party. 𝄓 And it was on the seventh day that he told her, for she impeded him, and he told the riddle for the children of her people.

And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the hot sun had set, What is sweeter than honey and what is stronger than a lion? 𝄓 And he said to them, if you had not ploughed with my calf, you would not have found my riddle.

And the spirit of Yahweh thrived on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck of them thirty men. And he took their gear, and he gave the renewals to those who told the riddle. 𝄓 And his anger burned, and he went up to the house of his father.
And she became, the wife of Samson, 𝄓 his associate's, who was his friend. P

And it was from the days in the days of the wheat harvest, and Samson visited his wife with a young kid of the she-goats, and he said, I will go in to my wife, the inner room. 𝄓 But her father would not permit him to come in.
And her father said, I figured that you hated her, so I gave her to your friend. 𝄓 Is not her younger sister better than she? Let her be yours, if you will, instead of her.
And Samson said to them, I will be acquitted this one time from the Philistines, 𝄓 though I do them a disservice.
And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes. 𝄓 And he took torches, and faced tail to tail, and set one torch between two tails, in the midst.
And he kindled fire in the torches, and he sent into the risen corn of the Philistines, 𝄓 and kindled a rich heap, both to the risen corn and to vineyard and olive.

And the Philistines said,Who has done this? And they said, Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, for he took his wife and gave her to his friend. 𝄓 And the Philistines came up and they cremated her and her father with fire.
And Samson said to them, Though you have done such as this, 𝄓 without fail, I will be avenged among you, and after I will refrain.
And he struck them leg over thigh, a great striking. 𝄓 And he went down and he settled in the apex of the cliff of Eitam. P
And the Philistines came up and encamped in Judah, 𝄓 and let out their tendrils in the Jawbone.
And the men of Judah said, Why have you come up to us? 𝄓 And they said, To bind Samson we have come up, to do to him as he has done to us.

And three thousand men came down from Judah to the apex of the cliff of Eitam. And they said to Samson, Do you not know that the Philistines are governors among us. So what is this that you have done to us? 𝄓 And he said to them, As they have done to me, so I have done to them.
And they said to him, To bind you we have come down, to give you into the hand of the Philistines. 𝄓 And Samson said to them, Swear to me, lest you intervene against me yourselves.
And they said to him, saying, No. For to bind, to bind you and to give you into their hand. But to die? You will not die. 𝄓 And they bound him with two new cords and brought him up from the cliff.

He came to Jawbone, and the Philistines were jubilant to encounter him. 𝄓 And the spirit of Yahweh thrived on him and the cords that were on his arms were like flax that was kindled with fire, and his bonds melted from his hands.
