And he found a fresh jawbone of an ass. 𝄓 And he extended his hand and took it. And he struck with it a thousand men.
And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, homer of homers. 𝄓 With the jawbone of the ass I struck a thousand men.
And it happened as he finished speaking, that he cast the jawbone from his hand. 𝄓 And he called that place, the high ground of Jawbone.

And he was very thirsty and he called to Yahweh, and he said, You yourself have given, by the hand of your servant, this great victory, 𝄓 but now I will die from thirst, and fall into the hand of the fore-skinned.

And God split the deep hollow that was in Jawbone, and water came forth from it, and he imbibed, and his spirit returned, and he lived. 𝄓 Therefore he called its name, the spring of the one calling, that is in Jawbone to this day.
And he judged Israel, in the days of the Philistines, twenty years. P
And Samson went to Gaza, 𝄓 and saw there a woman of harlotry, and he came to her.

To the Gazites it was said, Samson has come here. And they surrounded and they lay in wait for him all the night long by the gate of the city. 𝄓 And were silent all the night long, saying, Until the light of the morning, then we will slay him.

And Samson was laid out until midnight. And he arose at midnight and he held fast the portals of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and he pulled them out with the bar, that he put on his shoulders, 𝄓 and brought them up to the top of the hill that faces Hebron. P
And it was after such that he loved a woman in the wadi of Noble Vine, 𝄓 and her name was Delilah.

And to her the chieftains of the Philistines came up, and said to her, Seduce him, and see in what is his great power, and by what we might be able against him, that we might bind him to afflict him, 𝄓 and we will each give to you a thousand one hundred of silver.
And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, please, in what is your great power? 𝄓 And by what could you be bound to afflict you?
And Samson said to her, If you bind me with seven fresh bow-strings that not been drained and dried, 𝄓 then I will sicken, and I will be as any other human.
And to her the chieftains of the Philistines brought up seven fresh bow-strings that not been drained and dried, 𝄓 and she bound him with them.

And an ambush was sitting in her inner room, and she said to him, The Philistines are upon you, Samson. 𝄓 And he snapped the bow-strings as the tossed out lace is snapped when it smells fire, and his power was not known.
And Delilah said to Samson, Now you deluded me, and spoke to me lies. 𝄓 Now tell me please, with what could you be bound?
And he said to her, If binding, they bind me with new cords that have not been dealt with in a line of work, 𝄓 then I will sicken, and I will be as any other human.

And Delilah took new cords, and she bound him with them, and said to him, The Philistines are upon you, Samson. And an ambush was sitting in the inner room. 𝄓 And he snapped them from his arms like thread.

And Delilah said to Samson, Until now you have deluded me, and spoke to me lies. Tell me, with what could you be bound? 𝄓 And he said to her, if you weave seven renewed braids of my head with the warp of the web.
And she stuck with a peg, and she said to him, The Philistines are upon you, Samson. 𝄓 And he awoke from his sleep, and pulled out with the peg, the shuttle, and the warp of the web.
And she said to him, How can you say, I love you, and your heart is not with me? 𝄓 This is three times you deluded me and have not told me in what is your great power.
And it would be that she stressed him with her words every day, and badgered him, 𝄓 and he was discouraged to the point of death.

And he told her all his heart, and said to her, No alteration has come up on my head, for a Nazirite of God I am from my mother's belly. 𝄓 If I am shaven, then my power will turn aside from me, and I will sicken, and I will be like all humanity.

And Delilah saw that he had made clear to her all his heart. And she sent, and she called the chieftains of the Philistines, saying, Come up this one time, for he has made clear to me all his heart. 𝄓 And the chieftains of the Philistines came up to her, and they brought up the silver pieces in their hand.
And she made him sleep on her knees, and she called for a man, and she shaved seven renewed braids of his head, 𝄓 and she started to afflict him, and his power was turned aside from him.

And she said, The Philistines are upon you, Samson. 𝄓 And he awoke from his sleep, and he said, I will come out as time after time and brush myself off, and he did not know that Yahweh had turned aside from him.
And the Philistines held him fast, and they quarried out his eyes, 𝄓 and brought him down to Gaza, and they bound him with brass chains, and he did grind in the house of bondage.
But the hair on his head started to grow after he was shaved. P
And the chieftains of the Philistines were gathered to offer a great offering to Dagon, their God, and to be glad. 𝄓 And they said, Our God has given into our hands Samson, our enemy.
And the people saw him and they praised their God, 𝄓 for they said, Our God has given into our hands our enemy, and the one draining our land, and who increased our profaned.

And it was when their heart was merry that they said, Call Samson, that he may make us laugh. 𝄓 So they called Samson from the house of bondage, and he made sport facing them, and they had him stand between the pillars.
And Samson said to the lad who was encouraging him by his hand, Guide me that I may feel the pillars on which the house is established, 𝄓 that I may lean against them.
So the house was filled with the men and the women. And there were all the chieftains of the Philistines. 𝄓 And on the housetop, three thousand men and women, staring while Samson made them laugh.

And Samson called to Yahweh, and he said, My Lord Yahweh, remember me please, and encourage me please, but this one time, O God, 𝄓 that I may take vengeance, vengeance once for my two eyes, from the Philistines.
And Samson tussled with the two central pillars on which the house was established and was supported, 𝄓 one with his right hand, and the other with his left hand.

And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he stretched out in power, and the house fell on the chieftains, and on all the people that were in it. 𝄓 And the dead that he had put to death in his death, were many more than he had put to death in his life.

And his kin came down and all the house of his father and lifted him up, and they came up and they entombed him between Tsarah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoax his father. 𝄓 And he judged Israel twenty years. P
And there was a man from mount Ephraim, and his name was Mikayahu [Who-is-like-Yah].

And he said to his mother, the thousand, one hundred silver pieces which was taken of yours, and you sobbed, and even talked of in my ears, behold the silver is with me. I myself took it. 𝄓 Then said his mother, Blessed be you, my child, of Yahweh.

And he returned the thousand, one hundred silver pieces to his mother. 𝄓 And his mother said, The holy. I have made the silver holy to Yahweh, from my hands to my son, to make a graven image and of molten metal, so now I will return them to you.

And he returned the silver to his mother. 𝄓 And his mother took two hundred silver pieces and gave them to the refiner, and he made a graven image and of molten metal, and it was in the house of Mikayahu.
And the man, Micah, his was the house of God. 𝄓 And he made an ephod and healing images and he filled the hand of one from among his children, and he become his priest.
In those days there was no king in Israel. 𝄓 Everyone did what was upright in its own eyes. P
And there was a youth from Bethlehem of Judah from the family of Judah, and himself a Levite, 𝄓 and he was a guest there.
And the man came out of the city, from Bethlehem of Judah, to reside wherever he could find. 𝄓 And he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah in the making of his way.
And Micah said to him, From where do you come? 𝄓 And he said to him, I am a Levite, from Bethlehem of Judah, and I myself walk to reside wherever I can find.

And Micah said to him, Settle with me, and be for me father and priest, and I myself will give to you ten silver pieces for the days, and will arrange for garments and your living. 𝄓 And the Levite strutted.
And the Levite was humoured to settle with the man. 𝄓 And the youth became to him as one of his children.
And Micah filled the hand of the Levite and the youth became his priest, 𝄓 and was in the house of Micah.
And Micah said, Now I know that Yahweh will do good for me, 𝄓 for the Levite has become my priest. P

In those days there was no king in Israel. 𝄓 And in those days, the sceptre of the Danites sought for itself to settle an inheritance. For until that day the inheritance had not fallen to it among the sceptres of Israel. P

And the children of Dan sent from their family, five persons from their shores, persons of children of ability, from Tsora and from Eshtaol, to survey the land and to examine it, and they said to them, Go. Examine the land. 𝄓 And they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and they lodged there.

They were with the house of Micah, and they recognized the voice of the Levite lad, 𝄓 and they turned aside there and they said to him, Who brought you here? And what are you doing in this? And what do you have here?
And he said to them, As this and as this, Micah has done for me, 𝄓 And he has hired me, and I am his priest.
And they said to him, Ask, if you will, in God, 𝄓 that we may know which way for us will be prosperous, that we may go in it.
And the priest said to them, Go in peace. 𝄓 Straightforward of Yahweh is your way that you are going in. P

And the five persons went and they came to Laish. 𝄓 And they saw the people that were within her, settled, trusting, according to the framework of Sidonians, quiet and trusting. And there was no humiliating matter in the land. Dispossession could be coerced. Distant they were from Sidon, and they were without interaction with humanity.
And they came to their kin, to Tsora and Eshtaol, 𝄓 and their kin said to them, What is with you?
And they said, Arise. Let us go up over them, for we have seen the land, and behold it is very good. 𝄓 But you, are you becalmed? Do not be slothful to go, to enter, to possess the land.
When you come, you come to a trusting people, and the land is broad of means, 𝄓 for God has given her into your hand, a place where there is no lack of every thing that is in the earth.
And they migrated from there, from the family of Dan, from Tsora and from Eshtaol, 𝄓 six hundred, each attired with instruments of battle.
And they came up to and encamped in the town of Yearim in Judah. 𝄓 Therefore they call that place the camp of Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind the town of Yearim.
And they crossed over mount Ephraim from there, 𝄓 and they came to the house of Micah.

And the five persons who went to survey the land of Laish answered, and they said to their kin, Do you know that there is in those houses an ephod, and healing images, and a graven image, and a molten image, 𝄓 so now make known what you will do.
And they turned aside there, and they came to the house of the lad, the Levite, the house of Micah, 𝄓 and asked him for peace.
And six hundred, each attired with instruments of their battle, stood firm at the door of the gate, 𝄓 (who were from the children of Dan).

And the five persons who went to survey the land went up, entered there, took the graven image and the ephod and the healing images and the molten image. 𝄓 And the priest was standing firm at the door of the gate, and the six hundred, each attired with the instruments of the battle.
And these came to the house of Micah, and they took graven image, the ephod, and the healing images, and the molten image. 𝄓 And the priest said to them, What you are doing?

And they said to him, Silence. Set your hand over your mouth, and go with us, and be for us father and priest. 𝄓 Is it better for you to be a priest of the house of one man, or for you to be a priest for a sceptre and for a family in Israel?
And the heart of the priest was merry and he took the ephod, and the healing images, and the graven image, 𝄓 and went within the people.
And they faced about, 𝄓 and they went, and they put the little ones, and the livestock, and the glory before them.
They had distanced themselves from the house of Micah, 𝄓 and the men that were in the houses that were beside the house of Micah appealed, and followed the children of Dan closely.
And they called out to the children of Dan, and they turned round their faces, 𝄓 and they said to Micah, What is it to you that you appeal?
And he said, My gods that I have made, you have taken, and the priest, and you walk away, and what is mine any more? 𝄓 And What is this? you say to me, What is it to you?
And the children of Dan said to him, Let not your voice be heard with us, 𝄓 lest provocative persons come across you, and your very self be gathered, and those of your household.
And the children of Dan went their way. 𝄓 And Micah saw that they were resolute compared to him, and he faced about and returned to his house.

And they took what Micah had done and the priest that was his, and they came against Laish, against a people quiet and trusting, and they struck them with the edge of the sword, 𝄓 and the city they incinerated in the fire.

And there was none to deliver, for it was far from Sidon, and they were without interaction with humanity, and it was in the valley that is of the house of Rekob. 𝄓 And they built the city and they settled in it.
So they called the name of the city Dan, in the name of Dan their father, that was born to Israel. 𝄓 However, Laish was the name of the city at first.

And the children of Dan placed for themselves the graven image, 𝄓 and Jonathan child of Gershom, child of Manasseh, he and his children were priests for the sceptre of the Danites until the day of the exile of the land.
And they set up for themselves the graven image of Micah that he had made, 𝄓 all the days that the house of God was in Shiloh. P

And it happened in those days, (and there was no king in Israel), 𝄓 that there was a man, a Levite, residing by the flanks of mount Ephraim, and he took for himself a wife, a courtesan from Bethlehem of Judah.
And his courtesan played the harlot on him, and she went from him to the house of her father, to Bethlehem of Judah. 𝄓 And she was there for days, four months.

And her man arose, and he went after her to speak to her heart, to restore her. And his lad with him, with a pair of asses. 𝄓 And she had him come to the house of her father, and the father of the lass saw him and he was glad to encounter him.
And his father-in-law encouraged him, the father of the lass, and he settled with him three days, 𝄓 and they ate and they imbibed and they lodged there.

And it was on the fourth day and they rose early in the morning, and he arose to go. 𝄓 But the father of the lass said to his son-in-law, Find sustenance for your heart, a fragment of bread, and afterwards you will go.
And they sat and they ate, the two of them as one, and they imbibed. 𝄓 And the father of the lass said to the man, Be humoured, if you will, and stick around. And let your heart be merry.
And the man arose to go, 𝄓 and his father-in-law urged him, and he turned and lodged there.

And he rose up early in the morning on the fifth day to go, but the father of the lass said, Find sustenance, if you will, for your heart. And they lingered until the day declined, 𝄓 and they ate, the two of them.

And the man arose to go, he and his courtesan, and his lad. 𝄓 And his father-in-law said to him, the father of the lass, Behold, if you will, day slackens to the evening. Lodge, if you will. Behold, the day hovers. Lodge here, and let your heart be merry, and rise early tomorrow to journey to go to your tent.
And the man did not consent to lodge, and he arose and he walked away, and came to be opposite Yebus. (This is Jerusalem). 𝄓 And with him was a pair of asses saddled. And his courtesan was with him.
They were beside Yebus, and the day was wrapped excessively. 𝄓 And the lad said to his master, Come, please, and let us turn aside to this city of the Jebusite, and lodge in it.
And his master said to him, We will not turn aside to a foreign city who are not from the children of Israel, 𝄓 but we will pass through to Gibeah.
And he said to his lad, Come, let us draw near to one of the places. 𝄓 And we will lodge in Gibeah or in Ramah.
And they passed by and they went. 𝄓 And the sun set on them next to Gibeah, that is of Benjamin.
And they turned aside there to enter to lodge in Gibeah, 𝄓 and he came and sat in the plaza of the city, and there was no-one to billet them in a house to lodge.
And behold, an old man came from his task, from the field in the evening, and the man was from mount Ephraim, and he was a guest in Gibeah, 𝄓 and the men of the place were Benjaminites.
And he lifted up his eyes, and he saw the wayfarer in the plaza of the city, 𝄓 and the old man said, Where are you going, and where have you come from?

And he said to him, We are passing through from Bethlehem of Judah to the flanks of mount Ephraim. From there I am. And I went to Bethlehem of Judah and to the house of Yahweh I am going. 𝄓 And there was no-one to billet me in a house.
And there is both straw and also silage for our asses, and also bread and wine there is for me, and for your maidservant, and for the lad with your servants. 𝄓 There is no lack of any thing.
And old the man said, Peace to you, but all your deprivation be against me. 𝄓 Only in the plaza, do not lodge.
And he brought him to his own house, and gave fodder to the asses. 𝄓 And they washed their feet, and they ate and they imbibed.

They made their heart merry and behold, those of the city, the incurables of the children of worthlessness, surrounded the house, knocking on the gateway. 𝄓 And they said to the old man, the owner of the house, saying, Bring out the man that came to your house that we may know him.
And the man came out to them, the owner of the house, and he said to them, No, my kin. Do no evil, please. 𝄓 After all, this man has entered my house. You will not do this senselessness.
Behold my maiden daughter and his courtesan. Let me bring them out please, and afflict them, and do to them what is good in your sight. 𝄓 But to this man, you will not do this senseless thing.

But the men would not consent to hear him, and the man was resolute with his courtesan, and brought out to them outside. 𝄓 And they knew her, and were wanton with her all the night long till the morning, and they sent her away as the dawn ascended.
And the woman came before the morning, 𝄓 and fell at the door of the house of the man where her master was, until it was light.

And her master arose in the morning, and opened the gateways of the house, and came out to go his way, 𝄓 and behold the woman, his courtesan, fallen at the door of the house, and her hands were on the threshold.
And he said to her, Arise and we will go. And there was no answer. 𝄓 And he took her on the ass, and the man arose, and he went to his place.
And he entered his house, and he took the knife, and he was resolute with his courtesan, and he cut her to her bones in twelve pieces, 𝄓 and he sent her into every border of Israel.

And that is all that was seen. And he said, Never has been and never was seen such as this since the day the children of Israel came up from the land of Egypt to this day. 𝄓 Set it in place for yourselves. Take counsel, and speak. P
And all the children of Israel went forth and convened the assembly as one person from Dan and to Beer-Sheva and the land of the Gilead, 𝄓 to Yahweh at Mizpah.
And they presented themselves, the faces of all the people, all the sceptres of Israel in the congregation of the people of God, 𝄓 four hundred thousand men on foot that drew a sword. P
And the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah, 𝄓 and the children of Israel said, Speak. How was this evil?
And the Levite man answered, (the man of the wife that was murdered), and said, 𝄓 Toward Gibeah that is of Benjamin I came, I and my courtesan, to lodge.
And the superiors of Gibeah arose over me and they surrounded, against me, the house by night. 𝄓 Me they supposed they had slain, and my courtesan they afflicted, and she died.
And I grasped my courtesan, and cut her in pieces, and I sent her out into all the country of the inheritance of Israel, 𝄓 for they have done lewdness and senselessness in Israel.
Behold, all of you are the children of Israel. 𝄓 Provide for yourselves a word and counsel here.
And all the people arose as one person, saying, 𝄓 We will not go, anyone to his tent, nor will anyone turn aside to his own house.
And now, this is the thing that we will do to Gibeah, 𝄓 against it by lot.

We will take ten men of a hundred for all the sceptres of Israel, and one hundred of a thousand, and a thousand of ten thousand, to lay hold of provender for the people, 𝄓 that they may do, when they come to Geba of Benjamin, according to all the senselessness that it has done in Israel.
And everyone of Israel was gathered against the city as one person, cobbled together. P
And the sceptres of Israel sent men through all the sceptre of Benjamin, saying, 𝄓 What evil is this that is among you?

And now yield the men, the children of worthlessness, who are in Gibeah, and we will put them to death, and we will shrive evil from Israel. 𝄓 But the children of Benjamin would not consent to hear with the voice of their kin, the children of Israel.
And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves out of the cities toward Gibeah, 𝄓 to go forth to battle with the children of Israel.
And the children of Benjamin conscripted in that day from the cities, twenty six thousand men that drew a sword, 𝄓 besides the inhabitants of Gibeah, who conscripted seven hundred chosen men.
From all this people, seven hundred men chosen were hampered in the right hand. 𝄓 All these could sling with a stone at a hair and not miss. P
And the men of Israel had conscripted, besides Benjamin, four hundred thousand men that drew a sword, 𝄓 everyone a man of war.

And they arose and they came up to the house of God and asked in God, and the children of Israel said, Who will go up for us at the start to war with the children of Benjamin? 𝄓 And Yahweh said, Judah will start.
And the children of Israel arose in the morning, 𝄓 and they encamped by Gibeah.
And the men of Israel came forth to war with Benjamin, 𝄓 and the men of Israel arranged themselves for battle against Gibeah.
And the children of Benjamin went forth out of Gibeah, 𝄓 and destroyed among Israel in that day, twenty two thousand men, earthward.
And the people were resolved, the men of Israel, 𝄓 and they again arranged for battle in the place where they had arranged on the first day.

And the children of Israel came up and wept in the presence of Yahweh until evening, and asked Yahweh, saying, Will we again make overture to fight with the children of Benjamin, my brother? 𝄓 And Yahweh said, Go up to him. P
And the children of Israel approached the children of Benjamin on the second day.
And Benjamin came forth to encounter them from Gibeah on the second day, and destroyed among the children of Israel yet again, eighteen thousand men earthward. 𝄓 All these drew a sword.

And all the children of Israel came up, and all the people. And they entered the house of God and wept. And they sat there before Yahweh, and fasted in that day till evening, 𝄓 and offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings in the presence of Yahweh.
And the children of Israel asked Yahweh, 𝄓 (for there was the ark of the covenant of God in those days,

and Phineas child of Eleazar child of Aaron stood before it in those days), saying, Will I again further go forth to fight with the children of Benjamin my brother, or should I refrain? 𝄓 And Yahweh said, Go up, for tomorrow I will give him into your hand.
And Israel set up ambushes for Gibeah round about. P
And the children of Israel came up to the children of Benjamin on the third day, 𝄓 and arranged themselves against Gibeah as the pulse in the anvil.

And the children of Benjamin went forth to encounter the people. 𝄓 And they were detached from the city, and they started to strike the people, profaning as the pulse in the anvil, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and one toward Gibeah in the field, about thirty men in Israel.
And the children of Benjamin said, Plagued they are before us, as at the beginning. 𝄓 But the children of Israel said, Let us withdraw, and detach them from the city to the highways.
And all the men of Israel arose from their place, and arranged themselves at Baal Tamar, 𝄓 and those in the ambush for Israel burst out from their place, from the exposed places of Geba.
And they came, evident to Gibeah, ten thousand chosen men from all Israel, and the battle was glorious, 𝄓 and they did not know that evil touched them. P
And Yahweh plagued Benjamin in the face of Israel, and the children of Israel destroyed Benjamin in that day, twenty five thousand one hundred men. 𝄓 All these drew a sword.
And the children of Benjamin saw that they were plagued. 𝄓 And the men of Israel gave place for Benjamin, for they trusted to the ambush that they had set against Gibeah.
And those in ambush hurried and pillaged Gibeah, 𝄓 and those in ambush drew out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.
And the engagement was for the men of Israel with the ambush, 𝄓 that they should make ascend an abundant lifting up of smoke from the city.

And the men of Israel changed in the battle, 𝄓 and Benjamin started to strike and profane against the men of Israel, about thirty persons, for they said, Surely they will be plagued before us as in the first battle.
And when the lifting up started to ascend from the city, the pillar of smoke, 𝄓 Benjamin faced behind himself, and behold a whole offering ascended from the city towards the heavens.
And the men of Israel changed and the men of Benjamin were vexed, 𝄓 for they saw that evil had touched them.
And they faced about before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, and the battle followed them closely. 𝄓 And those from the cities, they destroyed in their midst.
They encircled Benjamin. They pursued them as if at rest. They trod them, 𝄓 until opposite Gibeah from the rising of the sun.
And Benjamin fell, eighteen thousand men. 𝄓 All these persons of ability.

And they faced about and withdrew towards the wilderness, to the cliff of the pomegranate [Rimmon], 𝄓 and they shackled in the highways, five thousand men, and followed closely after them until Gidom [Chopped Down] and they struck from them two thousand men.
And all the fallen from Benjamin were twenty five thousand men that drew a sword in that day. 𝄓 All these persons of ability.
And six hundred men faced about and withdrew towards the wilderness to the cliff of Rimmon, 𝄓 and they settled at the cliff of Rimmon four months.

And the men of Israel returned to the children of Benjamin, and they struck them with the edge of the sword from the city, complete, to beast, to everyone who was found. 𝄓 Furthermore, all the cities that were found, they dismissed in fire. P
And the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, 𝄓 Not one of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as wife.
And the people came to the house of God, and they sat there until evening before God. 𝄓 And they lifted up their voice and wept, a great weeping.
And they said, Why, Yahweh, O God of Israel, has this happened in Israel, 𝄓 that one sceptre is visited today from Israel?
And it happened afterwards that the people rose early, and they built there an altar, 𝄓 and offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings. P

And the children of Israel said, Who did not come up with the congregation from all the sceptres of Israel to Yahweh? 𝄓 For the great oath was for one who had not come up to Yahweh to Mizpah, saying, He will be put to death.
And the children of Israel sighed concerning Benjamin their kin, 𝄓 and said, Truncated today is one sceptre from Israel.
What will we do for them for the remaining of them for wives, 𝄓 when we swore in Yahweh that we will not give them our daughters as wives?
And they said, Which is the one from the bands of Israel that did not come up to Yahweh, to Mizpah? 𝄓 And behold, not one had come to the camp from Jabesh Gilead to the congregation.
And they took a census of the people, 𝄓 and behold there was no one there from the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead.

And the assembly sent there twelve thousand men from the children of ability, 𝄓 and commanded them, saying, Go and strike those inhabiting Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, and the women and the little ones.
And this is the thing that you will do, 𝄓 every male and every woman known to have lain with a male, you will utterly destroy.

And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred virgin lasses who had not known a man by lying with a male, 𝄓 and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh that is in the land of Canaan. P
And all the assembly sent and they spoke to the children of Benjamin who were at the cliff of Rimmon, 𝄓 and they called to them in peace.
And Benjamin returned at that time, and they gave them the women that they allowed to live from the women of Jabesh Gilead, 𝄓 but they had not found for them rightly.
And the people sighed for Benjamin, 𝄓 for Yahweh had made a breach among the sceptres of Israel.
And the elders of the assembly said, What will we do for the remaining of them for wives, 𝄓 for woman is exterminated from Benjamin?
And they said, The possession of security for Benjamin, 𝄓 that a sceptre from Israel is not wiped out.
But we ourselves are not able to give them wives from our daughters, 𝄓 for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed who gives a woman to Benjamin. S
And they said, Behold the feast of Yahweh in Shiloh regularly, that is the north of Bethel, east toward the sun on the highway ascending from Bethel towards Shechem, 𝄓 and south of Lebonah.
And they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, 𝄓 Go and lie in wait in the vineyards.

And see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh emerge to dance in the dance, then you will come forth from the vineyards and seize for you each his wife from the daughters of Shiloh, 𝄓 and go to the land of Benjamin.

And it will be that when their fathers or their brothers come to contend against us, that we will say to them, Be gracious with them, for we did not take each his wife in the battle. 𝄓 But you yourselves did not give them at this time. You would have borne guilt. S

And the children of Benjamin did so, and they took wives for their count from from the dancers that they had robbed, 𝄓 and they went and returned to their inheritance, and they rebuilt the cities and they settled in them.
And the children of Israel went from there at that time, each to its own band and its own family, 𝄓 and they went forth from there, each to its inheritance. P
In those days there was no king in Israel. 𝄓 Everyone did what was upright in its own eyes. W
And there was one man from the exalted lookout of Mount Ephraim, 𝄓 and his name was Elkanah, child of Jeroham, child of Elihu, child of Tohu, child of Zuph, an Ephrathite.
And he had two wives. The name of one Hannah and the name of the second, Peninnah. 𝄓 And Peninnah had succession, but Hannah had no succession.
And that man used to go up from his city regularly to worship and to offer to Yahweh of hosts in Shiloh. 𝄓 And there, the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phineas, were priests of Yahweh.
And it was the day Elkanah was offering, 𝄓 and he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters,
And to Hannah he gave one double-sized portion, 𝄓 for he loved Hannah but Yahweh had placed a bar on her womb.
And her adversary grieved her also, such grief as to make her thunderous, 𝄓 because Yahweh had placed a bar about her womb.
And so he did year in year out. As often as she came up to the house of Yahweh, so she grieved her, 𝄓 and she wept and did not eat.
And Elkanah her man said to her, Hannah, why do you weep, and why do you not eat, and why is your heart hurting? 𝄓 Am I not better to you than ten children?
And Hannah arose after she had eaten in Shiloh and after she had imbibed, 𝄓 and Eli the priest sat on the throne over the posts of the temple of Yahweh.
But she was provoked of being, 𝄓 and she prayed to Yahweh and weeping she wept.

And she vowed a vow and she said, Yahweh of hosts, if seeing, you see, into the poverty of your maidservant and remember me and do not forget your maidservant and you give to your maidservant a seed of men, 𝄓 then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and alteration will not come up on his head.
And it happened that she prayed to excess in the presence of Yahweh, 𝄓 and Eli was watching her mouth.
And she, Hannah, was speaking in her heart, but her lips were wavering to and fro and her voice was not heard, 𝄓 so Eli reckoned she was intoxicated.
And Eli said to her, How long will you be intoxicated? 𝄓 Put aside your wine from you.
And Hannah answered and she said, No, my lord, a woman of a hardened spirit am I. Neither wine nor strong drink have I imbibed, 𝄓 but I have poured out my being in the presence of Yahweh.
Do not take your maidservant as the face of a daughter of worthlessness, 𝄓 for out of the abundance of my blathering and grief I have spoken till now.
And Eli answered and said, Go in peace, 𝄓 and the God of Israel grant your request that you have asked with him.
And she said, May your handmaid find grace in your eyes. 𝄓 And the woman went on her way and she ate, and her face was no longer for herself.
And they rose up early in the morning and worshiped in the presence of Yahweh and returned, and they came to their house towards Ramah. 𝄓 And Elkanah knew Hannah, his wife, and Yahweh remembered her.
And it happened in due course of the days after Hannah became pregnant, that she gave birth to a son, 𝄓 and she called his name Samuel, for she had requested him from Yahweh.
And the man Elkanah would go up, and all his house, 𝄓 to offer to Yahweh an offering regularly, and his vow.
And Hannah did not come up, 𝄓 for she said to her man, Till the lad is weaned. Then I will bring him so he may appear before Yahweh and settle there for evermore. P

And Elkanah her man said to her, Do what is good in your eyes. Settle till you have weaned him. Surely Yahweh will uphold his word. 𝄓 And the woman settled and her son suckled, till she had weaned him.

And she brought him up with her when she had weaned him, with three young bulls and one ephah of flour and a skin-bottle of wine, and she brought him to the house of Yahweh in Shiloh. 𝄓 And the lad was a youth.
And they butchered the young bull, 𝄓 and they brought the lad to Eli.
And she said, O my lord, as lives your being, my lord, 𝄓 I am the woman that took her stand with you in this, praying to Yahweh.
For this lad I prayed, 𝄓 and Yahweh has given to me my request that I asked from him.
And furthermore I, myself, put him forward for Yahweh. All the days that are his, he is put forward for Yahweh. 𝄓 And he worshiped Yahweh there. P
And Hannah prayed and she said, My heart is elated in Yahweh. My horn is exalted in Yahweh. 𝄓 Open wide is my mouth over my enemies for I am glad in your salvation.
There is none holy like Yahweh, for there is nothing without you, 𝄓 and none a rock like our God.
Not with excess speak with the haughtiness of the haughty to let arrogance come out from your mouth, 𝄓 for a God of knowledge is Yahweh and of him, stabilized are practices.
The bow of the valiant ones is dismayed, 𝄓 and they that stumble are girded with ability.
Those sated find themselves earning bread and the famished are given relief, 𝄓 until the barren has given birth to seven, and of many children is enfeebled.
Yahweh puts to death and gives life, 𝄓 descends to Sheol and ascends.
Yahweh dispossesses and enriches, 𝄓 abases, also, celebrates,
raises from dust the weak, from the dump, exalts the needy to sit with princes and the throne of glory to inherit, 𝄓 for to Yahweh are the distresses of the earth and he has set on them the world.
The feet of those who are under his mercy he will keep and the wicked in the darkness are mute, 𝄓 for not in power does anyone prevail.

Yahweh will dismay those who strive over him. In the heavens he thunders. Yahweh makes the case for the ends of the earth, 𝄓 and he gives strength to his king and he will exalt the horn of his anointed. P
And Elkanah went towards Ramah to his house. 𝄓 And the lad became minister of Yahweh in the presence of Eli the priest.
And the children of Eli were children of worthlessness. 𝄓 They did not know Yahweh.
And the judgment of the priests is with the people. 𝄓 Everyone offers an offering and the priest's lad comes as the flesh is boiling and the three pronged fork is in his hand.

And he strikes into the chafing pan or into the pannier or into the cauldron or into the kettle. All that he brings up in the fork the priest takes for himself. 𝄓 Thus they did for all Israel when they came there into Shiloh.
