And a traveler came to the rich man and he pitied taking from his own flock or from his own herd to do for his wayfarer that came, 𝄓 so he took the young lamb of the man in want and did for the man that came to him.
And the anger of David burned against the man excessively, 𝄓 and he said to Nathan, Yahweh lives, but a son of death the man is who does this.
And the young lamb he will repay fourfold, 𝄓 inasmuch as he has done this thing and in that he had no pity. S
And said Nathan to David, You are the man. 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel, I myself anointed you king over Israel, and I myself delivered you from the hand of Saul.

And I gave to you the house of your lord, and the wives of your lord into your bosom, and I gave to you the house of Israel and Judah, 𝄓 and if little, I would have added for you like these and like these.

Why have you despised the word of Yahweh and do evil in his sight? Uriah the Hittite you have struck with the sword, and his wife you have taken as your wife, 𝄓 And him you have slain with the sword of the children of Ammon.
So now sword will not turn aside from your house for evermore, 𝄓 inasmuch as you have despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be as your wife. S

Thus says Yahweh, Note me well raising up against you evil from your own house. And I will take your wives in your sight and I will give to your friend, 𝄓 and he will lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.
Because you, you had acted in secret, 𝄓 but I, I will do this thing in front of all Israel and before the sun. S
And David said to Nathan, I have sinned for Yahweh, 𝄓 and Nathan said to David, Yea, Yahweh, has transferred your sin. You will not die.
The end is that the enemies of Yahweh will spurn and blaspheme in this matter, 𝄓 So even the son born to you, to die he will die.
And Nathan went to his house. 𝄓 And Yahweh plagued the newborn which the wife of Uriah gave birth to for David, and it was incurable.
And David sought out this God about the lad, 𝄓 and David fasted a fast, and went in and bode the time, and lay down earthward.
And the elders of his house arose over him to raise him up from the earth, 𝄓 and he did not consent and he ingested with them no bread.

And it was on the seventh day and the newborn died. 𝄓 And the servants of David feared to tell him that the newborn was dead, for they said, Just look when the newborn was living, we spoke to him but he did not hear with our voice. So why would we say to him, The newborn is dead? For he will do himself injury.
And David saw that his servants were worried, and David understood that the newborn was dead. 𝄓 And David said to his servants, Is the newborn dead? And they said, He is dead.

And David arose from the earth, and he washed, and put on makeup, and renewed his habit, and entered the house of Yahweh, and worshiped. 𝄓 And he entered his own house and asked that they might set bread for him and he ate.
And his servants said to him, What is this thing that you have done? 𝄓 On behalf of the living newborn, you fasted and wept, and when the newborn was dead, you arose and ate bread.
And he said, While the newborn lived, I fasted and I wept, 𝄓 for I said, Who knows whether Yahweh will be gracious and let the newborn live?
So now he is dead, why should I do this fasting? Am I able to make him yet return? 𝄓 I am going to him, but he will not return to me.
And David comforted Bathsheva his wife, and he came to her and he lay down with her. 𝄓 And she gave birth to a son, and she called his name Solomon, and Yahweh loved him.
And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he called his name Beloved-of-Yah, 𝄓 on behalf of Yahweh. P
And Joab fought in Rabbah of the children of Ammon, 𝄓 and he conquered the city of the kingdom.
And Joab sent messengers to David, 𝄓 and said, I have fought against Rabbah. Yea, I have conquered the city of the waters.
So now, gather the remaining of the people, and encamp against the city and conquer it, 𝄓 lest I myself conquer the city and my name be called over it.
And David gathered all the people and went towards Rabbah, 𝄓 and fought against it and conquered it.

And he took the crown of their king from his head and it weighed a talent of gold and precious stone, and there it was on the head of David. 𝄓 And the spoil of the city he brought out in excessive abundance.

And the people that were in it he brought out, and he set up with saws, and with flails of iron, and with parts of iron, and employed them in brick-making, and so he did to all the cities of the children of Ammon, 𝄓 and David returned and all the people to Jerusalem. P
And it was after such a thing. And Absalom, son of David, had a beautiful sister, and her name was Tamar. 𝄓 And Amnon, son of David, loved her.
And Amnon was so in anguish that he made himself ill over Tamar, his sister, for a virgin she was. 𝄓 And it would be a wonder in the eyes of Amnon to do to her anything whatever.
But Amnon had a friend, and his name was Yonadab, child of Shema, the brother of David, 𝄓 and Yonadab was a very shrewd person.
And he said to him, Why are you thus, the weak son of the king, from morning to morning? Will you not tell me? 𝄓 And Amnon said to him, Tamar, the sister of Absalom, my brother. I am in love.

And Yonadab said to him, Lie down on your litter and make yourself ill. 𝄓 When your father comes to see you, then say to him, Let Tamar my sister come, please, and pick me a meal of bread, and let her make the meal in my sight in order that I may see and eat by her hand.

And Amnon lay down and made himself ill. 𝄓 And the king came to see him. And Amnon said to the king, Let Tamar my sister come, please, and make a hearty cake in my sight, two hearty cakes that I may soar from her hand.
And David sent to Tamar towards the house, saying, 𝄓 Go please to the house of Amnon, your brother, and make him the meal.
And Tamar went to the house of Amnon, her brother, and he was lying down. 𝄓 And she took the dough, and kneaded, and made a hearty cake before his eyes, and boiled a succulent hearty cake.
And she took the skillet that she infused before him, but he would not eat. 𝄓 And Amnon said, Let every man go out from me and every man went out from him.

And Amnon said to Tamar, Bring the meal to the inner room, that I may soar from your hand. 𝄓 And Tamar took the hearty cakes that she had made, and brought them to Amnon her brother, into the inner room.
And she came close for him to eat. 𝄓 And he resolutely took hold of her and said to her, Come lie with me, my sister.
And she said to him, No, my brother. Do not afflict me, for such is not done in Israel. 𝄓 You will not do this senselessness.
And I, where will I go with my reproach? And you will be as one of the senseless in Israel. 𝄓 And now, speak please to the king, for he will not withhold me from you.
But he did not consent to hear with her voice. 𝄓 And he resolutely took hold of her, and afflicted her, and lay down with her.
Then Amnon hated her with a very great hatred. For the great hatred with which he hated her was more than the love with which he had loved her. 𝄓 And Amnon said to her, Arise. Go.
And she said to him, No rationale for this great evil. More than the other that you have done with me, to send me away. 𝄓 But he did not consent to hear her.
And he called his lad that ministered to him, and he said, Send please this away from me outside. 𝄓 And bolt the gateway after her.
And she had a many hued coat, for so were clothed the daughters of the king, the virgins, exterior cloaks. 𝄓 And his minister brought her out outside, and bolted the gateway after her.
And Tamar took ashes on her head. And the many hued coat that was over her, she ripped. 𝄓 And she put her hand on her head, and went on meandering, and appealing.

And Absalom her brother said to her, Has Amnon your brother been with you? And now my sister, be silent. He is your brother. Do not set your heart on this matter? 𝄓 And Tamar settled, and she was desolate in the house of Absalom, her brother.
And king David heard all these words. 𝄓 And he was burning with anger for himself, especially.
But Absalom did not speak with Amnon for evil or for good. 𝄓 For Absalom hated Amnon over the matter that he had afflicted Tamar his sister. P
And it was for two full years, and Absalom's shearers were at Baal Chatsor that is beside Ephraim. 𝄓 And Absalom called for all the sons of the king.
And Absalom came to the king and he said, Behold please, the shearers of your servant. 𝄓 Let the king please come, and his servants with your servant.
And the king said to Absalom, No, my child. Let not all of us go now, and let us not be heavy for you. 𝄓 And he had breached it, yet he did not consent to go. And he blessed him.
And Absalom said, If not, please let Amnon, my brother, go with us. 𝄓 And the king said to him, Why would he go with you?
But Absalom had breached him. 𝄓 And he sent with him Amnon, and all the sons of the king. S

And Absalom commanded his lads, saying, See, if you will, when the heart of Amnon is merry with wine, and I say to you, Strike Amnon. Then put him to death. Do not fear. 𝄓 Is it not I commanding you? Be courageous, and be children of force.
And the lads of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. 𝄓 And all the sons of the king arose, and they rode off each on his mule, and they withdrew.
And it happened they were on the way, and the report came to David, saying, 𝄓 Absalom has struck all the sons of the king, and there was not one left of them. P
And the king arose and he ripped his garments and lay down earthward. 𝄓 And all his servants stood firm, their garments ripped. S

And Yonadab child of Shema, the brother of David, answered and he said, Let not my lord say, All the lads of the king's children have died. For Amnon alone has died. 𝄓 For on the mandate of Absalom, it has been set from the day of his afflicting Tamar his sister.
So now, let not my lord the king set to his heart the matter, saying, All the sons of the king have died. 𝄓 In contrast, Amnon alone has died. P
And Absalom ran away. 𝄓 And the lad on lookout lifted up his eyes, and he saw, and behold, many people coming from a journey behind him, from the side of the hill.
And Yonadab said to the king, Behold the king's children come. 𝄓 As your servant spoke, so it is.
And it happened as he finished speaking. And, behold, the king's children came. And they lifted up their voice and wept. 𝄓 And also the king and all his servants wept, a very great weeping.
And Absalom ran away and went to Talmai, child of Ammihud, king of Geshur. 𝄓 And he lamented over his son every day.
And Absalom ran away and went to Geshur. 𝄓 And he was there three years.
And consumed was David the king to go forth to Absalom, 𝄓 for he was comforted over Amnon, for he was dead. S
And Joab child of Tseruyah, knew, 𝄓 that the heart of the king was on Absalom.

And Joab sent to Tekoa, and he took from there a shrewd woman. 𝄓 And he said to her, Lament please, and put on please, garments of lament, and do not make yourself up with oil, and be as a wife of lament, these many days, for what is dead.
And you will come to the king and speak to him like this word. 𝄓 And Joab put the words in her mouth.
And the Tekoan woman said to the king, and she fell on her nose earthward, and prostrated herself, 𝄓 and said, Save, O king. S
And the king said to her, What is it to you? 𝄓 And she said, Lamentably, a widow woman I am, and dead is my man.
And your handmaid had two sons, and they struggled, the two of them, in the field, and there was none to deliver between them, 𝄓 and the one struck the other and put him to death.

And behold all the family arose against your handmaid, and they said, Give the one who struck his kin, that we may put him to death for the integrity of his kin that he has slain, and we will exterminate also the heir. 𝄓 So they will quench my coal that is still here, so as not to lay up for my man, name or residue, over the face of the ground. P
And the king said to the woman, Go to your house, 𝄓 and I myself will command concerning you.
And the Tekoan woman said to the king, Concerning me, my lord O king, is the iniquity, and concerning the house of my father. 𝄓 And the king and his throne be innocent. S
And the king said, 𝄓 Whoever speaks to you, bring him to me, and he will not again any more touch you.

And she said, Let the king remember please, Yahweh your God, the excess of the redeemer of the blood to destroy, that they do not exterminate my child. 𝄓 And he said, Yahweh lives. Not a hair of your child will fall earthward.
And the woman said, Let your handmaid speak please, to my lord the king, a word. 𝄓 And he said, Speak. S
And the woman said, So why have you devised such as this against the people of God? 𝄓 For the king is speaking this word as if guilty, lest the king return his banished.
For to die, we will die, and are as water wrung out earthward, that will not be gathered, 𝄓 and God will not lift up a cadaver, but he devises devices, lest one being banished, be banished from him.

And now that I come to speak to the king, my lord, this thing, for the people have made me fear, 𝄓 and your handmaid said, I speak, please, to the king. Maybe the king will do the word of his maidservant.
For the king will hear to deliver his maidservant from the palm of the man, 𝄓 ... to exterminate me and my child as one from the inheritance of God.

And your handmaid said, Please, the word of my lord the king will be for rest. 𝄓 For like the angel of God, so is my lord the king to hear what is good or evil, and Yahweh your God will be with you. P
And the king answered and he said to the woman, Please do not conceal from me the word that I am asking you. 𝄓 And the woman said, Let, please, my lord the king speak.

And the king said, Is the hand of Joab with you in all this? 𝄓 And the woman answered and she said, As lives your integrity, my lord O king, if there is any to the right or to the left from all that my lord the king has spoken, for your servant Joab himself has commanded me, and he himself put in the mouth of your handmaid all these words.
It was to turn around the face of the matter that your servant Joab constructed this word, 𝄓 and my lord is wise as the wisdom of the messenger of God to know all that is in the land. S
And the king said to Joab, Behold, if you will, I have done this thing, 𝄓 so go, let the lad Absalom return.

And Joab fell to his face earthward, and prostrated himself, and blessed the king. 𝄓 And Joab said, Today your servant has known that I have found grace in your eyes, my lord, O king, in that the king has done the word of your servant.
And Joab arose and he went toward Geshur, 𝄓 and he brought Absalom to Jerusalem. S
And the king said, Let him circle around to his house, but my face, he will not see. 𝄓 And Absalom circled around to his house, and the face of the king, he did not see. S
But like Absalom there was not a man so much praised for beauty in all Israel. 𝄓 From the sole of his foot to his scalp there was not in him a spot.

And when he shaved his head, (and it was at the end of days and days that he shaved, when it was heavy over him then he shaved), 𝄓 then he weighed the hair of his head, two hundred shekels using the stone of the king.
And there were born to Absalom three sons and one daughter, and her name was Tamar. 𝄓 She was a woman beautiful of appearance. P
And Absalom settled in Jerusalem two years, 𝄓 but the face of the king he did not see.
And Absalom sent to Joab to send him out to the king, but he did not consent to come to him. 𝄓 And he sent further a second time, and he did not consent to come.
And he said to his servants, See the share of Joab adjacent to me, and his barley there. Go and char it in the fire. 𝄓 And the servants of Absalom charred the share in the fire. P
And Joab arose and he came to Absalom towards the house, 𝄓 and said to him, Why has your servant charred the share that is mine in the fire.

And Absalom said to Joab, Behold, I sent to you to say, Come here and I will send you out to the king to say, Why have I come from Geshur? It was better for me while I was there. And now let me see the face of the king. 𝄓 And if there is in me iniquity, then let him put me to death.

And Joab came to the king and made it clear to him, and he called to Absalom, and he came in to the king, and he prostrated himself to him on his nose earthward before the king. 𝄓 And the king kissed Absalom. S
And it happened afterward thus, that Absalom made for himself chariot and horses, 𝄓 and fifty men to race before him.

And Absalom rose up early and stood adjacent to the way of the gate. 𝄓 And it was for everyone for whom there was a contention, to come to the king for judgment, and Absalom called to him, and he said, What city are you from? And he said, Your servant is from one of the sceptres of Israel.
And Absalom said to him, See. Your matter is good and straightforward. 𝄓 But there is no one hearing for you from the king.
And Absalom said, Would that I were set up as judge in the land, 𝄓 and to me would come every man for whom there was a contention, and I would make righteous judgment for him.
And it was when anyone approached to prostrate themselves to him, 𝄓 that he would extend his hand, and resolutely hold him, and kiss him.
And Absalom would do a thing like this for anyone of Israel who came for judgment to the king. 𝄓 So Absalom stole the heart of the men of Israel. P
And it happened at the end of a forty year span, 𝄓 and Absalom said to the king, Let me go, please, that I may repay my vows that I have vowed to Yahweh in Hebron.
For your servant vowed a vow when I was settled in Geshur among the Aramaeans, saying, 𝄓 If Yahweh will return me to Jerusalem, then I will serve Yahweh.
And the king said to him, Go in peace. 𝄓 And he arose and he went toward Hebron. P
And Absalom sent spies among all the sceptres of Israel, saying, 𝄓 When you hear the voice of the shophar, then you will say, Absalom reigns in Hebron.
And Absalom went with two hundred men from Jerusalem who were called, 𝄓 and they went in their naivety, and did not know any thing.

And Absalom sent for Axitophel the Gilonite, the counselor of David, from his city, from Giloh, while he was offering sacrifices. 𝄓 And the collusion was assured, and the people were led and were abundant with Absalom.
And a herald came to David, saying, 𝄓 The heart of everyone of Israel is after Absalom.

And David said to all his servants that were with him in Jerusalem, Arise, and let us run, for there will not be security for us from the face of Absalom. 𝄓 Move swiftly to go, lest he move swiftly and overtake us, and impel evil against us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.
And the servants of the king said to the king, 𝄓 Everything my lord the king will choose, behold your servants.
And the king went out and all his house on foot, 𝄓 and the king delegated ten women courtesans to guard the house.
And the king went out and all the people on foot, 𝄓 and they stood at a distant house.

And all his servants passed through by his hand, and all the Cheretites, and all the Pelethites, 𝄓 and all the Gittites, six hundred men from Gath, who came on his pilgrimage, passing through in the presence of the king. S
And the king said to Ittai the Gittite, Why do you go, even you, with us? 𝄓 Return and sit with the king, for you are a foreigner, and moreover, an exile you are from your place.
Recently you came, and today should I make you a walking vagabond with us and I walking wherever I walk? 𝄓 Return, and return with your kin, your people, with kindness and truth.
And Ittai answered the king, and he said, 𝄓 Yahweh lives and my lord the king lives. Rather in the place where my lord the king will be, whether for death, or for life, there your servant will be.
And David said to Ittai, Come and pass through. 𝄓 And Ittai the Gittite passed through, and all his men, and every little one that was with him.
And all the land wept with a great voice, and all the people passed through. 𝄓 And the king passed through the wadi Kidron, and all the people passed through, facing the way through the wilderness.

And behold even Zadok and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God, and they impeded the ark of God, and Abiatar went up, 𝄓 until all the people completed crossing over from the city. S
And the king said to Zadok, Let the ark of God return to the city. 𝄓 Rather let me find grace in the eyes of Yahweh, and he will return me, and he will show me both him and his home.
But if thus he says, I have no delight in you. 𝄓 Here I am. He will do to me as is good in his eyes. S
And the king said to Zadok the priest, You are a seer. Return to the city in peace, 𝄓 and Aximats your child, and Jonathan child of Abiatar, your two children with you.
See, I will linger in the steppes of the wilderness, 𝄓 until word comes from you to tell me.
And Zadok and Abiatar returned the ark of God to Jerusalem, 𝄓 and they settled there.

And David went up the ascent of the olive trees, going up weeping, and his head hooded, and he himself walked barefoot. 𝄓 And all the people that were with him, hooded, each his head, they ascended, going up, and weeping.
And someone told David, saying, Axitophel is among those colluding with Absalom. 𝄓 And David said, Silliness, please, the counsel of Axitophel, O Yahweh.
And it happened that David came to the top, where he worshiped God. 𝄓 And behold Xushi the Arkite encountered him, his coat ripped and debris from the ground on his head.
And David said to him, 𝄓 If you pass through with me, then you will be to me a liability.

But if you return to the city, and say to Absalom, Your servant I will be, O king, I will be. And I was the servant of your father since whenever ..., but now I will be your servant. 𝄓 And you may thwart for me the counsel of Axitophel.

And will there not be with you there Zadok and Abiatar the priests? 𝄓 And it will happen that any thing that you will hear from the house of the king, you will make clear to Zadok and Abiatar the priests.
Behold there with them are their two children, Aximats of Zadok, and Jonathan of Abiatar, 𝄓 and you will send by means of them to me every thing that you hear.
So Xushi an associate of David entered the city, 𝄓 and Absalom entered Jerusalem. S

And David had crossed a little beyond the hilltop, and behold, Tsiba, the lad of Mephiboshet, encountered him, 𝄓 with a pair of asses saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred bunches of raisins, and one hundred of summer fruits, and a skin-bottle of wine.

And the king said to Tsiba, What are these that you have? 𝄓 And Tsiba said, The asses are for the household of the king to ride, and the bread and the summer fruits for the lads to eat, and the wine for one who is tired to imbibe in the wilderness.

And the king said, And where is the child of your master? 𝄓 And Tsiba said to the king, Behold, he sits in Jerusalem, for he said, Today the house of Israel will return to me the kingdom of my father.
And the king said to Tsiba, Behold, yours are all that was of Mephiboshet, 𝄓 and Tsiba said, I prostrate myself. Let me find grace in your eyes, my Lord O king.

And king David went in to Bachurim [Youths-in-their-Prime]. 𝄓 And behold, from there a man coming forth was of the family of the house of Saul, and his name was Shimei, a child of Gera. He came out. He came out and slighted.
And he engulfed with stones even David, and all the servants of king David, 𝄓 and all the people, and all the valiant from his right and from his left.
And thus Shimei said as he slighted, 𝄓 Go forth, go forth, man of blood, and man of worthlessness.

Yahweh has returned on you all the blood of the house of Saul in whose stead you reign. And Yahweh has given the kingdom into the hand of Absalom, your child. 𝄓 And here you are in your evil, for a man of blood you are.
And Abishai child of Tseruyah said to the king, Why should this dead dog slight my lord the king? 𝄓 Let me cross over please, and I will put aside his head. S
And the king said, What is this to me and to you, children of Tseruyah? 𝄓 So let him slight, for Yahweh has said to him, Slight David. So who says, Why have you done so? S

And David said to Abishai and to his servants, Behold, my son who came out from my inner parts, seeks my throat, 𝄓 and also for now a Benjaminite. Leave him, and let him slight, for Yahweh has bidden him.
Maybe Yahweh will see my affliction, 𝄓 and Yahweh will return to me good instead of his slighting this day.
So David went and his men by the way, and Shimei went on the rib of the hill set against him, meandering and slighting and jettisoning stones, 𝄓 set against him and dusting with dust. P
And the king came and all the people that were with him, exhausted. 𝄓 And he regrouped there.
And Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, had come to Jerusalem, 𝄓 and Axitophel with him.
And it happened that Xushi the Arkite, an associate of David, had come to Absalom. 𝄓 And Xushi said to Absalom, May the king live. May the king live.
And Absalom said to Xushi, This is your kindness with your associate. 𝄓 Why did you not go with your associate?
And Xushi said to Absalom, No. For whom Yahweh has chosen and this people, and all the men of Israel, 𝄓 his I will be, and with him I will sit.
And a second time, whom should I myself serve, if not in the presence of his son? 𝄓 As I served in the presence of your father, so I will be in your presence. P
And Absalom said to Axitophel, 𝄓 Provide yourselves counsel. What will we do?

And Axitophel said to Absalom, Go in to the courtesans of your father that he has left to keep the house. 𝄓 And all Israel will hear that you have disgusted your father, and the hands of all that are with you will be resolute.
And they stretched out for Absalom the tent on the housetop, 𝄓 and Absalom came to the courtesans of his father in the sight of all Israel.
And the counsel of Axitophel that he counseled in those days was as if anyone asked in a matter of God. 𝄓 So all the counsel of Axitophel was both for David and for Absalom. S
And Axitophel said to Absalom, 𝄓 Let me choose now twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.
And I will come upon him while he is weary, and slack of hand, and will make him apprehensive, and all the people will withdraw that are with him, 𝄓 and I will strike the king alone.
And I will bring back all the people to you, 𝄓 as if returning the whole person whom you seek. All the people will be at peace.
And the matter was upright in the eyes of Absalom, 𝄓 and in the eyes of all the elders of Israel. S
And Absalom said, Call, if you will, even Xushi the Arkite, 𝄓 and we will hear from his mouth, he also.
So Xushi came to Absalom and Absalom said to him, saying, A word like this Axitophel has spoken. Will we do his word? 𝄓 If not, you speak. S
And Xushi said to Absalom, 𝄓 The counsel is not good that Axitophel counseled at this time.

And Xushi said, You yourself know your father and his men, because they are valiant. And embittered they are, as a bear bereaved in the field. 𝄓 And your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

Just look. Now he is camouflaged into a single crater or in the other places, 𝄓 and as one falls among them at the start, then whoever hears will say, There is a plague among the people who follow Absalom,
And even a forceful son, whose heart is as the heart of the lion, will melt, 𝄓 because all Israel knows that your father is one who prevails, and the sons of force that are with him.

For loving those hating you and for hating those who love you, 𝄓 because you have made it clear today that there is not for you nobility or servants. For I know today that if only Absalom had lived and all of us today had died, that then it would be upright in your eyes.

So now arise, go forth, and speak to the heart of your servants, 𝄓 because, by Yahweh I swear, that if you do not come forth, no one will lodge with you tonight, and this will be more evil for you than all the evil that has come to you from your youth till now. S

And Joab answered and he said, 𝄓 Far be it, far be it from me if I would swallow up, or if I would destroy.

And the woman came to all the people in her shrewdness, and they cut off the head of Sheva, child of Bikri, that they flung to Joab. And he sounded the shophar, and they dispersed from the city, each to his tent. 𝄓 And Joab returned to Jerusalem, to the king. S
And Joab was with all the host of Israel, 𝄓 and Benaiah child of Jehoiada was over the Cheretites and over the Pelethites.

And there was a famine in the days of David, three years, year after year, and David sought out the face of Yahweh. 𝄓 And Yahweh said, To Saul and to the house of blood, in that he had put to death the Gibeonites.

And David said to the Gibeonites, What will I do for you? 𝄓 And with what will I make a cover-price, that you may bless the inheritance of Yahweh?
And the Gibeonites said to him, Not for us silver and gold, whether from Saul or from his house, and not for us to execute anyone in Israel. 𝄓 And he said, What do you say I should do for you?

Why then did you not keep the oath of Yahweh, 𝄓 and the commandment that I commanded you?
And the king said to Shimei, You yourself know all the evil which your heart knew that you have done to David my father, 𝄓 so Yahweh will return your evil on your head.
And the king Solomon will be blessed, 𝄓 and let the throne of David be established in the presence of Yahweh for evermore.
And the king commanded Benaiah child of Jehoiada, and he came forth and he compelled him and he died, 𝄓 and the kingdom was established by the hand of Solomon.

And Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh the king of Egypt. 𝄓 And he took Pharaoh's daughter and brought her to the city of David till he finished building his house, and the house of Yahweh, and the rampart of Jerusalem round about.
But the people sacrificed on the high places, 𝄓 for a house to the name of Yahweh had not yet been built in those days. P
And Solomon loved Yahweh, walking in the statutes of David his father, 𝄓 but on the high places he sacrificed and burnt incense.
And the king went towards Gibeon to sacrifice there, for this is the great high place. 𝄓 A thousand burnt offerings Solomon offered up on that altar.
In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night, 𝄓 and God said, Ask what I will give you?

And Solomon said, You yourself have done with your servant David, my father, great kindness, such that he walked in your presence in truth and in righteousness and in uprightness of heart with you, 𝄓 and you kept for him this great kindness and you gave to him a son to sit on his throne as on this day.
And now, Yahweh, my God, you yourself have made your servant king instead of David, my father, 𝄓 and I am a lesser lad. I do not know how to go out or to come in.
And your servant is in the midst of your people that you have chosen, 𝄓 a people abundant that will not be apportioned or counted for abundance.
So give to your servant a heart to hear, to judge your people, acumen to discern good from evil, 𝄓 for who is able to judge this your glorious people.
And it was good, the word in the eyes of the Lord, 𝄓 that Solomon had asked this word.

And God said to him, In that you have asked this word, and you did not ask for yourself many days, and you did not ask for yourself riches, and you did not ask for the throat of your enemies, 𝄓 but you asked for yourself acumen to hear judgment.
Behold, I have done according to your word. 𝄓 Behold, I have given to you a heart shrewd and discerning, that like you, there has not been before you, and after you, neither will one arise like you.
And moreover what you did not ask, I have given to you, both riches and glory, 𝄓 that there will not be like you, any among sovereigns, all your days.
And if you will walk in my ways to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David your father walked, 𝄓 then I will prolong your days. S

And Solomon awoke and behold, a dream. 𝄓 And he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and he offered up burnt offerings, and he made peace offerings, and he made a party for all his servants. P
Then came two women, harlots, to the king, 𝄓 and they stood before him.
And the first woman said, O my lord, I and this woman were settled in one house, 𝄓 and I gave birth with her in the house.
And it was on the third day after I gave birth that she gave birth, even this woman, 𝄓 and we were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, except we two, in the house.
And the child of this woman died in the night, 𝄓 when she lay down over it.
And she arose in the midst of the night, and took my child from next to me while your maidservant was asleep, and had it lie down in her embrace, 𝄓 and her dead child she had lie down in my embrace.
And I arose in the morning to suckle my child, and behold it had died, 𝄓 but I understood it in the morning, and behold it was not my child which I had given birth to.

And the other woman said, No, for my child is the living, and your child the one who died. But this said, No, for your child is the one who died, and my child is the living. 𝄓 And they were speaking in the presence of the king.
And the king said, This said, This is my child, the living, and your child is the one who died, 𝄓 but this said, No, for your child is the one who died, and my child is the living. P
And the king said, Take a sword for me, 𝄓 and they brought the sword before the king.
And the king said, Part the living newborn in two, 𝄓 and give half to one and half to the other.

And the woman whose child was the living said to the king, for her compassion was fevered over her child, and she said, O my lord, give her the living newborn. Let it not be put to death. 𝄓 But this said, Neither mine nor yours let it be. Part it.
And the king answered and he said, Give her the living newborn, and let it not be put to death. 𝄓 She is its mother. S
And all Israel heard the judgment that the king had judged, and they feared from the presence of the king, 𝄓 for they saw that it was the shrewdness of God within him to do judgment. S
And the king Solomon was king over all Israel. S
And these are the nobility that he had, 𝄓 Azariah, child of Zadok the priest, S
Elixoreph and Achiyah, the children of Shisha, secretaries, 𝄓 Jehoshaphat, child of Achilud the archivist, S
And Beniah, child of Jehoiada was over the host, 𝄓 Zadok and Abiatar, priests, S
And Azariah, child of Nathan, over the monitors, 𝄓 and Zabud, child of Nathan, a priest, a friend of the king, S
And Axishar over the house, 𝄓 and Adoniram, child of Abda, over the tax. S
And Solomon had twelve monitors over all Israel, and they nourished the king and his house, 𝄓 a month per year one was on for nourishment. S
And these are their names: the child of Hur in mount Ephraim. S
The child of Deqar in Maqaz, and in Shaalbim, and the House of the Sun, 𝄓 and Ailon Beth-Chanan. S
The child of Xesed in the Slits. 𝄓 His was Sokoh and all the land of Xefar. S
The child of Abinadab, all the elevation of Dor. 𝄓 Tapahth the daughter of Solomon was his wife. S
Baana, child of Achilud, Taanak and Megiddo, 𝄓 and all the house of Shean that was next to Tsartanah beneath Jezreel, from the house of Shean to Abel-Mecholah to beyond Yoqmeam. S

The child of Geber on the high ground of Gilead. 𝄓 His was the municipality of Jair. The child of Manasseh that is in Gilead. His was the territory of Argob that is in Bashan, sixty great walled cities and bars of brass. S
Axinadab, the child of Iddo, Two-Armies. S
Aximats in Naphtali. 𝄓 Also he took Basmat, the daughter of Solomon for a wife. S
Baana, the child of Xushi, in Asher and in Alot. S
Jehoshaphat, child of Paruah, in Issachar. S
Shimei, child of Elah, in Benjamin. S
Geber, the child of Uri, in the land of Gilead, 𝄓 the land of Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of fruitful Bashan. And the single monitor that was in the land.
Judah and Israel were many, as the sand that is by the sea in abundance, 𝄓 eating and partying and mirthful.

And Solomon had governance with all the kingdoms from the river of the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. 𝄓 They made overture with a gift, and served Solomon all the days of his life. P
And the bread of Solomon for one day was, 𝄓 thirty cor of fine flour and sixty cor of flour,
Ten firm oxen and twenty oxen of the pasture and one hundred sheep, 𝄓 besides hart and gazelle and roebuck and stuffed geese.
For he ruled in all beyond the river from Tipsah and to Gaza among all the kings beyond the river, 𝄓 and peace was his from all his thoroughfares round about.
And Judah and Israel settled in trust, everyone under their vine and under their fig tree from Dan and to Beer-Sheva, 𝄓 all the days of Solomon. S
And Solomon had forty thousand corrals of horses for his chariots, 𝄓 and twelve thousand cavalry.
These monitors nourished the king Solomon and all approaching to the table of king Solomon, each his month, 𝄓 lagging in no matter.
And barley and straw for the horses and for the steeds, 𝄓 they brought to the place where each was, according to his judgment. S
And God gave shrewdness to Solomon, and very abundant acumen, 𝄓 and breadth of heart, as the sand that is by the bank of the sea.
And the shrewdness of Solomon exceeded the shrewdness of all the children of the east, 𝄓 and all the shrewdness of Egypt.
For he was wiser than any human, whether Ethan the Ezrahite, or Heyman, or Kalkol, or Darda, the children of Maxul, 𝄓 and his reputation was among all the nations surrounding.
And he spoke three thousand proverbs, 𝄓 and his songs were a thousand and five.
And he spoke concerning the wood from the cedar that was in Lebanon, and to the hyssop that goes out from a house wall, 𝄓 and he spoke on the beast and on the fowl and on the creeper and on the fish.
And they came from all the peoples to hear the shrewdness of Solomon, 𝄓 from the kings of the earth who had heard of his shrewdness. S
And Hiram the king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon for he had heard that they had anointed him king instead of his father, 𝄓 for Hiram loved David throughout his days. S
And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

Yourself you know that David my father was not able to build a house to the name of Yahweh his God, in the face of the battle that was surrounding him, 𝄓 until Yahweh consigned them under the soles of my feet.
And now Yahweh my God has given rest to me all around. 𝄓 There is no accuser and there is no compelling evil.

So behold me, promising to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God. 𝄓 It is as Yahweh spoke to David my father, saying, Your son, that I will permit instead of you on your throne, he himself will build the house for my name.

And now command that they cut for me cedar from Lebanon, and my servants will be with your servants, and wage for your servants I will give you according to all that you say, 𝄓 for you, you know that there is no builder that knows how to cut lumber like the Sidonians.
And it happened when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he was very glad, 𝄓 and he said, Blessed is Yahweh today that he has given to David a wise son over this abundant people.
And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have heard what you sent me. 𝄓 I myself will deal with all your delight in cedar trees and in fir trees.

My servants will come down from Lebanon to the sea, and I will have them towed by sea to the place where you send me, and I will have them disembarked there, 𝄓 and you will assume liability and you will undertake my delight to give bread for my house.
So it was that Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees, all his delight.
And Solomon gave to Hiram twenty thousand cor of wheat for food for his household, and twenty cor of beaten oil. 𝄓 Thus Solomon gave to Hiram year in year out. P
And Yahweh gave shrewdness to Solomon as he spoke to him, 𝄓 and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and they cut a covenant, the two of them.
And the king Solomon got up enforced service from all Israel, 𝄓 and it was enforced service of thirty thousand men.
And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month as renewal. A month they were in Lebanon and two months in his house, 𝄓 and Adoniram was over the enforced service. S
And Solomon had seventy thousand to bear burdens, 𝄓 and eighty thousand to hew in the hill,
Besides the chiefs of the monitors for Solomon that were over the lines of work, three thousand three hundred, 𝄓 the rulers over the people who constructed in the lines of work. S
And the king commanded and they pulled out great stones, precious stones for the foundation of the house, gems of cut-stone.
And the builders of Solomon and the builders of Hiram sculpted and the Gebalites. 𝄓 So they prepared the timber and the stones to build the house. P

And it happened in the four hundred and eightieth year of the coming out of the children of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fourth year, in the new moon of Ziv (it is the second new moon) of the reign of Solomon over Israel, 𝄓 that he began to build the house of Yahweh.
And the house that the king Solomon had built for Yahweh was sixty cubits its length, and twenty its breadth, 𝄓 and thirty cubits its height.
And the porch before the temple of the house: twenty cubits its length before the breadth of the house, 𝄓 ten cubits its breadth before the house.
And he made for the house narrow clerestory windows.
And he built on the sidewall of the house berths round about with the sidewalls of the house round about, for the temple and for the word-place, 𝄓 and he made ribs round about.

The lowest berth was five cubits broad, and the central six cubits broad, and the third seven cubits broad, 𝄓 for he positioned recesses for the house round about outside so as not to hold fast in the sidewalls of the house.
And the house during its building, (with well-shaped imported stone), was built, 𝄓 so pick-ax and adze, any instrument of iron, was not heard in the house during its building.
The door of the central rib is on the right shoulder of the house, 𝄓 and on spiral stairs they ascend to the central and from the central to the third.
And he built the house and finished it, 𝄓 and paneled the house with arches and slats of cedar.
And he built the berth over all the house, five cubits its height, 𝄓 and it held fast the house in timber of cedar. P
And the word of Yahweh happened to Solomon, saying,

This house that you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and my judgments you do, and you keep all my commandments to walk in them, 𝄓 then I will place my word with you that I spoke to David your father.
And I will dwell among the children of Israel, 𝄓 and will not forsake my people Israel. P
And Solomon built the house and finished it.

And he built the sidewalls of the house inside with ribs of cedar, from the floor of the house to the sidewall panels, overlaid with wood inside, 𝄓 and he overlaid the floor of the house with ribs of fir.
And he built twenty cubits from the flanks of the house with ribs of cedar from the floor to the sidewalls. 𝄓 And he built for it inside the word-place, the Holy of Holies.
And forty cubits was the house, 𝄓 the temple, before it.
And the cedar of the house, its facings were slung with decorations and pursed blossoms. 𝄓 The whole was cedar. There was no stone seen.
And the word-place in the midst of the house, its faces he prepared, 𝄓 to position there the ark of the covenant of Yahweh.
And the faces of the word-place, twenty cubits in length, twenty cubits in breadth, twenty cubits its height. 𝄓 And he overlaid it with gold of a gold bar. And he overlaid the altar of cedar.
And Solomon overlaid the house of the presence with gold of a gold bar, 𝄓 and he made a crossing with manacles of gold before the word-place, and he overlaid it with gold.
And all the house he overlaid with gold until all the house was completed, 𝄓 and all the altar that was for the word-place, he overlaid with gold.
And he made in the word-place two cherubim of dense wood, 𝄓 ten cubits its height.
Five cubits the wing of the one cherub and five cubits the wing of the second cherub, 𝄓 ten cubits from the extremity of its wings and to the extremity of its wings.
And ten cubits was the second cherub, 𝄓 of one measure and of one size, for the two cherubim.
The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, 𝄓 and so for the second cherub.

And he positioned the cherubim in the midst of the house of the presence, and they spread the wings of the cherubim, and the one wing touched the sidewall and the wing of the second cherub touched the second sidewall, 𝄓 and their wings into the centre of the house touched wing to wing.
And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.
And all the sidewalls of the house round about, he slung with carved hangings of cherubim and palm trees, and pursed blossoms, 𝄓 from the presence and to the outside.
And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, 𝄓 for the presence and for the outside.
And for the door of the word-place he made portals of dense wood, 𝄓 the portico jambs of five-parts.

And two gateways of dense wood, and he slung over them hangings of cherubim and palm trees and pursed blossoms, 𝄓 that he overlaid with gold and he wrapped gold over the cherubim and over the palm trees.
And so he made for the door of the temple jambs of dense wood, 𝄓 from four parts,
And two gateways of the wood of the fir trees. 𝄓 Two ribs of the one gateway were rolling, and the two hangings of the second gateway were rolling.
And he slung cherubim and palm trees and pursed blossoms, 𝄓 that he overlaid with gold fitted over the engravings.
And he built the court of the presence, 𝄓 three rows of cut-stones, and a row of cut cedar.
In the fourth year, was the foundation of the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 in the moon of Ziv.
And in the eleventh year in the moon of Bul, (it is new moon the eighth) the house was finished in all of its matters and in all its frameworks. 𝄓 So its building took seven years.
And Solomon was building his house thirteen years. 𝄓 And he finished all his house.

And he built the house of the forest of Lebanon, a hundred cubits, its length, and fifty cubits, its breadth, and thirty cubits, its height, 𝄓 on four rows of cedar pillars, and cedar cuttings on the pillars.
And it was paneled with cedar above on the ribs that were on the forty five pillars, 𝄓 fifteen in the row.
And clerestories three rows, 𝄓 and vision to vision, three times.
And all the doors and the posts were squared with clerestory, 𝄓 and the cutting edge of vision to vision, three times.
And he made a porch of the pillars, fifty cubits its length, and thirty cubits its breadth, 𝄓 and porch was facing them, and pillars and thickness facing them.
And the porch for the throne where he would judge, the porch of judgment, he made, 𝄓 and panels with cedar, from the floor to the floor.
And his house where he inhabited, this had another court inside the porch similar in construction. 𝄓 And he constructed a house for the daughter of Pharaoh, (whom Solomon had taken) like this porch.

All these were of precious stones according to the measures of cut-stone, sawed with saws on the inside and on the outside, 𝄓 and from the foundation to the friezes, and from the street to the great court.
And the foundation was precious stones, great stones, 𝄓 stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
And ascending were precious stones according to the measures of cut-stone and cedar.
And the great court round about was three rows of cut-stones and a row of cut cedar, 𝄓 both for the court of the house of Yahweh, the presence, and for the porch of the house. P
And king Solomon sent and he took Hiram from Tyre.

A child of a widow woman, he was from the branch of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, an artificer of brass, and he was filled with shrewdness and discernment, and the knowledge of all lines of work in brass. 𝄓 And he came to king Solomon, and he did all his lines of work.
And he consolidated the two pillars of brass, 𝄓 eighteen cubits, the height of the first pillar, and a thread of twelve cubits surrounding the second pillar.
And two diadems he made to position above the tops of the pillars, molded brass. 𝄓 Five cubits, the height of the first diadem, five cubits the height of the second diadem.
Meshes making a great fretwork, made links for the diadems that were on the top of the pillars, 𝄓 seven for the first diadem and seven for the second diadem.
And he made the pillars, 𝄓 and two rows round about on the first fretwork to cover the diadems that were over the top of the pomegranates. And so he did for the second diadem.
And the diadems that were on the top of the pillars were making a lily in the porch, 𝄓 four cubits.
And the diadems on both the pillars were also above, matching the belly that passes through the fretwork, 𝄓 and the pomegranates, two hundred rows round about against the second diadem.

And he raised up the pillars for the porch of the temple. 𝄓 And he raised up the right hand pillar, and he called its name, He Will Prepare. And he raised up the left hand pillar, and he called its name, In Strength.
And over the top of the pillars he made a lily. 𝄓 And completed were the lines of work for the pillars.
And he made the molded sea, 𝄓 ten cubits from its brim to its brim, the diameter of the circle, and five cubits its height, and a line of thirty cubits surrounded it all around.
And decorations beneath its brim, round about surrounding it, ten per cubit, encompassing the sea round about. 𝄓 Two rows of decorations were molded when it was molded.

It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, and three facing seaward, and three facing southward, and three facing toward the sunrise, and the sea was over them from above it, 𝄓 and all their hindquarters toward the inside.
And its thickness was a hand-breadth, and its brim like the making of the brim of a cup, flourishing with lily, 𝄓 a thousand baths abiding. P
And he made the ten brass bases, 𝄓 four cubits the length of the first base, and four cubits its breadth, and three cubits its height.
And this was the construction of the bases. They had insets, 𝄓 and the insets were between the frames.
And over the insets that were between the frames were lions, oxen, and cherubim. And over the frames was a base above. 𝄓 And beneath for the lions and for the oxen were garlands made to descend.
And four wheels of brass for each single base, and axle-trees of brass, and its four footings had shoulder-brackets. 𝄓 Beneath the laver, the shoulder-brackets were molded across each garland.

And its funnel was from inside of the diadem, and came up by a cubit. And its funnel was a hoop making a base, a cubit and a half the cubit. 𝄓 And even over its funnel were hangings. But their insets were four-square, not a hoop.
And the four wheels were beneath the insets and the axles of the wheels in from its base. 𝄓 And the height of each one of the wheels, a cubit and a half the cubit.
And the construction of the wheels was like the construction of the wheel of a chariot, 𝄓 their axles, and their arches, and their spokes, and their hubs. The whole was molded.
And four shoulder-brackets were at the four corners of each one of the bases, 𝄓 from the base of its shoulder.
And on the top of the base, half the cubit in height, was a hoop surrounding, 𝄓 and over the top of its base were its axles and its insets.
And he carved upon the boards of its axles, and upon the insets, cherubim, lions, and palm trees, 𝄓 as if exposing a person, and garlands round about.
Like this he made the ten bases, 𝄓 one molding, one measure, one size, for all of them. S
And he made ten brass lavers, the one laver abiding forty baths. 𝄓 Each one of the lavers, four cubits, one laver over the one base for the ten bases.

And he positioned the bases, five by the shoulder of the house on the right, and five by the shoulder of the house on the left. 𝄓 And the sea he positioned on the right shoulder of the house, eastward, from the forefront southward. S
And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the bowls. 𝄓 And Hiram finished making all the lines of work which he had made for king Solomon, the house of Yahweh.
Pillars, two, and the globes of the diadems that were over the top of the pillars, two. 𝄓 And the two wreaths to cover the two globes of the diadems that were on the top of the pillars.
And the pomegranates, four hundred, for the two wreaths, 𝄓 two rows of pomegranates for a single wreath to cover the two globes of the diadems that were on the faces of the pillars.
And the ten bases, 𝄓 and the ten lavers on the bases.
And the one sea, 𝄓 and the twelve oxen under the sea.
And the pots, and the shovels, and the bowls, and all the these vessels, that Hiram had made for king Solomon, the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 of brass, polished.
In the basin of the Jordan the king molded them, in the thick ground, 𝄓 between Sukkoth and Tsartan.
And Solomon left all the vessels of very much abundance. 𝄓 An appraisal of the brass could not be examined.
And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 the altar of gold, and the table over which is the bread of the presence, gold.
And the five lamps on the right and five on the left before the word-place, gold of a gold bar, 𝄓 and the flourishes and the lamps and the tongs, gold.

And the crocks, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and the censers, gold of a gold bar. 𝄓 And its hinge-sockets for the gateways of the house, the facings of the Holy of Holies, the gateways of the house for the temple, gold. P

And all the lines of work were whole which the king Solomon had constructed for the house of Yahweh. 𝄓 And Solomon brought the holy things of David his father. The silver, and the gold, and the vessels, he gave into the treasuries of the house of Yahweh. P

Then Solomon convened the elders of Israel, all the preeminent of the branches, the principals of the ancestors of the children of Israel to king Solomon of Jerusalem, 𝄓 to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh from the city of David. This is Zion.
And everyone of Israel convened to king Solomon in the moon of Ethanim in the festival. 𝄓 This is the seventh new moon.
And all the elders of Israel came, 𝄓 and the priests were bearing the ark.
And they brought up the ark of Yahweh and the tent of engagement and all the vessels of the sanctuary that were in the tent. 𝄓 And the priests and the Levites brought them up.
Then the king Solomon, and all the assembly of Israel engaged with him, were with him before the ark, 𝄓 offering sheep and oxen that were uncounted and unfathomable for abundance.
And the priests brought the ark of the covenant of Yahweh to its place, to the word-place of the house, to the Holy of Holies, 𝄓 under the wings of the cherubim.
For the cherubim spread their two wings to the place of the ark, 𝄓 and the Cherubim overshadow the ark and its shafts from above.
And they retracted the shafts, and the tops of the shafts could be seen from the sanctuary above, facing the word-place, but they were not seen outside. 𝄓 And they are there until this day.
There was nothing in the ark but the two tablets of stone that Moses left there in Horeb, 𝄓 which Yahweh cut with the children of Israel at their going out from the land of Egypt.
And it happened when the priests came out from the sanctuary. 𝄓 And the cloud filled the house of Yahweh.
And the priests were not able to stand to minister from the presence of the cloud, 𝄓 for the glory of Yahweh filled the house of Yahweh. P
Then Solomon said, 𝄓 Yahweh, is said to dwell in dark turbulence.
To build, I have built a house of residence for you, 𝄓 established as your seat everlastingly.
And the king turned around, faced, and blessed all the congregation of Israel. 𝄓 And all the congregation of Israel stood.
And he said, Blessed is Yahweh the God of Israel who spoke with his mouth to David my father, 𝄓 and with his hand filled, said:

From that day when I brought my people Israel out from Egypt, I did not chose in a city from all the sceptres of Israel to build a house to be My Name Is There, 𝄓 but I chose in David, to be over my people Israel.
And it was with the heart of David my father, 𝄓 to build a house to the name of Yahweh the God of Israel.
And Yahweh said to David my father, In that it was with your heart to build a house for my name, 𝄓 you did well that it was with your heart.
But you, you will not build the house. 𝄓 In contrast, your son, the one coming forth from your genus, he, he will build the house for my name.
And Yahweh placed his word that he spoke. 𝄓 And I am placed under David my father and sit on the throne of Israel, as Yahweh spoke and I have built the house to the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
