And it happened that nation by nation constructed their gods, 𝄓 and had them rest in the houses of the high places that the Samaritans had made, nation by nation, in their cities where they settled.
And those of Babel made the booth of the daughters, and those of Kut made Nergal, 𝄓 and those of Hamath made Ashima.
And the Avites made Nibxaz and Tartaq, 𝄓 and the Sepharvites incinerated their children in the fire to Adramelek and Anammelek, the gods of Sepharvaim.
But they feared Yahweh, 𝄓 and they made for themselves priests of the high places, from their own limits, and they became the operators for them in the houses of the high places.
Yahweh they feared, 𝄓 and their gods, they served according to the framework of the nations from where they were exiled.

To this day they operate according to their former framework. 𝄓 They have no fear of Yahweh, and there is no operation according to their statutes, or according to their framework, or according to the instruction or the commandment which Yahweh commanded the children of Jacob, on whom he set his name, Israel.

And Yahweh cut with them a covenant and commanded them, saying, You will not fear other gods, 𝄓 and you will not prostrate yourselves to them, and you will not serve them, and you will not sacrifice to them.
Except Yahweh who brought you up from the land of Egypt in great power and by an arm stretched out, him, you will fear, 𝄓 and to him, you will prostrate yourselves, and to him, you will sacrifice.
And the statutes and the judgments and the instruction and the commandment that he wrote for you, you will keep watch to do every day, 𝄓 and you will not fear other gods.
And the covenant which I cut with you, you will not forget, 𝄓 and you will not fear other gods.
Except Yahweh your God you will fear, 𝄓 and himself, he will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies.
But they did not hear. 𝄓 In contrast, according to their former judgment, they did.

And it happened that these nations feared Yahweh and their graven images they were serving, 𝄓 even their children, and the children of their children, as their ancestors had done, they operate to this day. P
And it was in the third year of Hoshea, child of Eilah, king of Israel, 𝄓 Hezekiah reigned, child of Ahaz king of Judah.
A child of twenty five years he was when he began to reign, and twenty nine years he reigned in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and the name of his mother was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
And he did what is upright in the eyes of Yahweh, 𝄓 according to everything that David his father had done.

He put aside the high places, and shattered the monument, and cut off the fetish, 𝄓 and beat the brass snake that Moses had made, for to those days, the children of Israel were burning incense to it, and he called it Nehushtan.
In Yahweh, the God of Israel, he trusted, 𝄓 and after him there was not his like among all the kings of Judah, nor that were before him.
And he stayed close to Yahweh. He did not depart from following him, 𝄓 and kept his commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses.
And was Yahweh with him. Everywhere he went out was with insight. 𝄓 And he mutinied against the king of Ashur, and did not serve him.
Himself, he struck the Philistines to Gaza and her borders, 𝄓 from observation tower to enclosed city. P

And it happened in the fourth year of the reign of Hezekiah, (this was the seventh year of Hoshea child of Eilah king of Israel), 𝄓 Shalmaneser king of Ashur came up against Samaria and laid siege to it.
And he conquered it at the culmination of three years, in the sixth year of Hezekiah. 𝄓 (This was year nine of Hoshea, king of Israel, that Samaria was conquered.)
And the king of Ashur exiled Israel to Ashur, 𝄓 and he guided them into Xalax and Xabor, the river Gozan, and the cities of Media.
In that they did not hear with the voice of Yahweh their God, and they bypassed his covenant, 𝄓 all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded, both they did not hear and they had not done. P
And in the fourteenth year of the reign of Hezekiah, Senacherib king of Ashur came up to all the enclosed cities of Judah and occupied them.

And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Ashur towards Lachish, saying, I have sinned. Turn back from me. What you assign against me, I will bear. 𝄓 And the king of Ashur set over Hezekiah, king of Judah, three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
And Hezekiah gave all the silver that was found in the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 and in the treasuries of the house of the king.
At that time Hezekiah sundered the gateways of the temple of Yahweh, 𝄓 (and the faithfulness which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid) and he gave them to the king of Ashur. P

And the king of Ashur sent a field marshal and a eunuch overlord and a cupbearer overlord from Lachish to king Hezekiah with heavy force to Jerusalem, 𝄓 and they went up and they entered Jerusalem, and they went up and they came and they stood by the conduit of the blessing pool, the upper part that is on the highway to the field of the fuller.
So they called out to the king and Elyaqim child of Hilqiah, who is over the house, went out to them, 𝄓 and Shebna the secretary, and Joah child of Asaph, the archivist.
And the cupbearer overlord said to them, Say now to Hezekiah, 𝄓 Thus says the great king, the king of Ashur, What is this trust that you have trusted?
You say, (surely a lippy word). Counsel and valour to war. 𝄓 Now on whom do you trust that you mutiny against me?

Now, behold, you trust yourself on the staff of this splintered calamus, of Egypt, which for anyone who wants its support, it will go into his palm and pierce him. 𝄓 So is Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, to all those who trust in him.

But if you say to me, To Yahweh our God we have trusted, 𝄓 is it not he whose high places and altars Hezekiah put aside, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Before this altar you will prostrate yourselves in Jerusalem?
So now ensure, please, my lord the king of Ashur, 𝄓 and I will assign to you two thousand horses, if you can put forth for yourself riders on them.
How then will you turn the face of one viceroy of the least of my lord's servants? 𝄓 And you put your trust in Egypt for chariot and cavalry!
Now was it apart from Yahweh that I come up against this place to destroy it? 𝄓 said Yahweh to me, Go up to this land and destroy it.

And Elyaqim child of Hilqiah said, and Shebna and Joah, to the overlord cupbearer, 𝄓 Speak, please, to your servants, Aramaic, for we are the ones hearing, and do not speak with us Judean in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

And the overlord cupbearer said to them, Is it against your lord or against you that my lord sent me to speak these words? 𝄓 Is it not against the men sitting on the wall, to eat their filth, and to imbibe the water of their feet, with you.
And the overlord cupbearer stood, and he proclaimed with a great voice in Judean. 𝄓 And he spoke, and he said, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Ashur,
Thus says the king, Do not let Hezekiah lure you, 𝄓 for he is not able to deliver you from his hand.
So do not let Hezekiah make you trust to Yahweh, saying, For deliverance, Yahweh will deliver us, 𝄓 and this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Ashur.

Do not hear Hezekiah, 𝄓 for thus says the king of Ashur, Deal me a blessing, and come forth to me, and eat, each of their vine, and each of their fig tree, and imbibe, each of the waters of their cistern,

until I come, and I will take you to a land like your land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive, the clarified oil and honey, so live and you will not die. 𝄓 So do not hear Hezekiah when he persuades you, saying, Yahweh will deliver us.
Deliverance? Did any God of the nations deliver his land, 𝄓 from the hand of the king of Ashur?
Where is the God of Hamath and Arpad? Where is the God of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Iva? 𝄓 that they delivered Samaria from my hands?
Who is among all the gods of the lands that did deliver their land from my hands, 𝄓 that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem from my hands?
But the people kept silence and they did not answer him a thing, 𝄓 for the commandment of the king was this, saying, Do not answer him.

And Elyaqim child of Hilqiah came in, (who was over the house), and Shebna the secretary, and Joah child of Asaph, the archivist, to Hezekiah, their garments ripped, 𝄓 and they made clear to him the words of the cupbearer overlord.
And it happened when the king Hezekiah heard, that he ripped his garments. 𝄓 And he covered himself with sackcloth, and entered the house of Yahweh.
And he sent Elyaqim, who is over the house, and Shebna the secretary, and the elders of the priests, covered in sackcloth, 𝄓 to Isaiah the prophet, child of Amoz.
And they said to him, Thus says Hezekiah, A day of trouble and reproof and blasphemy is this day, 𝄓 for children come to the breaking, and there is no power to be born.

Maybe Yahweh your God will hear all the words of the overlord cupbearer whom the king of Ashur, his master, sent to reproach the God of life, and will referee with the words that Yahweh your God has heard. 𝄓 So lift up a prayer through the residue that is found.
And the servants of the king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
And Isaiah said to them, Thus you say to your master, 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh, Do not fear because of the presence of the words that you heard, with which the lads of the king of Ashur reviled me.
Note me well, I will give in him a spirit, and he will hear what is heard, and return to his land, 𝄓 and I will make him fall by the sword in his land.
And the cupbearer overlord returned and found the king of Ashur warring against Libnah, 𝄓 for he had heard that he had pulled out from Lachish.
And he heard of Tirhakah, king of Cush, saying, Behold, he has come out to fight you, 𝄓 and he turned and he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
Thus you say to Hezekiah, king of Judah, saying, Do not let your God, whom you trust in, lure you, saying, 𝄓 Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Ashur.
Behold yourself, you heard what the kings of Ashur have done to all the lands to destroy them utterly, 𝄓 and will you be delivered?
Did the gods of the nations deliver them whom my ancestors have destroyed: even Gozan and Xaran, 𝄓 and Retzeph and the children of Eden that were in Thelasar?
Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, 𝄓 Hena, and Iva?
And Hezekiah received the correspondence from the hand of the messengers, and recited it, 𝄓 and he ascended to the house of Yahweh, and Hezekiah spread it in the presence of Yahweh. P

And Hezekiah prayed in the presence of Yahweh, and he said, Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sits on the cherubim, you are he, the God, you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. 𝄓 You yourself have made the heavens and the earth.
Bend Yahweh, your ear, and hear. Give sight, Yahweh, to your eyes and see, 𝄓 and hear the words of Senacherib that he sent to reproach the God of life.
Truly Yahweh, 𝄓 the kings of Ashur have made desert of the nations and their land.
And they consigned their gods to the fire, 𝄓 for they are not God, but the construction of the hands of a human, tree and stone. So they have eliminated them.
And now, Yahweh our God, save us, if you will, from his hand, 𝄓 and they will know, all the kingdoms of the earth, that you, Yahweh, are God, you alone. S
And Isaiah child of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, What you prayed to me against Senacherib, king of Ashur, I have heard.
This is the thing that Yahweh spoke concerning him, 𝄓 The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you, has derided you. Behind you, the daughter of Jerusalem has wagged a head.
Whom did you reproach and revile? And against whom have you exalted a voice, 𝄓 and lifted up on high your eyes? against the Holy One of Israel.

By the hand of your messengers you have reproached my lord, and you have said, With my many chariots, I am. I have ascended the high ground of the hills, the flanks of Lebanon, 𝄓 and I will gouge the place of its cedars, its choice fir trees, and I will enter extreme lodging, the forest of its plantation.
I am my fountain, and I imbibe strange waters, 𝄓 and I will drain, by the sole of my footfall, all the canals of lower Egypt.
Have you not heard from afar? I have done it from the days of old, and I fashioned it. 𝄓 Now I have brought it, for you, to reduce to rubble the struggles of enclosed cities.
So their inhabitants were short-handed. They were dismayed and reticent. 𝄓 They were herbs of the field, and verdant foliage, housetop grass, and as blighted corn before it arises.
But your seat, and your going out, and your coming in, I know, 𝄓 and your shuddering against me.

Because your shuddering against me, and your tranquility has come up in my ears, 𝄓 and I have put my thorn in your nose, and my bit in your lips, and I will return you in the way by which you have come.

And this to you is the sign: you will eat this year accidental planting and in the second year, volunteer planting, 𝄓 and in the third year, sow and reap, and they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
And the residue will add to the security of the house of Judah, a rootstock downward, 𝄓 and make fruit upward.
For from Jerusalem a residue will go forth, and security from mount Zion. 𝄓 The jealousy of Yahweh of hosts will do this. S
Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning the king of Ashur, He will not come against this city, 𝄓 nor shoot there an arrow, nor confront her with a shield, nor pour out of a ramp, against her.
In the way that he came, in it he will return, 𝄓 and to this city he will not come. An oracle of Yahweh.
And I will defend this city to save it, 𝄓 for my sake, and for the sake of David my servant.

And it was in that night that the messenger of Yahweh came out and struck in the camp of Ashur a hundred and eighty five thousand, 𝄓 and they rose early in the morning and behold, all of them, dead carcasses.
So Senacherib king of Ashur pulled out, and went and returned. 𝄓 And he settled in Nineveh.

And it happened that he was worshiping in the house of Nisrok his God, and Adramelek and Sharetser, his children, struck him with the sword and they, they escaped into the land of Ararat, 𝄓 and Esarchadon his son reigned in his stead. P
In those days Hezekiah was ill to the point of death, 𝄓 and Isaiah child of Amoz the prophet came to him, saying to him, Thus says Yahweh, Set in order your house for you will die and not live.
And he turned his face around to the house wall, 𝄓 and he prayed to Yahweh, saying,
Beseeching, Yahweh, remember, if you will, that I walked in your presence in truth and with a heart at peace, and what is good in your eyes I have done. 𝄓 And Hezekiah wept, great weeping. S
And it happened, Isaiah had not gone out towards the central court, 𝄓 and the word of Yahweh happened to him, saying,

Return and say to Hezekiah, a herald of my people, Thus says Yahweh God of David your father, I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Note me well. I will heal you. 𝄓 On the third day you will ascend to the house of Yahweh.
I will add to your days a fifteen year span and from the palm of the king of Ashur I will deliver you and this city. 𝄓 I will defend this city for my sake and for the sake of David my servant.
And Isaiah said, Take a pressed lump of figs. 𝄓 So they took and they put it over the ulcer and he lived.
And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, What is a sign that Yahweh will heal me, 𝄓 and that I will ascend on the third day to the house of Yahweh?
And Isaiah said, This to you is the sign from Yahweh that Yahweh will do the thing that he spoke, 𝄓 will the shadow proceed ten degrees or return ten degrees?
And Hezekiah said, It is slight for a shadow to bend ten degrees. 𝄓 No. But let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
And Isaiah the prophet called to Yahweh, 𝄓 and he turned the shadow (by the degrees that it had gone down on the degrees of Ahaz) backward ten degrees. P
At that time Berodak-Baladan child of Baladan king of Babel sent correspondence and a gift to Hezekiah, 𝄓 for he had heard that Hezekiah was ill.

And Hezekiah broadcast to them, and he showed them all the house of his fortune, the silver and the gold, and the spices and the finest oil, and the house of his vessels, and all that was found in his treasuries. 𝄓 There was no thing that Hezekiah did not show them in his house or in all his governance.
And Isaiah the prophet came to king Hezekiah, 𝄓 and said to him, What did these persons say and from where did they come to you? And Hezekiah said, From a land far off they came, from Babel.
And he said, What did they see in your house? 𝄓 And Hezekiah said, All that is in my house they saw. There was no thing that I did not show them in my treasuries.
And said Isaiah to Hezekiah, 𝄓 Hear the word of Yahweh.
Behold days are coming and all that is in your house and that which your fathers had in the treasury until this day will be lifted up to Babel. 𝄓 No thing will remain, says Yahweh.
And of your children who emerge from you, which you will beget, they will be taken away. 𝄓 And they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babel.
And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, Good. The word of Yahweh that you have spoken. 𝄓 And he said, Is it so? Except there will be peace and truth in my days.

And the remaining words of Hezekiah and all his valour, and that he made the blessing pool, 𝄓 and a conduit and brought water into the city, are they not written in the record of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
And Hezekiah was laid out with his ancestors, 𝄓 and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead. P
A child of twelve years, Manasseh began to reign, and fifty five years he reigned in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and the name of his mother was Hephzibah [my delight is in her].
And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh, 𝄓 according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh had dispossessed before the face of the children of Israel.

And he turned and built the high places that Hezekiah his father had eliminated, 𝄓 and he raised up altars to Baal and he made a fetish as Ahab king of Israel had done, and he worshiped all the host of the heavens and served them.
And he built altars in the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 of which Yahweh had said, In Jerusalem I will set my name.
And he built altars for all the host of the heavens, 𝄓 in the two courts the house of Yahweh.
And he made his child pass through in the fire, and used fortunetellers and augury, and dealt with necromancy and wizards. 𝄓 He did much evil in the eyes of Yahweh that was grievous.

And he set up a graven image of the fetish that he made, 𝄓 in the house, of which Yahweh had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house and in Jerusalem that I have chosen from all the sceptres of Israel, I will set my name forever.

And I will not again move the foot of Israel aimlessly from the ground that I have given to their ancestors, 𝄓 but only if they will keep and do according to all I have commanded them, and all the instruction that my servant Moses commanded them.
But they did not hear. 𝄓 And Manasseh made them wander, to do more evil than the nations whom Yahweh exterminated before the face of the children of Israel.
And Yahweh spoke by the hand of his servants the prophets, saying,
In that Manasseh king of Judah did these abominations, evil more than all that the Amorites had done that were before him, 𝄓 and moreover made Judah to sin in his dung, S
Therefore thus says Yahweh, God of Israel, Note me well. I will bring evil on Jerusalem and Judah, 𝄓 that all hearing it, both their ears will tingle.
And I will stretch out over Jerusalem the line of Samaria and the appraisal of the house of Ahab. 𝄓 And I will wipe Jerusalem as the basin is wiped, wiped and overturned on its face.
And I will abandon the residue of my own inheritance and give them into the hand of their enemies, 𝄓 that they might become loot and booty for all their enemies.
In that they have done evil in my eyes and they have become grief with me, 𝄓 from the day that their ancestors came forth from Egypt and till this day.
And moreover Manasseh poured very much innocent blood till he had filled Jerusalem edge to edge, 𝄓 besides his sin with which he made Judah to sin and to do evil in the eyes of Yahweh.
And the remaining words of Manasseh and all that he undertook, and his sin that he sinned, 𝄓 are they not written in the record of the words of the days of the kings of Judah.
And Manasseh was laid out with his ancestors and was entombed in the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza. 𝄓 and Amon his son reigned in his stead. P
A child of twenty two years was Amon when he began to reign, and two years he reigned in Jerusalem. 𝄓 And the name of his mother was Meshalmah, the daughter of Charuts from Yitvah.
And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh, 𝄓 as Manasseh his father had done.
And he walked in all the way which his father walked in, 𝄓 and served the figurines that his father served and he worshiped them.
So he forsook Yahweh the God of his ancestors, 𝄓 and did not walk in the way of Yahweh.
And the servants of Amon colluded against him, 𝄓 and they put the king to death in his house.
And the people of the land struck all that had colluded against king Amon, 𝄓 and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
And the remaining matters of Amon that he undertook, 𝄓 are they not written in the record of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
And he entombed him in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, 𝄓 and Josiah his son reigned in his stead. P
A child of eight years Josiah was when he began to reign, and thirty one years he reigned in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and the name of his mother was Jedidah, the daughter of Adiyah from Botsqat.
And he did what is upright in the eyes of Yahweh, 𝄓 and he walked in all the way of David his father, and was not stubborn on the right hand or on the left. P
And it happened in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah, 𝄓 the king sent Shaphan, child of Atsalyahu, child of Meshullam, the secretary of the house of Yahweh, saying,
Go up to Hilqiah the great priest, and have him completely sum the silver that is brought into the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 which those keeping the doorway have gathered from the people.

And let them give it into the hand of those doing the lines of work, those entrusted with the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 and let them give it to those doing the lines of work that are in the house of Yahweh, to be resolute to refurbish the house.
To the carpenters and to the builders and to those who build fences, 𝄓 and to buy lumber and hewn stone to revamp the house.
But the silver given into their hand was not reckoned with them, 𝄓 for in faithfulness they constructed.
And Hilqiah the great priest said to Shaphan, the secretary, I have found the record of instruction in the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 and Hilqiah gave the record to Shaphan and he recited it.

And Shaphan the secretary came to the king and returned to the king a word, 𝄓 and said, Your servants have poured forth the silver that was found in the house and have given it into the hand of those doing the lines of work, those entrusted with the house of Yahweh.
And Shaphan the secretary made it clear to the king, saying, Hilqiah the priest gave me a record, 𝄓 and Shaphan recited it in the presence of the king.
And it happened as heard the king the words of the record of instruction, 𝄓 that he ripped his garments.
And the king commanded Hilqiah the priest, and Ahiqam child of Shaphan, and Aqbor, child of Mikayah, and Shaphan the secretary, and Asaiah, the servant of the king, saying,

Go, search out Yahweh about me, and about the people, and about all Judah, over the words of this record that was found, 𝄓 for great will be the heat of Yahweh which is charred in us, in that our ancestors have not heard about the words of this record, to do according to all that is written about us.

And Hilqiah the priest and Ahiqam and Aqbor and Shaphan and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum child of Tiqvah, child of Charchas, the keeper of the wardrobe, 𝄓 (and she settled in Jerusalem in the college) and they spoke to her.
And she said to them, Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel, 𝄓 Say to the person who sent you to me.
Thus says Yahweh, Note me well. I will bring evil to this place and on its inhabitants, 𝄓 all the words of the record that the king of Judah recited,
Instead that they have forsaken me, and they burned incense to other gods so that I was grieved in every deed of their hands, 𝄓 so my heat will char in this place and not be quenched.
And to the king of Judah who sent you to search out Yahweh, thus you will say to him, 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel of the things that you heard,

Because your heart was tender and you subdued yourself before Yahweh, when you heard what I spoke concerning this place and concerning its inhabitants, that they would be desolate, and a denial, and you ripped your garments, and you wept before me, 𝄓 so moreover I myself have heard. An oracle of Yahweh.

So note me well, I will gather you to your ancestors and you will be gathered to your tomb in peace, and you will not see with your eyes into all the evil that I am bringing on this place. 𝄓 And they returned to the king a word.
And the king sent, 𝄓 and gathered to himself all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

And the king went up to the house of Yahweh, and everyone of Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, from the youngest and to the greatest, 𝄓 and he recited in their ears, all the words of the record of the covenant, that was found in the house of Yahweh.

And the king stood by the pillar, and he cut the covenant in the presence of Yahweh, to walk following Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all heart and with all integrity, to raise up the words of this covenant that is written over this record. 𝄓 And all the people in the covenant stood.

And the king commanded Hilqiah the great priest and the priests of the second order and those keeping the doorway, to bring forth from the temple of Yahweh all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the fetish, and for all the host of the heavens, 𝄓 and he incinerated them outside of Jerusalem in the corn-blasts of Kidron and bore dust to Bethel.

And he put a stop to the ascetics that the kings of Judah assigned, and to burning incense on the high places of the cities of Judah and round about Jerusalem, 𝄓 and to those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, or to the moon, or to the Zodiac, and to all the host of the heavens.

And he brought out a fetish from the house of Yahweh, outside of Jerusalem to the wadi of the Kidron, and incinerated it in the wadi Kidron, and stamped out in the dust, 𝄓 and he cast its dust over the tomb of the children of the people.
And he broke down the house of the holy prostitutes that were in the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 where the women wove the housings for the fetish.

And he made all the priests from the cities of Judah come, and he defiled the high places where they burned incense, the priests from Geba to Beer-Sheva. 𝄓 And he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the door of the gate of Joshua, the chief of the city, that are on everyone's left hand by the city gate.
But the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of Yahweh in Jerusalem, 𝄓 but they ate the unleavened bread among their kin.
And he defiled Timbrel that is in the gorge of the child of Hinnom, 𝄓 that no person may make his son or his daughter pass through in the fire to Moloch.

And he put a stop to the horses that kings of Judah gave to the sun at the entrance of the house of Yahweh, to the chamber of Nathan Melek, the eunuch, that were in Parbar, 𝄓 and the chariots of the sun he incinerated in the fire.

We have been pregnant. We have writhed like we have given birth to wind. 𝄓 Victories of the earth, we have not made. But the inhabitants of the world have not miscarried.
Your dead will live. With my corpse they will arise. 𝄓 Awaken and shout for joy, those that dwell in dust, for the dew of light is your dew, and the land will let Shades fall. P
Come my people. Enter your inner room, and lock your portal about you. 𝄓 Shroud yourself for a brief moment, until indignation is passed by.

For behold, Yahweh comes forth from his place to visit the iniquity of the inhabitants of the earth over him, 𝄓 and the earth will disclose her blood, and no longer will you cover concerning her slain. P

In that day Yahweh will visit with his sword, the intransigent, and the great, and the courageous, against Leviathan, the snake that runs away, and against Leviathan, the snake of crooked ways, 𝄓 and he will slay the dragon that is in the sea. S
In that day, 𝄓 a coveted vineyard, answer her.
I, Yahweh preserve her at every moment. 𝄓 I irrigate her lest any visit against her. Night or day, I preserve her.
Heat is not of me. 𝄓 Who will give me spike, wild growth in the battle? I would attack against it. I would char it together.
Or let him be resolute with my strength to make peace for me. 𝄓 Peace he will make for me.
Those to come of Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and flourish, 𝄓 and fill the face of the world with profit. P
As the striking of the one who struck him, has he struck him? 𝄓 Or as the slaying of the one slaying him, has he slain?
In its utmost, when it extends, you will strive with it. 𝄓 He mutters in his intransigent spirit in the day of the east wind.

So in this the iniquity of Jacob will find a cover-price, and this is all the fruit to put aside his sin, 𝄓 when he renders all the stones of the altar as stones of smashed chalk. Fetishes and sun-pillars will not arise.
For the fortified city is isolated, the home dismissed and forsaken as a wilderness. 𝄓 There a calf will pasture, and there will recline, and will faint in a fissure.

When her harvest is dried up, it will be broken. Women will come to reveal it, 𝄓 for it is not a people of understanding, so its maker will not have compassion on them, and its fashioner will not be gracious to them. P
And it will happen in that day, Yahweh will beat out from the floods of the river to the wadi of Egypt, 𝄓 and you will be gleaned, one by one, O children of Israel. P

And it will happen in that day, the great shophar will sound, and those who were perishing in the land of Ashur will come, and the banished in the land of Egypt, 𝄓 and they will worship Yahweh on the holy hill in Jerusalem. P
Ah, the crown of the pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, a blossom withering is the estate of his adornment, 𝄓 that was over the head of the gorge of stout things, smitten with wine.
Behold one encouraged, and assured of my Lord, like an inundation of hail, a hairy canker, 𝄓 like an inundation of waters, like an intense downpour, he will allow on the earth by hand.
By feet will be trampled, 𝄓 the crown of the pride of the drunkards of Ephraim.

And a withering blossom will be the estate of his adornment that was over the head of the gorge of stout things, 𝄓 as first ripe fruit before summer that one who sees, sees it. While in its palm, it swallows it. S
In that day Yahweh of hosts will be the crown of the estate, and the prize of adornment, 𝄓 for the residue of his people.
And for a spirit of judgment, 𝄓 for those who sit over the judgment, and for valour from those who turn the battle toward the gate. S

And moreover, these through wine have strayed, and through strong drink have wandered. 𝄓 Priest and prophet have strayed through strong drink, and are swallowed up from the wine. They have wandered from the strong drink. They have strayed in seeing. They have drawn forth its prayer.
For all tables are full of filthy vomit, 𝄓 without place. P
Whom will he instruct in knowledge? And who will understand what is heard? 𝄓 The weaned from milk, viscous from breasts?
For command by command, command by command, line by line, line by line, 𝄓 far between there, somewhat more closely there.
For with derisive lip and another tongue, 𝄓 he will speak to this people.
That he said to them, This is the rest. Give the exhausted rest. And, This is where to find ease. 𝄓 But they would not consent to hear.

And the word of Yahweh was for them, command by command, command by command, line by line, line by line, far between there, somewhat more closely there, 𝄓 so that they might walk on and stumble, averse, and be broken, and be trapped, and be conquered. P
Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, scornful persons, 𝄓 governing this people that is in Jerusalem,

Though you say, We have cut a covenant with death, and with Sheol we have dealt a vision, 𝄓 when an overflowing scourge passes through, it will not come upon us, for we have set a lie for our refuge, and falsehood as our hiding place. P
Therefore thus says my Lord Yahweh, Behold me founding in Zion, a stone, 𝄓 a tested stone, a precious corner, the foundation of the foundation. One who believes will not hurry.
And I have put judgment for a line, and righteousness for appraisal, 𝄓 and hail will scoop the refuge of a lie, and a hiding place of waters will overflow. S
And your covenant with death will be covered over and your vision with Sheol will have no place. 𝄓 When an overflowing scourge has passed through, you will be trampled for it.
As often as it passes through you will be taken, for from morning to morning it will pass through, by day and by night. 𝄓 And it will be unnerving but to discern its report.
For more shortened is the bunk that anything might be superfluous, 𝄓 and the spilling out more straitening than one could find in a storeroom.
For as in mount Peretsim, Yahweh will arise. As in the valley in Gibeon, he will shudder, 𝄓 for the doing of his deeds, his strange deeds, and to serve his service, his alien service.
So now, do not be scornful, lest your bonds be made resolute, 𝄓 for a decisive consummation I have heard from my Lord Yahweh of hosts concerning all the earth. P
Lend an ear and hear my voice. 𝄓 Attend and hear my saying.
The whole day, does the plougher plough to sow? 𝄓 Does he open and harrow his own ground?
Will it not be that when he has equalized her face, and dispersed fennel, and has peppered cumin, 𝄓 he will set influential wheat and seasoned barley and spelt, its border?
And his God turns him aside for lessons in judgment and instructs him.
For not with flail is fennel threshed, nor is a wagon wheel turned round for cumin, 𝄓 but with the rod he will beat out fennel, and cumin with the sceptre.
Bread is finely ground, for he will not perpetually thresh it, 𝄓 nor confuse by rolling his wagon over it, nor stamp it with his cavalry.
Even this from Yahweh of hosts emerges. 𝄓 He has made wonderful counsel. He has magnified enterprise. P
Alas, Ariel, Ariel, the town of the camp of David, 𝄓 let them snatch, year in year out, let them strike festive sacrifices.
And I will distress Ariel. 𝄓 And there will be opportunity and opportuning, and it will be to me as Ariel.
And I will encamp like a ball over you. 𝄓 And I will lay siege to you with firmness, and I will raise up fortifications over you.
And you will be abased. From the earth you will speak, and from dust your promise will be depressed. 𝄓 and your voice will be like a necromancer from the earth, and from dust your promise will peep.
And the tumult of your strangers will be as powder stamped out. 𝄓 And as chaff passing through, the tumult of the ruthless. And it will happen suddenly. Suddenly.
From Yahweh of hosts you will be visited, with thunder and with quake, and a great voice, 𝄓 storm-wind, and tempest, and the flame of a consuming fire.
And it will be as a dream, a vision by night, the tumult of all the nations, the hosts over Ariel, 𝄓 and the whole of her estate, and her hunters, and those who distress her.

And it will be that as one who is hungry dreams, and behold it eats, but it awakens, and its cadaver is empty or as one who is thirsty dreams and behold, it imbibes, but it awakens, and behold, exhausted, but its cadaver is shiftless. 𝄓 So will be the tumult of all the nations, the hosts on the hill of Zion. P
Linger yourselves, and marvel, and reveling, revel. 𝄓 They are intoxicated, but not with wine, wavering to and fro, but not with strong drink.
For Yahweh has spilled out over you a spirit of stupour and he has staunched your eyes, (the prophets), 𝄓 and your heads (the visionaries) he has covered.

For the whole vision has become to you as the words of the sealed book that they give to one who knows correspondence, saying, Recite, if you will, this one. 𝄓 And such says, I am not able for it is sealed.
And the book is given to one who does not know correspondence, saying, Recite, if you will, this one. 𝄓 And such says, I do not know correspondence. S

And said my Lord, Because this people come close with their mouth, and with their lips they glorify me, but their heart is distant from me, 𝄓 and their fear of me is the commandment of mortals being taught,
So note me well adding wonderfully to this people, the wonder and wonderful. 𝄓 And the shrewdness of their wise will perish, and the discernment of their discerning will be hidden. S
Alas the inscrutable things, from Yahweh to hide counsel. 𝄓 And from darkness are their deeds, and they say, Who sees us? And who knows us?
Your overturning, rather, as the clay of the potter will be reckoned, 𝄓 for would what is made say to its maker, He did not make me? Or what is fashioned say to its fashioner, He has no discernment.
Is it not yet a little and somewhat close that Lebanon will be turned into a plantation? 𝄓 And the plantation as forest be reckoned?
Then the deaf will hear in that day the words of the book, 𝄓 and from gloom and from darkness, the eyes of the blind will see.
And the afflicted in Yahweh will add to gladness, 𝄓 and the needy of humanity in the Holy One of Israel will rejoice.
For the ruthless has come to an end and the scornful will be finished, 𝄓 and all vigilant for mischief will be cut off.
Making a human into a sinner with a word, and for the referee by the gate, entrapment, 𝄓 and bending a righteous one into disorder. P
Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning the house of Jacob, who ransoms Abraham, 𝄓 Not now will Jacob be ashamed and not now will his face pale.
But when they see their successions, the deed of my hands near them, they will sanctify my name, 𝄓 and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and of the God of Israel, they will be in panic.
And those who wandered in spirit will know discernment, 𝄓 and those who nattered will learn tuition. S
Ah rebellious children, an oracle of Yahweh, to do counsel, but not from me, to spill out a libation, but not my spirit, 𝄓 so as to add sin on sin.
They are going to descend to Egypt, but my mandate they have not asked, 𝄓 to strengthen themselves with the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shade of Egypt.
And it will be that for you, the strength of Pharaoh is to your shame, 𝄓 and the refuge in the shade of Egypt, humiliation.
For his nobles were in Zoan, 𝄓 and his messengers were joined in Xanas.
All dried up over a people of no use to them, nor help, 𝄓 and not to be of use, but for shame and also for a reproach. S

A load about the beasts of the south. 𝄓 In the land of trouble and distress, (great cat and codger cat are from them, asp and flying seraph) they will lift up on the shoulder of foals their wealth, and on the humps of camels their treasuries, to a people of no use.
And Egypt? Futile and empty their help. 𝄓 Therefore I have proclaimed this. They are bold to cease.
Now come, write upon a tablet with them, and in a record engrave it, 𝄓 and it will be for the day to follow, for ever, for evermore.
For a people of provocation it is, children dissimulating, 𝄓 children who will not consent to hear the instruction of Yahweh,
Who said to the seer, You will not see, and to the visionary, You will not envision for us what is straightforward. 𝄓 Speak for us smooth things. Envision delusions.
Turn aside from the way. Bend from the path. 𝄓 Make the Holy One of Israel cease from before us. S
Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel, Because you refuse in this matter, 𝄓 and trust in oppression and drift, and you lean upon it,
Therefore this iniquity will be for you as a breach pending a fall, simmering upon the wall, set on high, 𝄓 that suddenly, suddenly comes its breaking.

And he will break it as the breaking of a potter's jar beaten without pity, 𝄓 and from its beating there will be not found a potsherd to take hold of fire from a burning mass, or to strip water from a marsh. S
For thus says my Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, In returning and rest you will be saved. In quietness and trust will be your valour. 𝄓 But you would not consent.
And you said, No, for by horse we will withdraw. So you will withdraw. 𝄓 And, On the fleet we will ride. So fleet will be your pursuers.
One thousand, before the rebuke of one. Before the rebuke of five, you will withdraw, 𝄓 till even you will be left as a mast on the top of the hill, and as a standard by a hillock.
And Yahweh therefore will tarry, to be gracious to you, and therefore he will be exalted, to be compassionate with you. 𝄓 For Yahweh is the God of judgment. Happy are all who tarry for him. P
For people in Zion will settle, in Jerusalem. 𝄓 To weep, you will not weep. He will be gracious to you at the voice of your appeal. When he hears it, he will answer you.

Though my Lord give to you the bread of anguish and the water of restriction, 𝄓 yet your instructor will not cover himself with his wings any more, and it will be that your eyes will see your instructor.
And your ears will hear a word behind you, saying, 𝄓 This is the way. Walk in it when you turn right or when you turn left.
And you will defile the overlay of your graven images of silver, and the ephod of your molten images of gold. 𝄓 You will consecrate them like an infirmity. Go forth, you will say to it.

And he will grant the rain of your seed that you will sow in the ground, and bread, the income of the ground, and it will be fat and stout. 𝄓 your livestock will pasture in that day in a broad meadow.
And the droves and the foals, the servants of the ground, they will eat leavened fodder, 𝄓 that has been winnowed with fragrance and with pitchfork.
And there will be over every haughty hill and over every hillock lifted up, productive streams of water, 𝄓 in the day of abundant slaying when towers fall.

And the light of the white will become as the light of the warmth, and the light of the warmth will be seven times the light of seven days, 𝄓 in the day that Yahweh binds the shattering of his people, and the wound of his defeat, heals. P
Behold the name of Yahweh comes from afar, kindled with his anger, glorious in its bearing. 𝄓 His lips are full of indignation, and his tongue is as fire devouring.
And his spirit like a torrent overflowing, will reach half way up a neck, a wave offering of nations elevated in vain, 𝄓 and a bridle from wandering, on the cheeks of the peoples.
The song will be yours as in the night of a holy festive sacrifice, 𝄓 and gladness of heart, as one goes with a flute to enter to the hill of Yahweh, to the rock of Israel.

And Yahweh will make the splendour of his voice heard and the repose of his arm he will show, in the outrage of the anger, and the flame of a consuming fire, 𝄓 smashing, and inundation, and hailstone.
For from the voice of Yahweh Ashur will be dismayed. 𝄓 He will strike with the sceptre.
And anyone passing through the rod of the foundation to whom Yahweh has given rest, will be with timbrels and harps. 𝄓 And with battles of a wave offering, he fights with them.
For seduction was previously arranged, even this for the king, prepared, deep, broad, 𝄓 from a generation of fire and much timber. The breath of Yahweh, like a torrent of pitch, kindles it. P

Alas for those who go down to Egypt for help. On horses they lean, 𝄓 and they trust in chariot for abundance, and in cavalry for they are very numerous, but they do not look on the Holy One of Israel, and Yahweh they do not search out.
And moreover he is wise and brings evil, and his words he has not put aside, 𝄓 but will arise over the house of evildoers, and over the help of workers of mischief.

And Egyptians are human and not God, and their horses flesh and not spirit, 𝄓 and Yahweh will stretch out his hand, and helper will stumble, and the one helped will fall, and they together, all of them, will be consumed. S

Because thus says Yahweh to me, As meditates the lion, or the cub over its prey, when a fullness of shepherds calls against it, from their voice he is not dismayed, nor from their tumult is he afflicted, 𝄓 so Yahweh of hosts will come down to the host on the hill of Zion, and over its hillock.
As birds flying, so Yahweh of hosts will defend over Jerusalem. 𝄓 Defending, also he will deliver one that is lame and let it escape.
Turn to whom the children of Israel are in deep revolt.
For in that day, each will refuse its good for nothing silver and its good for nothing gold, 𝄓 that your hands made for yourselves to sin.
And Ashur will fall by the sword, not of a man, and a sword not of a human, will devour him. 𝄓 He will withdraw for himself in the face of a sword, and his chosen ones will be in forced service.
And his cliff from terror will pass away, and his nobles will be dismayed from a standard. 𝄓 An oracle of Yahweh, whose light is in Zion and whose oven is in Jerusalem. P
Lo, for righteousness a sovereign will reign, 𝄓 and re nobility, they will influence for judgment.
And each will become as camouflage for wind, and a hiding place from inundation, 𝄓 as streams of water in arid places, like the shadow of a heavy cliff in an exhausted earth.
And the eyes of those who see will not look away, 𝄓 and the ears of whose who hear will pay attention.
And the heart of the impetuous will discern knowledge, 𝄓 and the stammering tongue will be impetuous to speak glowingly.
Senseless will no longer be called willing, 𝄓 nor will the knave be said to be crying for help.
For senseless speaks senselessness and its heart makes mischief, 𝄓 to do hypocrisy, and to speak wandering to Yahweh, and to make a famished self empty and to deprive drink from the thirsty.
And knave! its instruments are evil. 𝄓 It schemes to take counsel to inflict pain on the poor while saying falsehood, even when the word of the needy is astute.
But the willing willingly take counsel, 𝄓 and such to willing acts will arise. S
Tranquil women, arise, hear my voice. 𝄓 Trusting daughters, give ear to what I say.
From days to years you will shudder trusting, 𝄓 for faint is the vintage. Ingathering will not come.
Be apprehensive, O tranquil women. Shudder you who trust. 𝄓 Strip and be laid bare, and be attired over your reins.
To breasts wailing, 𝄓 to fields coveted, to a vine bearing fruit,
To the ground of my people, bramble-spike will come up, 𝄓 over all the houses of joy, the town exultant.
For the citadel will be abandoned, the tumult of the city forsaken. 𝄓 Promontory and watchtower will be for caves for ever, the joy of wild donkeys, the pasture of troops.
Until spirit from on high is exposed over us, 𝄓 and wilderness becomes a plantation, and the plantation be reckoned as forest.
Then judgment will dwell in the wilderness, 𝄓 and righteousness in the plantation will settle.
And the deed of righteousness will be peace, 𝄓 and the service of righteousness quiet and trust for evermore.
And my people will settle at home in peace, 𝄓 and in trusted dwelling-places and in tranquil resting-places.
And when hail descends on the forest, 𝄓 then in a lowly place, humble is the city.
Happy are you who sow over all waters, 𝄓 who set loose the foot of the bull and the ass. S

Ah devastator, and you were not devastated, and treacherous, and they were not treacherous in it. 𝄓 As you complete devastation, you will be devastated. As you finish with treachery, they will be treacherous with you. S
Yahweh be gracious to us. For you we have waited. 𝄓 Be their arm in the morning, indeed our salvation in a time of trouble.
From the voice of tumult, peoples fled. 𝄓 From your exaltation, nations were smashed.
And your spoil will be gathered, the gathering of the caterpillar, 𝄓 as shiftless as great grubs shifting about in it.
Set on high is Yahweh because he dwells on high. 𝄓 Full is Zion of judgment and righteousness.
And shrewdness and knowledge will be the faithfulness of your time, the invincibility of victories. 𝄓 The fear of Yahweh, it is its fund. P
Lo their lion-hearted will cry out outside. 𝄓 Messengers of peace bitterly will weep.
Highways desolated, itinerant ceased, 𝄓 covenant thwarted, cities refused, he does not consider a mortal.
Earth enfeebled laments, Lebanon festering, is confounded, 𝄓 the plain becomes as steppe, and tossed are Bashan and Carmel. S
Now I will arise, says Yahweh. 𝄓 Now I will be exalted. Now I will be lifted up.
You will be pregnant with hay. You will give birth to stubble. 𝄓 Your wind will devour you with fire.
And peoples will become as incinerations of lime. 𝄓 Brambles cut up in the fire, they will be charred. P
Hear, you who are distant, what I have done. 𝄓 Now set down this, you who are near, I will prevail.
Sinners in Zion were in dread. Trembling grasps hypocrites. 𝄓 Who will guest for us with a consuming fire? Who will guest for us with an everlasting burning mass.

One walking in righteousness, and who speaks uprightness, 𝄓 who has refused the extortion of oppression, tossing its palms, retaining a bribe, who plugs its own ear from hearing of blood, and staunches its eyes from seeing evil.
He from the high ground will dwell, from the fortress of cliffs is his retreat, 𝄓 his bread given, his waters faithful.
A king in his beauty your eyes will gaze on. 𝄓 They will see the land of those who are far off.
Your heart will meditate on horror. 𝄓 Where is the secretary? Where is the appraiser? Where is the one who counts the great things?
A barbarous people you do not see, 𝄓 a people of more inscrutable language than you can hear, a derisive indiscernible tongue.

Gaze on Zion, the town of our engagement. 𝄓 Your eyes will see Jerusalem, home of one without a care, a tent not to be dismantled. Its tent pegs will not be pulled out in perpetuity, and none of its ropes will be snapped.
In contrast, there, the majesty of Yahweh is for us, a place of rivers, canals, broad of hand. 𝄓 No ship with oars will go in it, nor majestic galley pass through it.
For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. 𝄓 Yahweh our king, he will save us.
Abandoned are your ropes. 𝄓 They do not make resolute as such their mast. They have not spread a spinnaker. Then increased spoil is divided further. The lame will despoil the loot.
Nor will a neighbour say, I am ill. 𝄓 O people who settle in her, lifted up is iniquity. S
Come near nations to hear, and tribes attend. 𝄓 Let the land hear and its fullness, the world and all emerging from it.
For the rage of Yahweh is on all the nations, and heat over all their hosts, 𝄓 to utterly destroy them. He will give them to the slaughter.
And their profaned will be cast down and their carcasses, their stink will ascend, 𝄓 and the hills will be molten from their blood.
And all the host of the heavens will rot. The heavens will be rolled up like a book, 𝄓 and all their hosts will wither as a leaf from the vine withers and as the withering a fig tree.
For saturated in the heavens is my sword. 𝄓 Behold on Edom it descends, and over the people of my ban for lessons in judgment.

The sword of Yahweh is full of blood, fattened from the choicest with the blood of butting lambs and goats, from the choicest of the kidneys of rams, 𝄓 for an offering to Yahweh in the enclosure [Bozrah], and great slaughter in the land of Edom.
And wild bulls will come down with them, and young bulls with the mighty, 𝄓 and their land will be saturated with blood and their dust from the choicest will be fattened,
For a day of the vengeance of Yahweh, 𝄓 a year of repayment for the contention of Zion.
And her torrents will be changed to tar and her dust to pitch, 𝄓 and her land will be for tar kindled.
Night and day not quenched, forever her smoke will ascend. 𝄓 From generation to generation, deserted, in perpetual perpetuity, none will pass through her.
And unclean bird and porcupine and barn owl will possess her, and raven will dwell in her, 𝄓 and he will stretch out on her a line of disorder and stones of the void.
Her freeborn, (but none is there) her royalty will proclaim, 𝄓 and all her nobility will be terminated.
And prickles will come up in her citadels, stinging nettle and thorns in her enclosures, 𝄓 and she will be the home of jackals, grass to the daughters of an ostrich.
And wild places will meet coasts, and kid against its associate will call. 𝄓 Surely there is the uneasy Lilith, but she will find rest in her.
There is her nest, great owl, and she will lay and hatch and foment in her shadow. 𝄓 Surely there, kites are collected, each with her associate.
Search out from the record of Yahweh and recite. Not one from them will lag, each her associate will not visit, 𝄓 for my mouth has commanded it, and its spirit, itself, collects.
And he has let fall for them the lot, and his hand has divided for them by line. 𝄓 For evermore they will possess her, from generation to generation, they will dwell in her. S
Wilderness will sing for joy for them, and arid place, 𝄓 and steppe will rejoice and flourish like a crocus.

Flourishing they will flourish, and rejoice indeed, rejoicing and shouting for joy. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the honour of the plantation and the plain. 𝄓 They, they will see the glory of Yahweh, the honour of our God. P
Make resolute timid hands, 𝄓 and stumbling knees assure.
Say to the precipitous of heart, Be courageous. Do not fear. 𝄓 Behold your God. Vengeance, the recompense of God will come. He will come and will save you.
Then the eyes of the blind will receive sight, 𝄓 and the ears of the deaf will be opened.
Then one that is lame will leap as a hart and the tongue of the dumb will shout for joy, 𝄓 for waters will split in the wilderness, and torrents in the steppe.
And the mirage will become a pool, and thirsty ground will ferment with water, 𝄓 and the home of jackals reclining, will be grass with calamus and rush.
And a highway will be there, and a way. And the way of holiness it will be called. nothing unclean will pass through it, but it is for them. 𝄓 Traveler or foolish will not wander.
No lion will be there and no ravenous animal will ascend on it. It will not be found there. 𝄓 But the redeemed, they will walk.
And the ransomed of Yahweh will return and enter Zion with a shout of joy and gladness everlasting over their heads. 𝄓 Joy and mirth they will overtake, and sadness and sighing will withdraw. S
It was the fourteenth year of the reign of Hezekiah that Senacherib king of Ashur came up to all the cities of Judah enclosed and occupied them.

And the king of Ashur sent a cupbearer overlord from Lachish toward Jerusalem to king Hezekiah with heavy force. 𝄓 And he stood by the conduit of the blessing pool, the upper part, on the highway to the field of the fuller.
And Elyaqim child of Hilqiah, who is over the house, went out to him, 𝄓 and Shebna the secretary, and Joah child of Asaph, the archivist.
And the cupbearer overlord said to them, Say now to Hezekiah, 𝄓 Thus says the great king, the king of Ashur, What is this trust that you have trusted?
I said, (surely a lippy word). Counsel and valour to war. 𝄓 Now on whom do you trust that you mutiny against me?

Behold, you trust on the staff of this splintered calamus, of Egypt, which for anyone who wants its support, it will go into his palm and pierce him. 𝄓 So is Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, to all those who trust in him.

How then will you turn the face of one viceroy of the least of my lord's servants? 𝄓 And you put your trust in Egypt for chariot and cavalry!
So now, was it apart from Yahweh that I come up against this land to destroy it? 𝄓 said Yahweh to me, Go up to this land and destroy it. S

And Elyaqim said, and Shebna and Joah, to the overlord cupbearer, 𝄓 Speak, please, to your servants, Aramaic, for we are the ones hearing, and do not speak to us Judean in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

Do not hear Hezekiah, 𝄓 for thus says the king of Ashur, Deal me a blessing, and come forth to me, and eat, each of their vine, and each of their fig tree, and imbibe, each of the waters of their cistern,
until I come, and I will take you to a land like your land, 𝄓 a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards,
Lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, Yahweh will deliver us. 𝄓 Did any God of the nations deliver his land from the hand of the king of Ashur?
Where is the God of Hamath and Arpad? Where is the God of Sepharvaim, 𝄓 and that they delivered Samaria from my hands?
Who is among all the gods of these lands that did deliver their land from my hands, 𝄓 that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem from my hands?
But they kept silent and they did not answer him a thing, 𝄓 for the commandment of the king was this, saying, Do not answer him.

And Elyaqim child of Hilqiah came in, (who was over the house), and Shebna the secretary, and Joah child of Asaph, the archivist, to Hezekiah, their garments ripped, 𝄓 and they made clear to him the words of the cupbearer overlord. S
