Maybe Yahweh your God will hear the words of the overlord cupbearer whom the king of Ashur, his master, sent to reproach the God of life, and will referee with the words that Yahweh your God has heard. 𝄓 So lift up a prayer through the residue that is found.
And the servants of the king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
And Isaiah said to them, Thus you say to your master, 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh, Do not fear because of the presence of the words that you heard, with which the lads of the king of Ashur reviled me.
Note me well, giving in him a spirit, and he will hear what is heard, and return to his land, 𝄓 and I will make him fall by the sword in his land.
And the cupbearer overlord returned and found the king of Ashur warring against Libnah, 𝄓 for he had heard that he had pulled out from Lachish.
For he had heard concerning Tirhakah, king of Cush, saying, He has come out to fight you, 𝄓 for he had heard and he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
Thus you say to Hezekiah, king of Judah, saying, Do not let your God, in whom you trust, lure you, saying, 𝄓 Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Ashur.
Behold yourself, you heard what the kings of Ashur have done to all the lands to destroy them utterly, 𝄓 and will you be delivered?
Did the gods of the nations deliver them whom my ancestors have destroyed: even Gozan and Xaran, 𝄓 and Retzeph and the children of Eden that were in Thelasar?
Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, 𝄓 Hena, and Iva?
And Hezekiah received the correspondence from the hand of the messengers, and recited it, 𝄓 and he ascended to the house of Yahweh, and Hezekiah spread it in the presence of Yahweh. S
And Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,
Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, who sits on the cherubim, you are he, the God, you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. 𝄓 You yourself have made the heavens and the earth.
Bend Yahweh, your ear, and hear. Give sight, Yahweh, to your eye, and see, 𝄓 and hear all the words of Senacherib that he sent to reproach the God of life.
Truly Yahweh, 𝄓 the kings of Ashur have made desert of all the lands and their land.
And consigned their gods to the fire, 𝄓 for they are not God, but the construction of the hands of a human, tree and stone. So they have eliminated them.
And now, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, 𝄓 and they will know, all the kingdoms of the earth, that you are Yahweh, you alone.
And Isaiah child of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, What you prayed to me against Senacherib, king of Ashur,
this is the thing that Yahweh spoke concerning him, 𝄓 The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you, has derided you. Behind you, the daughter of Jerusalem has wagged a head.
Whom did you reproach and revile? And against whom have you been exalting a voice, 𝄓 and lifted up on high your eyes? to the Holy One of Israel.

By the hand of your servants you have reproached my Lord, and you have said, With my many chariots, I am. I have ascended the high ground of the hills, the flanks of Lebanon, 𝄓 and I will gouge the place of its cedars, its choice fir trees, and I will come into from on high its outskirts, the forest of its plantation.
I am my fountain, and I imbibe waters, 𝄓 and I will drain, by the sole of my footfall, all the canals of lower Egypt.
Have you not heard from afar what I have done from the days of old, and I fashioned it. 𝄓 Now I have made it come, for you, to reduce to rubble the struggles of enclosed cities.
So their inhabitants were short-handed. They were dismayed and reticent. 𝄓 They were herbs of the field and verdant foliage, housetop grass and a field before it arises.
But your seat, and your going out, and your coming in, I know, 𝄓 and your shuddering against me.

Because your shuddering against me, and your tranquility has come up in my ears, 𝄓 and I have put my thorn in your nose, and my bit in your lips, and I will have you return in the way by which you have come.

And this to you is the sign: you will eat this year accidental planting and in the second year, volunteer planting, 𝄓 and in the third year, sow and reap, and they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
And the residue will add to the security of the house of Judah, a rootstock downward, 𝄓 and make fruit upward.
For from Jerusalem a residue will go forth, and security from mount Zion. 𝄓 The jealousy of Yahweh of hosts will do this. S
Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning the king of Ashur, He will not come against this city, 𝄓 nor shoot there an arrow, nor confront her with a shield, nor pour out of a ramp, against her.
In the way that he entered, in it he will return, 𝄓 and to this city he will not come. An oracle of Yahweh.
And I will defend this city to save it, 𝄓 for my sake, and for the sake of David my servant. S
And the messenger of Yahweh came out and struck in the camp of Ashur a hundred and eighty five thousand, 𝄓 and they rose early in the morning and behold, all of them, dead carcasses.
So Senacherib king of Ashur pulled out, and went and returned. 𝄓 And he settled in Nineveh.

And it happened that he was worshiping in the house of Nisrok his God, and Adramelek and Sharetser, his children, struck him with the sword and they, they escaped into the land of Ararat, 𝄓 and Esarchadon his son reigned in his stead. S
In days those Hezekiah was ill to the point of death, 𝄓 and Isaiah child of Amoz the prophet came to him, saying to him, Thus says Yahweh, Set in order your house for you will die and not live.
And Hezekiah turned his face around to the house wall, 𝄓 and he prayed to Yahweh.

And he said, Beseeching, Yahweh, remember, if you will, that I walked in your presence in truth and with a heart at peace, and what is good in your eyes I have done. 𝄓 And Hezekiah wept, great weeping. S
And the word of Yahweh happened to Isaiah, saying,
Go and say to Hezekiah, Thus says Yahweh, the God of David your father, I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. 𝄓 Note me well adding to your days a fifteen year span.
And from the palm of the king of Ashur I will deliver you and this city. 𝄓 I will defend this city.
And this to you is the sign from Yahweh, 𝄓 that Yahweh will do this matter that he spoke.

Note me well, reversing the shadow of the degrees that it had gone down on the degrees of Ahaz in the sun, backward ten degrees. 𝄓 And the sun returned ten degrees by the degrees that it had gone down. S
The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, 𝄓 in his illness, and he lived from his illness.
I, I said in the muting of my days, I will go to the gates of the grave, 𝄓 officiating over the leftovers of my years.
I said, I will not see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. 𝄓 I will no longer take note of humanity with the inhabitants of the finite.

My generation is pulled out and exiled from me as the tent of my tending. 𝄓 I excise the warp like the weaver of my life from her trellis. He will find my mark. From day until night will you make me whole?
I conferred until morning. Like a lion indeed he breaks all my bones. 𝄓 From day until night will you make me whole?
Like a horse? A thrush indeed I did twitter. I muttered like a dove. 𝄓 My eyes are brought low from exaltation. My Lord, I am my oppression. Be my insurance.
What will I speak? And he say to me? And himself, he undertake? 𝄓 I will go in solemnity all my years over the bitterness that is mine.
My Lord, on them they will live, 𝄓 and for all, in them is the life of my spirit, and you will make me dream and I will live.
Behold of peace, bitterness to me, bitterness. 𝄓 But you, you have attached yourself to my being, impaired, worn out, for you have cast behind your back all my sin.
For the grave will not thank you, death praise you, 𝄓 Those going down into a pit will not inspect your truth.
One who lives, one who lives, he will give you thanks, like me today. 𝄓 Father to children will make known your truth.
Yahweh to save me, 𝄓 and my accompaniments we will perform all the days of our life over the house of Yahweh.
And Isaiah said, Take up a pressed lump of figs, 𝄓 and apply it over the ulcer and he will live.
And Hezekiah said, What is a sign, 𝄓 that I will ascend to the house of Yahweh? S
At that time Merodok-Baladan child of Baladan king of Babel sent correspondence and a gift to Hezekiah, 𝄓 for he had heard that he was ill but was resolute.

And Hezekiah was glad about them, and he showed them the house of his fortune, the silver and the gold, and the spices and the finest oil, and all the house of his vessels, and all that was found in his treasuries. 𝄓 There was no thing that Hezekiah did not show them in his house or in all his governance. S
And Isaiah the prophet came to king Hezekiah, 𝄓 and said to him, What did these persons say and from where did they come to you? And Hezekiah said, From a land far off they came to me, from Babel.
And he said, What did they see in your house? 𝄓 And Hezekiah said, All that is in my house they saw. There was no thing that I did not show them in my treasuries.
And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, 𝄓 Hear the word of Yahweh of hosts.
Behold days are coming and all that is in your house and that which your fathers had in the treasury until this day will be lifted up to Babel. 𝄓 No thing will remain, says Yahweh.
And of your children who emerge from you, which you will beget, they will be taken away. 𝄓 And they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babel.
And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, Good. The word of Yahweh that you have spoken. 𝄓 And he said, For there may be peace and truth in my days. P
Comfort, comfort, my people, 𝄓 says your God.
Speak to the heart of Jerusalem and call to her, for fulfilled is her pressed service, for accepted is her iniquity, 𝄓 for she has received from the hand of Yahweh double in all her sins. S
The voice of one calling, In the wilderness, face the way of Yahweh. 𝄓 Make a level place in the steppe, a highway for our God.
Every gorge will be lifted up, and every hill and hillock will be abased, 𝄓 and the footstep will be for the level place and the cliques for the crevasse.
And disclosed is the glory of Yahweh, 𝄓 and all flesh will see together, for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken. P
A voice said, Proclaim. And I said, What will I proclaim? 𝄓 All the flesh is grass, and all its kindness as the blade of the field.
Grass dries up. Blossom withers, for the spirit of Yahweh dispatches it. 𝄓 Surely the people are grass.
Grass dries up. Blossom withers, 𝄓 and the word of our God is placed forever. S

Above a haughty hill, go up for yourself, one bearing good news of Zion. Lift high in power your voice, one bearing good news of Jerusalem. 𝄓 Lift high. Have no fear. Say to the cities of Judah, Behold your God.
Behold my Lord Yahweh, resolute will come, and his arm will govern for him. 𝄓 Behold his wages are with him, and his work in his presence.
As a shepherd, his troop he will tend. In his arm, he will collect the patchwork and in his embrace lift it up. 𝄓 Infants, he will refresh. S
Who has measured his fistful of waters, or heaven in a span, stabilized, or nourished in three, the dust of the earth, 𝄓 or weighed in a level, the hills and the hillocks in the balance?
Who stabilizes the spirit of Yahweh, 𝄓 or as his counsel informs him?
With whom did he take counsel, that he would give him understanding, or teach him in the road of judgment, 𝄓 or teach him knowledge, and the way of understanding make known to him?
Lo, nations are as a brew distilled. As pulverized from balances, they are reckoned. 𝄓 Lo, coasts as finely ground, he hurls down.
And Lebanon is not enough for kindling, 𝄓 nor its animals enough for a burnt offering. P
All the nations are as nothing before him. 𝄓 From an extreme and formless, they are considered by him.
And to whom will you liken the One? 𝄓 Or to what likeness will you compare him?
The graven image spilled out by a smith, 𝄓 and with refined gold pummeled, and manacled with refined silver?
One who is destitute makes a contribution to a tree. One that is not rotten he will choose. 𝄓 He will seek a wise smith for him to establish a graven image not to be moved. S
Have you not known? Have you not heard? Has it not been evident from the beginning to you? 𝄓 Have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?
Who sits on the ambit of the earth, (and her inhabitants are like grasshoppers), 𝄓 stretching out, as if flimsy, the heavens, and unfurling them as a tent to settle in?
Who consigns rule-makers to nothing, 𝄓 those who judge the earth, he constructs as formless.

Indeed they will not be planted. Indeed they will not be sown. Indeed their stump will not be rooted in the earth. 𝄓 And moreover, he will breeze into them and they will be ashamed, and tempest as stubble will bear them away. S
And to whom will you liken me or will I be equaled? 𝄓 says the Holy One.
Lift up on high your eyes and see. Who created these? Who brings forth by count their host, calling to them all by name, 𝄓 from abundance of vigour and assurance of power? None lags behind. S
Why do you say, Jacob, or speak, Israel, 𝄓 My way is hid from Yahweh, and from my God, my judgment will pass away?
Do you not know or have you not heard? God everlasting, Yahweh, who creates the extremes of the earth, does not tire nor is he weary. 𝄓 There is no examining his understanding.
He gives to the tired, power, 𝄓 to those without vigour, he increases staunchness.
And youngsters will tire and be weary, 𝄓 and youths in their prime, they will stumble.
But who waits for Yahweh will renew power. They will ascend on the pinions of eagles. 𝄓 They will race and not be weary. They will walk on and will not tire. S
Be silent for me, coasts, and let tribes renew power. 𝄓 Let them come close, then let them speak, and as one for lessons in judgment, let us come near.
Who roused righteousness from the sunrise, called him to his feet, 𝄓 gave, in his presence, nations, and made him rule sovereigns? His sword gives like dust, his bow blows as stubble.
He pursued them, passing through whole. 𝄓 No path by his feet was entered.
Who works and will do the calling of the generations from the beginning? 𝄓 I am Yahweh, first, and with those who follow after. I am he.
Coasts see and will fear, the extremes of the earth are apprehensive, 𝄓 come near, and arrive.
Each helped its associate, 𝄓 and to its kin said, Be encouraged.
So a smith encouraged a refiner, and one who smooths with a forge-hammer, one who smites an anvil, 𝄓 saying, It is good for the soldering. And he resolved it with nails. It will not be moved. S
And you Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, 𝄓 seed of Abraham whom I loved,
Whom I encouraged from the ends of the earth and from her elect I called you, 𝄓 and I said to you, My servant you are. I have chosen you and not refused you.
Do not fear, for I am with you. Do not look away, for I am your God. 𝄓 I will assure you, indeed I will help you, indeed I will maintain you with the right hand of my righteousness.
Lo, let them be ashamed and humiliated, all those who burn against you. 𝄓 They will be as nothing and those who contend with you will perish.
You will seek and not find those who struggle with you. 𝄓 They will be as nothing, and as a termination, those who are at war with you.
For I am Yahweh your God who holds resolute your right hand, 𝄓 saying to you, Do not fear. I myself will help you. S
Have no fear, worm Jacob, men of Israel. 𝄓 I myself will help you, an oracle of Yahweh, and your redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
Behold I will set you as a sharp new threshing instrument, the owner of edges. 𝄓 You will pound the hills and finely grind, and the hillocks like chaff you will set.
You will winnow them, and wind will bear them away, and tempest will disperse them. 𝄓 And you will rejoice in Yahweh. In the Holy One of Israel you will boast. S
The poor and the needy seek water, and there is none, their tongues desiccated of thirst. 𝄓 I Yahweh will answer them. The God of Israel will not forsake them.
I will open rivers over protruding places and among crevasses, springs. 𝄓 I will set up wilderness as a pool of water, and an arid land as emerging water.
I will give in the wilderness, cedar, acacia, and myrtle and oil tree. 𝄓 I will set up in the steppe, fir tree, pine, and boxwood together.
So that they may see and know and set out and have insight together that the hand of Yahweh has done this, 𝄓 and the Holy One of Israel has created it. P
Approach with your dispute, says Yahweh. 𝄓 Make overture with your sheer numbers, says the sovereign of Jacob.
Let them make overture and tell us what will transpire, 𝄓 the former things, what they make evident, and we will set our heart so we may know their aftermath, or broadcast what is to come.
Make evident what is to arrive afterwards, so we may know that you are God. 𝄓 Indeed, do good or do evil, that we may cry for help, and see it together.
Lo, you are from nothing and your works puffed up. 𝄓 An abomination it is, to choose you. P
I have roused from the north, and he will arrive from the rising of the sun. He will call in my name. 𝄓 And he will conduct prefects like mortar, and as one who fashions by trampling muck.

Who made it clear from the beginning that we may know? And from before, and we said, The righteous one? 𝄓 Ha! There is none making clear. Ha! There is none broadcasting. Ha! There is none to hear your sayings.
First to Zion, behold these. 𝄓 And to Jerusalem, I will give one to bring good news.
And I saw that there was no person from them, and there was no counselor. 𝄓 If I asked them, they returned pestilence.
Lo all of them are mischief. Terminated are their deeds. 𝄓 A wind that is formless, their molten images. P
Lo, my servant. I will maintain him. My chosen, my very self accepts. 𝄓 I have given my spirit to him. The judgment of the nations, he will bring forth.
He will not cry out and he will not lift up, 𝄓 or make his voice heard in the street.
A damaged purchase he will not break, and dim flax he will not quench. 𝄓 To truth he will bring forth judgment.
He will not dim and he will not be damaged until he has set judgment in the land, 𝄓 and for his instruction, coasts will hope. P

Thus says the God, Yahweh, who creates the heavens and stretches them out, the expanse of the earth, and what emerges from it. 𝄓 He gives breath to the people on it and spirit to those who walk in it.
I am Yahweh. I call to you in righteousness, and I will give courage into your hand, 𝄓 and I will preserve you, and I will give you for a covenant of a people, for a light to nations.
To give sight to blind eyes, 𝄓 to bring forth prisoner from prison, from the house of restraint those sitting in darkness.
I am Yahweh. This is my name, 𝄓 and my glory to another I will not give, nor my praise to graven images.
The former things, behold they came, 𝄓 and new things I am making clear. Ere they grow, I broadcast with you. P
Sing to Yahweh a new song, praise from the extremity of the earth, 𝄓 those descending to the sea and its fullness, coasts and their inhabitants.
Let wilderness and its cities lift up, courts where blackness sits, 𝄓 let them shout for joy. The inhabitants of a cliff, from the top of the hills, let them complain.
Let them render to Yahweh glory, 𝄓 and his praise in the coasts make evident.
Yahweh, as one who prevails comes forth, as one among warriors he arouses jealousy. 𝄓 He will raise a shout. Indeed, he will scream. Against his enemies he prevails. S
I was calm from everlasting, I will be silent, repressing myself. 𝄓 As if giving birth, I will puff up, I will bear breath and I will bear down together.
I will make the hills and the hillocks desert and all their herbs I will dry up, 𝄓 and I will set rivers as coasts, and pools I will dry up.

And I will usher the blind in a way they do not know, in pathways they do not know I will direct them. 𝄓 I will set up darkness before them for light, and devious things as a level place. These things I will do to them and I will not forsake them.
They will be relocated from behind, they will be ashamed, the shame of those who trust in a graven image, 𝄓 those saying before the molten metal, You are our God. P
You deaf, hear, 𝄓 and you blind, take note that you may see.
Who is blind but my servant, or deaf as my messenger that I will send? 𝄓 Who is blind as the one who is whole, or blind as the servant of Yahweh?
You see many things but you are not watching, 𝄓 giving sight to ears but not hearing.
Yahweh is delighted because of his righteousness. 𝄓 He will magnify instruction and make it majestic.

But this is a people despoiled and plundered, snared in holes all of them, and in houses of restraint they are camouflaged. 𝄓 They are to be despoiled and there is none to deliver, plundered and there is none saying, Return.
Who among you will listen to this, 𝄓 will attend and hear for tomorrow?
Who gives Jacob and Israel for plunder and for despoiling? Is it not Yahweh? 𝄓 This! We have sinned! For him? Nor would they consent to walk in his ways and they did not hear his instruction.
So he has poured out on him the heat of his anger and the strength of war, 𝄓 and has blazed him round about and he did not know, and kindled him but he did not set it to heart.
So now, thus says Yahweh who created you, O Jacob, and who fashioned you, O Israel, 𝄓 Do not fear, for I have redeemed you. I have called in your name. Mine, you are.
When you pass through the waters, with you I am, and in the rivers, they will not overflow you. 𝄓 When you go into a fire, you will not be branded, and to the flame, it will not kindle in you.
For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your saviour. 𝄓 I have given Egypt for your cover-price, Cush and Seba, in stead of you.
From which you are precious in my sight. You are glorified, and I myself have loved you. 𝄓 And I give humanity in stead of you, and tribes in stead of your very self.
Do not fear for with you I am. 𝄓 From the east, I will bring your seed, and from the west, I will collect you.
I will say to the north, Give. And to the south, Do not restrain. 𝄓 Bring my sons from afar, my daughters from the extremity of the earth,
Everyone called in my name. And for my glory I have created him. 𝄓 I have fashioned him. Indeed I have made him.
Bring out people who are blind, for there are eyes, 𝄓 and the deaf, and ears for them.

Let all the nations be collected together, and let the tribes be gathered. Who among them can herald this and broadcast former things to us? 𝄓 Let them give their witnesses, that they may be justified, and let them hear, and let them say, Truth.

You are my witnesses, an oracle of Yahweh, and my servant whom I have chosen, 𝄓 so that you may know, and you may believe me. And you will discern that I am he. Before me, God was not fashioned, and after me, there will be none. S
I, I am Yahweh, 𝄓 and there is, apart from me, no saviour.
I, I announce, and I will save, and I broadcast, that there will be among you no estranged, 𝄓 and you are my witnesses, an oracle of Yahweh, that I am God.
Moreover from day, I am he, and there is none to deliver out of my hand. 𝄓 I will work and who will turn it away? S
Thus says Yahweh, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, 𝄓 For your sake I have sent toward Babel, and have brought down their fugitives, all of them, and the Chaldeans. In the ships is their shout.
I am Yahweh, your Holy One, 𝄓 creator of Israel, your sovereign. S
Thus says Yahweh, who gives in the sea, a way, 𝄓 and in the strong waters, a pathway,
Who brings forth rider and horse, force and strength. 𝄓 Together they lie down. They will not arise. They are extinguished, as flax is quenched.
You will not remember former things, 𝄓 and the things of old you will not discern.
Behold me doing a new thing. Now it will sprout. Will you not know it? 𝄓 Also I will set up in the wilderness a way, in the wasteland, rivers.
The animals of the field will glorify me, jackals and the daughters of an ostrich, 𝄓 for I have given waters in the wilderness, rivers in the wasteland, to irrigate my people, my chosen.
This people I have fashioned for me, my praise they will recount. S
But you have not called me, O Jacob, 𝄓 for you have wearied me, O Israel.
You have not brought me the lamb of your burnt offerings, and with your sacrifices, you have not glorified me. 𝄓 I have not made you serve with a gift, nor wearied you with frankincense.
You have not purchased calamus for me with silver, and with the gross fat of your offerings you have not saturated me, 𝄓 but you have made me serve in your sins, and wearied me in your iniquities.
I, I am he who wipes out your transgression for my sake, 𝄓 and your sins, I will not remember.
Remember me. Let us judge together. 𝄓 Recount, yourself, so you may be justified.
Your first father sinned, 𝄓 and your translators have transgressed against me.
So I have profaned the chiefs of the sanctuary, 𝄓 and I have given to utter destruction, Jacob, and Israel to reviling. P
So now hear, Jacob, my servant, 𝄓 and Israel. I have chosen in him.
Thus says Yahweh your maker, and who fashioned you from a belly, I will help you. 𝄓 Do not fear, my servant, Jacob, and Jeshurun. I have chosen in him.
For I will infuse water to the thirsty, and flowing over dry land. 𝄓 I will infuse my spirit over your seed, and my blessing on what comes forth from you.
And they will sprout as amid grass, 𝄓 as willows by productive water.
This one says, Yahweh's I am. And this one will call in the name of Jacob. 𝄓 And this one will inscribe his hand, Yahweh's, and in the name of Israel entitle himself. P
Thus says Yahweh king of Israel, and his redeemer, Yahweh of hosts, 𝄓 I am first, and I am last, and apart from me there is no God.
And who such as I, will call, and will make it clear, and will arrange it for me? I set in place the people of eras past, 𝄓 and what arrives, and that which will come, let them make clear to them.
Do not be in dread and do not fear. Have I not from then reported to you and made it clear? And you are my witnesses. 𝄓 Is there God apart from me? And there is no Rock that I do not know.
Fashioners of a graven image, all of them, are disordered, and their attractions are useless. 𝄓 And they are their own witnesses. They do not see and they do not know. So let them be ashamed.
Who has fashioned a god, or graven image has spilled out, 𝄓 with nary a use?
Lo, all their companions will be ashamed. And the artificers, they are human. 𝄓 Let them be rallied, all of them. Let them stand. Let them be in dread. Let them be ashamed together.
Smith with iron tool both works in the hot coals and with hammers fashions it, 𝄓 and works with the arm of his power, even famished and without power, imbibing no water and tired.

Carpenter, piece of wood stretching out a line, forms a pleat, constructs it with planes, and with compass he forms it. 𝄓 And he makes it as the pattern of a man, as the adornment of a human, to sit it in a house.
He cuts for it cedar, or takes cypress or oak, and, assured for it among the trees of the forest, 𝄓 he plants a sapling that heavy rain will grow.

And it will be for a human, for kindling, and to be received from them, and for heat, indeed, ignited, and to bake bread. 𝄓 Also to work a god, and worship it, making a graven image, and paying homage to it?
Its half incinerated into a fire, with its half, flesh for the eating, roasting a roast, and sated, 𝄓 indeed, warmth, and saying, Aha, I am warm. I have seen a light.
And its residue, for making a god? for its graven image? 𝄓 to pay homage to it? and worship? and pray to it? and say, Deliver me, for my God you are?
They do not know and they do not understand, 𝄓 for he has plastered from seeing, their eyes, from insight, their heart.

One does not reply to his heart, nor know, nor discern, saying, Its half I incinerated in a fire, and also I have baked bread on its coals. I have roasted flesh, and I have eaten. 𝄓 And its surplus into an abomination will I make? To a hunk of a tree will I pay homage?
He grazes on ashes, heart deluded, bent, 𝄓 nor can he deliver his very self, nor say, Is there no falsehood in my right hand? S
Remember these, Jacob, and Israel, for my servant you are. 𝄓 I have fashioned you. My servant you are, Israel. Do not be oblivious of me.
I have wiped out as a thick cloud your transgressions, and as a cloud your sins. 𝄓 Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

Shout for joy, heaven, for Yahweh has made it so. Raise a shout, lower parts of the earth. Erupt, hills, with a loud shout, forest and every tree in it. 𝄓 For Yahweh has redeemed Jacob, and in Israel, he has adorned himself. S
Thus says Yahweh your redeemer, and who fashioned you from a belly, 𝄓 I am Yahweh, doing all, stretching out the heavens alone, the expanse of the earth by myself.
Who thwarts the signs of those who contrive, and the soothsayers he makes dunderheads, 𝄓 reversing the wise from behind, and their knowledge making silly.

Raising the word of his servant, and the counsel of his messengers making whole, 𝄓 saying to Jerusalem, You will be inhabited. And to the cities of Judah, You will be built. And her ruins I will raise up.
Saying to the depth, Be drained, 𝄓 and your rivers, I will dry up.
Saying to Cyrus, my shepherd, and all my delight he will make whole. 𝄓 And to say to Jerusalem, You will be built, and, the temple, Your foundation will be laid. P

Thus says Yahweh to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have made resolute, to wrap nations before him. And the loins of sovereigns I will loose, 𝄓 to open before him portals and gates. They will not be latched.
I myself will go before you. And the honoured, I will make upright. 𝄓 Brazen gateways I will break, and bars of iron I will truncate.
And I will give to you the treasuries of darkness, and the buried treasure from hidden places, 𝄓 in order that you may know that I am Yahweh, the one calling in your name, the God of Israel.
For the sake of my servant, Jacob, and Israel my chosen, 𝄓 I called to you in your name. I have entitled you, and you do not know me.
I am Yahweh and there is none else. Except me, there is no God. 𝄓 I have girded you and you do not know me.
So that they will know from the rising of the sun and from the sunset, that it is ended apart from me. 𝄓 I am Yahweh, and there is none else,
fashioning light and creating darkness, making peace and creating evil, 𝄓 I am Yahweh doing all these. P
Let heaven drip from above and let skies flow with righteousness. 𝄓 Let the earth open, and let them be fruitful. Let salvation and righteousness grow together. I, Yahweh, I have created it. S
Alas for one who strives with the one who fashions him, potsherd with the potsherds of the ground, 𝄓 Will clay say to its potter, What are you doing? And your work, there are no hands for it? S
Alas for one who says to a father, What did you beget? 𝄓 And to the woman, What have you birthed? S
Thus says Yahweh the Holy One of Israel and its fashioner, 𝄓 What is to arrive? Ask me concerning my children. And concerning the work of my hands, command me.
I am. I made earth, and the human on it I created. 𝄓 I am. My hands stretched out heaven, and all their hosts I have commanded.
I am. I have roused him in righteousness and all his ways I will make upright. 𝄓 He himself will build my city. and my exiles he will send. Not at a price and not for a bribe, says Yahweh of hosts. S

Thus says Yahweh, The labour of Egypt and the wares of Cush and Seba, persons of measure to you will transfer, and yours they will be. Behind you they will walk. In chains, they will transfer. 𝄓 And to you, they will prostrate themselves. To you, they will pray, Surely among you is the One, and there is none else. God has come to an end.
Notwithstanding, you are a God who hides himself, 𝄓 the God of Israel, a saviour.
They will be ashamed, and moreover they will be humiliated, all of them. 𝄓 Together they will go into humiliation, those who keep silence when notified.
Israel will be saved in Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. 𝄓 You will not be ashamed and you will not be humiliated for ever, eras past and for ever. P

Because thus says Yahweh who creates the heavens, God himself fashioning the land and making it. He himself will establish it. Not for disorder he created it. To settle in he fashioned it. 𝄓 I am Yahweh and there is none else.
Not in secret have I spoken in a place of the land of darkness. I said not to the seed of Jacob, Seek me in disorder. 𝄓 I, Yahweh, speak righteousness, making clear what is upright.
Collect yourselves and come. Come close together, those secured from the nations. 𝄓 They do not know, who lift up the wood of their graven images, or who pray to a god not able to save.

Make clear and bring close. Indeed let them counsel together. 𝄓 Who has broadcast this from antiquity, ever since making it clear? Is it not I, Yahweh? And there is no further God apart from me, God the righteous one, and saviour. There is none except me.
Face me and be saved, all the ends of the earth, 𝄓 for I am the One, and there is none else.
By myself I have sworn. A word goes out from my mouth in righteousness, 𝄓 and it does not return, for to me will bow down every knee, and every tongue will swear.
Surely in Yahweh, mine, he says, are righteousness and strength. 𝄓 To him will come and will be ashamed, all those who burn against him.
In Yahweh, all the seed of Israel will be justified, and will boast.
Bel bows down. Nebo ducks. Their idols are on an animal or a beast. 𝄓 Your carts are onerous, a load for the exhausted.
They duck, they bow down as one. They are not able to escape the load, 𝄓 and their group, into captivity has gone. P
Hear me, house of Jacob and all the residue of the house of Israel, 𝄓 who were onerous from a belly, who were borne from a womb.
And even to old age, I am he. And even grey hair, I myself will bear the burden. 𝄓 I myself have made, and I myself lift up, and I myself will bear the burden, and I will provide escape. S
To whom will you liken me or consider equal? 𝄓 or make a parable that we may be likened?
They lavish gold from a cup, and silver in purchase they weigh. 𝄓 They hire a refiner, and he makes it a god. They pay homage. Also they worship.

They lift it up on a shoulder. They bear it as burden and they leave it, lowering it, and it stands from its place, unfeeling. 𝄓 Indeed one will cry out to it, but it does not answer. From trouble, it will not save anyone. S
Remember this. Make yourselves for real. 𝄓 Restore yourselves, you transgressors against the heart.
Remember the former things from everlasting. 𝄓 For I am the One, and there is nothing else, God, and there is no extreme like me,
Making clear from the beginning, the things that will follow, and from antiquity, what had not been done, 𝄓 saying, My counsel will arise, and all my delight, I will do,
Calling from the sunrise a bird of prey, from a distant land, the person of my counsel. 𝄓 Indeed, I have spoken. Indeed, I will bring, I will fashion. Indeed, I will do it. S
Hear me, you mighty of heart, 𝄓 who are distant from righteousness.
I bring near my righteousness. It is not distant. And my salvation will not delay. 𝄓 And I will give, in Zion, salvation for Israel, my adornment. S
Come down, and sit on dust, virgin daughter of Babel. Sit on the earth without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans, 𝄓 for not again will they proclaim you tender and delicate.
Take millstones and grind flour. 𝄓 Uncover your headscarf, strip stalk, uncover leg, pass through rivers.
Your nakedness will be uncovered. Even your reproach will be seen. 𝄓 Vengeance I will receive, and I will not compel humanity. P
Our redeemer, Yahweh of hosts is his name, 𝄓 the Holy One of Israel.
Sit muted, and enter into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans, 𝄓 for not again will they proclaim you the valiant of kingdoms.
I was enraged over my people. I have profaned my own inheritance. And I gave them into your hand. 𝄓 You did not define compassion for them. Upon the aged, you have made your shackle especially heavy.
And you said, Forever I will be valiant, 𝄓 while you did not set these on your heart, nor have you remembered its consequences. P
And now hear this, O enthralled that inhabits with confidence, who says in her heart, I am, and my ends continue. 𝄓 I will not sit widowed, nor will I know bereavement.

But these two will come to you in a moment, in one day, bereavement and widowhood. 𝄓 As completeness they will come over you, for the abundance of your sorceries, for the sheer numbers of your excessive charms.
And you trusted in your evil. You said, None sees me. Your shrewdness and your knowledge, it has turned you. 𝄓 And you said in your heart, I am and my ends continue.
And evil will come over you. You will not know to seek it early. And calamity will fall on you. You will not be able to cover it. 𝄓 And catastrophe will come over you suddenly, without your forecast.
Stand now in your charms, and in the abundance of your sorceries in which you have laboured from your youth. 𝄓 Maybe you will be able to use. Maybe you will panic.
You are fatigued with the abundance of your counselors. 𝄓 Stand please and let the analysts of heaven, the visionaries among the stars, the monthly forecasters, save you from what will come over you.
Behold they are as stubble. Fire will incinerate them. They will not deliver themselves from the hand of the flame, 𝄓 it is no coal for bread, light to sit before it.
Indeed they are for you what you have laboured for, 𝄓 your vendors from your youth. Each to its passage, they will wander. None is your saviour. S

Hear this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and from the waters of Judah, emerged, 𝄓 who swear in the name of Yahweh, and in the God of Israel, they remember, not in truth and not in righteousness.
For a holy city, they call themselves, and over the God of Israel, they support themselves. 𝄓 Yahweh of hosts is his name. S
The former things from then I made clear, and from my mouth they emerged, and I broadcast them. 𝄓 Suddenly I acted, and they are coming.
From my knowledge that you are intransigent, 𝄓 with sinew of iron your scruff, and your forehead brazen,
I told you from then, before it came, I reported to you, 𝄓 lest you would say, My pained fetish did them, and my graven image, and my molten image commanded them.
You have heard, Gaze on all of it, and you, will you not make it clear? 𝄓 I have reported to you what is new from now, and preserved things and you did not know them.
Now they have been created, and not from then, facing day, and you did not hear them, 𝄓 lest you would say, Behold, I knew them.
Both you have not heard, and you did not know. Even from then, your ear was not opened. 𝄓 For I know that with treachery you would betray, for transgressor from a belly, it was proclaimed of you.
For the sake of my name, I will slow my anger, and for my praise, I will dampen myself for you, 𝄓 so as not to cut you off.
Behold, I have refined you, but not with silver. 𝄓 I have chosen you in the forge of affliction.
For my sake, for my sake will I act. For how will he be profaned? 𝄓 But my glory to another, I will not give. P
Hear me, Jacob, and Israel whom I have called. 𝄓 I am he. I am first. Also I am last.
Indeed my hand laid the foundation of earth, and my right hand cloaked heaven. 𝄓 I myself called to them. They stand together.
Collect yourselves, all of you, and hear. Who among them made these clear? 𝄓 Yahweh has loved him. He will do his delight in Babel, and his arm, the Chaldeans.
I myself, I have spoken. Indeed, I called him. 𝄓 I have brought him, and his way thrives.
Come near me. Hear this. Not from the beginning in secret have I spoken. From the time that has been, there am I. 𝄓 And now my Lord, Yahweh, has sent me, and his spirit. P
Thus says Yahweh, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, 𝄓 I am Yahweh your God who teaches you to be of use, who directs you in the way you will go.
Oh that you had paid attention to my commandments. 𝄓 Then like a river your peace would have been, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
Your seed would be as the sand, and the offspring of your inner parts as its particles. 𝄓 Not cut off and not exterminated is his name in my presence. S

Go forth from Babel. Run away from the Chaldeans. With a voice of a loud shout, make clear, broadcast this. 𝄓 Have it brought forth to the extremity of the earth. Say, Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob.
And they did not thirst in the deserts where he had them walk. From the rock he made water flow for them, 𝄓 and he split a rock and water gushed out.
There is no peace, says Yahweh, for the wicked. P
Pay heed, coasts, to me and attend, you tribes from afar, 𝄓 Yahweh from a belly called me. From the inner parts of my mother, he remembered my name.
And he set my mouth as a keen sword. In the shadow of his hand he has camouflaged me. 𝄓 And he has set me as an arrow pure. In his quiver he has hidden me.
And he said to me, My servant you are. 𝄓 Israel, that in you I will be adorned.
And I, I said, Without cause I have laboured to disorder, and in futility my power I have consumed. 𝄓 Nevertheless my judgment is with Yahweh and my work with my God. S

And now says Yahweh fashioning me from a belly to be a servant for him, to return Jacob to him, 𝄓 and Israel for him will be gathered, and I will be glorified in the eyes of Yahweh, and my God will be my strength.

And he said, It is slight that you should be my servant for the raising up of the sceptres of Jacob, or to restore the preserved of Israel, 𝄓 so I will give you for a light to the nations, to be my salvation to the extremity of the earth. S

Thus says Yahweh, the one redeeming Israel, his holy one, to a self despised, to a nation abhorred, to a servant of governors, Sovereigns will see and nobility arise and they will worship, 𝄓 because of Yahweh who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, and he will choose you. S

Thus says Yahweh, At an acceptable time I have answered you, and in the day of salvation I have helped you, 𝄓 and I will preserve you, and I will give you for a covenant of a people, to uphold earth, to effect an inheritance of desolated heritages.
To say to the prisoners, Go forth, to those who are in the darkness, Be disclosed. 𝄓 On journeys they will pasture, and in all protruding places will be their pastures.
They will not hunger, nor will they thirst, nor will mirage strike them or sun, 𝄓 for the one who has compassion will lead them, and by tumbling waters he will refresh them.
And I will set up all my mountains for a journey, 𝄓 and my highways will be exalted.
Behold, these are come from afar, 𝄓 and behold, these are from the treasured place and from the sea, and these from the land of Sinim.
Shout for joy, heaven, and rejoice, earth, and erupt, hills, with a loud shout, 𝄓 for Yahweh has comforted his people, and his afflicted he will nurture. S
But Zion said, Yahweh has forsaken me, 𝄓 and my Lord has forgotten me.
Does a woman forget her infant? out of compassion for the child of her belly? 𝄓 Even these may forget, but I myself will not forget you.
Lo, on palms I have engraved you. 𝄓 Your ramparts are in front of me continually.
Impetuous are your children. 𝄓 Those who overthrow you and those who make you a desert, from you will go out.

Lift up round about your eyes and see. All of them are collected. They come to you. 𝄓 I, Living, an oracle of Yahweh. For with all of them as trappings you will clothe yourself, and fasten them, as a bride,
for your deserts, and your desolations, and the land where you were overthrown. 𝄓 For now you will be fashioned from one who sits, and remote are those who swallowed you up.
Still let the children of your bereavement say in your ears, 𝄓 Strait to me is the place. Come close to me that I may sit.
And you say in your heart, Who gave these birth for me and I bereaved and bleak? 𝄓 Uncovered and turning aside, And who grew these? Lo I was bereft, alone. These, where have they been? P

Thus says my Lord Yahweh, Behold, I lift up to nations my hand, and to peoples I lift high my standard, 𝄓 and they will bring your sons in their forearms, and your daughters on a shoulder they will bear.

And sovereigns will be your nurses and noble women your nursing mothers. Noses to earth, they will worship you, and the dust of your feet they will lick. 𝄓 And you will know that I am Yahweh, of whom they are not ashamed who wait for me. S
Does one take from the valiant what is taken? 𝄓 Or do captives of the righteous one escape? S

Because thus says Yahweh, Even captives of the valiant will be taken, and what is taken by the ruthless will escape, 𝄓 and with your contender I myself will contend, and your children I myself will save.

And I will feed those who suppress you with their flesh, and as new pressed wine, with their blood, they will be intoxicated, 𝄓 and all flesh will know that I am Yahweh your saviour. And your redeemer is the Mighty One of Jacob. S

Thus says Yahweh, Where is the record of the cutting off of your mother, whom I have dismissed? or to whom among my creditors have I sold you? 𝄓 Lo, in your iniquities you sold yourselves, and in your transgressions your mother was dismissed.

Why when I came was there no person? I call and there is none to answer? Is my hand shortened from ransoming? Or is there no power in me to deliver? 𝄓 Lo, at my rebuke, I make desert of sea. I set rivers as wilderness. Their fish stink without water and die of thirst.
I clothe heaven with blackness, 𝄓 and sackcloth, I set to cover them. P

My Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who learn, that I should know to subvert a word with one who is tired. 𝄓 He arouses from morning to morning. He arouses for me an ear to hear as those who learn.
My Lord Yahweh has opened for me an ear, and I, I have not been provocative. 𝄓 From behind I have not been repulsed.
My body I have given to those who strike, and my cheeks to those who pare. 𝄓 My face I did not hide from humiliation and spitting.
And my Lord Yahweh will help me, so I will not be humiliated, 𝄓 so I have set my face like a flint and I know that I will not be ashamed.
Near is one who justifies me. Who will contend with me? Let us stand as one. 𝄓 Who is the husband of my judgment? Let him make overture to me.
Lo, my Lord Yahweh will help me. Who is he who will condemn me? 𝄓 Lo, all of them like a garment will fade. A moth will eat them up. S
Who is among you who fear Yahweh? 𝄓 Hear with the voice of his servant who walks dark places and without illumination for him. Let him trust in the name of Yahweh and lean on his God. S
Lo, all of you, incandescent with fire, girded with chains. 𝄓 Walk in the light of your fire and in the chains kindled from my hands. This is for you. To hardship you will lie down. S
Hear me pursuers of righteousness, seekers of Yahweh, 𝄓 Take note to the rock from which you are hewn and to the drilled pit from which you were quarried.
Take note of Abraham your father and of Sarah who endured your birth, 𝄓 for as one I called him and I blessed him and I increased him.

For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her deserts, and he sets her wilderness as Eden, and her steppes as the garden of Yahweh. 𝄓 Joy and mirth will be found in her, thanksgiving and the voice of a psalm. S
Attend to me, my people, and my tribes, to me listen, 𝄓 for instruction from me will go forth, and my judgment for the light of peoples, I will bring in a moment.
Near is my righteousness. My salvation comes forth, and my arm will judge peoples. 𝄓 On me coasts will wait, and on my arm they will hope.

Lift up your eyes to the heavens and take note of the earth beneath, for the heavens as smoke will be dissipated, and the earth like a garment will wear out, and her inhabitants like a gnat will die, 𝄓 but my salvation will be forever and my righteousness will not be dismayed. P
Hear me, you who know righteousness, the people with my instruction in their heart. 𝄓 Do not fear the reproach of a mortal, and from their revilings, do not be dismayed.
For like a garment, a moth will eat them up, and like wool, a louse will eat them, 𝄓 but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to the generation of generations. S

Be roused, be roused, be clothed with strength, O arm of Yahweh. Be roused as in the days of antiquity, the generations of eras past. 𝄓 Is it not the same as the hewing of Rahab or whistling for a dragon?
Is it not as making a desert of the sea, the water of an exceeding abyss, 𝄓 the setting of the deeps of the sea as a way the redeemed will pass through.
And the ransomed of Yahweh will return and enter Zion with a shout of joy and everlasting gladness over their heads. 𝄓 Joy and mirth they will overtake. Sadness and sighing will withdraw. S
I, I am he that comforts you. 𝄓 Who are you that you should fear from a mortal that will die, or from the children of humanity made as grass?

And do you forget Yahweh your maker, bending the heavens, and founding earth, dreading continually all the day long in the presence of the heat of distress, as if it were prepared to destroy, 𝄓 and where is the heat of the distress?
Swiftly the stooped is loosed, 𝄓 and he will not die to destruction, and his bread will not be lacking.
But I am Yahweh your God. Uneasy is the sea and its waves murmur. 𝄓 Yahweh of hosts is his name.
And I have put my words in your mouth, and in the shadow of my hand I have covered you, 𝄓 to plant the heavens and to lay the foundation of earth and to say to Zion, My people you are. S
Be roused, be roused, arise O Jerusalem, who have imbibed from the hand of Yahweh the cup of his heat, 𝄓 the lees of the cup of staggering, you have imbibed, pressed out.
There is none to refresh her from all the children she has begotten, 𝄓 and there is none to encourage in her hand, from all the children she has reared.
Twice, behold, I call to you. Who will condole you? 𝄓 The devastation and the brokenness and the famine and the sword, by whom will I comfort you?
Your children languish. They lie down at the head of all the streets, as an antelope in fever, 𝄓 filled with the heat of Yahweh, the rebuke of your God.
Therefore hear, please, this, O afflicted, 𝄓 and intoxicated, and not from wine. P

Thus says your Lord Yahweh, and your God that contends with his people, Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering, 𝄓 the lees of the cup of my heat. Not again will you imbibe of it any more.
But I will set it into the hand of those who sadden you, who said to your being, Worship so we may pass through. 𝄓 And you set as the earth your back, and as a street to those who passed through. P

Be roused, be roused, be clothed with your strength, Zion. 𝄓 Be clothed with the garments of your adornment, Jerusalem, city of holiness, for not again will the fore-skinned or the unclean come into you any more.
Brush yourself from the dust. Arise, inhabitants of Jerusalem. 𝄓 Open yourself from the bonds around your neck, captive daughter of Zion. S
For thus says Yahweh, for you sold yourselves for nothing, 𝄓 and not with silver will you be redeemed. S
Because thus says my Lord Yahweh, my people descended to Egypt in the beginning to reside there, 𝄓 and Ashur in the end oppressed them.
And now what have I here? An oracle of Yahweh. For my people is taken for nothing. 𝄓 Those governing them torment them. An oracle of Yahweh. And continually, all the day long, my name is spurned.
