And you gave them this land that you swore to their ancestors to give them, 𝄓 a land gushing with milk and honey.

And they came and they possessed it, and they did not hear with your voice, and in your instruction they did not walk. All that you commanded them to do, they have not done, 𝄓 so you have had them encounter all evil this.

Behold the ramps. They enter the city to conquer it, and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans that fight against it, in the face of the sword and the famine and the pestilence. 𝄓 And what you have spoken has happened. Here you are, seeing.
But you, you said to me, O Lord Yahweh, You buy for yourself the field with silver and have it witnessed by witnesses, 𝄓 and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans. S
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah, saying,
Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. 𝄓 For me is any thing too wonderful?
Therefore thus says Yahweh, Note me well, giving this city into the hand of the Chaldeans and into the hand of Nebukadretsar, king of Babel, 𝄓 and he will conquer it.

And the Chaldeans will come that fight this city, and they will char this city in the fire and incinerate it, 𝄓 and the houses where they have burnt incense on their housetops to Baal, and spilled out libations to other gods so that they may grieve me.

Because the children of Israel and the children of Judah were surely doing evil in my eyes from their youth, 𝄓 for the children of Israel surely grieve me with the deed of their hands. An oracle of Yahweh.
For concerning my anger, and concerning my heat, this city has become for me, from the day that they built it and till this day... 𝄓 that I should put it aside from my presence,

Over all the evil of the children of Israel and the children of Judah that they did to grieve me, they, their kings, their nobility, their priests, and their prophets, 𝄓 and each of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And they faced to me, nape and not faces, 𝄓 and I taught them, rising early, and teaching, and there is none of them hearing, to lay hold of my chastening.
But they set up their detestable things in the house that is called, My Name Is On It, to defile it.

And they built the high places of the Baal that are in the gorge of the child of Hinnom, to transfer their sons and their daughters to Moloch, that I did not command them, nor did such come up in my heart to do this abomination, 𝄓 so as to make Judah sin. S
And now therefore, thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, 𝄓 against this city which you are saying is given into the hand of the king of Babel by the sword and by famine and by pestilence.
Note me well, collecting them from all the lands where I banished them in my anger and in my heat and great rage, 𝄓 and I will return them again to this place, and I will settle them in trust.
And they will be my people, 𝄓 and myself, I will become their God.
And I will give them one heart and one way to fear me every day, 𝄓 for good for them, and their children after them.
And I will cut for them a covenant forever, that I will not turn away from them, that I may do them good. 𝄓 And my fear I will give in their heart, that they not turn aside from me.
And I will joy over them to do good to them, 𝄓 and I will plant them in this land in truth, with all my heart and with all my being. S
Because thus says Yahweh, As I have brought to this people all this great evil, 𝄓 so I will bring upon them all the good that I was speaking concerning them.
And the field will be purchased in this land, 𝄓 that you are saying, It is desolate, without human or beast, given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

Fields with silver they will buy, and write in the record, and seal them, and will have witnesses witness in the land of Benjamin, and in the places surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the hill, and in the cities of the lowly places, and in the cities of the Negev, 𝄓 for I will reverse their captivity. An oracle of Yahweh. P
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah a second time, 𝄓 when he was yet detained in the court of the cell, saying,
Thus says Yahweh, her maker, 𝄓 Yahweh who fashioned her, to establish her. Yahweh is his name.
Call to me and I will answer you, 𝄓 and I will tell you great things and enclosed, that you do not know. P
For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, 𝄓 broken down by the ramps and by the sword,
by those who came to fight the Chaldeans and to fill them with the carcasses of the human, that I struck in my anger and in my heat, 𝄓 in that I hid my face from this city over all their evil.
Note me well, making patience ascend for her, and healing, and healing them, 𝄓 and I will disclose to them a petition for peace and truth.
And I will turn the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel, 𝄓 and will build them at as the beginning.
And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, who have sinned against me, 𝄓 and I will forgive all their iniquities, who have sinned against me and who have transgressed against me.

And it will be to me for a name of joy, for praise and for adornment, for all the nations of the earth, 𝄓 who hear all the good that I am doing them. And they will dread and shudder over all the good and over all the peace that I make of it. S

Thus says Yahweh, Yet will be heard in this place (that you are saying, It is a desert, without humanity and without beast), 𝄓 in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate, without humanity, and without inhabitant, and without beast,

the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of bridegroom and the voice of bride, the voice of them who say, Give thanks to Yahweh of hosts, for Yahweh is good, for his kindness is forever, those who bring thanksgiving into the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 for I will restore the captivity of the land as at the beginning, says Yahweh. S
Thus says Yahweh of hosts, Yet there will be in this place, the desert without humanity, and even beast, and in all its cities, 𝄓 the home of shepherds making sheep recline,

in the cities of the hill, in the cities of the lowly places, and in the cities of the Negev, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, 𝄓 ever the flock will pass through by the hands of one who is appointed, says Yahweh. S
Behold days are coming, an oracle of Yahweh, 𝄓 and I will place the good thing that I spoke to the house of Israel and over the house of Judah.
In those days and at that time, I will make grow, of David, the sprout of righteousness, 𝄓 and it will do judgment and righteousness in the land.
In days those Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will dwell in trust. 𝄓 And this is what he will recite for her, Yahweh is our righteousness. S
Because thus says Yahweh, 𝄓 There will not be cut off of David a representative to sit on the throne of the house of Israel.
Of the priests, the Levites, neither will there be cut off a representative from my presence, 𝄓 making burnt offering ascend and incense, gift, and doing sacrifice, every day. P
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah, saying,
Thus says Yahweh, If you can annul my covenant of the day and my covenant of the night, 𝄓 and without there being day and night in their time,
even annul my covenant with David, my servant, from having his son king on his throne, 𝄓 and with the Levites, the priests, my ministers,
as the host of the heavens cannot be counted, nor measured the sand of the sea, 𝄓 so I will increase the seed of David my servant, and the Levites ministering to me. S
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah, saying,

Have you not seen what this people speak, saying, The two families which Yahweh chose by themselves?... But he has refused them. 𝄓 And my people he has spurned from being any more a nation in their presence. S
Thus says Yahweh, If my covenant is not, day and night, 𝄓 the decrees of heaven and earth I do not set,

even the seed of Jacob, and David, my servant, I will refuse, to take from his seed to be governors, 𝄓 over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, for I will reverse their captivity, and I will have compassion on them. P

The word that happened to Jeremiah from Yahweh, 𝄓 when Nebukadretsar king of Babel, and all his force, and all the kingdoms of earth governed by his hand, and all the peoples, fought over Jerusalem and over all her cities, saying,

Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Go, and you say to Zedekiah king of Judah, 𝄓 and say to him, Thus says Yahweh, Note me well, giving this city into the hand of the king of Babel, and he will incinerate it in the fire.

And you, you will not escape from his hand, for arrested, arrested you will be, and into his hand given. 𝄓 And your eyes, the eyes of the king of Babel, will see, and his mouth, your mouth will address, and Babel, you will enter.
Surely hear the word of Yahweh, Zedekiah, king of Judah. 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh against you, You will not die by the sword.

In peace you will die, and as the incinerations of your ancestors, the former kings which were before you, so they will incinerate for you, and, Alas Lord, they will wail for you. 𝄓 For a word, I, I have spoken, an oracle of Yahweh. S
And Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah, 𝄓 all these words in Jerusalem.

And the force of the king of Babel fought over Jerusalem and over all the cities of Judah that remained, 𝄓 to Lachish and to Azeiqah, for behold, of the cities of Judah, enclosed cities were residue. P
The word that happened to Jeremiah from Yahweh. 𝄓 After this, king Zedekiah had cut a covenant with all the people that were in Jerusalem, to proclaim to them liberty.
That each set loose its male slave, and each its female slave, the Hebrew male, and the Hebrew female, to be free, 𝄓 that none among the Judeans be a slave among them. Each is their kin.

And all the nobility heard, and all the people that had entered into the covenant, to set loose each its male slave and each its female slave to be free, that none be a slave among them any more. 𝄓 And they heard, and they set them loose.
But they turned back afterwards, and made their male slaves and their female slaves return, that they had set loose to be free, 𝄓 and they took control of them as male slaves and as female slaves. P
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, 𝄓 I myself cut a covenant with your ancestors on the day I brought them out from the land of Egypt, from the house of servitude, saying,

At the end of seven years, you will set loose, each, its kin, the Hebrew that was sold to you, and who has served you six years and you will set it loose to be free from you. 𝄓 And your ancestors did not hear me and they did not bend their ear.

And you were turned, you were, today, and you had done what is upright in my eyes, to proclaim liberty each to his associate, 𝄓 and you had cut a covenant in my presence in the house that is called My Name Is On It,

And you turned and profaned my name, and made each its male slave and each its female slave to return, whom you had set loose to be free for themselves, 𝄓 and you took control of them to become yours as male slaves and as female slaves. S

Therefore thus says Yahweh, You yourselves did not hear me, in proclaiming liberty, each to its kin, and each of you to its associate. 𝄓 Note me well, I am proclaiming your liberty, an oracle of Yahweh, ... to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine, and I will consign you to be unnerved for all the kingdoms of the earth.

And I will give everyone who passes through my covenant, who has not placed the words of the covenant which they cut in my presence, 𝄓 the calf that they cut in two, and passed through between its sections,
The nobility of Judah, and the nobility of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, 𝄓 who passed between the sections of the calf,
And I will give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their cadaver, 𝄓 and their corpses will be as food to the fowl of the heavens and to the beasts of the earth.

And Zedekiah, king of Judah, and his nobles, I will give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their cadaver, 𝄓 and into the hand of the force of the king of Babel, those ascending away from you.

Note me well, a command, an oracle of Yahweh. And I will have them return against this city, and they will fight against it and conquer it, and he will incinerate it in the fire, 𝄓 and the cities of Judah I will consign to desolation, without inhabitant. P
The word that happened to Jeremiah from Yahweh, 𝄓 in the days of Jehoiachim child of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak to them, and have them come to the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 to one of the chambers, and irrigate them with wine.
And I took Jaazaniah child of Jeremiah child of Chabatsinyah and his kin, 𝄓 and all his children and all the house of the Rechabites.

And I had them come to the house of Yahweh to the chamber of the children of Chanan, child of Yigdalyah, the man of God, 𝄓 that was next the chamber of the nobility, that was above the chamber of Maaseyah, child of Shallum, the keeper of the doorway.
And I consigned, before the children of the house of Rechabites, calyces full of wine and cups. 𝄓 Then I said to them, Imbibe wine.
And they said, We will not imbibe wine, 𝄓 for Yonadab, child of Rekab our father, commanded us, saying, You will not imbibe wine, you, and your children for evermore.

Nor house will you build, nor seed will you sow, nor vineyard will you plant, and it will not be there for you. 𝄓 But in tents you will sit all your days, so that you may live many days on the face of the ground where you are guests.
And we heard with the voice of Yonadab child of Rekab, our father, all that he commanded us, 𝄓 without imbibing wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, and our daughters.
And without building houses to settle. 𝄓 And vineyard and field and seed, there will not be for us.
But we sit in tents, 𝄓 and we have heard and we will do according to everything that Yonadab our father has commanded us.

But it happened as Nebukadretsar king of Babel came up to the land, that we said, Come and let us go to Jerusalem rather than face of the force of the Chaldeans, and rather than face of the force of the Aramaeans, 𝄓 and let us settle in Jerusalem. P
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah, saying,
Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, Go. And you say to each of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, 𝄓 Will you not receive a warning to hear my words? An oracle of Yahweh.

The words have arisen of Yonadab child of Rekab, which he commanded his children, to do without imbibing wine and they do not imbibe until this day, for they hear the commandments of their father. 𝄓 And myself, I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, and you did not hear me.

And I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending to say, Return, please, each from its evil way. Make good your wantonness. And you will not go after other gods to serve them, and you will settle on the ground that I gave to you and to your ancestors. 𝄓 And you have not bent your ear and you did not hear me.
For the children of Yonadab child of Rekab have placed the commandments of their father that he commanded them, 𝄓 but this people do not hear me.

Therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of hosts, the God of Israel, Note me well. I will bring against Judah and to all inhabitants of Jerusalem, all the evil that I have spoken concerning them, 𝄓 because I have spoken to them and they did not hear, I called to them and they have not answered.

And to the house of the Rechabites Jeremiah said, Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, In that you have heard the commandments of Yonadab your father, 𝄓 and you have kept all his commandments, and done everything that he commanded you,
Therefore thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, 𝄓 A representative will not be cut off, for Yonadab, child of Rekab, to stand in my presence, every day. P
And it happened in the fourth year of Jehoiachim, child of Josiah, king of Judah, 𝄓 there was this word to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

Take for yourself a scroll for a book, and write in it all the things that I have spoken to you, over Israel, and over Judah, and over all nations, 𝄓 from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah and till this day.
Maybe the house of Judah will hear all the evil that I considered to do to them, 𝄓 in order that they may return, each from its evil way, and I may forgive their iniquity and their sin. S
And Jeremiah called Baruch, child of Neriah, 𝄓 and Baruch wrote, from the mandate of Jeremiah, all the words of Yahweh that he had spoken to him on a scroll for a book.
And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, 𝄓 I am detained, I can not enter the house of Yahweh.

So you enter yourself, and recite from the scroll that you have written from my mandate, the words of Yahweh, in the ears of the people, the house of Yahweh, in the day of a fast, 𝄓 and even in the ears of all Judah that come from their cities, you will recite them.
Maybe their supplication will fall in the presence of Yahweh, and they will turn each from its evil way, 𝄓 for great is the anger and the heat that Yahweh has spoken to this people.
And Baruch, child of Neriah, did according to everything that Jeremiah the prophet had commanded him, 𝄓 to recite in the book, the words of Yahweh, the house of Yahweh. P

And it happened in the fifth year of Jehoiachim, child of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth new moon, they proclaimed a fast in the presence of Yahweh, all the people in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and all the people that came from the cities of Judah into Jerusalem.

And Baruch recited in the book, the words of Jeremiah, the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 in the chamber of Gemariah, child of Shaphan, the secretary, in the higher court, at the door of the new gate of the house of Yahweh, in the ears of all the people.
And Mikaiah child of Gemariah child of Shaphan heard all the words of Yahweh from the book.

And he descended to the house of the king, to the chamber of the secretary, and behold there sat all the nobility, 𝄓 Elishama the secretary, and Delaiah child of Shemaiah, and Elnathan child of Acbor, and Gemariah child of Shaphan, Zedekiah child of Hananiah, and all the nobility.
Then Mikaiah made evident to them all the things that he heard, 𝄓 in the recitation of Baruch in the book, in the ears of the people.

And all the nobles sent Jehudi, child of Nathaniah, child of Shelemyah, child of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, The scroll that you recited through in the ears of the people, take in your hand and come. 𝄓 And Baruch child of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and complied with them.
And they said to him, Sit, if you will, and recite it in our ears. 𝄓 And Baruch recited in their ears.
And it happened as they were hearing all the words, they were in dread, each to his friend, 𝄓 and they said to Baruch, We will be sure to make all these words clear to the king.
And they asked Baruch, saying, 𝄓 Tell us, if you will, how you have written all these words from his mouth.
And Baruch said to them, From his mouth he recited to me all these words, 𝄓 and I wrote in the book with ink. S
And the nobles said to Baruch, For yourself, hide. You and Jeremiah, 𝄓 and let no person know where you are.
And they came to the king toward the court, and the scroll they entrusted to the chamber of Elishama, the secretary. 𝄓 And they announced all the words in the ears of the king.

And the king sent Jehudi to receive the scroll, and he took it from the chamber of Elishama, the secretary, 𝄓 and Jehudi recited it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the nobles standing beside the king.
And the king sat in the house of autumn in the ninth new moon, 𝄓 and the hearth before him was kindled.

And it happened as Jehudi recited three columns, or four, he ripped the book with a razor, and he flung into the fire that was in the hearth, 𝄓 until all the scroll was completely in the fire that was on the hearth.
And they were not in dread, and they did not rip their garments, 𝄓 the king, and all his servants who were hearing all these words.
And moreover, Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had intervened with the king not to incinerate the scroll, 𝄓 but he did not pay heed to them.

And the king commanded Jerahmeel child of Hammelech, and Saraiah child of Azriel, and Shelemyah child of Abdiel, to take Baruch, the secretary, and Jeremiah the prophet, 𝄓 but Yahweh had hidden them. S
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah, 𝄓 after the king had incinerated the scroll and the matters that Baruch wrote from the mandate of Jeremiah, saying,
Return, take for yourself another scroll, 𝄓 and write on it all the former words that were upon the first scroll that Jehoiachim king of Judah incinerated.

And to Jehoiachim, king of Judah, you will say, Thus says Yahweh, 𝄓 You, yourself have incinerated this scroll, saying, For what purpose have you written on it to say, Coming, coming is the king of Babel, and he will destroy this land and make human and beast cease from it. S

Therefore thus says Yahweh against Jehoiachim, king of Judah, There will not be for him, one to sit on the throne of David, 𝄓 and his corpse will be flung to the desert in the day, and to the ice in the night.

And I will visit upon him, and upon his seed, and upon his servants, their iniquity, 𝄓 and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to anyone of Judah, all the evil that I have spoken to them and they did not hear.

And Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to Baruch, child of Neriah, the secretary, and he wrote on it, from the mandate of Jeremiah, all the words of the book that Jehoiachim king of Judah incinerated in the fire. 𝄓 And further, many words like them were added to them. P
And king Zedekiah, child of Josiah, reigned, 𝄓 instead of Konyah, child of Jehoiachim, whom Nebukadretsar king of Babel made king in the land Judah.
But he did not hear, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, 𝄓 the words of Yahweh that he spoke by the hand of Jeremiah the prophet.
And king Zedekiah sent Jehukal, child of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah, child of Maaseyah the priest, to Jeremiah the prophet, saying, 𝄓 Pray, if you will, concerning us to Yahweh our God.
And Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, 𝄓 for they had not consigned him to the house of restraint.
And a force from Pharaoh came out from Egypt, 𝄓 and the Chaldeans, who had laid siege against Jerusalem, heard a message about them, and they went up from Jerusalem. P
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Thus you will say to the king of Judah who sent you to me to search of me, 𝄓 Behold the force of Pharaoh has come out to you to help. It will return to its land of Egypt.
And the Chaldeans will return, and they will fight this city, 𝄓 and they will conquer it, and will incinerate it in the fire. P
Thus says Yahweh, Do not lure yourselves to say, the Chaldeans will walk on away from us, 𝄓 for they will not walk on.
For though you had struck all the force of the Chaldeans that fight you, and the residue in them of men were thrust through, 𝄓 each in his tent, they would arise and incinerate this city in the fire.
And it happened in the going up of the force of the Chaldeans from Jerusalem, 𝄓 rather than face of the force of Pharaoh, S
That Jeremiah came forth from Jerusalem to walk to the land of Benjamin, 𝄓 to part from there in the midst of the people.

And he was at the gate of Benjamin, and a senior officer was there and his name, Iriyah child of Shelemiah, child of Hananiah, 𝄓 and he arrested Jeremiah the prophet, saying, You are falling away to the Chaldeans.
And Jeremiah said, Falsehood. I am not falling away to the Chaldeans. But he did not hear him. 𝄓 And Iriyah arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the nobility.
And the nobility raged over Jeremiah, and struck him. 𝄓 And they consigned him to the house of bondage, the house of Jonathan, the secretary, for they had made it the house of restraint.
For Jeremiah came to the house of the pit, and to the camps, 𝄓 And Jeremiah sat there many days.

And king Zedekiah sent and took him, and the king asked him in his house in secret, and he said, Is there any word from Yahweh? 𝄓 And Jeremiah said, There is, and he said, Into the hand of the king of Babel, you will be given.
And Jeremiah said to king Zedekiah, 𝄓 What have I sinned against you or against your servants or against this people, that you have consigned me to the house of restraint?
And where are your prophets that prophesied to you, saying, 𝄓 The king of Babel will not come against you and against this land?
So now hear, if you will, my lord the king. 𝄓 Let now my supplication fall before you, and do not let me return to the house of Jonathan, the secretary, and I will not die there.

And king Zedekiah commanded that they entrust Jeremiah in the court of the cell, and give him a talent of bread daily, from the street of the bakers, until all bread from the city was completed, 𝄓 and Jeremiah settled in the court of the cell.
And Shepatyah child of Mattan, Gedoliah child of Pashur, and Yukal child of Shelemyah, and Pashur child of Malchiah, 𝄓 heard the things that Jeremiah was speaking to all the people, saying,

Thus says Yahweh, One who persists in this city will die by the sword, in scarcity, and by pestilence, 𝄓 and one who goes out to the Chaldeans will live. And it will be for it, its very self as spoil, and it will live. S
Thus says Yahweh, 𝄓 This city is given into the hand of the force of the king of Babel, and he will conquer it.

And the nobility said to the king, Let this man be put to death, please, for so he is making slack the hands of the soldiers of the battle, those still here in this city, and the hands of all the people, to speak to them according to these words. 𝄓 For this man is not searching for peace for this people but rather for hurt.
And king Zedekiah said, Behold himself in your hand, 𝄓 for there is no king that can do a thing with you.

And they took Jeremiah, and they flung him to the pit of Malchiah, child of Hammelech, that was in the court of the cell, and they sent Jeremiah down with ropes. 𝄓 And in the pit there was no water but rather dirt. And Jeremiah sunk into the dirt. S
And Ebedmelek the Cushite, a eunuch, heard, (and he was in the house of the king), that they had consigned Jeremiah to the pit. 𝄓 And the king was sitting at the gate of Benjamin.
And Ebedmelek emerged from the house of the king, 𝄓 and he spoke to the king, saying,

My lord, the king, these persons have done evil with all that they did to Jeremiah the prophet whom they have flung to the pit, 𝄓 and he will die beneath it facing the famine, for there is no longer bread in the city.
And the king commanded Ebedmelek the Cushite, saying, 𝄓 Take by your hand from here thirty soldiers, and bring up Jeremiah the prophet from the pit before he dies.

And Ebedmelek took the soldiers by his hand, and entered the house of the king to beneath the treasury, and he took from there worn out rags and worn out detritus, 𝄓 and he sent them down to Jeremiah to the pit by ropes.
And Ebedmelek the Cushite said to Jeremiah, Set if you will, the worn out rags and the detritus under the joints of your hands from beneath the ropes, 𝄓 and Jeremiah did so.
And they drew out Jeremiah with ropes, and they brought him up from the pit, 𝄓 and Jeremiah settled in the court of the cell. S

And king Zedekiah sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to him, to the third entry that was by the house of Yahweh. 𝄓 And the king said to Jeremiah, I am asking you to speak. Do not conceal from me a word.
And Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, If I make clear to you, will you not put me to death? 𝄓 And if I advise you, you will not hear me.

And king Zedekiah swore to Jeremiah in secret, saying, 𝄓 Yahweh lives who made for us this integrity. I will not put you to death, and I will not yield you into the hand of persons these which seek your integrity. S

And Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, Thus says Yahweh, the God of hosts, the God of Israel, If to go forth, you go forth to the nobles of the king of Babel, then you will live, and this city will not be incinerated in the fire, 𝄓 and you will live, you and your house.

And if you do not go forth to the nobles of the king of Babel, then this city will be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, 𝄓 and they will incinerate it in the fire and you, you will not escape from their hand. S
And king Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, 𝄓 I am anxious about the Judeans that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they give me into their hands and they ill-treat me.
And Jeremiah said they will not give. 𝄓 Hear, if you will, with the voice of Yahweh, which I will speak to you, so it will be good for you and you will live.
And if you will not go forth, 𝄓 this is the word that Yahweh showed me.

And behold, all the women that are still here in the house of the king of Judah will be brought forth to the chiefs of king of Babel. 𝄓 And they will say, Those with whom you were at peace incited you and overpowered you. Sunk in the swamp, your feet are repulsed.

And all your wives and your children will be brought out to the Chaldeans, and you, you will not escape from their hand, 𝄓 for by the hand of the king of Babel you will be arrested and this city, you will have incinerated in the fire. S
And Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, Let no one else know these words, and you will not die.

But if the nobility hear that I did speak with you, and they come to you, and they say to you, Make it clear, please, to us, what you have spoken to the king. Do not conceal from us, and you will not die. 𝄓 Also what the king spoke to you.
Then you say to them, I let my supplication fall in the presence of the king, 𝄓 not to have me returned to the house of Jonathan to die there. P
And all the nobility came to Jeremiah and asked him. Then he made evident to them according to all these words that the king commanded, 𝄓 and they kept silent about it, so the matter not was heard.
And Jeremiah settled in the court of the cell until the day that Jerusalem was conquered. 𝄓 And there he was when Jerusalem was conquered.
In the ninth year of Zedekiah, king of Judah, in the tenth new moon, Nebukadretsar king of Babel came and all his force to Jerusalem, and laid siege against her.
In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth new moon, on the ninth of the month, 𝄓 the city was split.

And all the nobles of the king of Babel came and sat at the central gate, 𝄓 Nergal, chief of treasury, Samgar of Nebo, chief of personnel, a eunuch overlord, Nergal, chief of treasury, overlord of shields, and all the residue of the nobles of the king of Babel.

And it happened, as Zedekiah, king of Judah, saw them, and all the men of the battle, then they ran, and they went forth by night from the city, by way of the king's garden, at the gate between the walls, 𝄓 and he went out by way of the steppe.

And the force of the Chaldeans pursued after them, and they overtook Zedekiah in the steppes of Jericho, and they took him and brought him up to Nebukadretsar, king of Babel, toward Riblah, in the land of Hamath, 𝄓 and he subjugated him to judgment.
And the king of Babel butchered the children of Zedekiah toward Riblah before his eyes. 𝄓 And all the freeborn of Judah, the king of Babel butchered.
And the eyes of Zedekiah, he blinded, 𝄓 and bound him with brass chains to bring him toward Babel.
And the house of the king, and the house of people, the Chaldeans incinerated in the fire, 𝄓 and the walls of Jerusalem, they broke down.

And the remaining of the people, the residue in the city, and the fallen that fell to him, and the remaining of the people, the residue, 𝄓 Nebuzaradan, the overlord of the slaughterers of Babel, exiled.

And from the people, the weak for whom there was nothing whatever, Nebuzaradan, the overlord of the slaughterers, left a residue in the land of Judah, 𝄓 and he gave to them vineyards and ploughed fields on that day.
And Nebukadretsar king of Babel had commanded concerning Jeremiah, 𝄓 into the hand of Nebuzaradan, the overlord of the slaughterers, saying,
Take him, and set your eyes upon him, and do not injure him whatsoever. 𝄓 According to what he speaks to you, so deal with him.
And Nebuzaradan the overlord of the slaughterers sent, (and Nebushazban, overlord of the eunuchs, Nergal chief of treasury, overlord of shields, 𝄓 and all the overlords of the king of Babel),
They sent and they took Jeremiah from the court of the cell, and gave him to Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, child of Shaphan, to bring him out to the house, 𝄓 and he settled in the midst of the people. S
And to Jeremiah it happened that Yahweh spoke, 𝄓 when he was detained in the court of the cell, saying,

Go and say to the servant of the king, the Cushite, saying, Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, Note me well, I will bring my words against this city for evil and not for good, 𝄓 and they will be before you in that day.
But I will deliver you in that day, an oracle of Yahweh, 𝄓 and you will not be given into the hand of persons of whom you are in terror from their presence.
Because to escape, I will have you escape, and by the sword, you will not fall, 𝄓 and your being will be for you as spoil, because you have trusted in me, an oracle of Yahweh. P

The word that happened to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after Nebuzaradan, the overlord of the slaughterers, set him loose from Ramah, 𝄓 when he took him and he was bound in chains, in the midst of all the exiled of Jerusalem and Judah, the exiles going toward Babel.
And the overlord of the slaughterers took Jeremiah, 𝄓 and said to him, Yahweh your God has spoken this evil to this place.
And Yahweh came and did as he had spoken, 𝄓 because you sinned against Yahweh, and you did not hear with his voice, so it is for yourselves, this word.

And now behold, I open you today from the chains that are on your hand. If it is good in your eyes to come with me to Babel, come, and I will set my eyes over you, or if it is evil in your eyes to come with me to Babel, refrain. 𝄓 See, all the earth is before you, to what is good or to what is upright in your eyes, for you to walk there.

And while he had not turned, ... Or turn to Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, child of Shaphan, to whom the king of Babel has entrusted the cities of Judah, and settle with him in the midst of the people, or to anywhere that is upright in your eyes for you to walk. 𝄓 And to him, the overlord of the slaughterers gave a ration card, and a care package, and set him loose.
And Jeremiah came to Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, to Mizpah, 𝄓 and settled with him in the midst of the people, the residue in the land. P

When all the chiefs of the forces who were in the field, they and their soldiers, heard that the king of Babel had entrusted Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, in the land, 𝄓 and that he had entrusted him with men and women and little ones, and from the weak of the land, from those not exiled toward Babel,

Then they came to Gedoliah, to Mizpah, 𝄓 both Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, and Jochanan and Yonathan, the children of Qareiach, and Saraiah, child of Tanhumeth, and the children of Ephai, the Netophatite, Yezeniah, child of the Maakatite, they and their soldiers.

And to them Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, child of Shaphan, and to their soldiers, swore to say, Do not fear service to the Chaldeans. 𝄓 Settle in the land, and serve the king of Babel, and it will be good for you.

As for me, note me well. I will settle in Mizpah to stand before the Chaldeans that will come to us, 𝄓 but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put in your vessels, and settle in your cities that you have occupied.

And even all the Judeans that were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and wherever in all the lands, heard that the king of Babel had permitted a residue of Judah, 𝄓 and that he had entrusted over them Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, child of Shaphan,
then all the Judeans returned from all the places where they were banished, and they entered the land of Judah to Gedoliah, to Mizpah, 𝄓 and gathered wine and very much summer fruit. S
And Jochanan, child of Qareiach, and all the chiefs of the forces that were in the field, 𝄓 came to Gedoliah, to Mizpah.

And they said to him, Did you know that Baalis, king of the children of Ammon, has sent out Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, for him to strike you? 𝄓 But Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, did not believe them.

Jochanan, child of Qareiach, said to Gedoliah in secret in Mizpah, saying, Let me go, please, and I will strike Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, and no-one will know. 𝄓 Why should he strike you and smash all Judah who are collected to you, and the residue of Judah perish.
And Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, said to Jochanan, child of Qareiach, You will not do this thing, 𝄓 for you are speaking falsehood of Yishmaeil. P

And it happened in the seventh month, Yishmaeil child of Nathaniah, child of Elishama, from the seed of royalty, and overlords of the king, and ten soldiers with him, to Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, came to Mizpah, 𝄓 and they ate bread there, as one, in Mizpah.

And Yishmaeil child of Nathaniah arose and the ten soldiers who were with him, and struck Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, child of Shaphan, with the sword, and put to death him, 𝄓 to whom the king of Babel had entrusted the land.
And all the Judeans that were with him, with Gedoliah in Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, 𝄓 with the warriors, Yishmaeil struck.
And it was by the second day of the death of Gedoliah, 𝄓 and no one knew,

that persons came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, eighty persons, shaven beard, and ripped garments, and self-slashed, 𝄓 and gift and frankincense in their hands, to come to the house of Yahweh.
And Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, came forth to encounter them from Mizpah, walking, walking and weeping, 𝄓 and it was as he met them, that he said to them, Come to Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam.
And it was when they entered into the centre of city, 𝄓 that Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, butchered them in the centre of the pit, he, and everyone that was with him.

But ten persons were found among them that said to Yishmaeil, Do not put us to death, for we have buried treasure in the field, wheat and barley, and oil and honey, 𝄓 so he refrained, and did not put them to death among their kin.

And the pit where Yishmaeil cast out all the carcasses of the persons that he struck (by the hand of Gedoliah), 𝄓 it is that which king Asa made facing Baasha, king of Israel. Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, filled it with the profaned.

And Yishmaeil took captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, the daughters of the king, and all the people left as residue in Mizpah, that Nebuzaradan, the overlord of the slaughterers, had entrusted with Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam. 𝄓 And Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, took them captive and went to cross over to the children of Ammon. S
And Jochanan, child of Qareiach, heard, and all the chiefs of the forces that were with him, 𝄓 all the evil that Yishmaeil child of Nathaniah had done.
And they took all the soldiers and went to fight with Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, 𝄓 and they found him at the many waters that were in Gibeon.
And it happened that when all the people that were with Yishmaeil saw Jochanan, child of Qareiach, and all the chiefs of the forces who were with him, 𝄓 then they were glad.
And they turned around, all the people that Yishmaeil took captive from Mizpah, 𝄓 and they returned and went to Jochanan, child of Qareiach.
But Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, escaped with eight soldiers from Jochanan, 𝄓 and went to the children of Ammon. S

And Jochanan child of Qareiach, and all the chiefs of the forces that were with him, took all the residue of the people that he had restored from Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, from Mizpah, (after he struck Gedoliah child of Ahiqam), 𝄓 valiant warriors, and women, and little ones, and eunuchs, that he had restored from Gibeon.
And they went and settled in the abode of Kimham that was next to Bethlehem, 𝄓 to go to the entry to Egypt,
in the face of the Chaldeans, for they feared before them, 𝄓 for Yishmaeil, child of Nathaniah, had struck Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, to whom the king of Babel had entrusted the land. P
And they came close, all the chiefs of the forces, Jochanan, child of Qareiach, and Yezeniah, child of Hoshaiah, 𝄓 and all the people from the least and to the greatest.

And they said to Jeremiah the prophet, Let now our supplication fall before you, and pray concerning us to Yahweh your God, concerning all this residue, 𝄓 for we are residue, the few from the many, as your eyes see us.
And let Yahweh your God make clear to us the way which we may walk in, 𝄓 and the thing that we may do.

And Jeremiah the prophet said to them, I have heard. Note me well. I will pray to Yahweh your God according to your words. 𝄓 And it will happen that any thing that Yahweh will answer you, I will make clear to you. I will not withhold from you a thing.
And they, they said to Jeremiah, Let Yahweh be between us for a witness, true and faithful, 𝄓 if not according to all of the thing that Yahweh your God will send you to us, so we will do.
Whether good or evil, with the voice of Yahweh our God, that we, those who send you to him, we will hear, 𝄓 in order that it may be good for us, but we will hear with the voice of Yahweh our God. P
And it happened at the end of ten days, 𝄓 that the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah.
And he called to Jochanan, child of Qareiach, and to all the chiefs of the forces who were with him, 𝄓 and to all the people, from the youngest and to the greatest.
And he said to them, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, 𝄓 to whom you sent me to let your supplication fall before him.
If turning, you will settle in this land, then I will build you up and not overthrow you and I will plant you and not deport you, 𝄓 for I regret the evil that I did to you.
Do not fear before the king of Babel, of whom you are fearful before his face. 𝄓 Have no fear from him, an oracle of Yahweh, for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
And I will demonstrate to you compassion, and he will be compassionate with you. 𝄓 And he will restore you to your ground.
But if you are saying, We will not settle in this land, 𝄓 so as not to hear with the voice of Yahweh your God.
Saying, No, for we will go to the land of Egypt where we will not see war and the voice of a shophar we will not hear, 𝄓 and of bread we will not have scarcity, and there we will settle.
And now therefore, hear the word of Yahweh, O residue of Judah: 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, If you to set, you set your face to go to Egypt, and you come to reside there,

Then it will be that the sword that you feared, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt, 𝄓 and the famine that you were anxious about will stay close behind you there in Egypt, and there you will die.

And it will be that all the persons that set their faces to come to Egypt to reside there will die by the sword, in scarcity, and by pestilence, 𝄓 and there will be for them neither survivor nor security from the presence of the evil that I, I will bring upon them.

Because thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, As I have poured forth my anger and my heat on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my heat will be poured forth on you when you come to Egypt, 𝄓 and you will become a sob, and a desolation, and a denial, and a reproach, and you will not see this place any more.
Yahweh spoke about you, O residue of Judah, Do not enter Egypt, 𝄓 You know that I engage among you today.

For you wandered in your integrity when you, you sent me to Yahweh your God, saying, Pray concerning us to Yahweh our God, 𝄓 and according to all that Yahweh our God says, so make clear to us, and we will do it.
So I have made clear to you today, 𝄓 and you did not hear with the voice of Yahweh your God, or to anything that he sent me for you.
And now you know that by the sword, in scarcity, and by pestilence, you will die, 𝄓 in the place where you delight to come to, to reside there. S
And it happened as Jeremiah finished speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, that Yahweh their God sent him for them, 𝄓 all these words. S

And Azariah child of Hoshaiah said, and Jochanan, child of Qareiach, and everyone who was presumptuous, 𝄓 saying to Jeremiah, Falsehood you are speaking. Yahweh our God has not sent you, saying, Do not enter Egypt to reside there.
For Baruch, child of Neriah, incited you against us, 𝄓 in order to give us into the hand of the Chaldeans, to put us to death and to exile us to Babel.
So Jochanan child of Qareiach and all the chiefs of the forces and all the people did not hear with the voice of Yahweh, 𝄓 to settle in land Judah.
And Jochanan child of Qareiach and all the chiefs of the forces took all the residue of Judah, 𝄓 that were returned from all the nations where they were banished, to reside in the land Judah,

the valiant men and the women and the little ones, and the daughters of the king, and everyone that Nebuzaradan, the overlord of the slaughterers, had left with Gedoliah, child of Ahiqam, child of Shaphan, 𝄓 and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch child of Neriah.
And they entered the land of Egypt for they did not hear with the voice of Yahweh, 𝄓 and they came to Taxpanxes. S
And the word of Yahweh happened to Jeremiah in Taxpanxes, saying,
Take into your hand great stones and bury them in the cement, in the bricks that are in the door of the house of Pharaoh in Taxpanxes, 𝄓 in the sight of the Judean adults.

And you say to them, Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, Note me well. I will send and I will take Nebukadretsar, king of Babel, my servant, and I will set up his throne from above on these stones which I have buried. 𝄓 And he will stretch his marquee over them.
And when he comes he will strike the land of Egypt: 𝄓 whoever is for death to death, and whoever is for captivity to captivity, and whoever is for the sword to the sword.

And I will bring forth fire into the houses of the gods of Egypt, and he will incinerate them, and lead them captive, 𝄓 and will wrap the land of Egypt, as the shepherd wraps himself in his garment, and he will come forth from there in peace.
And he will shatter the monuments of the house of the sun that is in the land of Egypt, 𝄓 and the houses of the gods of Egypt, he will incinerate in the fire. P
The word that happened to Jeremiah, to all the Judeans, those settled in the land of Egypt, 𝄓 those settled in Migdol and Taxpanxes and in Noph and in the land of Patros, saying,

Thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, you yourselves have seen all the evil that I have brought over Jerusalem and over all the cities of Judah, 𝄓 and behold them deserted this day and there is no inhabitant in them.
From the face of their evil that they did to grieve me: to go, to burn incense, to do service to other gods, 𝄓 that they did not know, they or their ancestors.
And I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending, to say, 𝄓 Please, you will not do this abominable thing that I hate.
And they did not hear and they did not bend their ear to return from their evil, 𝄓 without burning incense to other gods.
So my heat and my anger were poured forth, and were kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, 𝄓 and they were deserted, a desolation as on this day. S

And now thus says Yahweh, God of hosts, the God of Israel, Why would you do great evil to your integrity, to cut off your man, or woman, progeny and suckling, from the midst of Judah, 𝄓 that no residue be left for you.

To grieve me in the deeds of your hands, to burn incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, where you have come to reside, 𝄓 so that you cut yourselves off and so that you may become a slight, and a reproach, among all the nations of the earth.

Have you forgotten the hurt of your ancestors, and the hurt of the kings of Judah, and the hurt of their wives, and your hurt, and the hurt of your wives, 𝄓 that was done in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem.
They are not crushed to this day, 𝄓 and they do not fear and they have not rushed to my instruction, and my statutes, that I gave in your presence and in the presence of your ancestors. S
Therefore thus says Yahweh of hosts, the God of Israel, Note me well. I set my face among you for evil, 𝄓 and to cut off all Judah.

And I will take the residue of Judah that have set their faces to come to the land of Egypt to reside there, and they will all be completed in the land of Egypt. They will fall by the sword in scarcity. They will be completed from the least and to the greatest. By the sword, and by famine they will die, 𝄓 and will be for a censure, for a desolation, and for a denial, and for a reproach.
And I will visit the settlers in the land of Egypt as I have visited at Jerusalem, 𝄓 by the sword, in scarcity, and by pestilence.

And there will be neither security nor survivor for the residue of Judah that come to reside there in the land Egypt, 𝄓 that they should return to the land of Judah, as if they are partial for themselves to return, to settle there, for they will not return, except those that are secured. P

And they answered Jeremiah, all the persons who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, and all the women standing by, a great congregation, 𝄓 and all the people, those settled in the land of Egypt in Patros, saying,
The thing that you have spoken to us in the name of Yahweh, 𝄓 none of us will pay heed to you.

For we will do every thing that goes out from our mouth, to burn incense for the queen of the heavens, and to spill out libations for her, as we have done, we and our ancestors, our kings, and our nobility, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, 𝄓 and we were sated with bread, and we were well off, and evil we did not see.

And from then, when we refrained from burning incense for the queen of the heavens, and spilling out libations for her, we have been lacking in everything, 𝄓 and by the sword and by famine, we have been completed.

But when we burned incense for the queen of the heavens and spilled out libations for her, 𝄓 was it apart from our men that we made for her preparations to idolize her, and to spill out libations for her? S
And Jeremiah said to all the people, 𝄓 concerning the valiant men and concerning the women, and concerning all the people that had answered him a word, saying,

Did not the incense that you burned as smoke in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your ancestors, your kings, and your nobility, and the people of the land... 𝄓 them, did Yahweh remember? and did it come up against his heart?

And Yahweh was not able any more to bear the presence of the evil of your wantonness, the presence of the abominations that you constructed, 𝄓 and your land became deserted, and a desolation, and a denial, without inhabitant as at this day.

In the face of your burning incense, and that you sinned against Yahweh, and you did not hear with the voice of Yahweh, and in his instruction and in his statutes and in his testimonies you did not walk, 𝄓 so this evil has encountered you as on this day. S
And Jeremiah said to all the people, and to the women, 𝄓 Hear the word of Yahweh, all Judah that is in the land of Egypt.

Thus says Yahweh of Hosts, the God of Israel, saying, You and your wives, you are speaking with your mouths, and with your hands you fulfill, saying, We will undertake to make our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense for the queen of the heavens, and to spill out libations for her. 𝄓 You will arise to place your vows, and you will undertake to make your vows. S

Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, all Judah settled in the land of Egypt, 𝄓 Note me well. I have sworn by my great name, says Yahweh, that my name will not any more be proclaimed in the mouth of any person of Judah, saying, My Lord Yahweh lives, in all the land of Egypt.

Note me well, I will be vigilant over them for evil and not for good, 𝄓 and they will be completed, everyone of Judah that is in the land of Egypt, by the sword and by famine, until they are consumed.

But they who are secured from sword, will turn again from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah, men counted. 𝄓 And all the residue of Judah that entered into the land of Egypt to reside there will know whose word is upheld, mine or theirs.
And this for you is the sign, an oracle of Yahweh. For I myself will visit concerning you in this place, 𝄓 so that you may know that arisen, upheld, are my words concerning you, for evil. P

Thus says Yahweh, Note me well giving Pharaoh Chophra, the king of Egypt, into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of those who seek his very self, 𝄓 as I gave Zedekiah, king of Judah, into the hand of Nebukadretsar, king of Babel, his enemy, and he sought his very self. S

The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch, child of Neriah, 𝄓 when he had written these words in the record from the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiachim child of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel, 𝄓 to you Baruch.
You said, Woe now for me for Yahweh will add sadness to my sorrow. 𝄓 I am weary with my sighing and rest I have not found.
Thus you say to him: Thus says Yahweh, Note well. What I have built I overthrow, and what I have planted I will deport, 𝄓 and all this land.

But you, do you seek for yourself greatness? do not seek. 𝄓 For note me well, I will bring evil on all flesh, an oracle of Yahweh, but I will give to you your being as spoil in all the places where you walk. P
That happened, the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

For Egypt, the force of Pharaoh Neko the king of Egypt that was by the river Euphrates in Karkemish, 𝄓 which Nebukadretsar king of Babel struck in the fourth year of Jehoiachim, child of Josiah, king of Judah.
Arrange shield and grappling hook, and make overture for war.
Hitch the horses, and bring up the cavalry, and station yourselves with helmets. 𝄓 Furbish the lances, and put on the chain mail.
Why do I see them dismayed and repulsed and their valiant beaten, and they have withdrawn and will not face terror all around? 𝄓 An oracle of Yahweh.
Let not the fleet withdraw nor the valiant escape. 𝄓 Towards the north over the dike of the river Euphrates, they stumbled and fell.
Who is this as the Nile coming up, 𝄓 as rivers whose waters are shaken?
Egypt as the Nile comes up, and waters are shaken as rivers, 𝄓 and he said, I will go up and will cover a land. I will eliminate a city and those settled in her.
Ascend O horses, and bluster O chariots, and go forth O valiant. 𝄓 Cush and Put take up a shield, and Ludites take up, direct a bow.

For this day is for my lord Yahweh of hosts, a day of vengeance to be avenged of his foe, and a sword will devour and will be sated and will be saturated from their blood, 𝄓 for an offering for my lord Yahweh of hosts in the land of the north by the river Euphrates.

Living I, an oracle of my Lord Yahweh. Without fail, because my flock has been despoiled, and my flock has become food for all the animals of the field, without shepherd, 𝄓 and my shepherds do not search out my flock but the shepherds shepherd themselves and my flock they do not shepherd,

For thus says my Lord Yahweh, 𝄓 Behold me, myself, and I will search out my flock, and I will reflect them.

In good pasture I will shepherd them. On the mountains of the high ground of Israel will be their home. 𝄓 There they will recline in a good home and a stout pasture, they will graze on the mountains of Israel.
I myself will shepherd my flock, and I myself will have them recline, an oracle of my Lord Yahweh.

The lost I will seek, and the banished I will bring back, and the broken I will bandage, and the ill, I will make resolute. 𝄓 And the stout and the resolute I will exterminate. I will shepherd such in the judgment.
And you, my flock, thus says my Lord Yahweh, 𝄓 Behold me, judging between lamb and lamb, and rams, and goats.

Is it insignificant to you that the good pasture you have grazed, and the remainder of your pasture you have trampled with your feet, 𝄓 and the plunging waters you have imbibed, and those that remain, with your feet you have made turbid?
And my flock? 𝄓 What is trampled by your feet they graze, and what is made turbid by your feet they imbibe. P
Therefore thus says my Lord Yahweh to them, 𝄓 Behold me, for I myself judge between a lamb who has had a meal, and a lamb who is emaciated.

And I will save my flock, and no more will they be despoiled, 𝄓 and I will judge between lamb and lamb.

And I Yahweh, I will be their God, and my servant David principal among them. 𝄓 I am Yahweh. I have spoken.
And I will cut for them a covenant of peace, and I will eradicate hurtful life from the land. 𝄓 And they will settle in the wilderness in trust, and sleep in the forest.
And I will put them forth and the places around my hillock as a blessing, 𝄓 that will make the heavy rain come down in its time. Showers of blessing, they will be.

And you are my flock, the sheep of my pasture, humanity, you are. 𝄓 I am your God. An oracle of my Lord Yahweh. P
And happened the word of Yahweh to me, saying,

Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says my Lord Yahweh, 𝄓 Because, because to desolate and to make you sigh heavily on every side, that you might become a possession of the residue of the nations, and you are offered up by the lips of a tongue, and are an infamy of a people,

Therefore prophesy on the ground of Israel, 𝄓 and say to the hills and to the hillocks, to the river channels, and to the gorges, Thus says my Lord Yahweh, Behold me. In my jealousy and in my heat I have spoken, because the humiliation of nations you have borne.
Therefore thus says my Lord Yahweh, I myself lifted up my hand. 𝄓 Without fail, the nations that are on every side of you, they, their humiliation will bear.
And you, O mountains of Israel, your boughs you will give and your fruit you will bear for my people Israel, 𝄓 for their close combat is to come.

Thus says my Lord Yahweh, Because they say to you, You ate humanity, 𝄓 and you were one who bereaves your nations.

And I will not broadcast to you any more the humiliation of the nations, and the reproach of peoples you will not bear any more, 𝄓 and you will not make your nations stumble any more, an oracle of my Lord Yahweh. P
And happened the word of Yahweh to me, saying,

Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says my Lord Yahweh, Not for your sake I am acting O house of Israel, 𝄓 but for my holy name that you have profaned in the nations which you have come to.

And I will sanctify my great name, the one profaned among the nations, which you profaned among them, 𝄓 and the nations will know that I am Yahweh, an oracle of my Lord Yahweh, when I will be sanctified in you for their eyes.
And I will take you from the nations, and I will collect you from all the lands, 𝄓 and I will bring you to your ground.
And I will dash against you clean water and you will be clean, 𝄓 from all your uncleanness. And from all your figurines I will cleanse you.
And I will give to you a new heart and a new spirit I will give within you, 𝄓 and I will put aside the heart of stone from your flesh, and I will give to you a heart of flesh.

And I will save you from all your uncleanness, 𝄓 and I will call to the grain, and I will increase it, and I will not permit against you a famine.
And I will increase the fruit of the tree, and the profit of the field, 𝄓 in order that you will not receive any more the reproach of a famine among the nations.
And you will remember your evil ways, and from your practices that are not good, 𝄓 you will be upset in your presence, concerning your iniquities and concerning your abominations.
Not for your sake I am acting, an oracle of my Lord Yahweh. Let it be known to you. 𝄓 Be ashamed and humiliated from your ways, O house of Israel. S
Thus says my Lord Yahweh, In the day I have cleansed you from all your iniquities, 𝄓 then I will resettle the cities and the ruins will be built.

And the nations who are still here round about you will know that I, Yahweh, I built what was overthrown. I planted what was desolate. 𝄓 I am Yahweh. I have spoken and I will undertake. S
Thus says my Lord Yahweh, for this I will still be searched out for the house of Israel to undertake for them. 𝄓 I will increase you like a flock of humanity.
Like a flock of holy ones, like the flock of Jerusalem in her engagement, so will the deserted cities be filled with a human flock, 𝄓 and they will know that I am Yahweh. P
The hand of Yahweh was upon me and brought me out by the spirit of Yahweh, and had me rest in the midst of a crevasse. 𝄓 And it was full of bones.

Am I the valiant mirroring poverty, through the sceptre of his fury?
Advanced me he has, but led into darkness and not light.
Against me surely he has turned. He has changed his hand all the day long. S
Broke my bones, worn out my flesh and my naked skin.
Built against me and encompassed venom and fatigue.
Bid me sit in dark places as the dead of the era. S
Guard-fences about me so I cannot go forth, making heavy my brass chains.
Groaning even, for I appeal and cry for help. He obstructs my prayer.
Guard-fenced my ways with cut-stones, my pathways perverse. S
Dreadful lurking bear he is to me, a lion in secret lairs.
Dismembering me, departing me from my ways, rendering me desolate.
Directing his bow, and taking his stand with me as the target for the arrow. S
He enters my vital centres, with the children of his quiver.
Hilarity I have become to all my people, their string to play all the day long.
He has sated me with bitterness. He has saturated me with wormwood. S
Violence to my teeth are ground up arrowheads. He has made me cower in the ashes.
Very far is my being rejected from peace. I am oblivious to what is good.
Victory that was mine is perished, I said, also my hope from Yahweh. S
Zeroing in on my poverty and my restlessness, wormwood and gall.
Zealous in memory, but ruminating against me is my integrity.
Zigzags this into my heart, therefore I hope. S
How by the mercies of Yahweh we are not completed, for his compassions are not finished.

He Yahweh is my share, says my being. Therefore I hope in him. S

'tis good for the valiant, to bear a shackle in its youth. S
Yonder seated in solitude and mute, for it tolerates it.
Yielding in the dust its mouth, as if there is expectation.
Yielding cheek to the striker, sated with reproach. S
'Cause my Lord will not reject for ever.

My Lord does not command it. Who is it who says and it happens?

May living humus cavil? a valiant one about its sin? S

Shadowed in your cloud from furious prayer,
scrapings and refuse you have labeled us within the peoples. S

Regarded you have, Yahweh, my distortion. Judge my judgment.
Regarded you have all their vengeance, all their devisings about me. S

Sneering lips and their muttering, against me all the day long.
