The Levites, 𝄓 the children of Jeshua and Qadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy four. S
The singers, 𝄓 the children of Asaph, a hundred and twenty eight. P

The children of the gatekeepers, the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Aqub, the children of Xatita, the children of Shobai, 𝄓 all these, a hundred and thirty nine. P
Nethinim, 𝄓 the children of Tsixa, the children of Xasupha, the children of Tabbaoth. S
The children of Qeros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padan. S
The children of Lebanah, the children of Xagebah, the children of Aqub. S
The children of Grasshopper, the children of Shalmi, the children of Chanan. S
The children of Giddel, the children of Gaxar, the children of Rayah. S
The children of Rezin, the children of Neqoda, the children of Gazzam. S
The children of Uzza, the children of Paseax, the children of Besai. S
The children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephusim. S
The children of Baqbuq, the children of Xaqupha, the children of Harhur. S
The children of Batsluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha. S
The children of Barqos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamax. S
The children of Netsiax, the children of Xatipha. S
The children of the servants of Solomon, 𝄓 the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda. S
The children of Yaaiah, the children of Darqon, the children of Giddel. S
The children of Shepatyah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pokereth of Zebaim, the children Amy.
All the Nethinim and the children of the servants of Solomon, 𝄓 three hundred and ninety two. S
And these are they who went up from the Salt Tel, Tel Smith, Cherub, Addan, Immer, 𝄓 but who were not able to announce the house of their ancestors, and their seed, whether they were from Israel.
The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Neqoda, 𝄓 six hundred and fifty two. S

And from the children of the priests, the children of Habaiah, the children of Qots, 𝄓 the children of Barzillai, who took from the daughters of Barzillai of the Gilead, a wife, and was called by their name.
These sought their register in the genealogies but they were not found, 𝄓 and were sullied from the priesthood.
And Tirshatha said to them that they should not eat from the holy of holy things, 𝄓 until a priest stood with the lights and with the completions.
All the congregation as one, 𝄓 forty two thousand three hundred sixty.
Besides their servants and their maidservants. These were seven thousand three hundred and thirty seven, 𝄓 and of them were two hundred male singers and female singers.
Their horses, seven hundred and thirty six, 𝄓 their mules, two hundred and forty five.
Their camels, four hundred and thirty five, 𝄓 their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty. P
And from the heads of the ancestors, when they came to the house of Yahweh that is in Jerusalem, 𝄓 they made a freewill offering for the house of this God, to make it stand on its base.
According to their power, they gave from the treasury of the lines of work, gold, sixty one thousand drams, and silver, five thousand portions, 𝄓 and priests coats, a hundred. S
So they settled, the priests and the Levites, and from the people, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the Nethinim, in their cities, 𝄓 and all Israel in their cities. S
And at the touch of the seventh new moon and the children of Israel were in the cities, 𝄓 the people gathered as one person at Jerusalem. S

And Jeshua, child of Jotsadaq, arose and his kin, the priests, and Zerubbabel, child of Shealtiel, and his kin, and they built the altar of the God of Israel, 𝄓 to offer up on it burnt offerings as it is written in the instruction of Moses the man of God.

And they prepared the altar on its bases because of the horror over them from the people of the lands. 𝄓 And they offered up on it burnt offerings to Yahweh, burnt offerings in the morning and in the evening.
And they did the festive sacrifice of tabernacles as it is written, 𝄓 and the burnt offering day by day by count according to the judgment of the matter day by day.
And afterward burnt offering continually, both of the new moons, and of all the appointed times of Yahweh, that are holy, 𝄓 and for all that willingly offered a freewill offering to Yahweh.
From the first day of the seventh month, they commenced to offer up burnt offerings to Yahweh, 𝄓 but the temple of Yahweh had no foundation.

And they gave silver to the masons and the carpenters, 𝄓 and food and beverage and oil, to those of Sidon and of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon by sea to Joppa, according to their license from Cyrus king of Persia. P

And in the second year of their coming to the house of God to Jerusalem in the second month, 𝄓 commenced Zerubbabel, child of Shealtiel, and Jeshua, child of Jotsadaq, and the residue of their kin, the priests, and the Levites, and all that had come from the captivity of Jerusalem. And they had the Levites from twenty years and upward stand to lead on the lines of work for the house of Yahweh. P

And stood Jeshua, his children, and his kin, Qadmiel, and his children, the children of Judah, as one, to lead on the deeds of the lines of work in the house of God, 𝄓 the children of Henadad, their children, and their kin, the Levites.

And the builders laid the foundation of the temple of Yahweh, 𝄓 and they had the priests stand in their clothing with the trumpets and the Levites, the children of Asaph with cymbals, to praise Yahweh by the hands of David, king of Israel.

And they answered in praising and thanksgiving to Yahweh, for it is good, for his kindness is forever over Israel. 𝄓 And all the people raised a shout of great jubilation in praise to Yahweh, over the foundation of the house of Yahweh. S

But many among the priests and the Levites, and those preeminent of the fathers, elders who had seen the first house when the foundation of this house was laid in their sight, wept with a great voice, 𝄓 and many with jubilation, with gladness, lifted high their voice.

And none of the people could recognize, over the voice of jubilation, the gladness, the voice of the weeping of the people, 𝄓 for the people raised a shout of great jubilation, and the voice was heard afar off. P
When the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard, 𝄓 that the children of the exiled were building the temple to Yahweh the God of Israel,

they came close to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of the ancestors, and said to them, Let us build with you, for as you, we search out your God. 𝄓 And his we are, sacrificing from the days of Esarchadon, the king of Ashur, who brought us up here.

And to them, Zerubbabel and Jeshua and the residue of the heads of the ancestors of Israel said, It is not for you, but for us to build a house to our God. 𝄓 For together, we ourselves will build to Yahweh, the God of Israel, as the king has commanded us, Cyrus king of Persia.
And it happened that the people of the land made the hand of the people of Judah slacken, 𝄓 and vexed them in building.
And they hired counselors against them to thwart their counsel, 𝄓 all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, and till the kingdom of Darius king of Persia.
And in the reign of Ahasuerus, at the commencement of his reign, 𝄓 they wrote an accusation to the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem. S

And in the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Miteradat, Tabeel, and the residue of the entitled wrote to Artaxerxes, king of Persia. 𝄓 And the writing of the epistle was inscribed in Aramaic and given interpretation in Aramaic. P
Rehum, a superior of warrant, and Shimshai, a secretary wrote a first letter against Jerusalem, 𝄓 to Artaxerxes the king, likewise.

Then Rehum, a superior of warrant, and Shimshai, a secretary, and the residue of their confederates, 𝄓 the advocates, and the legates of Persia, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Arkevites, the Babelites, the Shushankites, the Dehites, the Elamites,
And the residue of the clans that Asnappar exiled, (the great and the esteemed), and settled them in the towns of Samaria, 𝄓 and the residue beyond the river, and at such a time.
This is a copy of the letter that they sent to him, to Artaxerxes the king, 𝄓 Your servants, mortals beyond the river, and at such a time, P

Be it known to the king that the Judeans who came from you to us have arrived at Jerusalem. 𝄓 The town of mutiny and stink they build, and a barrier they have consolidated, and the foundations they have threaded.
Now let it be known to the king that if this town is built, and her barriers consolidated, 𝄓 levy, tariff, and toll, they will not yield, and the revenue of the sovereigns, you will affront.
Now all because we salt with the salt of the palace, and the exposure of the king was not proper for us to envision, 𝄓 on this we have sent and informed the king,

That an enquiry be made in a book of the archives of your ancestors, and you will find, in a book of the archives, and you will know that this town was a mutinous town and an affront to kings, and provinces. And they have cultivated sedition within it from days of old. 𝄓 So this town, it was deserted.
We ourselves make it known to the king that if this town is built, and her barriers consolidated, 𝄓 in view of this, there will be no part beyond the river for you. P

The king sent an edict to Rehum, a superior of warrant, and Shimshai, a secretary, and the residue of their confederates that were settled in Samaria, and the residue beyond the river, 𝄓 Peace, and at such a time. S
The epistle that you sent to us, 𝄓 distinctly clear, has been recited before me.
From me was set a warrant, and they enquired, and they found that this town, from days of old, against kings has shown partiality, and mutinied, 𝄓 and sedition has been cultivated in it.
And energetic kings have been over Jerusalem, and have taken authority over all beyond the river, 𝄓 and levy, tariff, and toll was provided to them.
Now set in place a warrant that these men of valour be stopped, 𝄓 and this town not be built, until from me a warrant be set in place.
And you be admonished against neglect of service concerning this. 𝄓 Why should there be much hurt to affront kings? S

Then from that, the copy of the epistle of Artaxerxes, the king, having been recited before Rehum, and Shimshai, a secretary, and their confederates, 𝄓 they went brashly to Jerusalem, to the Judeans, and made them stop with a strong arm and force. S
Then the administration stopped for the house of God that is in Jerusalem. 𝄓 And it was stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius, king of Persia. P
And the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Judeans who were in Judea and in Jerusalem, 𝄓 in the name of the God of Israel, to them. S
Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Jeshua son of Jotsadaq, arose and got the building of the house of God underway that is in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and with them, the prophets of God confirming them. P

In that season for them Tatnaii viceroy of beyond the river arrived, and Shetar Bozni and their confederates, 𝄓 and said thus to them, Who set in place for you the warrant to build this house or to consolidate this structure. S
Then likewise we said to them, 𝄓 Who are these, the names of the men of valour, who build this building?
But the eye of their God was over the grey-haired of the Judeans, and they could not make them stop until the warrant came to Darius, 𝄓 and they then responded by return mail to it. P
A copy of the letter that Tatnaii sent, viceroy of beyond the river, and Shetar Bozni and his confederates, the Apharsachites, who were across the river, 𝄓 to Darius the king,
An edict they sent to him, and written like this within it, 𝄓 To Darius the king, all peace, S

Be it known to the king that we went to Judea the province, to the house of God, the great, and it is built with rolling stone, and timber is laid in its embankments, 𝄓 and this service is promptly being served and prospers in their hands. S
Then we asked these grey-haired likewise. We said to them, 𝄓 Who set in place for you the warrant to build this house or to consolidate this structure?
And also their names we asked them, to let you know, 𝄓 that we will write the name of the men of valour who are their heads. S

And thus they responded to us an edict, saying, 𝄓 We are they, servants of the God of the heavens and the earth, and build the house that itself was built before these many years, and a great king of Israel built and finished it.

But in that our ancestors made the God of the heavens shudder, he provided them to the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babel, the Chaldean, 𝄓 and this house he did away with and had the people exiled to Babel. S
Yet in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babel, 𝄓 Cyrus the king set a warrant to build this house of God.

And also the vessels of the house of God of gold and silver that Nebuchadnezzar had appropriated from the temple that was in Jerusalem and had escorted them to the temple of Babel, 𝄓 Cyrus the king had them appropriated from the temple of Babel, and they were provided to Sheshbazzar, by name, whom he had set as viceroy.
And he said to him, Bear these vessels. Go. Stow them in the temple that was in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and let the house of God be built in its place. S
Then this Sheshbazzar arrived. He provided the foundation of the house of God that is in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and from then and till now it has been in building, but it is not whole.

And now if to the king it be good to reflect in the house of the depositories of the king, that is there in Babel, whether it be so that from Cyrus the king was set the warrant to build this house of God in Jerusalem, 𝄓 then let the resolution of the king on this be sent to us. S
Then Darius the king set a warrant, 𝄓 and they enquired in the house of the records where the depositories were stowed in Babel.
And there was found in Axmetha, in the castle that is in the Medean province, one roll, 𝄓 and written thus within it, an archive. P

In the first year of Cyrus, the king, Cyrus the king set a warrant of the house of God in Jerusalem. Let the house be built, the place where they sacrifice sacrifices. Let the foundations bear a burden, 𝄓 altitude sixty cubits, width sixty cubits,
Three layers of rolling stone, and a layer of new timber, 𝄓 and let the outlay be provided from the house of the king.

And also the vessels of the house of God, of gold and silver, that Nebuchadnezzar had appropriated from the temple that was in Jerusalem, and had escorted to Babel, 𝄓 let them be returned and come to the temple that is in Jerusalem, to be placed and stowed in the house of God. S
Now Tatnaii, viceroy of beyond the river, Shetar Bozni and their confederates, the Apharsachites, who were across the river, 𝄓 distant you will be from there.
You leave the fabrication of this house of God. 𝄓 Let the viceroy of the Judeans and the grey-haired of the Judeans build this house of God in its place.

And from me a warrant is set for how you will serve with the grey-haired of the these Judeans to build this house of God. 𝄓 And from the material wealth of the king, that is, from the levy from beyond the river, promptly, the outlay will be provided to these men of valour, that they be not stopped.

And what must be in readiness of the male foals of bullocks and rams and lambs for the burnt offerings of the God of the heavens, wheat, salt, red wine, and oil, as is indicated by the priests that are in Jerusalem, let it be provided to them day by day without neglect.
That they may make appeasing oblations to the God of the heavens, 𝄓 and intercede for the life of the king and his children.

From me is set a warrant that any mortal that would revise this edict, let timber be extirpated from his house and being uplifted, let him be impaled on it, 𝄓 and let his house serve as a dunghill over this.

And the God that made his name dwell there heave every king or people that would extend its hand to revise, to hurt this house of God that is in Jerusalem. 𝄓 I Darius have set up a warrant. Promptly, let it be served. P
Then Tatnaii, viceroy of beyond the river, Shetar Bozni, and their confederates, 𝄓 because of what Darius the king sent, likewise promptly, they served.

And the grey-haired of the Judeans built. And they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. 𝄓 And they built and they consolidated from the warrant of the God of Israel, and from the warrant of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
And this house emerged on the third day of the moon Adar. 𝄓 This was year six of the reign of Darius the king. P
And the children of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the residue of the children of the exiles, served the dedication of this house of God with cheer.

And they made oblation to dedicate this house of God, bullocks a hundred, rams two hundred, lambs four hundred, 𝄓 and he-goats of she-goats, for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve, for the number of the sceptres of Israel.
And they placed the priests in their courses, and the Levites in their divisions, over the administration of the God that is in Jerusalem, 𝄓 as written in the record of Moses. P
And the children of the exiled did the Passover, 𝄓 on the fourteenth of the first month.

For the priests and the Levites had cleansed themselves as one. All of them were clean. 𝄓 And they butchered the Passover for all the children of the exiled, and for their kin, the priests, and for themselves.
And the children of Israel ate who had returned from exile, and all who were differentiated from the national defilement of the land against them, 𝄓 to search out to Yahweh the God of Israel.

And they made the feast of unleavened bread, seven days with gladness, 𝄓 for Yahweh had made them glad, and had turned round the heart of the king of Ashur concerning them, to make their hands resolute in the lines of work of the house of God, the God of Israel. P
And after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes, king of Persia, 𝄓 Ezra child of Saraiah, child of Azariah, child of Hilqiah,
Child of Shallum, child of Zadok, child of Achitov,
Child of Amariah, child of Azariah, child of Meraioth,
Child of Zeraxiah, child of Uzzi, child of Buqi,
Child of Abishua, child of Phineas, child of Eleazar, child of Aaron, the head priest,

This Ezra went up from Babel, and he was an impetuous scribe in the instruction of Moses that Yahweh the God of Israel had given, 𝄓 and the king gave him, according to the hand of Yahweh his God upon him, all that he sought. P
And went up from the children of Israel, and from the priests and the Levites, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the Nethinim, to Jerusalem, 𝄓 in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
And he entered Jerusalem in the fifth new moon. 𝄓 This was the seventh year of the king.
For on the first of the first month, he laid the foundation of the ascent from Babel, and on the first of the fifth month he had come to Jerusalem, 𝄓 according to the good hand of his God upon him.
For Ezra prepared his heart to search out the instruction of Yahweh and to act, 𝄓 and to teach in Israel, statute and judgment. S

And this is a copy of the written record in which the king, Artaxerxes, granted to Ezra the priest, the secretary. 𝄓 The record of the words of the commandment of Yahweh and his statutes over Israel, P
Artaxerxes, king of kings, 𝄓 to Ezra the priest, scribe of the dictate of the God of the heavens, perfect peace. And now,
From me is set a warrant that all who willingly offered, within my kingdom, from the people of Israel, and its priests, and the Levites, to go up to Jerusalem with you, may go.
All because, from before the king and seven of his counselors, you are sent to enquire concerning Judah and of Jerusalem, 𝄓 according to the dictate of your God which is in your hand.
And to convey the silver and gold, 𝄓 that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel that is in Jerusalem, his dwelling-place.
And all the silver and gold that you find in all the province of Babel, 𝄓 with the freewill offering of the people and the priests, offer willingly to the house of their God that is in Jerusalem.

All because of this, promptly, you will buy with this silver, bullocks, rams, lambs, and their gifts, and their libations, 𝄓 and make oblation of them on the altar of the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
And whatever to you and to your kin seems good with the residue of the silver and the gold to administer, 𝄓 according to the resolution of your God, you will administer.
And the vessels that are provided to you for the reverence of the house of your God, 𝄓 repay before the God of Jerusalem.
And the residue of what is necessary for the house of your God that will fall to you to give, 𝄓 let be given from the house of the depositories of the king.

And I myself, Artaxerxes the king, set the warrant for all the treasurers who are across the river, 𝄓 that all that Ezra the priest scribe of the dictate of the God of the heavens will ask, promptly let it be served.
To silver a hundred talents, and to wheat a hundred cor, and to red wine a hundred baths, and to baths of oil, a hundred, 𝄓 and salt without requisition.

All that is from the warrant of the God of the heavens, let it be served with excellence, to the house of the God of the heavens, 𝄓 for why should there be rage concerning the kingdom of the king and his children?

And to you we make it known, that all the priests and the Levites, the psalmists, the gatekeepers, the Nethinim, and those who reverence this house of God, 𝄓 levy, tariff, or toll, it is not legal to heave upon them.

And you, Ezra, in the wisdom of your God which is in your hand, number judges and advocates, that they may advocate for all the people who are across the river, for all knowing the dictates of your God. 𝄓 And who does not know him, you inform.

And anyone that will not be servant of the dictate of your God, let the dictate of the king promptly be sentenced for him, being served from him, 𝄓 whether to death or to uprooting or to a fine of material wealth or to bondage. P
Bless Yahweh, the God of our ancestors, 𝄓 who has given such as this into the heart of the king, to adorn the house of Yahweh that is in Jerusalem.

And to me has stretched out kindness before the king and his counselors, and to all the valiant sultans of the king. 𝄓 And I myself was encouraged according to the hand of Yahweh my God on me, and I collected from Israel the preeminent to go up with me. P
And these are the heads of their ancestors, and enrolled by genealogy, 𝄓 who went up with me in the reign of Artaxerxes, the king, from Babel. S
From the children of Phineas, Gershom, from the children of Ithamar, Daniel, 𝄓 from the children of David, Xatush. S
From the children of Shekanayah, from the children of Parosh, Zechariah, 𝄓 and with him by genealogy, of the males, a hundred and fifty. S
From the children of the viceroy of Moab, Elihoenai, child of Zeraxiah, 𝄓 and with him, two hundred males. S
From the children of Shekanayah, child of Yaxaziel, 𝄓 and with him, three hundred males. S
And from the children of Adin, Ebed child of Yonathan, 𝄓 and with him, fifty males. S
And from the children of Eilam, Isaiah child of Ataliah, 𝄓 and with him, seventy males. S
And from the children of Shepatyah, Zebadiah child of Michael, 𝄓 and with him, eighty males. S
From the children of Joab, Obadiah child of Yexiel, 𝄓 and with him, two hundred and eighteen males. S
And from the children of Shelomit, child of Yosipyah, 𝄓 and with him, a hundred and sixty males. S
And from the children of Bebai, Zechariah child of Bebai, 𝄓 and with him, twenty eight males. S
And from the children of Azgad, Jochanan child of the lesser, 𝄓 and with him, a hundred and ten males. S
And from the other children of Adonikam, and these are their names, 𝄓 Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them, sixty males. S
And from the children of Bigvai, Uthai and Zakkur, 𝄓 and with him, seventy males. P
And I collected them at the river that comes to Ahava, and we camped there three days. 𝄓 And I discerned among the people and the priests, and from the children of Levi, I found none there.

And I sent for Eliezar, for Ariel, for Shemiah, and for Elnathan, and for Yariv, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Mashallum, who are heads, 𝄓 and for Yoariv, and for Elnathan, who are discerning.

And I commanded them to Ido, the head, at Kasaphya, the place, 𝄓 and I put in their mouths words to speak to Ido, his kin the Nethinim, in Kasaphya, the place, to bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

And they brought to us, according to the hand of our good God over us, a man of insight from the children of Maxali, the child of Levi, the child of Israel, 𝄓 both Sherebiah and his children and his kin, eighteen.
And Xeshabyah, and with him, Isaiah from the children of Merari, 𝄓 his kin and their children, twenty. S
And from the Nethinim, David and the nobility had assigned for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim, 𝄓 all of them drilled by name.
And I called there a fast by the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, 𝄓 to seek from him an upright way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our property.

For I was ashamed to request a force from the king, or cavaliers to help us from an enemy on the journey, 𝄓 for we had said to the king, saying, The hand of our God is over all seeking him for good, and his strength and his anger is over all forsaking him.
So we fasted and we sought from our God over this, 𝄓 and he was petitioned for us.
And I differentiated from the chief of the priests, twelve, 𝄓 Sherebiah, Xeshabyah, and with them from their kin, ten.

And I weighed for them the silver and the gold and the vessels, a contribution for the house of our God, 𝄓 contributed by the king, and his counselors, and his nobility, and all Israel that were found.
And I weighed by their hand six hundred and fifty silver talents, and vessels of silver, a hundred talents, 𝄓 gold, a hundred talents.
And twenty crocks of gold of a thousand darics, 𝄓 and two fine yellow vessels of brass, as attractive as gold.
And I said to them, You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy, 𝄓 and the silver and the gold, a freewill offering to Yahweh, the God of your ancestors.
Be vigilant and guard, until you weigh before the chiefs of the priests, and the Levites, and the chiefs of the ancestors of Israel, in Jerusalem, 𝄓 the chambers of the house of Yahweh.
And the priests and the Levites received the appraisal of the silver and the gold and the vessels, 𝄓 to bring to Jerusalem to the house of our God. P

And we pulled out from the river of Ahava on the twelfth of the first month to go to Jerusalem. 𝄓 And the hand of our God was over us, and he delivered us from the palm of the enemy or ambush over the journey.
And we went to Jerusalem, 𝄓 and we settled there three days.

And on the fourth day, we weighed the silver and the gold and the vessels in the house of our God, by the hand of Meremot, child of Uriah the priest, and with him, Eleazar, child of Phineas, 𝄓 and with them, Jozebad, child of Jeshua, Noadiah, child of Binnui, the Levites.
By count, by weight, for all, 𝄓 and all the weight was written at that time. P

Those that had come from the captivity of the children of the exiled brought near burnt offerings to the God of Israel, young bulls, twelve for all Israel, rams, ninety six, young lambs, seventy seven, he-goats a sin offering of twelve, 𝄓 all these, a burnt offering to Yahweh. P
And they put forth the dictates of the king to the satraps of the king, and to the viceroys beyond the river, 𝄓 and they lifted up the people, and the house of God. S

And as these were finished, the nobility came close to me, saying, The people of Israel and the priests and the Levites have not differentiated themselves from the people of the lands, 𝄓 according to their abominations, of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

For they take up from their daughters for themselves and for their sons, and the seed of the holy has intermingled in the people of the lands, 𝄓 and the hand of the nobility and the prefects have been first in this trespass. S
And when I heard this word, I ripped my garment and my mantle, 𝄓 and pared the hair of my head and my beard, and sat down appalled.
And to me were gathered all who were apprehensive with the words of the God of Israel concerning the trespass of the exiled, 𝄓 and myself, I sat appalled until the gift of the evening.
And at the gift of the evening, I arose from my affliction, and having ripped my garment and my mantle, 𝄓 I bowed down on my knees, and spread my palm to Yahweh my God.
And I was saying, My God, I am ashamed and I am humiliated to exalt, my God, my face to you, 𝄓 because our iniquities are multiplied to come up over a head. Our offence is great to the heavens.

From the days of our ancestors, we have been a great offence to this day, 𝄓 and in our iniquities we have been given, ourselves, our kings, our priests, into the hand of the sovereigns of the lands, by the sword, into captivity, and to be looted, and in shame of face, as at this day.

And now, for a brief moment, there has been grace from Yahweh our God, to a residue, to us, security, and to give to us a tent peg in his holy place, 𝄓 for our God to light our eyes, and give us a little life in our servitude.

For we have been servants, but in our servitude, our God has not forsaken us. 𝄓 And he has stretched out kindness over us before the sovereigns of Persia, to give to us life, to lift high the house of our God, and to give standing to its desert, and to give to us a fence in Judah and in Jerusalem. S
And now, what we will say, O our God, after this? 𝄓 for we have forsaken your commandments,

That you commanded by the hand of your servants the prophets, saying, The land that you are coming to possess, this is a segregated land, in the segregation of the peoples of the lands, 𝄓 in their abominations, who have filled her from edge to edge in their uncleanness.

And now your daughters, you will not give to their sons, and their daughters, you will not take up for your sons, and you will not search out their peace or their good for evermore, 𝄓 so that you may be resolute, and you will eat the good of the land that you will possess for your children for evermore.
And after all that has come over us from our evil deeds and in our great offense, 𝄓 (for you, our God, you kept back for less than our iniquities and have given to us security such as this),
Should we return to thwart your commandments and intermarry with the people of these abominations? 𝄓 Would you not be angry among us till the finish, to be without a residue or security? P
Yahweh, O God of Israel, a righteous one you are, for we are still here secure as at this day. 𝄓 Behold us in your presence in our offenses, but there is no standing in your presence over this. P

And when Ezra had prayed and when he had given thanks, weeping, and falling down before the house of God, 𝄓 from Israel, a very vast congregation was collected to him of men and women and juveniles, for the people wept, excessively weeping. S

And Shekanayah, child of Yexiel, from the children of Eilam answered, and he said to Ezra, We ourselves have trespassed against our God, and we have settled with foreign wives from the people of the land. 𝄓 And now there is expectation for Israel over this.

And now let us cut a covenant for our God, to bring out all wives and those born of them, in the counsel of my lord, and those who are apprehensive by the commandment of our God. 𝄓 And according to the instruction, let it be done.
Arise because for you is the matter, and we will be with you. 𝄓 Be encouraged, and take action. P
And Ezra arose and made the chief of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel swear to do according to this word, and they swore.

And Ezra arose from the presence of the house of God, and walked to the chamber of Yehoxanan, child of Elyashib. 𝄓 And he went there. Bread he did not eat, and water he did not imbibe, for he was longing concerning the trespass of the exiled. S
And they had a declaration pass through in Judah and Jerusalem, for all the children of the exiled to collect themselves in Jerusalem.

And all that would not come within the three days, according to the counsel of the chiefs and the elders, all his property would be put to the ban, 𝄓 and he would be differentiated from the congregation of the exiled. S

And all the men of Judah and Benjamin collected themselves to Jerusalem within the three days. This was the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month. 𝄓 And all the people sat in the piazza of the house of God from trembling concerning the matter, and for the heavy rain. P
And Ezra the priest arose and he said to them, You yourselves have trespassed, and you have settled with foreign wives, 𝄓 to add to the offense of Israel.
And now yield thanksgiving to Yahweh the God of your ancestors to do his bidding. 𝄓 And differentiate yourselves from the people of the land and from the foreign women.
And all the congregation answered and said with a great voice, 𝄓 So, according to your word, we have come up to do.

Lamentably the people are too many, and it is the time of heavy rains, and without power to stand outside. 𝄓 And the line of work is not for one day and not for two, for we are many who transgressed in this matter.

Let please our chiefs stand for all the congregation, and let all that in our cities have settled with wives foreign come in due time from the seasons, and with them, elders city by city, and their judges, 𝄓 until the burning of the anger of our God is turned from us during this matter. P
But Yonathan, child of Ashael, and Yehezyah, child of Tiqvah, stood at this, 𝄓 and Meshullam, and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

And the children of the exiled did so. And Ezra the priest, some from the heads of the ancestors for the house of their ancestors, differentiated themselves, and they all, by name. 𝄓 And they sat on the first day of the tenth month to search out the matter.
And they found an end with all the men who had settled with foreign wives, 𝄓 by the first day of the first month. P
And there were found from the children of the priests that brought back foreign wives, 𝄓 from the children of Jeshua, child of Jotsadaq, and his kin, Maaseyah and Eliezer, Yariv and Gedoliah.
And they gave their hand to bring out their wives, 𝄓 a guilt offering of a ram of the flock for their offense. S
And from the children of Immer, Hanani, and Zebadiah. S
And from the children of Xarim, 𝄓 Maaseyah, and Elyah, and Shemaiah, and Jechiel, and Uzziah.
And from the children of Pashur, 𝄓 Elyoeinai, Maaseyah, Yishmaeil, Netaneel, Jozebad, and Elasah. S
And from the Levites, 𝄓 Jozebad, and Shimei, and Qelayah, (this was Qelita), Petaxiah, Judah, and Eliezer. S
And from the singers, Elyashib, 𝄓 and from the gatekeepers Shallum, and Telem, and Uri. S
And from Israel, 𝄓 from the children of Parosh, Ramiah, and Yezyah, and Malkiah, and Miyamin, and Eleazar, and Malkiah, and Benaiah. S
And from the children of Eilam, 𝄓 Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jechiel, and Abdi, and Yarmut, and Elyah. S
And from the children of Zattu, 𝄓 Elioenai, Elyashib, Mattaniah, and Yarmut, and Zebad, and Aziza. S
And from the children of Bebai, 𝄓 Yehoxanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Atlai. S
And from the children of Bani, 𝄓 Meshullam, Malluk, and Adiyah, Yeshuv, and Sheal, and Ramot. S
And from the children of the viceroy of Moab, Adna, and Kella, 𝄓 Benaiah, Maaseyah, Mattaniah, Betsalel, and Binnui, and Manasseh. S
And the children of Xarim, 𝄓 Eliezer, Yeshiah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Simeon,
Benjamin, Malluk, Shamariah, S
From the children of Xashum, 𝄓 Mattnay, Mattathah, Zebad, Eliphelet, Yeremy, Manasseh, Shimei, S
From the children of Bani, Maadai, Amram, and Uel, S
Benaiah, Bedeyah, Kelluh,
Vanyah, Meremot, Elyashib,
Mattaniah, Mattnay, and Yaasai,
And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
And Shelemyah, and Nathan, and Adiyah,
Maknadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Azarel, and Shelemyah, Shamariah,
Shallum, Amariah, Joseph. S
From the children of Nebo, 𝄓 Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zebad, Zebina, Yadi, and Yoel, Benaiah.
All these had taken foreign wives. 𝄓 And there were of them, wives that had put out children. P
The words of Nehemiah, child of Hikaliah, 𝄓 and it happened in the new moon of Kislev, the twentieth year, and I, I was in Shushan, the temple precincts.
And Hanani came, one of my kin, himself and soldiers from Judah, 𝄓 and I asked them concerning the Judeans that had been secured, that were residue from the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

And they said to me, The residue, that are residue from the captivity there in the province, are hurting greatly and are reproached. 𝄓 And the wall of Jerusalem is breached, and her gates charred in the fire.
And it happened as I heard these words, I sat and I wept and lamented daily, 𝄓 and I was fasting and praying before the God of the heavens.
And I said, beseeching, Yahweh the God of the heavens, the One great and fearful, 𝄓 keeping the covenant and kindness for those who love him and who keep his commandments,

Let be, if you will, your ear attentive, and your eyes open, to hear the prayer of your servant, that I pray before you today, day and night over the children of Israel, your servants, 𝄓 and acknowledging the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against you. Both I and the house of my father, we have sinned.
We have inflicted pain on you, 𝄓 and we have not kept the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, that you commanded Moses your servant.
Remember, if you will, the word that you commanded Moses, your servant, saying, 𝄓 You, you trespass. I, I will disperse you among the peoples.

But return to me, and keep my commandments, and do them. 𝄓 Though you were banished at the outskirts of the heavens, from there I would collect them, and would bring them to the place where I have chosen to let my name dwell there.
And they are your servants and your people, 𝄓 which you have ransomed in your great power and with your resolute hand.

Beseeching my Lord, let be, if you will, your ear attentive to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants, who delight to fear your name, and prosper, if you will, your servant today, and grant him compassion in the presence of this man, 𝄓 for I was cupbearer to the king. P

And it happened in the new moon of Nisan, the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king. Wine was in his presence. 𝄓 And I lifted up the wine and I gave it to the king, and I had not been dejected in his presence.
And the king said to me, For what purpose is your face dejected, though you yourself have no illness. Is it not this, but a dejection of heart? 𝄓 And I feared very much.
And I said to the king, O king, live forever. 𝄓 For what purpose is my face not dejected, that the city, the house of the tombs of my fathers, is desert and her gates devoured in the fire. S
And the king said to me, What is it you seek? 𝄓 And I prayed to the God of the heavens.
And I said to the king, If to the king it is good, and if your servant has done well in your presence, 𝄓 that you would send me to Judah to the city of the tombs of my fathers that I may build it.

And the king said to me, (and the consort was sitting next to him), How long will your expedition be, and when will you return? 𝄓 So it was good before the king, and he sent me, and I gave him a season.
And I said to the king, If to the king it is good, let letters be given to me to viceroys beyond the river, 𝄓 that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah.

And a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the paradise that is the king's, that will give me trees for rafters for the gates of the temple precincts, that is for the house and for the wall of the city, and the house into which I will enter. 𝄓 And the king gave me permission according to the good hand of my God upon me.
And I came to the viceroys beyond the river, and I gave to them the letters of the king. 𝄓 (And the king had sent with me forceful chiefs and cavaliers.) P
And Sanballet the Horonite heard, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and it irritated them in thought greatly, 𝄓 that a human had come to seek towards good for the children of Israel.
So I came to Jerusalem, 𝄓 and I was there three days.

And I arose by night, I and a few soldiers with me, and I had not told any human what my God had permitted in my heart to do for Jerusalem. 𝄓 And beast there was none with me, but only the beast that I was riding on.

And I went out at the gorge gate by night, and at the face of the eye of the dragon, and at the gate of the garbage dump, 𝄓 and I was inspecting the walls of Jerusalem, they that were breached, and her gates devoured in the fire.
And I passed through to the gate of the spring and to the blessing pool of the king, 𝄓 but there was no place for the beast under me to pass through.
And I ascended in the wadi by night and I was inspecting the wall, 𝄓 and I turned back and entered at the gorge gate and I returned.

And the prefects did not know where I walked or what I was doing. 𝄓 And to the Judeans and to the priests and to the freeborn and to the prefects and to the rest, the deeds of the lines of work, so long, I did not tell.
And I said to them, You see the evil that we are in, that Jerusalem is deserted, and her gates charred in the fire, 𝄓 Come and build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no longer a reproach.

And I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me, and also the words of the king that he had said to me. 𝄓 And they said, Let us arise and let us build, and they encouraged their means towards the good. P

And Sanballet the Horonite heard and Tobiah, the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, and they derided us and despised us. 𝄓 And they said, What is this thing that you are doing? Do you mutiny against the king?

And I turned to them a word, and I said to them, The God of the heavens himself will prosper us and we, his servants, arise and build, 𝄓 but to you there is neither share nor righteousness nor memorial in Jerusalem.

And Elyashib the great priest arose, and his kin the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They themselves sanctified it, and installed its portals. 𝄓 To the tower of a Hundred they sanctified it, until the tower of Hananeel [the grace of God]. S
And adjacent to him, the soldiers of Jericho were building. 𝄓 And adjacent to them, Zakkur, child of Imri was building. S
And the fish gate, the children of Hasenaah were building. 𝄓 They laid its rafters, and they installed its portals, its door-bolts, and its cross-beams. S

And adjacent to them, revamping was Meremot, child of Uriah, child of Qots, and adjacent to them, revamping was Meshullam, child of Berechiah, child of Meshezabeel, 𝄓 and adjacent to them, revamping was Zadok, child of Baana. S
And adjacent to them revamping were the Tekoans. 𝄓 Their majesties did not bring their necks into the service of their Lord. S
And the gate of the old store, Yoiada, child of Paseax and Meshullam, child of Besodeyah revamped. 𝄓 They laid its rafters, and they installed its portals, and its door-bolts, and its cross-beams. S
And adjacent to them, revamping was Melatyah, the Gibeonite, and Yadon, the Meronotite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, 𝄓 to the throne of the viceroy beyond the river. S
Adjacent to him revamping was Uzziel, child of Karhayah, (refiners), and adjacent to him revamping was Hananiah, child of apothecaries, 𝄓 and they assisted Jerusalem until the broad wall. S
And adjacent to them revamping was Rephayah, child of Hur, chief of a half sector of Jerusalem. S
And adjacent to them revamping was The Hand of Yah, child of Harumaph, and in front of his house, 𝄓 and adjacent to him revamping was Xatush, child of Xashabniah.
A second measure Malchiah, child of Xarim and Xashuv, child of the viceroy of Moab revamped, 𝄓 and the tower of the ovens. S
And adjacent to him revamping was Shallum, child of Haloxesh, chief of a half sector of Jerusalem, 𝄓 himself and his daughters. S

The gate of the gorge, Xanun revamped, and the inhabitants of Zanoach. They built it and installed its portals, its door-bolts, and its cross-beams, 𝄓 and a thousand cubits on the wall to the gate of the garbage dump.
And the gate of the garbage dump, Malchiah, child of Rider revamped, chief of a sector of the house of the vineyard. 𝄓 He built it and installed its portals, its door-bolts, and its cross-beams. S

And the gate of the spring Shallun revamped. Child of All-Vision, chief of a sector of Mizpah, he built it and put up a rain-awning, and installed its portals, its door-bolts, and its cross-beams, 𝄓 and the rampart of the blessing pool of Siloah, of the garden of the king, and to the stairs that go down from the city of David. S

After him, revamping was Nehemiah, child of Azbuq, chief of a half sector of the house of Tyre, 𝄓 until what is in front of the tomb of David, to the blessing pool that was made, to the house of the valiant. S
After him, revamping were the Levites, Rehum, child of Bani. 𝄓 Adjacent to him revamping was Xeshabyah, chief of a half sector of Qilah, for his sector. S
After him, revamping were their kin, Bavy, child of Henadad, 𝄓 chief of a half sector of Qilah. S
And revamping adjacent to him, Ezer, child of Jeshua, chief of Mizpah, a measure second, 𝄓 from before the ascent to the armory at the cut. S
After him fiercely revamping, was Baruch, child of Zakkai, a second measure, 𝄓 from the cut even to the door of the house of Elyashib, the great priest. S
After him revamping was Meremot, child of Uriah, child of Qots, a second measure, 𝄓 from the door of the house of Elyashib to the finish of the house of Elyashib. S
And after him, revamping were the priests, the men of the basin.
After him, revamping were Benjamin and Xashuv in front of their house. 𝄓 After him, revamping was Azariah, child of Maaseyah, child of Ananyah, next to his house. S
After him, revamping was Binnui, child of Henadad, a second measure, 𝄓 from the house of Azariah until the cut and to the corner.
Palal, child of Uzai, from before the cut, and the tower that comes forth from the house of the king, the higher, that is for the court of the cell. 𝄓 After him, Pedayah, child of Parosh. S
And the Nethinim were settled in Ophel, 𝄓 to what is in front of the water gate to the east, and the tower that comes forth. S
After him revamping were the Tekoans, a second measure, 𝄓 from before the great tower that comes forth, and to the rampart of Ophel.
From above the gate of the horses, revamping were the priests, each in front of his house. S
After him revamping was Zadok, child of Immer, in front of his house, 𝄓 and after him, revamping was Shemaiah, child of Shekanayah, keeping the gate of the east. S
After him revamping was Hananiah, child of Shelemiah, and Xanun, child of Tsalap, (the sixth), a second measure. 𝄓 After him, revamping was Meshullam, child of Berechiah, in front of his chamber. S
After him, revamping was Malchiah, child of Zarephath, to the house of the Nethinim and the merchants, 𝄓 in front of the gate of the visitation, and to the ascent of the corner.
And between the ascent of the corner to the sheep gate, revamping were the refiners and the merchants. P
And it happened when Sanballet heard that we ourselves had built the wall, he was burning with anger himself, and grieved much, 𝄓 and derided the Judeans.

And he said before his kin and the force of Samaria, and he said, What are the feeble Judeans doing? 𝄓 Will they assist themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones from the piles of dust that are incinerated?
And Tobiah the Ammonite was next to him, 𝄓 and he said, And even what they build, if a fox ascended, it would breach the rampart of their stones. P
Hear our God, for we are disdained, and return their reproach on their head, 𝄓 and give them to be despised in the land of captivity.
And do not cover their iniquity, and let not their sin from your presence be wiped out, 𝄓 for they have provoked grief before the builders.
So we built up the wall, and all the wall was sturdy to its half, 𝄓 for it was heartfelt for the people to act. P

And it happened that as Sanballet and Tobiah and the Arabians and the Ammonites, and those of Ashdod heard that the length of the walls of Jerusalem had come up, that the breaches were starting to be mended, 𝄓 he was burning especially about them.
And they colluded all of them together, to come to make war against Jerusalem, 𝄓 and to make it slow down.
But we prayed to our God, 𝄓 and stood guard against them day and night in their faces.
And Judah said, The power of the burden-bearer falters and the dust is excessive, 𝄓 that we ourselves are not able to build the wall.
And our adversaries said, They will not know and they will not see until we are come to their midst and slay them, 𝄓 and put a stop to the lines of work.
And it happened that as the Judeans who had settled next to them came, 𝄓 they said to us ten times, From all the places where you return to us.
So I installed, from the lower places behind the wall, in the hot spots, 𝄓 and I installed the people by family, with their swords, their lances, and their bows.

And I saw and I arose and I said to the freeborn and the prefects and the remaining people, Do not fear from their presence. 𝄓 Remember the Lord, great and fearful, and fight for your kin, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your houses. P
And it happened that as our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had thwarted their counsel. 𝄓 And we returned, all of us, to the wall, each to his line of work.
And it happened from that day, half my lads would do the lines of work, and half were resolute with lances, shields, and bows, and chain mail, 𝄓 and the chiefs were behind all the house of Judah.
The builders on the wall, and the lifters of burdens, carried on, 𝄓 with one hand doing the lines of work, and the other resolutely holding the weapon.
And the builders, each his sword bound on his waist, and building, 𝄓 and the one who sounded the shophar was next to me.
And I said to the freeborn and the prefects and the remaining people, The lines of work are excessive and broad, 𝄓 and we are separated on the wall, distant each from his kin.
In the place that you hear the voice of the shophar, 𝄓 there rally to us. Our God will fight for us.
So we did the lines of work, 𝄓 and half were resolute with lances, from the coming up of the dawn until the coming out of the stars.
Even at that time, I said to the people, Let each with his lad lodge within Jerusalem, 𝄓 that they will be for us by night a guard, and by day for a line of work.
So there was not for me, or my kin, or my lads, or the soldiers of the guard that followed me, there was not for us stripping our garments, 𝄓 each, his weapon in the water. S
And there was a great outcry of the people and their wives, 𝄓 to their kin, the Judeans.
And there are who say, Our sons and our daughters, (we are many), 𝄓 and we will take the grain, and we will eat that we may live.
And there are who say, our fields and our vineyards and our houses we have given as surety, 𝄓 that we may take the grain in scarcity.
And there are who say, we have borrowed money for the levy of the king, 𝄓 our fields and our vineyards.

And now as the flesh of our kin is our flesh, as their children our children, 𝄓 and behold we ourselves have lost control of our sons, and our sons are slaves, and there are some from our daughters who are controlled, and impotent is our hand, and our fields and our vineyards belong to others.
And I burned with much anger, 𝄓 as I heard their appeal and these words.

But I reigned over my heart, and I contended with the freeborn and the prefects, and said to them, You have lured each his kin. You have lured them. 𝄓 And I positioned a great congregation against them.

And I said to them, We have acquired our kin the Judeans, the ones being sold to the nations, as often as was in us. And even you, will you sell your kin? Or will they be sold to us? 𝄓 But they kept silent and failed to find a word. S
And I said, Not good is the thing that you are doing. 𝄓 Is it not in the fear of our God you should go, out of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?
And even I, my kin, or my lads, might have lured from them silver or grain. 𝄓 Let us forsake please, this luring.

Restore please to them as of today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive trees, and their houses, 𝄓 and a hundred of the silver, and the grain, the new wine, and the clarified oil that you have lured from them.
And they said, We will restore, and from them, nothing we will demand, so we will do as you say. 𝄓 And I called the priests, and I had them swear to do according to this word.

Also I brushed off my forearm and said, Thus will God brush off every person who does not uphold this word, from his house, and from his labour. Thus he will be brushed off and emptied. 𝄓 And all the congregation said, Amen. And they praised Yahweh. And the people did according to this word.

Moreover from that day, he commanded me to become their viceroy in the land of Judah from the twentieth year to the thirty second year of Artaxerxes the king, twelve years. 𝄓 I and my kin have not eaten the bread of the viceroy.

And the former viceroys that were before, were heavy over the people, and had taken from them bread and wine, after forty silver shekels. Also their lads had authority over the people. 𝄓 But I, I have not done so in the presence of the fear of God.
And also in the lines of work of this wall, I was resolute, but we acquired no field, 𝄓 and all my lads were collected there over the lines of work.
And the Judeans and the prefects, a hundred and fifty men, and they came to us from the nations that surrounded us, at my table.

And what was done for one day, one bull, six pure sheep were done for me, and birds. And once every ten days, with all wine in abundance. 𝄓 And with this, the bread of the viceroy I did not seek, for the service was heavy over this people.
Remember me, my God, for the good, 𝄓 all that I have done over this people. P

And it happened that as Sanballet and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies heard that I had built the wall, (and there was not a breach left in it, 𝄓 but also until that time, I had not installed the portals in the gates),
That Sanballet and Geshem sent to me, saying, Come, let us engage together in cover in the grassland of Ono. 𝄓 But they were devising to do me injury.
And I sent to them messengers, saying, A great line of work I am doing, and I am not able to come down. 𝄓 Why should the line of work cease as I slacken from it, and go down to you.
And they sent to me a word like this four times. 𝄓 And I returned to them a word like this. S
And Sanballet sent to me his lad, a word like this, a fifth time, 𝄓 and an open letter in his hand.
Written in it, In the nations it is reported, and Geshemu has said, You and the Judeans plot mutiny. Therefore you are building the wall. 𝄓 And you are for them, to be king, according to these words.

And you have even installed prophets to proclaim about you in Jerusalem, saying, A king in Judah, and, Now let it be reported to the king about these things. 𝄓 So now, come, and let us take counsel together. S
And I sent to him, saying, There are no things like these which you say, 𝄓 but from your heart you contrive them.
For all of them made us fear, saying, Let their hands slacken from the lines of work, that it not be done. 𝄓 So now, encourage my hand.

And myself, I entered the house of Shemaiah, child of Delaiah, child of Mehetabeel, (and he had been detained). 𝄓 And he said, Let us engage at the house of God in the centre of the temple, and let us lock the gateways of the temple, for they are coming to slay you, and by night, coming to slay you.
And I said, Such a man as I, will he run? And who is there such as I who would come to the temple so to live? 𝄓 I will not go.
And I recognized, and behold, God had not sent him. 𝄓 But the prophecy he spoke of me. And Tobiah and Sanballet had hired him.
So he was hired, so that I would fear, and I would do so, and I would sin. 𝄓 And it would be for them for an evil reputation, so that they could reproach me. P
Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballet, according to these their deeds, 𝄓 and furthermore, Noadiah the prophetess, and the rest of the prophets who would have made me fear.
And the wall became whole on the twenty fifth of Elul, 𝄓 in fifty two days. P
And it happened that as all our enemies heard, and all the nations that surrounded us saw, that they utterly let their eyes fall. 𝄓 And they knew that from our God, this line of work was done.
Moreover in those days, many of the freeborn of Judah had their letters travel to Tobiah, 𝄓 and those of Tobiah came to them.
For many in Judah owed allegiance to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shekanayah, child of Arax, 𝄓 and Yehoxanan his son had taken the daughter of Meshullam, child of Berechiah.
Furthermore, they were mentioning his good before me, and my words they were bringing out to him. 𝄓 Tobiah sent out letters to make me fear.
And it happened that as the wall was built and I had installed the gateways, 𝄓 and had conscripted the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites,
That I gave Hanani my brother and Hananiah chief of the temple precincts commission over Jerusalem, 𝄓 for he was as person, truthful, and he feared God above many.

And I said to them, let the gates of Jerusalem not be opened until the sun is warm, and while they were standing by, let them put trunks in the gateways and hold them fast, 𝄓 and have the inhabitants of Jerusalem stand as guards, each in his watch and each in front of his house.
And the city was broad of hands and was great, and the people were few in the midst of it, 𝄓 and there were no houses built.

And my God permitted in my heart to collect the freeborn and the prefects and the people, to enroll by genealogy, 𝄓 and I found the record of the genealogy of those who came up in the beginning, and I found inscribed within it, P
These are the children of the province who went up from the captivity, the exiled that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel had exiled, 𝄓 and they returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, each to its city.
Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nexum, Baanah, 𝄓 the count of those of the people of Israel. S
The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred and seventy two. S
The children of Shepatyah, three hundred and seventy two. S
The children of Arax, six hundred and fifty two. S
The children of the viceroy of Moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, 𝄓 two thousand eight hundred and eighteen. S
The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty four. S

The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty five. S

The priests, 𝄓 the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy three. S
The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty two. S

Nethinim, 𝄓 the children of Tsixa, the children of Xasupha, the children of Tabbaoth.

All the Nethinim, and the children of the servants of Solomon, 𝄓 three hundred and ninety two. P
And these are they who went up from the Salt Tel, Tel Smith, Cherub, Addan, and Immer, 𝄓 but who were not able to announce the house of their ancestors, and their seed, whether they were from Israel.
The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Neqoda, 𝄓 six hundred and forty two. S
And from the priests, the children of Habaiah, the children of Qots, 𝄓 the children of Barzillai, who took from the daughters of Barzillai of the Gilead, a wife, and was called by their name.
These sought their register in the genealogies but were not found, 𝄓 and were sullied from the priesthood.
And Tirshatha said to them that they should not eat from the holy of holy things, 𝄓 until a priest stood with the lights and completions.
All the congregation as one, 𝄓 forty two thousand three hundred and sixty,
besides their servants and their maidservants. These were seven thousand three hundred and thirty seven, 𝄓 and of them were two hundred and forty five male singers and female singers. S
Camels, four hundred and thirty five, 𝄓 their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
And a limited number of the heads of the ancestors gave to the lines of work. 𝄓 The Tirshatha gave to the treasury a thousand gold drams, fifty bowls, five hundred and thirty priests' coats.
And from the heads of the ancestors, they gave from the treasury to the lines of work, twenty thousand gold drams, 𝄓 and two thousand and two hundred silver portions.
And what the residue of the people gave, twenty thousand gold drams, and two thousand silver portions, 𝄓 and sixty seven coats priests. P

So they settled, the priests and the Levites, and the gatekeepers and the singers, and from the people and the Nethinim, and all Israel in their cities. 𝄓 And at the touch of the seventh new moon, the children of Israel were in their cities.

And all the people gathered as one person at the plaza that is before the water gate, 𝄓 and they said to Ezra the secretary to bring the record of the instruction of Moses which Yahweh commanded Israel.
And Ezra the priest brought the instruction before the congregation of men and women, 𝄓 and all with discernment to hear on the first day of the seventh month.

And he recited within it before the plaza that is before the water gate, from first light to the mid day, in front of the men and the women and the discerning, 𝄓 and the ears of all the people were to the record of instruction.

And Ezra the secretary stood on a pulpit of wood that they made for the word, and standing next to him, Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Uriah, and Hilqiah, and Maaseyah, at his right hand, 𝄓 and from his left, Pedayah, and Mishael, and Malkiah, Xashum, and Xashbadana, Zekariah, Meshullam. P
And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, (because he was above all the people), 𝄓 and as he opened it, all the people stood.
And Ezra blessed Yahweh the great God, 𝄓 and all the people answered, Amen, amen, offering up their hands. And they bowed the head and worshiped Yahweh nostrils earthward.

And Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Yamin, Aqqub, Shabbethai, Hodyah, Maaseyah, Qelita, Azariah, Jozebad, Chanan, Peleyah, and the Levites made the people understand the instruction, 𝄓 and the people per their standing.
So they recited in the book, in the instruction of God distinctly, 𝄓 and rendered insight, and made them understand in the recitation. S

And Nehemiah (he is the Tirshatha) and Ezra the priest, the secretary, and the Levites who made the people understand, said to all the people, Today is holy to Yahweh your God. Do not lament and do not weep. 𝄓 For all the people wept as they were hearing the words of instruction.

And he said to them, Come. Eat from the stoutest and imbibe from sweetness, and send portions to those with nothing prepared, for holy is today to our Lord, 𝄓 and do not be pained, for the cheer of Yahweh is your strength.
And the Levites calmed all the people, saying, Hush for today is holy, 𝄓 so do not be pained.
And all the people went to eat and to imbibe and to send portions, and to make great mirth, 𝄓 for they had understood the words that were made known to them. S
And on the second day the heads of the fathers for all the people, the priests and the Levites, gathered to Ezra the secretary, 𝄓 and were given insight into the words of instruction.
And they found inscribed in the instruction, 𝄓 that Yahweh commanded by the hand of Moses that the children of Israel settle in booths in the festival in the seventh month.

And that they should broadcast and have a voice pass through in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth to the hill, and bring leaves of olive, and leaves of oil tree, and leaves of myrtle, and leaves of palm trees, and leaves of a thick tree, 𝄓 to make booths as it is written. P

And the people went forth and they brought and they made for themselves booths, each on their roof, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, 𝄓 and in the plaza of the water gate, and in the plaza of the gate of Ephraim.

And all the congregation of those who returned from the captivity made booths, and they sat in booths, for the children of Israel had not done so from the days of Jeshua child of Nun to that day, 𝄓 and there was very great gladness.

And he recited in the record of the instruction of God day by day, from the first day to the last day, 𝄓 and they made the feast seven days, and on the eighth day, a conclave according to the framework. P
And on the twenty fourth day of this month, the children of Israel gathered with fasting, and in sackcloth, and debris from the ground upon them.
And the seed of Israel differentiated themselves among all the children of the alien, 𝄓 and they stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their ancestors.

And they arose in their standing, and they recited in the book of the instruction of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day, 𝄓 and a fourth part they confessed and prostrated themselves to Yahweh their God. P
And the Levites arose on the stairs, Jeshua, and the children of Qadmiel, Shebanyah, Bunni, Sherebiah, the children of Kenani, 𝄓 and they appealed with a great voice to Yahweh their God.

And the Levites said, (Jeshua, and Qadmiel, Bunni, Xashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodyah, Shebanyah, Petaxiah), Arise, bless Yahweh your God from the everlasting to the everlasting, 𝄓 and let them bless the name of your glory and let it be celebrated over all blessing and praise.

You are he, Yahweh, you only. You yourself have made the heavens, the heaven of the heavens, and all their hosts, the earth, and all that is on it, the seas, and all that is in them, and you revive them all. 𝄓 And the host of the heavens worship you.
You are he, Yahweh, the God who chose in Abram, and brought him out from Ur of Chaldea, 𝄓 and set his name as Abraham.

And you found his heart faithful before you and you cut with him the covenant to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give for his seed, 𝄓 and you have placed your words for a righteous one you are.
And you saw the impoverishment of our ancestors in Egypt, 𝄓 and their appeal you heard at the sea of reeds.

And you gave signs and portents to Pharaoh and to all his servants, and to all the people of his land, for you knew that they acted presumptuously over them, 𝄓 and you made yourself a name as at this day.
And the sea you split before them, and they crossed over in the midst of the sea on dry land, 𝄓 and their pursuers you cast into the depths as a stone in the strong waters.
And in a pillar of cloud you guided them by day, 𝄓 and in a pillar of fire by night, to give light to them in the way that they should walk.
And on mount Sinai you came down and spoke with them from the heavens, 𝄓 and you gave them upright judgments and true instruction, statutes and commandments that are good.
And your holy Sabbath you made known to them, 𝄓 and commandments, and statutes, and instructions, you commanded them by the hand of Moses your servant.

And bread from the heavens you gave for them for their hunger, and water from a cliff you brought forth for them for their thirst. 𝄓 And you said to them to enter to possess the land that you had lifted up your hand to give them.
But they and our ancestors were presumptuous, 𝄓 and they hardened their scruffs, and they did not hear your commandments.

And they would not hear, and they did not remember your wonders that you did with them, but they hardened their scruffs, and they put forth a head to return to their service in their provocation. 𝄓 But you are the God of pardons, gracious, and compassionate, slow to anger, and of abundant kindness, and you did not forsake them.
Indeed, for they made for themselves a calf, a molten image, and said, This is your God who brought you up from Egypt. 𝄓 And they undertook great blasphemies.

But you, in your many compassions, you did not forsake them in the wilderness. 𝄓 The pillar of cloud did not turn aside from over them by day to guide them in the way, nor the pillar of the fire by night as light for them, and the way that they should walk in.
And your good spirit you gave to give them insight, 𝄓 and your manna you did not withhold from their mouth, and water you gave for them for their thirst.
And forty years you nourished them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. 𝄓 Their apparel did not wear out, and their feet did not blister.
And you gave them kingdoms, and peoples, and divisions into quarters, 𝄓 and they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og, king of Bashan.
And their children you have increased as the stars of the heavens, 𝄓 and you brought them to the land which you had promised to their ancestors to enter to possess.

And the children entered and they possessed the land, and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and you gave them into their hands, 𝄓 both their kings and the peoples of the land, to do with them according as they found acceptance with them.

And they conquered enclosed cities and a stout ground, and they possessed houses full of all good, hewn cisterns, vineyards and olive trees, and trees for food in abundance, 𝄓 and they ate and were sated, and became stout, and enthralled themselves in your great goodness.

And they were provocative, and they mutinied in you, and they flung your instruction behind their backs, and your prophets they slew, who witnessed in them to return them to you, 𝄓 and they undertook great blasphemies.

And you gave them into the hand of their adversaries, 𝄓 and they were trouble to them, and in the time of their trouble, they cried out to you, and from the heavens you yourself heard, and according to your many compassions, you gave them saviours, and they saved them from the hand of their adversaries.

But as they had rest, they returned to do evil before you, 𝄓 and you forsook them into the hand of their enemies, and they ruled them, and they returned, and they appealed to you, and from the heavens you yourself heard, and you delivered, according to your compassions, many times.

And you testified against them to return them to your instruction, but they acted presumptuously and they did not hear your commandments, but they sinned against your judgments, (that a human does so he will live in them), 𝄓 and they put forth a shoulder, turned aside, and their scruff they hardened, and they did not hear.
And you drew them out many years and your spirit testified in them by the hand of your prophets, but they did not give ear. 𝄓 And you gave them into the hand of the people of the lands.
But in your many compassions, you did not undertake to consume them, and you did not forsake them, 𝄓 for you are a God gracious and compassionate.

And now, our God, the One, the Great, the Valiant, and the Fearful, who keeps the covenant and the kindness, let not be too little before you, all the exasperation that has found us, for our kings, for our chiefs, and for our priests, and for our prophets, and for our ancestors, and for all your people, 𝄓 from the days of the kings of Ashur to this day.
And you are a righteous one in all that has come over us, 𝄓 because truth you have done, and ourselves, we are wicked.

And our kings, our chiefs, our priests, and our ancestors, they did not do your instruction, 𝄓 and they did not attend to your commandments, and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

And they in their kingdoms, and in your abundant good that you gave to them, and in the land, broad and stout, that you gave before them, they did not serve you, 𝄓 and they did not turn from their practices of evil.
Behold, we are today servants, and the land that you gave to our ancestors, to eat its fruit, and its good, 𝄓 behold, we are servants on it.
And its income is increased, to the kings that you gave over us in our sins, 𝄓 and over our bodies they govern, and with our cattle at their bidding, and in great straits we are. P
And in all this, we were in league faithfully, and written, 𝄓 and over the seal of our nobility, our Levites, our priests.
