And the residue of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the Nethinim, and all who were differentiated from the people of the lands to the instruction of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, 𝄓 all having knowledge with discernment,

They were resolute over their excellent kin, and entered into an imprecation, and into an oath, to walk in the instruction of this God, that was given by the hand of Moses, the servant of God, 𝄓 and to keep and to do all the commandments of Yahweh, our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes.
And that we would not give our daughters to the people of the land, 𝄓 and their daughters we would not take for our sons.

And the people of the land who bring commodities or any crushed corn on the day of the Sabbath to sell, we would not take from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day, 𝄓 and we would abandon, the seventh year, the debt of every hand.
And we installed for ourselves the commandment, to give for ourselves a third of a shekel per year, 𝄓 for the service of the house of our God.

For bread for the arrangement, the continual gift, and the continual burnt offering, the Sabbaths, the new moons, for appointed times, for the holy things, and for the sin offerings for the cover-price over Israel, 𝄓 and all the lines of work for the house of our God. S

And we let lots fall over the oblation of the wood, the priests, the Levites, and the people, to bring for the house of our God, for the house of our ancestors, for the times from the seasons, year in year out, 𝄓 for kindling on the altar of Yahweh our God, as it is written in the instruction.
And to bring the first ripe fruit of our ground, and the first ripe fruit of all the fruit of every tree, year in year out, 𝄓 to the house of Yahweh.

And the firstborn of our sons, and of our beasts, as it is written in the instruction, 𝄓 and the firstborn of our herds, and our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, for the priests ministering in the house of our God.

And the first of our coarse meal, and our contributions, and the fruit of every tree, or new wine, or clarified oil, we should bring to the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God, and the tithe of our ground to the Levites, 𝄓 that they the Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our cultivation.

And the priest, a child of Aaron, will be with the Levites when the Levites are getting tithes. 𝄓 And the Levites will bring up the tithe of the tithe to the house of our God, to the chambers for the house, of the treasury.

For to the chambers, the children of Israel and the children of the Levite will bring the contribution of the grain, the new wine, and the clarified oil, for there are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the ministering priests, and the gatekeepers, and the singers, 𝄓 and we will not forsake the house of our God.

So the nobles of the people settled in Jerusalem. 𝄓 And the residue of the people, they let the dice fall to bring one in ten to settle in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine, the protectors in the cities.
And the people blessed, 𝄓 for all the persons who offered themselves willingly to settle in Jerusalem. P

And these are the heads of the provinces who had settled in Jerusalem. 𝄓 And in the cities of Judah, each settled in his holdings in their cities of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of the servants of Solomon.

And in Jerusalem settled some of the children of Judah, and from the children of Benjamin. 𝄓 Of the children of Judah, Atayah child of Uzziah, child of Zechariah, child of Amariah, child of Shepatyah, child of Mahalaleil, of the children of Perez.
And Maaseyah, child of Baruch, child of All-Vision, child of Xaziah, child of Adiyah, child of Yoyarib, child of Zechariah, child of the Shelanite.
All the children of Perez who had settled in Jerusalem, 𝄓 four hundred and sixty eight persons of ability. S
And these are the children of Benjamin, 𝄓 Sallu child of Meshullam, child of Yoed, child of Pedayah, child of Kolayah, child of Maaseyah, child of God-Is-With-Me, child of Isaiah.
And after him Gabbi, Salli, 𝄓 nine hundred and twenty eight.
And Joel child of Zikri, an officer over them, 𝄓 and Judah child of Senaah, over the city, second. P
From the priests, 𝄓 Jedaiah child of Yoyarib, Yakin.
Saraiah, child of Hilqiah, child of Meshullam, child of Zadok, child of Meraioth, child of Achitov, herald of the house of God.

And their kin, those doing the lines of work, for the house, eight hundred and twenty two, 𝄓 and Adiyah, child of Jeroham, child of Pelaliah, child of Amtsi, child of Zechariah, child of Pashur, child of Malchiah.
And his kin, heads of the ancestors, two hundred forty two, 𝄓 and Amashai, child of Azarel, child of Axasai, child of Mishlamot, child of Immer.
And their kin, valiant of force, a hundred and twenty eight, 𝄓 and officer over them, Zabdiel, child of the great. S
And from the Levites, 𝄓 Shemaiah child of Xashuv, child of Azriqam, child of Xeshabyah, child of Bunni.
And Shabbethai, and Jozebad, (over the lines of work of the outward for the house of this God), from the heads of the Levites.

And Mattaniah, child of Micah, child of Zavdi, child of Asaph, preeminent to start the thanksgiving for the prayer, and Baqbuqyah the second from his kin, 𝄓 and Abda, child of Shammua, child of Roller, child of Jeduthun.
All the Levites in the holy city, two hundred and eighty four. P
And the gatekeepers, Aqqub, Talmon, and their kin, those keeping the gates, 𝄓 one hundred and seventy two.
And the residue of Israel, the priests, the Levites, in all the cities of Judah, for each, in its inheritance.
And the Nethinim settled in Ophel, 𝄓 and Tsixa and Gishpa were over the Nethinim. P

The officer of the Levites in Jerusalem, Uzzi, child of Bani, child of Xeshabyah, child of Mattaniah, child of Mika. 𝄓 Of the children of Asaph, the singers, in front of the lines of work for the house of God.
For the commandment of the king was over them, 𝄓 that the singers be faithful over the word, day by day.
And Petaxiah, child of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerach, child of Judah, handy to the king for all matters for the people.
And the villages with their fields. 𝄓 Of the children of Judah, some had settled in Qiryath-Arba and her built-up areas, and in Dibon and her built-up areas, and in Yiqbetsel and her villages.
And in Jeshua and in Moladah and in Beth-Pelet.
And in the courts of the fox, and in Beer-Sheva and her built-up areas.
And in Tsiqlag, and in Mekonah and her built-up areas.
And in Einrimmon and in Tsarah and in Yarmut.
Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and her countryside, Azeiqah and her built-up areas. 𝄓 And they camped from Beer-Sheva to the gorge of Hinnom.
And the children of Benjamin, 𝄓 from Geba, Mikmas, and Ayyah, and Beth-El and her built-up areas.
Anathoth, Nob, Ananyah,
Chatsor, Ramah, Gittaim,
Xadid, Tsebaim, Neballat,
Lod and Ono, the gorge of the artificers.
And from the Levites, the divisions of Judah, of Benjamin. P
And these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel, child of Shealtiel, and Jeshua, 𝄓 Saraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
Amariah, Malluk, Xatush,
Shekanayah, Rakam, Meremot,
Iddo, Ginneton, Abijah,
Miyamin, Maadyah, Bilgah,
Shemaiah, and Yoyarib, Jedaiah,
Salu, Amoq, Hilqiah, Jedaiah. 𝄓 These were the heads of the priests and their kin in the days of Jeshua. P
And the Levites, Jeshua, Binnui, Qadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, Mattaniah, 𝄓 over the thanksgiving, he and his kin.
And Baqbuqyah, and Unni, their kin before them, for keeping the watches.
And Jeshua had Yoiaqim, 𝄓 and Yoiaqim had Elyashib, and Elyashib, Yoiada.
And Yoiada had Yonathan, and Yonathan had Yaddua.
And in the days of Yoiaqim were priests, the heads of the ancestors, 𝄓 Saraiah, Meryah, Jeremiah, Hananiah.
Of Ezra, Meshullam, of Amariah, Yehoxanan.
Of Maliku, Yonathan, of Shebanyah, Joseph.
Of Xarim, Adna, of Meraioth, Xelqi.
Of Iddo, Zechariah, of Ginneton, Meshullam.
Of Abijah, Zikri, 𝄓 of Minyamin of Moadyah, Palti.
Of Bilgah, Shammua, of Shemiah, Jonathan.
And of Yoyarib, Mattnay, of Jedaiah, Uzzi.
Of Salu, Qalai, of Amoq, Eber.
Of Hilqiah, Xeshabyah, of Jedaiah, Netaneel.
The Levites in the days of Elyashib, Jedaiah, and Jochanan, and Yaddua, inscribed as the heads of the ancestors, 𝄓 and the priests over the kingdom of Darius the Persian. P
The children of Levi, the heads of the ancestors are written in the record of the words of the days, 𝄓 to the days of Jochanan, child of Elyashib.

And the head of the Levites, Xeshabyah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua, child of Qadmiel, and their kin before them, to praise, to give thanks, by the commandment of David the man of God, 𝄓 guard set against guard.
Mattaniah, and Baqbuqyah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Aqqub, 𝄓 kept the watch of the gates, guarding at the ingathering of the gates.
These were in the days of Yoiaqim, child of Jeshua, child of Jotsadaq, 𝄓 and in the days of Nehemiah, the viceroy, and Ezra, the priest, the secretary. P

And at the dedication of the rampart of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites from all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, 𝄓 to do the dedication, and with gladness, and with thanksgiving, and with song, cymbals, lutes, and harps.
And the children of the singers gathered, 𝄓 both from the basin round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of the Netophatites,
And from the house of the Gilgal, and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, 𝄓 for the singers had built for themselves villages round Jerusalem.
And the priests cleansed themselves and the Levites, 𝄓 and they cleansed the people, and the gates, and the wall.
And I brought up the nobility of Judah over the wall, 𝄓 and I installed two great thanksgivings, and one went on the right hand from above the wall to the gate of the garbage dump,
And after them went Hoshaiah and half the nobility of Judah.
And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah, S
And from the children of the priests with the trumpets, 𝄓 Zechariah, child of Yonathan, child of Shemaiah, child of Mattaniah, child of Mikayah, child of Zakkur, child of Asaph.
And his kin, Shemaiah, and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the instruments of the song of David the man of God, 𝄓 and Ezra, the secretary, before them.
And over the gate of the spring, and in front of them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the ascent of the wall, 𝄓 from above the house of David to the water gate from the east.
And the second thanksgiving went over against, and I following it, 𝄓 and half the people on the wall over against the tower of the ovens, to the broad wall,

And from over the gate of Ephraim, and over the gate of the old store, and over the gate of the fish, and from the tower of Hananeel, and from the tower of Hundred, to the sheep gate, 𝄓 and they stood at the gate of the cell.
And both the thanksgivings stood in the house of God, 𝄓 and I, and half the prefects with me.
And the priests, Elyaqim, Maaseyah, Minyamin, Mikayah, Elyoeinai, Zechariah, Hananiah, with the trumpets,
And Maaseyah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Yehoxanan, and Malkiah, and Eilam, and Ezer, 𝄓 and the singers broadcast, and Yizraxiah, the officer.

And they offered in that day great sacrificing, and they were glad, for God had made them glad with great gladness, and even the women and the juveniles were glad, 𝄓 and the gladness of Jerusalem was heard from afar.

And they entrusted persons in that day, over the interests of the treasuries for the contributions, for the first-fruits, and for the tithes, to garner into them for the fields, the cities, the portions, of the instruction for the priests and for the Levites. 𝄓 For Judah was glad over the priests and over the Levites who were installed.
And both the singers and the gatekeepers watched the watch of their God and the watch of cleansing, 𝄓 according to the commandment of David, Solomon his son.
For in the days of David and Asaph of old, 𝄓 there were the heads of the singers, and the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

And all Israel, in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions to the singers and the gatekeepers, the wherewithal day by day, 𝄓 and the holy things, to the Levites, and the Levites sanctified them for the children of Aaron. P
In that day they recited in the record of Moses in the ears of the people, 𝄓 and it was found inscribed in it, that an Ammonite or a Moabite should not come into the congregation of God evermore.
For he did not come to the children of Israel with bread and water, 𝄓 but contracted Balaam against him to deny him, and our God changed the denial to blessing.
And it happened as they were hearing the instruction, 𝄓 that they differentiated all the intermingled from Israel.
And before this, Elyashib the priest, assigned in the chamber of the house of our God, 𝄓 was near Tobiah.

And he made for himself a great chamber where before they would have consigned the gift, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the clarified oil, as commanded for the Levites and the singers and the gatekeepers, 𝄓 and the contribution for the priests.
And in all this, I had not been in Jerusalem, 𝄓 for in the thirty second year of Artaxerxes, king of Babel, I came to the king, and after some days, I asked leave from the king.
So I came to Jerusalem. 𝄓 And I understood the evil that Elyashib had undertaken for Tobiah to make for himself a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
And it irritated me much. 𝄓 And I cast out all the vessels of the house of Tobiah outside of the chamber.
And I said that they should clean the chambers. 𝄓 And I restored there the vessels of the house of God, the gift, and the frankincense. P
And I knew that the portions of the Levites had not been given. 𝄓 And to their field they had been made to run, each of the Levites and the singers who did the lines of work.
And I contended with the prefects, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? 𝄓 And I collected them and installed them per their standing.
And all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, and the new wine, and the clarified oil, to the treasuries.

And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the secretary, and Pedayah from the Levites, and by their hand, Chanan, child of Zakkur, child of Mattaniah, 𝄓 for they were reckoned faithful, and it was to them to divide for their kin. P
Remember me, my God, over this. 𝄓 And let not my kindness be wiped out that I have done in the house of my God and for its guardians.

In those days I saw in Judah treading vats on the Sabbath, and bringing in the piles, and laying a load on asses, and also wine, grapes, and figs, and all loads, and entering Jerusalem on the day of the Sabbath. 𝄓 And I testified by day for their selling of provender.
And Tyrians settled there who brought fish and all that is sold. 𝄓 And they sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah and in Jerusalem.
And I contended with the freeborn of Judah, 𝄓 and said to them, What evil thing is this that you are doing, that you profane the day of the Sabbath?
Did not thus your ancestors, and our God brought against us all this evil and over this city? 𝄓 And would you add burning anger over Israel by profaning the Sabbath? P

And it happened that as the gates of Jerusalem were shadowed before the Sabbath, that I said that the gateways should be locked. And I said that they should not open until after the Sabbath. 𝄓 And some of my lads I had installed over the gates. No load is to enter on the day of the Sabbath.
And the merchants hung around, and sellers of all that is sold, outside of Jerusalem one or two times.

And I testified against them and said to them, Why are you hanging around in front of the wall? If you do a second time, my hand I will extend against you. 𝄓 From that time, they did not come on the Sabbath. S

And I said to the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and come and keep the gates, to sanctify the day of the Sabbath. 𝄓 Even this. Remember me, my God, and spare me in the multitude of your mercies. P
Moreover in those days I saw the Judeans who settled with women, Ashdodite, Ammonite, Moabite...
And their children spoke half Ashdodite, and they could not recognize a Judean word, 𝄓 but according to the tongue of each people.

And I contended with them, and slighted them, and struck some persons from them, and pared them. 𝄓 And I had them swear in God, You will not give your daughters to their sons, and you will not take from their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.

By these things, did not Solomon king of Israel sin? Yet among the many nations, there was not a king like him, and he was loved of his God, and God assigned him king over all Israel. 𝄓 Even him the foreign women made to sin.
And to you should we pay heed to do all this great evil, to trespass in our God, 𝄓 to settle with foreign women?
And one from the children of Yoiada, child of Elyashib the great priest was son-in-law of Sanballet the Horonite, 𝄓 so I made him run from me.
Remember them, my God, 𝄓 concerning the sullying of the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.
So I cleansed them from all foreigners. 𝄓 And I installed guardians of the priests and of the Levites, each in his trade.
And for the oblation of the wood, in the times of the seasons, and for the first ripe fruit, 𝄓 remember me, my God, for the good. W
Adam Seth Enosh.
Qeinan Mahalaleil Yared.
Enoch Methuselah Lamech.
Noah Shem Ham and Japhet. S
The children of Japhet, Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal, 𝄓 and Meshek and Tiras. S
And the children of Gomer, 𝄓 Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah. S
And the children of Javan, Elishah and Tarshish, 𝄓 Kittim and Rodanim. S
The children of Ham, 𝄓 Cush and Egypt, Put and Canaan.
And the children of Cush, Seba and Havilah, Savta and Rama, and Savteka, 𝄓 and the children of Rama, Sheba, and Duddan. S
And Cush had Nimrod. 𝄓 He started what was to become valour in the earth. S
And Egypt had Ludim and Anamim and Lehavim and Naftuhim.
And Patrusim and Casluhim, from whom emerged Philistines, and Caphtorim. S
And Canaan had Tsidon his firstborn and Heit.
And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite.
And the Hivite and the Arqite and the Sinite.
And the Arvadite and the Tsemarite and the Hamite. S
The children of Shem, Eilam and Ashur and Arpacshad and Lud and Aram, 𝄓 and Uts and Chul and Geter and Meshek. S
And Arpacshad had Shalach, 𝄓 and Shalach had Eber.
And to Eber were born two sons, 𝄓 the name of the first Peleg, because in his days the earth was entangled, and the name of his brother, Joktan.
And Joktan had Almodad and Shalef, 𝄓 and Chatsarmavet and Yarach.
And Hadoram and Uzal and Diqlah.
And Eival and Avimaeil and Sheba.
And Ofir and Chavilah and Yovav, 𝄓 all these, the children of Joktan. S
Shem Arpacshad Shalach.
Eber Peleg Ru.
Serug Nachor Tarach.
Abram, he is Abraham. S
The children of Abraham, Yitschaq and Yishmaeil. S
These their successions, 𝄓 the firstborn of Yishmaeil, Nevayot and Qeidar and Adbeeil and Mivsam.
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Chadad, and Tema.
Yetur, Nafish, and Qeidmah. 𝄓 These, they are the children of Yishmaeil. S
And the children of Qeturah, courtesan of Abraham, she gave birth to Zimran and Yoqshan and Medan and Midian and Yishbaq and Shuach. 𝄓 And the children of Yoqshan, Sheba and Dedan. S
And the children of Midian, Eifah and Eifer and Chanok and Avida and Eldaah. 𝄓 All these are the children of Qeturah. S
And Abraham had Yitschaq. 𝄓 The children of Yitschaq, Esau and Israel. S
The children of Esau, 𝄓 Elifaz, Reueil and Yeush and Yalam and Korach. S
The children of Elifaz, 𝄓 Teiman and Omar, Tsefi and Gatam, Qenaz and Timna and Amalek. S
The children of Reueil, 𝄓 Nachat, Zerach, Shamah and Mizah. S
And the children of Seir, Lotan and Shoval and Tsivon and Anah, 𝄓 and Dishon and Eitser and Dishan. S
And the children of Lotan, Chori and Homam, 𝄓 and the sister of Lotan, Timna. S
The children of Shoval, Alyan and Manachat and Eival Shefi and Onam, 𝄓 and the children of Tsivon, Ayah and Anah. S
The children of Anah, Dishon, 𝄓 and the children of Dishon, Chamran and Eshban, Yitran and Cran.
The children of Eitser, Bilhan and Zaavan, Yaaqan, 𝄓 the children of Dishon, Uts, and Aran. P
And these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before a king reigned of the children of Israel, 𝄓 Bela child of Beor, and the name of his city, Dinhavah.
And when Bela had died, 𝄓 Yovav, child of Zerach of Batsrah, reigned in his stead.
And when Yovav had died, 𝄓 Chusham, from the land of the Temanite, reigned in his stead.
And when Chusham had died, 𝄓 reigned in his stead Hadad child of Bedad, who struck Midian in Sdeh-Moab, and the name of his city, Avit.
And when Hadad had died, 𝄓 Samlah from Masreiqah reigned in his stead.
And when Samlah had died, 𝄓 Shaul from Rechovot of the river, reigned in his stead.
And when Shaul had died, 𝄓 Baal Chanan child of Acbor reigned in his stead.
And when Baal Chanan had died, Hadad reigned in his stead, and the name of his city, Pai, 𝄓 and the name of his wife, Maheitaveil, the daughter of Matreid, the daughter of Mei Zahav.
And Hadad died. 𝄓 And these were the captains of Edom, captain Timna, captain Alvah, captain Yeteit.
Captain Ahalivamah, captain Eilah, captain Pinon.
Captain Qenaz, captain Teiman, captain Mivtsar.
Captain Magdieil, captain Iram, 𝄓 these are the captains of Edom. P
These are the children of Israel, 𝄓 Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun,
Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher. P
The children of Judah, Er, Onan and Shelah, three born for him from the daughter of Shua the Canaanite. 𝄓 And Er the firstborn of Judah was evil in the eyes of Yahweh, so he had him put to death. S
And Tamar his daughter-in-law gave birth for him to Perez and Zerach. 𝄓 All the children of Judah were five. S
The children of Perez, Hetsron and Xamul. S
And the children of Zerach, Zimri and Ethan and Heyman and Kalkol and Dara, in all, five of them. S
And the children of Carmi, 𝄓 Akar the agitator of Israel who trespassed against the ban. S
And the children of Ethan, Azariah. S
And the children of Hetsron that were born to him, 𝄓 Jerahmeel and Ram and Kelubai.
And Ram had Aminadab, 𝄓 and Aminadab had Nashon, a principal of the children of Judah.
And Nashon had Salma, and Salma had Boaz.
And Boaz had Obed, and Obed had Jesse.
And Jesse had his firstborn, Eliab, 𝄓 and Abinadab the second, and Shema the third,
Netaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
Otsem the sixth, David the seventh.
Whose sisters were Tseruyah and Abigail. 𝄓 And the children of Tseruyah, Abishai and Joab and Asahel, three.
And Abigail gave birth to Amasa, 𝄓 and the father of Amasa, Yether the Ishmaelite.
And Caleb, child of Hetsron, begot with Azuvah [Forsaken] a wife, and Yiriot [Curtains], 𝄓 and these are her children, Yashar [Upright] and Shobab [Shattered Pieces] and Ardon.
And Azuvah died, 𝄓 and Caleb took for himself Ephrat and she gave birth for him to Hur.
And Hur had Uri [My Light], and Uri had Betsalel. S
And after, Hetsron came to the daughter of Makir, the father of Gilead, and he took her when he was a child of sixty years, 𝄓 and she gave birth for him to Segub.
And Segub had Jair, 𝄓 and there were for him twenty three cities in the land of the Gilead. S
And he took Geshur and Aram, the municipality of Jair with them, Qenah and its built-up areas, sixty cities. 𝄓 All these are the children of Makir, the father of Gilead.
And after the death of Hetsron, in Caleb-Ephrata, 𝄓 the wife of Hetsron, Abijah, and she gave birth for him to Ashxur the father of Tekoa. S
And the children of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hetsron were, the firstborn, Ram, 𝄓 and Bunah and Aran and Otsem and Achiyah.
And there was another wife for Jerahmeel, and her name Atarah. 𝄓 She was the mother of Onam. S
And the children of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel [may God have a womb] were, 𝄓 Mets [From a tree] and Yamin [South] and Eqer [Barren].
And the children of Onam were Shammai and Yada, 𝄓 and the children of Shammai, Nadab and Abishur.
And the name of the wife of Abishur, Abihail, 𝄓 and she gave birth for him to Axban [kin to understanding] and Molid [boy].
And the children of Nadab, Seled and Appaim, 𝄓 but Seled [leap for joy] died without children.
And the children of Appaim, Yoshy [my salvation], 𝄓 and the children of Yoshy, Sheshan [lily], and the children of Sheshan, Ahlai [ah that].
And the children of Yada, the brother of Shammai, Yether and Yonathan, 𝄓 and Yether died without children. S
And the children of Yonathan, Peleth and Zaza. 𝄓 These are the children of Jerahmeel.
And Sheshan was without sons, but daughters. 𝄓 And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, and his name was Yarxa.
And Sheshan gave his daughter to Yarxa his servant as wife, 𝄓 and she gave birth for him to Attai [Timely].
And Attai had Nathan, and Nathan had Zebad.
And Zebad had Ephlal, and Ephlal had Obed.
And Obed had Jehu, and Jehu had Azariah.
And Azariah had Helets, and Helets had Elasah.
And Elasah had Sisamai, and Sisamai had Peace.
And Peace had Yequmyah [Yahweh raises], and Yequmyah had Elishama [My God has Heard]. S
And the children of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, Meisha his firstborn, (he is the father of Zif), 𝄓 and the children of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.
And the children of Hebron, 𝄓 Korah and Tappuah and Reqem and Shema.
And Shema had Raxam, the father of Yorkoam, 𝄓 and Reqem had Shammai.
And the child of Shammai was Maon, 𝄓 and Maon was the father of the house of Tyre.
And Eifah, courtesan of Caleb, gave birth to Xaran, and Motsa and Gazez, 𝄓 and Xaran had Gazez. S
And the children of Yahdai, 𝄓 Crowd and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Eifah and Shaaf.
The courtesan of Caleb, Makah, gave birth to Shattering and Tirxanah.
And she gave birth to Shaaf, the father of Madmanah, Vanity, the father of Makbenah, and the father of Gibea, 𝄓 and the daughter of Caleb was Akesah. S
These are the children of Caleb, child of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, 𝄓 Shobal the father of the town of Yearim.
Salma the father of Bethlehem [House of bread], Xarep the father of the House of Fence [Bayit-Geder].
And there were children of Shobal, the father of the town of Yearim, 𝄓 Haroeh, half of the Gifts.
And the families of the town of Yearim, the Yiterites the Puhites and the Shumatites and the Mishraites. 𝄓 From these emerged the Tsareatites and the Eshtaulites. S
The children of Salma, Bethlehem and the Netophatites, Crown of the house of Joab, 𝄓 and half the Gifts, the Tsorites.
And the families of secretaries who settled at Yabets, Tiratites, Shimeatites, Suktites. 𝄓 They are the Kenites to come from Hamath, the father of the house of Rider. S
And these are the children of David that were born to him in Hebron, 𝄓 the firstborn, Amnon of Axinoam the Jezreelite, second, Daniel of Abigail the Carmelite,
The third Absalom, child of Makah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur, 𝄓 the fourth Adonijah child of Haggit,
The fifth Shepatyah of Abital, 𝄓 the sixth Yitream of Eglah his wife.
Six born for him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months, 𝄓 and thirty three years, he reigned in Jerusalem. S
And these were born to him in Jerusalem, 𝄓 Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon, four of Bathshua [daughter crying for help], the daughter of Ammiel.
And Yibxar and Elishama and Eliphelet.
And Illumination and Nepheg and Yapya.
And Elishama and Elyada and Eliphelet, nine.
All the children of David, 𝄓 besides the children of courtesans, and Tamar their sister. P
And the son of Solomon, Rehoboam, 𝄓 Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son.
Joram his son, Achaziah his son, Joash his son.
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son.
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son.
Amon his son, Josiah his son.
And the children of Josiah, the firstborn Jochanan, 𝄓 the second Jehoiachim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
And the children of Jehoiachim, 𝄓 Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
And the children of Jeconiah, Assir, Shealtiel his son.
And Malkiram and Pedayah and Shenatsar, 𝄓 Yequmyah, Hoshama and Nebadyah.
And the children of Pedayah, Zerubbabel and Shimei, 𝄓 and the son of Zerubbabel, Meshullam, and Hananiah and Shelomit their sisters.
And Chashubah and Ohel and Berechiah and Chasidiah and Jushab Xesed, five.
And the son of Hananiah, Pelatiah, and Isaiah, 𝄓 the children of Rephayah, the children of Arnan, the children of Obadiah, the children of Shekanayah.
And the children of Shekanayah, Shemaiah, 𝄓 and the children of Shemaiah, Xatush and Yigael and Baryah and Nearyah and Shaphat, six.
And the son of Nearyah, Elyoeinai and Hezekiah and Azriqam, three. S
And the children of Elyoeinai, Hodaiyah and Elyashib and Pelayah and Aqub and Jochanan and Delaiah and Anani, seven. S
The children of Judah, 𝄓 Perez, Hetsron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
And Rayah, child of Shobal, had Jachat, and Jachat had Axumi and Laxad. 𝄓 These are the families of the Tsareatites. S
And these were the father of Eitam [Bird of Prey], Jezreel [God sows], Ishma [Wasteland] and Yidbash [Honey], 𝄓 and the name of their sister Hatselelponi [Facing the Shade].

And Penuel [Facing God] the father of Gdor [Fence], and Ezer [Help], the father of Hushah [Hurry]. 𝄓 These are the children of Hur [Hole], the firstborn of Ephratah [Fruitful], the father of Bethlehem.
And for Ashxur the father of Tekoa, there were two wives, 𝄓 Helah and Naarah.
And Naarah gave birth for him, Axuzam and Xefar and Temani and Haxashtari. 𝄓 These are the children of Naarah.
And the children of Helah, 𝄓 Tseret and Tsochar and Etnan.
And Brambles had Grapes and Tsobevah [Tortoise], 𝄓 and the families of Axarxel child of Harum.
And Yabets was more glorious than his kin, 𝄓 and his mother called his name Yabets, saying, For I have begotten in hardship.

And Yabets called to the God of Israel, saying, If blessing, you will bless me, and increase my borders, and your hand will be with me and you deal with evil lest it be hardship to me. 𝄓 And God brought what he asked. S
And Kelub the brother of Shuach had Price. 𝄓 He is the father of Eshton.
And Eshton had Healing-House, and Lame, and Army, the father of Snake-Cities. 𝄓 These are the men of Rekah. S
And the children of Qenaz, Othniel, and Saraiah, 𝄓 and the children of Othniel, Dismay.
And Meonothai [My Habitation] had Her-Dust, 𝄓 and Saraiah had Joab, the father of the gorge of the ploughers, for ploughers they were. P
And the children of Caleb, child of Jepunah, His-City, Rump, and Pleasure, 𝄓 and the children of Rump, ... and Qenaz.
And the children of Jehaleleel, 𝄓 Zif and Ziphah, Tyrya and Asrael.
And the child of Her-Help, Yether, and Mered, and Eifer, and Yalon, 𝄓 and she was big with Miriam, and Shammai, and Yishbax, the father of Eshtemoa.

And his cargo-bearer saw that Saul had died, 𝄓 and he also fell on the sword and he died. S

And this is the record of the valiant that David had: 𝄓 Yashavam child of Xakmuny, head of the adjutants, he unleashed his spear over three hundred profaned at one time.

He was with David at Fingertip of Blood where the Philistines gathered to battle, and there was a parcel of a field full of barley, 𝄓 and the people withdrew before the Philistines,
And they presented themselves in the midst of the parcel and delivered it, and struck the Philistines. 𝄓 And Yahweh saved with a great salvation.
And three from the thirty heads came down to the rock, to David, to the cave of Adullam, 𝄓 and the army of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of the titans.

And David intensely desired, and said, 𝄓 Who will give me a drink of water from a cistern of Bethlehem that is at the gate?

And the three split in two the camp of the Philistines, and they drew water from a cistern of Bethlehem that was at the gate, and they bore, and they came to David. 𝄓 But David did not consent to imbibe, and he spilled it out to Yahweh.

And David went up and all Israel to Baalah, to the town of Yearim that is of Judah, 𝄓 to bring up from there the ark of God, Yahweh sitting, the cherubim, where the name is called.

And David and all Israel gamboled before God in all strength, 𝄓 and with singing and with harps and with lutes and with timbrels and with cymbals and with trumpets.
And they came to the threshing-floor of Kidon, 𝄓 and Uzza extended his hand to hold fast the ark, for the oxen lurched.
And the anger of Yahweh burned against Uzza and he struck him in that he extended his hand to the ark. 𝄓 And he died there before God.
And burning was for David, for Yahweh breached the breach against Uzza. 𝄓 And that place is called the breach of Uzza to this day.
And David feared this God in that day, saying, 𝄓 How will I conduct to me the ark of God?
So David did not turn aside the ark to himself, to the city of David, 𝄓 but he swerved to the house of the servant of humanity [Obed-Edom] the Gittite.
And the ark of God settled with the house of the servant of humanity in his house three months, 𝄓 and Yahweh blessed the house of the servant of humanity and all that he had. S
And Hiram the king of Tyre sent messengers to David and cedar trees and artificers of sidewall and artificers of timber, 𝄓 to build for him a house.
And David knew that Yahweh had prepared him to be king over Israel, 𝄓 for his kingdom was lifted up to the ascendant on behalf of the people of Israel. S

When the Philistines heard that David was anointed as king over all Israel then all the Philistines came up to seek David. 𝄓 And David heard and came forth facing them.

And David went up at Baal of the breaches and struck them there, and David said, God breached my enemy by my hand as a breach of waters. 𝄓 Therefore they call the name of that place Baal of the breaches.

And David did as God had commanded, 𝄓 and struck the army of the Philistines from Gibeon and till Gezer.
And the name of David went forth in all the lands, 𝄓 and Yahweh put forth the dread of him over all the nations.

Asaph the head and second to him Zekariah, 𝄓 Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jechiel and Mattithiah and Eliab and Benaiah and Obed Edom and Jeiel with instruments, lutes and harps, and Asaph with cymbals, broadcast.

On that day then, David chanted as the beginning of thanksgiving to Yahweh, 𝄓 by the hand of Asaph and his kin. W
Give thanks to Yahweh. Call in his name. Make known among the peoples his prodigality. R
Sing to him. Sing a psalm to him. Ponder on all his wonders. R
Praise in the name of his holiness. The heart of those who seek Yahweh will be glad. R
Search out Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face continually. R
Remember his wonders that he did, his portents and the judgments of his mouth. R
O seed of Israel his servant, children of Jacob his chosen. R
He is Yahweh our God. In all the earth are his judgments. R
Remember forever his covenant, the word he commanded to a thousand generations, R
which he cut with Abraham, and his oath to Yitschaq. R
And stood by it to Jacob as a statute, for Israel a covenant ever. R
Saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, the pledge of your inheritance. R
When you were men counted as few, and guests in it. R
And they were meandering from nation to nation, from a kingdom to another people. R
He did not allow anyone to oppress them and he reproved kings over them. R
Do not touch my anointed and to my prophets do no evil. W
Sing to Yahweh all the earth. Publish from day to day his salvation.
Recount in the nations his glory, to all the peoples his wonders. R
For great is Yahweh and much to be praised, and to be feared he is, above all gods. R
For all the gods of the peoples are good for nothing, but Yahweh made the heavens. R
Splendour and honour are in his presence. Strength and cheer are in his place. R

Let all the earth be brought to birth from his presence. Indeed the world is established so it will not move. S
Let the heavens be glad and let the earth rejoice, and let them say in the nations, Yahweh reigns. S

Of the divisions of the gatekeepers, 𝄓 of the Korahites, Meshelemiah, child of Qore, from the children of Asaph.

Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulti the eighth, 𝄓 for God blessed him. S

The children of Shemaiah, Otni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, his kin, children of ability, 𝄓 Elihu, and Semakyah.
All these from the children of Obed-Edom, they and their children and their kin, each of ability in power for the service, 𝄓 sixty two of Obed-Edom.
And of Shelemiah, children and kin, children of ability, eighteen. S

Hilqiah the second, Tebalyah the third, Zachariah the fourth. 𝄓 All the children and the kin of Hosah, thirteen.

And they let the dice fall, whether the lesser or the greater, for the house of their ancestors, gate by gate. P
And the dice fell toward the sunrise for Shelemiah. 𝄓 And Zechariah, his child, a counselor with insight, they let the dice fall, and his lot went out northward.
Of Obed-Edom, southward, 𝄓 and for his children, the house of the gatherings.
To Shuppim and to Hosah, to the west, with the gate of Shalleket by the highway going up, 𝄓 guard set against guard. S

To Parbar westward, 𝄓 four at the highway, two to Parbar.
These from the divisions of the gatekeepers of the children of the Korahite, and of the children of Merari.
And the Levites, 𝄓 Achiyah over the treasuries the house of God, and for the treasuries of the holy things. S
The children of Laadan, the children of the Gershonite of Laadan, the heads of the ancestors of Laadan, the Gershonite, Yexieli. S
The children of Yexieli, 𝄓 Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasuries of the house of Yahweh. S
Of the Amramites, of the Yitsharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites,
And Shebuel, child of Gershom, child of Moses, was herald over the treasuries. S
And his kin through Eliezer, 𝄓 Rexabyah his child, and Isaiah his child, and Joram his child, and Zikri his child, and Shelomit his child.

From the battles, and from the spoil, they sanctified, 𝄓 to revamp the house of Yahweh.
And all that Samuel the seer sanctified, and Saul child of Kish, and Abner child of Ner, and Joab child of Tseruyah. 𝄓 All who sanctified, it was by the hand of Shelomit and his kin. P

Of the Hebronites, Xeshabyah and his kin, children of ability, a thousand seven hundred, over officers of Israel from beyond Jordan, from the westward, 𝄓 for every line of work of Yahweh, and in the service of the king.

Of the Hebronites, Yeriah was the head of the Hebronites for the successions of the ancestors. 𝄓 In the fortieth year of the reign of David, they were searched out, and was found in them valiant of force at Yezir of Gilead.

And his kin, the children of ability, two thousand seven hundred heads of the ancestors, 𝄓 and David the king made them officers to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and half the band of the Manassites, for any matter of God and the routine of the king. P

And the children of Israel, for their count, the heads of the ancestors, and the chiefs of thousands and of hundreds, and their overseers, ministered to the king for all matters of the divisions that came in and went out month by month for every month of the year. 𝄓 One division, twenty four thousand.
