From the children of Perez was the head for all the chiefs of the hosts of the first month. S
And over the division of the second month, Dodai the Axohite and his division, and Miqlot, the herald, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
Chief of the third host of the third month, Benaiah child of Jehoiada, the head priest, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand.
He is Benaiah the valiant, of the thirty, and over the thirty. 𝄓 And in his division was Ammizabad his son. S
The fourth of the fourth month, Asahel, brother of Joab, and Zebadiah, his son after him, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
The fifth of the fifth month, the chief, Shamhuth, the Yisraite, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
The sixth of the sixth month, Ira, child of Devious, the Tekoan, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
The seventh of the seventh month, Rescue the Pelonite, from the children of Ephraim, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
The eighth of the eighth month, Thicket the Xushty, of the Zerachites, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
The ninth of the ninth month, Abiezer, the Antothite of Benjamin, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
The tenth of the tenth month, Swiftie, the Netophatite of the Zerachites, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
The eleventh of the eleventh month, Benaiah the Pirathonite, from the children of Ephraim, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. S
The twelfth for the twelve month, Heldai the Netophatite of Othniel,, 𝄓 and over his division, twenty four thousand. P
And over the sceptres of Israel, for Reuben, herald, Eliezer child of Zikri, 𝄓 for the Simeonites, Shepatyah child of Makah, S
For Levi, Xeshabyah child of Qemuel, for Aaron, Zadok, S
For Judah, Elihu from the kin of David, 𝄓 for Issachar, Omri child of Michael, S
For Zebulun, Shemaiah child of Obadiah, 𝄓 for Naphtali, Yerimoth child of Azriel, S
For the children of Ephraim, Hoshea child of Azazyah, 𝄓 for the half band of Manasseh, Joel child of Pedayah, S
For the half of Manasseh toward Gilead, Ido child of Zachariah, 𝄓 for Benjamin, Asiel child of Abner, S
For Dan, Azarel child of Jeroham. 𝄓 These were the chiefs of the sceptres of Israel.
And David did not lift up their count from the children twenty years and downward, 𝄓 for Yahweh had said he would increase Israel as the stars of the heavens.
Joab child of Tseruyah started to fathom, but he did not finish, and there was rage in this over Israel. 𝄓 And the count does not come up in the record of the words of the days of king David. S
And over the treasuries of the king, Azmaveth child of Adiel, 𝄓 and over the treasuries in the field, in the cities, and in the coverings, and in the towers, Jonathan child of Uzziah, S
And over those who did the lines of work for the field for the service of the ground, 𝄓 Ezry child of Caleb, S
And over the vineyards, Shimei the Ramatite, 𝄓 and over the vineyards for the treasuries of the wine, Zavdi the Shifmite, S
And over the olive trees and the sycamore that were in the lowly place, Baal-Chanan the Gederite, 𝄓 and over the treasuries of oil, Yoash, S
And over the oxen that grazed in the plain, Shirti the Sharonite, 𝄓 and over the oxen in the valleys, Shaphat child of Adli, S
And over the camels, Obil the Ishmaelite, 𝄓 and over the donkeys, Yexediah the Meronotite, S
And over the flock, Yaziz the Hagarite. 𝄓 All these were the chiefs of the property that had belonged to the king David. S
And Jonathan the uncle of David was a counselor, a man of discernment, and he was a scribe, 𝄓 and Jechiel child of Xakmuny, was with the children of the king. S
And Axitophel was counselor to the king, 𝄓 and Xushi the Arkite, a friend of the king. S
And after Axitophel, Jehoiada child of Benaiah, and Abiatar. And the chief of the host of the king was Joab. P

And David convened all the chiefs of Israel, the chiefs of the bands, and the chiefs of the divisions ministering to the king, and the chiefs of thousands, and the chiefs of hundreds, and the chiefs of all the property and acquisitions for the king and for his children, with the eunuchs and the valiant, and for all of valour and ability, to Jerusalem.

And David the king arose to his feet and said, Hear me my kin and my people. 𝄓 I am with my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, and the footstool of our God, and I have prepared for the building.
But God said to me, You will not build a house for my name, 𝄓 for a man of war are you, and blood you have shed.

But Yahweh the God of Israel chose in me from all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For Judah he has chosen as herald, and in the house of Judah, the house of my father, 𝄓 and among the children of my father, in me he found favour to make me king over all Israel.
And from all my sons, (for many sons Yahweh has given me), 𝄓 he chose Solomon, my son, to sit on the throne of the kingdom of Yahweh over Israel.
And he said to me, Solomon your son, he, he will build my house and my courts, 𝄓 for I have chosen in him, my son, and I, I will be to him a father.
And I will establish his kingdom endlessly, forever, 𝄓 if he is resolute to do my commandments and my judgments as on this day.

And now in the sight of all Israel, the congregation of Yahweh, and in the ears of our God, keep and search out all the commandment of Yahweh your God, 𝄓 for the sake of those who will possess the good land, and your inheritance for your children after you, for evermore.

And you Solomon, my son, know the God of your ancestors and serve him with a whole heart and with integrity of delight. For Yahweh is searching every heart, and discerning all the fashioning of devices. 𝄓 If you search him out, he will be found of you, but if you forsake him, he will reject you for ever.
See now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be encouraged and take action. P
And David gave Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and its houses, and its depositories, and its upper rooms, and its inner rooms, the facings and the house of the ark-cover.

And the pattern of all that was by the spirit with him for the courts of the house of Yahweh, and for all the chambers round about, 𝄓 for the treasuries of the house of God, and for the treasuries of the holy things.
And for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, and for all the lines of work of the service of the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 and for all the vessels of the service of the house of Yahweh.
Of gold by weight for gold for all instruments of one service or another, 𝄓 for all the instruments of silver by weight for all instruments of one service or another.

And the weight for the lamp stands of gold and their lamps of gold by weight, lamp stand by lamp stand and its lamps, 𝄓 and for the lamp stands of silver by weight, for the lamp stands and its lamps, according to services, lamp stand by lamp stand.
And the gold by weight for the tables of the arrangement, table by table, 𝄓 and silver for the tables of silver.
And the forks, and the bowls, and the chalices of lustrous gold, 𝄓 and for the covers of gold by weight, cover by cover, and for the covers of silver by weight, cover by cover.
And for the altar of incense, gold purged by weight, 𝄓 and for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubim, gold for the spreading that screens over the ark of the covenant of Yahweh.
The whole in writing from the hand of Yahweh upon me gave insight, 𝄓 all the lines of work of the patterns. P

And David said to Solomon his son, Be encouraged and be assured and take action. Do not fear and do not be in disarray. 𝄓 For Yahweh God, my God is with you. He does not desist for you and will not forsake you until the consummation of all the lines of work of the service of the house of Yahweh.

And behold, the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of the house of God, 𝄓 and with you in all lines of work, will be everyone willing in wisdom for any service, and the chiefs and all the people for all your matters. S

And David the king said to all the congregation, Solomon my son, the one whom God has chosen, is a youth and is tender, 𝄓 and the line of work is great, because not for a human are the temple precincts, but for Yahweh God.

And with all my power I have prepared for the house of my God, gold for gold, and silver for silver, and brass for brass, iron for iron, and the wood for wood, 𝄓 onyx stones and stones to be inlaid, antimony, and embroidery, and all precious stone and alabaster stones in abundance.

And further, in my acceptance in the house of my God, I have my own treasure trove of gold and silver, 𝄓 that I have given for the house of my God over and above from all I have prepared for the house of the sanctuary.
Three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, 𝄓 and seven thousand talents of purged silver, to plaster the sidewalls of the houses.
Of gold for gold, and of silver for silver, and for all lines of work by the hand of artificers, 𝄓 and whoever is willing to fill his hand. Today is for Yahweh.
And the chiefs of the fathers, and the chiefs of the sceptres of Israel, and the chiefs of thousands and of hundreds, and the chiefs of the lines of work willingly offered for the king.

And they gave for the service of the house of God, gold talents, five thousand, and darics, ten thousand, and silver talents, ten thousand, and brass, eighteen thousand talents, 𝄓 and iron, a hundred thousand talents.
And they with whom were found stones, they gave for the treasury of the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 by the hand of Yexiel the Gershonite.
And the people were glad over their willing offering, for with a whole heart they made a freewill offering for Yahweh, 𝄓 and even David the king was glad. It was great gladness. P
And David blessed Yahweh in the sight of all the congregation, 𝄓 and David said, Blessed are you, Yahweh, the God of Israel our father, from everlasting and unto everlasting.

Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness and the valour, and the adornment, and the leadership, and the splendour, for all in the heavens and on the earth. 𝄓 Yours, Yahweh, is the kingdom, and you are lifted up to all as head.
Both riches and glory are from your presence, and you govern in all, and in your hand is power and valour, 𝄓 and in your hand, to make great and to encourage for all.
And now, our God, we are thankful to you, 𝄓 and give praises to the name of your adornment.
But who am I and what is my people, that contained of power, we willingly offer such as this? 𝄓 For from you is the whole, and from your hand we give to you.
For guests we are before you, and immigrants as were all our ancestors. 𝄓 Like a shadow are our days over the earth, and there is no expectation.
Yahweh our God, all this tumult that we have prepared to build for yourself a house to your holy name, 𝄓 from your hand it is, and of you is the whole.

And I know, my God, because you test a heart, and uprightness you will accept. 𝄓 I, in the uprightness of my heart, have willingly offered all these, and now your people who are found here, I have seen with gladness, to offer willingly to you.
Yahweh, the God of Abraham, Yitschaq, and Israel, our ancestors, keep this forever for the fashioning of the devices of the heart of your people, 𝄓 and prepare their heart for you.
And to Solomon my son, give a heart of peace to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, 𝄓 and to do it all, and to build the temple precincts that I have prepared. P

And David said to all the congregation, Bless, please, Yahweh your God. 𝄓 And all the congregation blessed Yahweh the God of their ancestors. They bowed their head and they worshiped Yahweh and the king.

And they sacrificed to Yahweh, sacrifices, and offered up burnt offerings to Yahweh, in the dawn of that day, young bulls, a thousand, rams, a thousand, young lambs, a thousand, and their libations, 𝄓 and offerings in abundance for all Israel.

And they ate and they imbibed in the presence of Yahweh in that day with great gladness. 𝄓 And they made Solomon child of David king a second time, and they anointed for Yahweh as herald, and for Zadok as the priest.
And Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king instead of David, his father, and prospered. 𝄓 And all Israel heeded him.
And all the nobility, and the valiant, and even all the children of the king David, 𝄓 gave a hand under Solomon, the king.
And Yahweh magnified Solomon to the ascendant in the sight of all Israel, 𝄓 and he assigned to him royal splendour that there had not been over any king before him in Israel. P
And David the son of Jesse was king over all Israel.
And the many days that he reigned over Israel was a forty year span. 𝄓 In Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty three.
And he died with good grey hair, satisfaction of days, riches and glory, 𝄓 and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
And the words of David the king, the first and the last, 𝄓 behold they are written in the words of Samuel the seer, and in the words of Nathan the prophet, and in the words of Gad the visionary,
With all his kingdom and his valour, 𝄓 and the times that passed through against him, and against Israel, and against all the kingdoms of the lands. P
And Solomon child of David was resolved concerning his kingdom, 𝄓 and Yahweh his God was with him and made him to be greatly ascendant.
And Solomon talked to all Israel, to the chiefs of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges and to every principal for all Israel, the heads of the ancestors.

And they went, Solomon and all the congregation with him, to the high place that was in Gibeon, 𝄓 for there was the tent of engagement of God which Moses the servant of Yahweh had made in the wilderness.
Lamentably the ark of God, David had brought up from Qiryath-Yearim into David's base for it, 𝄓 for he had stretched out for it a tent in Jerusalem.
And the brass altar that Betsalel, child of My Light, child of Hur had made, he set up before the dwelling-place of Yahweh, 𝄓 and Solomon and the congregation searched out for it.
And Solomon offered up there on the altar of brass in the presence of Yahweh that was at the tent of engagement, 𝄓 and he offered up on it a thousand burnt offerings.
In that night God appeared to Solomon, 𝄓 and said to him, Ask what I will give you.
And Solomon said to God, You yourself have done with David my father great kindness, 𝄓 and have made me reign in his stead.
Now Yahweh, God, let your word with David my father be verified, 𝄓 because you have made me reign over a people abundant like the dust of the earth.
Now wisdom and knowledge give me, that I may go out before this people and come in, 𝄓 for who will judge this your great people. S

And God said to Solomon, In that this was with your heart, and you did not ask for riches, material wealth, and glory, nor the throat of those hating you, and even for many days, you did not ask, 𝄓 but you asked for yourself, wisdom and knowledge, that you may judge my people over whom I have made you king.

The wisdom and the knowledge is given to you, 𝄓 and riches and material wealth and glory I will give you, such that there was not for kings who were before you, and after you neither will there be such.
So came Solomon to the high place that was in Gibeon, Jerusalem ... from before the tent of engagement, 𝄓 and reigned over Israel. P
And Solomon gathered chariot and cavaliers, and he had a thousand four hundred of chariot and twelve thousand cavalry, 𝄓 and he left them in the cities of the chariot and with the king in Jerusalem.
And the king gave the silver and the gold in Jerusalem like stones, 𝄓 and cedar he gave like sycamores, that are abundant in the lowly place.
And the horses brought out that were Solomon's were from Egypt, 𝄓 and from Que. The wares of the king from Que they took at a price.

And they brought up, and they brought out from Egypt, chariot at six hundred of silver, and horse at one hundred and fifty, 𝄓 and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of Aram, by their means, they brought out.
And Solomon made a pronouncement to build a house to the name of Yahweh, and a house for his kingdom.
And Solomon counted seventy thousand men to bear burdens, and eighty thousand men to hew in the hill, 𝄓 and the leaders over them were three thousand six hundred. P
And Solomon sent to Hiram the king of Tyre, saying, 𝄓 As you have done with David my father, and sent him cedar to build for him a house to settle in,

Behold I am building a house to the name of Yahweh my God, to sanctify for him, to burn incense in his presence, incense of sweet spices, and arrangement continually, and for the burnt offerings in the morning and in the evening, on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and for the appointed times of Yahweh our God, 𝄓 this forever over Israel.
And the house that I am building is great, 𝄓 for greater is our God than all gods.

But who contains the power to build for him a house when the heavens and the heaven of the heavens is not able to nourish him? 𝄓 And who am I that I should build for him a house, except to burn incense in his presence?

So now send me a wise man, to undertake in gold and in silver and in brass and in iron, and in purple and cinnabar and amethyst, and the knowledge to carve carvings, 𝄓 with the wise that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem that David my father had prepared.
And send me cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees from Lebanon, for I know myself that your servants know how to cut the trees of Lebanon. 𝄓 And behold, my servants will be with your servants,
To prepare for me trees in abundance, 𝄓 for the house that I am building is great and extraordinary.

And behold to the dressers, to the cutters of the timber, I will give to your servants, milled wheat, twenty thousand cor and barley, twenty thousand cor, 𝄓 and wine, twenty thousand baths and oil, twenty thousand baths. S
And Hiram the king of Tyre said in writing that he sent to Solomon, 𝄓 In the love of Yahweh of his people, he has given you over them as king.

And Hiram said, Blessed is Yahweh the God of Israel who has made the heavens and the earth, 𝄓 who has given to David the king, a wise child who knows insight and discernment, who would build a house for Yahweh and a house for his kingdom.
So now I have sent a wise person who knows discernment, of Xuram my father.

A child of a woman from the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, who knows how to undertake in gold and in silver, in brass, in iron, with stones and with timber, in purple, in amethyst, and in sea silk, and in cinnabar, and in carving all carving, and to devise any device, 𝄓 that is given to him, with your wise, with the wise of my lord David your father.
So now the wheat and the barley, the oil and the wine that my Lord had promised, let him send to his servant.
And we will cut trees from Lebanon according to all you need, and we will bring them to you by float over the sea to Joppa, 𝄓 and you will bring them up to Jerusalem. P
And Solomon counted the persons, guests that were in the land of Israel, after the count that David his father counted, 𝄓 and they found a hundred and fifty three thousand six hundred.
And he made seventy thousand of them to bear burdens and eighty thousand to hew in the hill, 𝄓 and three thousand six hundred leaders to make the people serve.

And Solomon started building the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem on the hill Moriah, that of the appearance to David his father, 𝄓 which David had prepared in the place at the threshing-floor of I Shout With Joy the Jebusite.
And he started building on the second of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.
And these are to be the foundation of Solomon's building the house of God, 𝄓 the length (by measure of the former cubits), sixty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits.
And the porch that was before the length, before the breadth, of the house, twenty cubits, and the loft a hundred and twenty, 𝄓 and he overlaid it, its faces, with lustrous gold.
And the greater house he canopied with the wood of fir trees and he laminated the canopy in fine gold, 𝄓 and he brought up upon it palm trees and links.
And he overlaid the house with precious stone for adornment, 𝄓 and the gold was gold of the orient.
And he laminated the house, the rafters, the doorway, and its sidewalls, and its gateways with gold, 𝄓 and he carved cherubim on the house walls. S

And he constructed the house of the Holy of Holies, its length in the face of the breadth of the house, twenty cubits and its breadth, twenty cubits, 𝄓 and he laminated it with fine gold, for six hundred talents.
And the weight of the nails, fifty gold shekels. 𝄓 And the upper rooms he laminated with gold.
And he made in the house of the Holy of Holies the two cherubim, an undertaking of statuary, 𝄓 and overlaid them with gold.
And the wings of the cherubim, their lengths twenty cubits, 𝄓 the one wing of five cubits touched the sidewall of the house, and the other wing, five cubits, touched the wing of the other cherub.
And the wing of the other cherub, five cubits, touched the sidewall of the house, 𝄓 and the other wing, five cubits, clung to the wing of the other cherub.
The wings of these cherubim spread twenty cubits, 𝄓 and they were standing on their feet and their faces to the house. S
And he made the veil, amethyst and purple and cinnabar and sea silk, 𝄓 and he made cherubim ascend on it. S
And he made before the house two pillars thirty five cubits in length, 𝄓 and the lookout that was on its top, five cubits. S
And he made links in the word-place that he positioned over the tops of the pillars, 𝄓 and he made a hundred pomegranates that he positioned in the links.

And he raised up the pillars before the temple, one on the right and the other on the left, 𝄓 and he called the name of the right, he will establish [Yakin], and the name of the left Boaz [quickness?]. S
And he made the altar of brass, twenty cubits its length and twenty cubits its breadth, 𝄓 and ten cubits its height. S
And he made the molded sea, 𝄓 ten cubits from brim to its brim the diameter of the circle, and five cubits its height and a line of thirty cubits surrounded it all around.
And the likeness of oxen was under it, round and round about surrounding it, ten per cubit, encompassing the sea round about. 𝄓 Two rows of oxen were molded when it was molded.

It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, and three facing seaward, and three facing southward, and three facing toward the sunrise, and the sea was over them from above it, 𝄓 and all their hindquarters toward the inside.
And its thickness was a hand-breadth, and its brim like the making of the brim of a cup flourishing with lily, 𝄓 resolutely abiding three thousand baths. S

And he made ten lavers and positioned five on the right and five on the left, to wash in them. What was used to do the burnt offering they rinse in them, 𝄓 and the sea is for the priests to wash in. S
And he made the ten lamps of gold according to their judgment, 𝄓 and positioned in the temple five, on the right and five on the left. S
And he made ten tables that he left in the temple, five on the right and five on the left, 𝄓 and he made bowls of gold, a hundred. S
And he made the court of the priests and the great ledge, 𝄓 and gateways to the ledge, and their portals he overlaid with brass.
And the sea, he positioned on the shoulder of the right eastward, the forefront southward.
And Xuram made the pots and the shovels and the bowls, 𝄓 and Xuram finished the undertaking of the lines of work which he had done for king Solomon in the house of God.
Pillars two, and the globes and the diadems on the top of the pillars, two, 𝄓 and the wreaths, two, to cover the two globes of the diadems that were on the top of the pillars.
And the pomegranates, four hundred for the two wreaths, 𝄓 two rows of pomegranates for each single wreath to cover the two globes of the diadems that were on the faces of the pillars.
And the bases he made, 𝄓 and the lavers he made on the base.
The sea, one, 𝄓 and the oxen, twelve, under it.
And the pots and the shovels and the forks and all their vessels made by Xuram his father for king Solomon for the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 furbished of brass.
In the basin of the Jordan the king molded them on the thick cloudy ground, 𝄓 between Sukkoth and Tsereda.
And Solomon made all these vessels in much abundance, 𝄓 that an appraisal of the brass could not be examined. S
And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, 𝄓 and the altar of gold, and the tables on which was the bread of the presence.
And the lamp stands, and the lamps, to kindle according to the framework, before the word-place, gold of a gold bar.
And the flourishes, and the lamps, and the tongs, gold. 𝄓 This is consummate gold.

And the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and the censers, gold of a gold bar, 𝄓 and the door of the house, the portals of the presence of the Holy of Holies, and the gateways of the house for the temple, gold.

And all the lines of work were whole which Solomon had constructed for the house of Yahweh. 𝄓 And Solomon brought the holy things of David his father, and the silver and the gold and all the vessels, he gave into the treasuries of the house of God. P

Then Solomon convened the elders of Israel and all the preeminent of branches, the principals of the ancestors of the children of Israel to Jerusalem, 𝄓 to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh from the city of David. This is Zion.
And everyone of Israel congregated to the king in the festival. 𝄓 This is the seventh new moon.
And all the elders of Israel came, 𝄓 and the Levites were bearing the ark.
And they brought up the ark and the tent of engagement and all the vessels of the sanctuary that were in the tent. 𝄓 The priests, the Levites, brought them up.
Then the king Solomon, and all the assembly of Israel engaged with him before the ark, 𝄓 offering sheep and oxen that were uncounted and unfathomable for abundance.
And the priests brought the ark of the covenant of Yahweh to its place, to the word-place of the house, to the Holy of Holies, 𝄓 under the wings of the cherubim.
And there are the cherubim spreading their two wings over the place of the ark, 𝄓 and the cherubim covered the ark and its shafts from above.
And they retracted the shafts and the tops of the shafts could be seen from above the ark facing the word-place, but they were not seen outside. 𝄓 And it is there until this day.
There was nothing in the ark but the two tablets that Moses yielded in Horeb, 𝄓 which Yahweh cut with the children of Israel at their going out from Egypt. P
And it happened when the priests came out from the sanctuary. 𝄓 (For all the priests that were found were sanctified. There was nothing to keep the divisions.)

And the Levites, the singers, to all of them, of Asaph, of Heyman, of Jeduthun, and of their children, and of their kin, in their clothing of sea silk, with cymbals, and with lutes and harps, were standing from the sunrise to the altar, 𝄓 and with them were priests, a hundred and twenty trumpeting with the trumpets.

And it was as one for the trumpeters and for the singers to be heard, one voice to praise and to give thanks to Yahweh. And as they lifted voice high with the trumpets and with the cymbals and instruments, the song and the praise to Yahweh, "for it is good for forever is his kindness", 𝄓 so the house filled with cloud, the house of Yahweh.
And the priests were not able to stand to minister from the presence of the cloud, 𝄓 for the glory of Yahweh filled the house of God. P
Then Solomon said, 𝄓 Yahweh is said to dwell in dark turbulence.
And I, I have built a house of residence for you, 𝄓 and an establishment as your seat everlastingly.
And the king turned around, faced, and blessed all the congregation of Israel. 𝄓 And all the congregation of Israel were standing.
And he said, Blessed is Yahweh the God of Israel who spoke with his mouth to David my father, 𝄓 and with his hands filled, said:

From that day when I brought my people out from the land of Egypt, I did not chose in a city from all the sceptres of Israel to build a house to be My Name Is There, 𝄓 and I did not chose in anyone, to be heralded over my people Israel.
But I chose in Jerusalem for my name to be there, 𝄓 and I chose in David to be over my people Israel.
And it was with the heart of David my father, 𝄓 to build a house to the name of Yahweh the God of Israel.
And Yahweh said to David my father, In that it was with your heart to build a house for my name, 𝄓 you did well that it was with your heart.
But you, you will not build the house, 𝄓 for your son, the one who comes forth from your genus, he, he will build the house for my name.
And Yahweh placed his word that he spoke. 𝄓 And I am placed under David my father and sit on the throne of Israel, as Yahweh spoke and I have built the house to the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
And I have set there the ark, where there is the covenant of Yahweh, 𝄓 which he cut with the children of Israel.
And he stood before the altar of Yahweh in front of all the congregation of Israel, 𝄓 and spread his palms.

For Solomon had made a brass scaffold and consigned it to the midst as a help, five cubits its length, five cubits its breadth, three cubits its height, 𝄓 and he stood on it and he knelt on his knees in front of all the congregation of Israel and spread his palms heavenward. P

And he said, Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is none like you, O God, in the heavens or on the earth, 𝄓 keeping the covenant and the kindness for your servants who walk before you with all their heart,
who kept for your servant, David, my father what you spoke to him, 𝄓 and you speak with your mouth, and with your hand you fulfill as on this day.

And now Yahweh, the God of Israel, keep for your servant, David, my father what you spoke to him, saying, There will not be cut off for you, a man from my presence to sit on the throne of Israel, 𝄓 solely if your children will keep their way to walk in my instruction as you have walked in my presence.
And now, Yahweh, the God of Israel, 𝄓 let your word be verified that you spoke for your servant, for David.
For is it in verity, God sits with humanity on the earth? 𝄓 Behold, heaven and the heaven of the heavens do not abide you. How much less this house which I have built.
And face the prayer of your servant and his supplication, Yahweh, my God, 𝄓 to hear the joyful cry and the prayer that your servant prays to your face,
to let your eyes be open to this house day and night, to the place where you promised to put your name there, 𝄓 to hear the prayer that your servant will pray to this place.
Then hear the supplication of your servant and your people Israel who pray to this place, 𝄓 and you, you hear from the place of your seat, from the heavens. Then hear and forgive.
If anyone sins against his associate and claims censure against him that causes him to be censured, 𝄓 and censure comes before your altar in this house,

then you, you hear from the heavens, and do, and judge your servants to make return to one who is wicked, to permit his way on his head, 𝄓 and to justify a righteous one to permit for him according to his righteousness. S
And if your people Israel are plagued facing an enemy for they sin against you, 𝄓 then let them return and give thanks to your name, and have them pray and supplicate in your presence in this house,
then you, you hear from the heavens, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, 𝄓 and have them returned to the ground that you gave for them and for their ancestors. P
When the heavens are contained and there is no rain for they sin against you, 𝄓 and they pray to this place and give thanks to your name, from their sin they turn, for you afflict them,

then you, you hear, the heavens, and forgive the sin of your servants and your people Israel, that you instruct them in the good way which they should walk in, 𝄓 and you give rain on your land that you gave to your people for an inheritance. S

Famine. For there may be in the earth pestilence, for there may be blight and mildew, locust and caterpillar, for there may be. For his enemies give him trouble in the land of his gates, 𝄓 all contagion and all illness.
all prayer, all supplication, that will be, to all humanity and to all your people Israel, 𝄓 anyone who knows their contagion and from sorrow, and spreads his palms to this house.

then you, you hear, from the heavens, the base of your seat, and forgive, and you give to each according to all his ways, 𝄓 whose heart you do know. For you, you know, you only, the heart of the children of the human.
So that they will fear you, to walk in your ways all the days that they live over the face of the ground, 𝄓 that you gave to our ancestors. S

And even to the foreigner who is not of your people Israel such a one, and he comes from a land far off for the sake of your great name, and your courageous hand and your stretched out arm, 𝄓 and they come and they pray to this house.

And you, you hear from the heavens, from the base of your seat, and do everything the foreigner calls to you, 𝄓 so that they will know, all the peoples of the earth, your name and fear you, as your people Israel, and to know that your name is called over this house which I have built.
For your people go forth to war against its enemies in the way that you send them, 𝄓 and they pray to you via this city, in her which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name,
then hear from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, 𝄓 and do their judgment.

For they sin against you (for there is no human who does not sin) and you are angry with them and you give them into the presence of an enemy, 𝄓 and captive, they carry them away to a land far off or near.

And they are turned in their heart in the land where they are captive, 𝄓 and they turn and supplicate to you in the land of their captives and say, We have sinned. We have been perverse and we are wicked.

Then let them return to you with all their heart and with all their integrity in the land of their captives who led them away captive, 𝄓 and pray via their land that you have given to their ancestors and the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name.
Then hear from the heavens, from your established seat their prayer and their supplications and do their judgment, 𝄓 and forgive your people who have sinned against you.
Now my God, let, please, your eyes be open and your ears pay attention, 𝄓 to the prayer of this place. S
And now, arise, Yahweh God, to your rest, you and the ark of your strength. 𝄓 Your priests, Yahweh God, let them be clothed in salvation and those under your mercy make glad with goodness.
Yahweh God, do not turn away the presence of your anointed. 𝄓 Remember the mercies of David your servant. P
And as Solomon finished praying, the fire descended from the heavens and it devoured the burnt offering and the sacrifices, 𝄓 and the glory of Yahweh filled the house.
And the priests were not able to enter into the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 for the glory of Yahweh filled the house of Yahweh.

And all the children of Israel saw when the fire descended and the glory of Yahweh was upon the house. 𝄓 And they bowed down their noses earthward upon the pavement and worshiped and gave thanks to Yahweh, for it is good. For his kindness is forever.
Then the king and all the people, 𝄓 offered an offering in the presence of Yahweh. S
And king Solomon offered the offering of oxen: twenty two thousand and sheep: a hundred and twenty thousand. 𝄓 And the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

And the priests over their watches were standing, and the Levites with the instruments of the song of Yahweh that David the king had made to give thanks to Yahweh, for his kindness is forever, when David praised by their hand. 𝄓 And the priests from the courts announcing, and all Israel stood. S

And Solomon sanctified the centre of the court that is before the house of Yahweh, for he had done there the burnt offerings and the gross fat of the peace offerings, 𝄓 for the altar of brass that Solomon had made could not abide the burnt offering and the gift and the gross fat.
And Solomon made festivities at that time, seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, 𝄓 from the entrance of Hamath to the wadi of Egypt.
And they made on the eighth day a conclave. 𝄓 For the dedication of the altar, they undertook seven days, and the festivity, seven days.

And on the twenty third day of the seventh month he dismissed the people to their tents, 𝄓 glad and of a good heart over the good that Yahweh had done for David and for Solomon and for Israel with him.
And Solomon finished the house of Yahweh and the house of the king. 𝄓 And in all that came to the heart of Solomon to undertake in the house of Yahweh and in his own house, he prospered. P
And Yahweh appeared to Solomon in the night, 𝄓 saying to him, I have heard your prayer and I have chosen in this place for myself for the house of offering.
Lo, I contain the heavens and there is no rain and lo, I will command over grasshopper to eat the earth, 𝄓 and if I send pestilence onto my people,

and my people, who are called My name is over them, are brought to heel and they pray and they seek my presence and they turn from their evil ways, 𝄓 then I, I will hear from the heavens and I will forgive their sin and I will heal their land.
Now my eyes will be open and my ears will pay attention, 𝄓 to the prayer of this place.
And now I have chosen and sanctified this house to let my name be there for evermore, 𝄓 and my eyes and my heart will be there every day.
And you, if you will walk in my presence as David your father walked and do everything I commanded you, 𝄓 and my statutes and my judgments you keep,
then I will place the throne of your kingdom, 𝄓 as I cut for David, your father, saying, There will not be cut off for you a man governing in Israel.
But if you turn away and you discard my statutes or my commandments that I gave in your presence, 𝄓 and you go and serve other gods and prostrate yourselves to them,

then I will deport them from off my ground that I gave for them and this house which I have sanctified for my name I will cast down from my presence. 𝄓 And I will consign them as a parable and a gibe among all the peoples.
And this house that is of the Most High, to all who traverse by it, it will be a desolation. 𝄓 And they will say, Why did Yahweh do thus to this land and to this house?

And they will say, For they have forsaken Yahweh the God of their ancestors who brought them out from the land of Egypt and they have encouraged other gods and prostrated themselves to them and served them. 𝄓 So all this evil has come upon them. P
And it happened at the end of twenty years that Solomon had built the house of Yahweh and his house.
The cities that Hiram gave to Solomon, Solomon had them built, 𝄓 and he had the children of Israel settle there.
And Solomon went to Hamath-Zobah and was resolute over it.
And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, 𝄓 and all the cities of storerooms that he built in Hamath.
And he built BethHoron the upper part, and BethHoron the lower part, 𝄓 cities fortified with ramparts gateways and bars,

And Baalat and all the cities of storerooms that are of Solomon, and all the cities of the chariots, and the cities of the cavalry, 𝄓 and all the commitment of Solomon that he was committed to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his governance.
All the people remaining from the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, who are not from Israel, they,
from their children who remained after them in the land that the children of Israel did not consume, 𝄓 Solomon brought them up into forced service to this day.

But from the children of Israel whom Solomon did not assign as servants for his affairs, 𝄓 for they are men from battle, and his nobility his adjutants, and the chiefs of his chariot, and his cavaliers. P
And these were the chiefs of the monitors that were of king Solomon, two hundred and fifty, 𝄓 the rulers among the people.

And the daughter of Pharaoh, Solomon brought up from the city of David to the house that was built for her, 𝄓 for he said, My wife will not settle in the house of David king of Israel, for they are holy, those to which came the ark of Yahweh. P
Then Solomon offered up burnt offerings to Yahweh, 𝄓 upon the altar of Yahweh that he had built before the porch,

so, in a word, day by day, to offer up according to the commandment of Moses, on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and for the appointed times, three times in the year, 𝄓 in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

And he installed, according to the framework of David his father, the divisions of the priests per their service, and the Levites per their watches, to praise, and to minister before the priests for the word, day by day, and the gatekeepers in their divisions, gate by gate, 𝄓 for so had commanded David the man of God.
And they did not put aside the commandments of the king, the priests and the Levites, for any matter, or for the treasuries.
And all the lines of work for Solomon were established until the day of the foundation of the house of Yahweh, and until it was finished. 𝄓 The house of Yahweh was made whole. S
Then Solomon went to Etsion-geber and to Hart [Eiloth] by the bank of the sea in the land of Edom.

And Hiram sent him by the hand of his servants, ships, and servants with knowledge of the sea, and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir and took from there four hundred and fifty talents of gold, 𝄓 and they came to king Solomon. P

And the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, and she went to prove Solomon with riddles in Jerusalem, with excessively glorious wealth, and camels bearing spices, and gold abundant, and precious stone. 𝄓 And she went to Solomon and spoke with him all that was with her heart.
And Solomon made clear for her all her words, 𝄓 and no word was obscured from Solomon that he did not make clear for her.
And the queen of Sheba saw the shrewdness of Solomon, 𝄓 and the house that he had built.

And the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the standing of his ministers and their raiment, and his cupbearers and their raiment, and his ascent which he went up to by the House of Yahweh, 𝄓 and there was in her no more wind.
And she said to the king, It was the truth of the matter that I had heard in my land, 𝄓 about your words and your shrewdness.
And I had not believed their words until I came and my eyes had seen, and behold the half of the excess of your shrewdness was not told me. 𝄓 You have added again over the report that I had heard.
Happy your soldiers, and happy these your servants, 𝄓 those standing in your presence continually, and those hearing your wisdom.

Let Yahweh your God be blessed that he delighted in you to give you his throne as king for Yahweh your God, 𝄓 in the love of your God to make Israel stand forever, and to give you over them as king to do judgment and righteousness.

And she gave to the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and spices in excessive abundance, and precious stone, 𝄓 and there is not a spice such as this that the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
And even the servants of Xuram and the servants of Solomon that brought gold from Ophir, 𝄓 brought wood of algum trees and precious stone.

And the king made the wood of the algum trees floorboards for the house of Yahweh, and the house of the king, and harps and lutes for the singers, 𝄓 and none had been seen like them before in the land of Judah.
Then the king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her delight that she asked, besides what she had brought to the king, 𝄓 and she changed and went to her land, she and her servants. P
And the weight of the gold that came to Solomon in the first year was, 𝄓 six hundred and sixty six talents of gold,
Besides what salespersons and vendors brought. 𝄓 And all the kings of Arabia and the viceroys of the earth brought gold and silver to Solomon.
And the king Solomon made two hundred receptacles of malleable gold. 𝄓 Six hundred of malleable gold went up over the one receptacle.
And three hundred shields of malleable gold, (three hundred of gold went up on the one shield), 𝄓 and the king assigned them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
And the king made a great throne of ivory, 𝄓 and he overlaid it with lustrous gold.
And six stairs to the throne, and a hassock in gold for the throne, held fast, and protections from this and from that by the place of the seat, 𝄓 and two lions standing next to the protections.
And twelve lions standing there on the six stairs from this and from that. 𝄓 Such had not been made for any kingdom.

And all the drinking vessels for the king Solomon, gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon, gold, of a gold bar. 𝄓 Silver was not to be reckoned in the days of Solomon for anything much.
For the ships of the king went to Tarshish with the servants of Xuram. 𝄓 Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bearing gold and silver, ivory tusks, apes and baboons. P
And king Solomon became greater than all the kings of the earth, 𝄓 in riches and shrewdness.
And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, 𝄓 to hear his shrewdness that God gave in his heart.
And they brought each their gifts, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and apparel, equipment, and spices, horses, and mules, 𝄓 a routine year in year out. S
And Solomon had four thousand corrals for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand cavalry, 𝄓 and he left them in the cities of the chariot, and with the king in Jerusalem.
And he had governance with all the kings, 𝄓 from the river and to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
And the king gave the silver in Jerusalem like stones, 𝄓 and cedar he gave like sycamores, that in the lowly place are abundant.
And they brought out horses from Egypt to Solomon, and from all the lands.

And the residue of the words of Solomon, the former and the latter, 𝄓 are they not written over the words of Nathan the prophet, and over the prophesy of Achiyah the Shilonite, and the visions of Iddo the visionary, over Jeroboam child of Nebat.
And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel, a forty year span.
And Solomon was laid out with his ancestors, and they entombed him in the city David his father, 𝄓 and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead. P
And Rehoboam went to Shechem, 𝄓 for to Shechem all Israel had come to make him king.
And it was when Jeroboam child of Nebat heard, (and he was in Egypt, where he ran away from the presence of the king Solomon), 𝄓 that Jeroboam returned from Egypt,
that they sent and called to him, and Jeroboam came and all Israel, 𝄓 and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
Your father hardened our shackles. 𝄓 So now lighten the service your father hardened, and his heavy shackles that he assigned to us, and we will serve you.
And he said to them, Three days longer then return to me. 𝄓 And the people went. S
And king Rehoboam took counsel with the elders who had stood in the presence of Solomon his father when he was alive, and he said, 𝄓 How do you advise replying with a word to this people?
And they spoke to him, saying, If it is to be for the good of this people and to seek their favour, then speak to them good things, 𝄓 and they will be your servants every day.
But he forsook the counsel of the elders with which they advised him, 𝄓 and he took advice from the male peers that promoted him, who had standing in his presence.
And he said to them, What you do advise that we may reply with a word to this people, 𝄓 who have spoken to me, saying, Lighten the shackle that your father assigned to us.

And they subjugated him, the male peers that promoted him, saying, Thus you say to the people who have spoken to you, saying, Your father made our shackles heavy so you lighten for us. 𝄓 Thus you say to them, My wee is thicker than the loins of my father.
And now my father has made you carry a heavy shackle, and I, I will add to your shackle. 𝄓 My father chastened you with scourges, and I with scorpions. P
And Jeroboam and all the people came in to Rehoboam on the third day, 𝄓 as the king had spoken, saying, Return to me on the third day.
And the king answered them with intransigence, 𝄓 and the king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the elders.
And he spoke to them according to the advice of the male peers, saying, I will make your shackle heavy and I, I will add to it. 𝄓 My father chastened you with scourges, and I, with scorpions.
So the king did not hear the people, 𝄓 for the context was with God, so that Yahweh might uphold his word that he spoke by the hand of Achiyah the Shilonite to Jeroboam child of Nebat.

And all Israel ... that the king did not pay heed to them, and the people returned to the king, saying, What is our share in David? And no inheritance in the child of Jesse. Each to your tents, Israel. Now see to your house, David. 𝄓 And all Israel went to its tents. S
But the children of Israel, those inhabiting in the cities of Judah, 𝄓 ... and Rehoboam reigned over them.

And the king Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the tax, and the children of Israel pelted him with stone and he died. 𝄓 Then the king Rehoboam made sure to get himself up into a chariot to withdraw to Jerusalem. S
So Israel transgressed, in the house of David, to this day.
And Rehoboam entered Jerusalem and convened the house of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen, 𝄓 to make war to fight with Israel to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam. P
And the word of Yahweh happened to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
Say to Rehoboam, child of Solomon, king of Judah, 𝄓 and to all Israel in Judah, and Benjamin, saying,

Thus says Yahweh, Do not go up, and do not fight with your kin. Return each to his own house, for from me is this matter. 𝄓 When they heard the words of Yahweh, they returned from going to Jeroboam. P
And Rehoboam settled in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and built cities to fortify Judah.
And he built Bethlehem, and Eitam, and Tekoa,
And the house of Tsur, and Socoh, and Adullam,
And Gath, and Mareshah, and Zif,
And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azeiqah,
And Tsarah, and Ailon, and Hebron, that is in Judah, and in Benjamin, 𝄓 fortified cities.
And he revamped the fortifications, 𝄓 and he assigned to them heralds, and treasuries of food and oil and wine.
And in every city by city, grappling hooks and lances, and he revamped them very much, 𝄓 and for him were Judah and Benjamin. S
And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel, 𝄓 presented themselves to him from all their borders.
For the Levites forsook their outlands and their holdings, and they went to Judah and to Jerusalem, 𝄓 for Jeroboam and his children rejected them from the priesthood to Yahweh.
And he installed for himself priests of the high places, 𝄓 and for the kids and for the calves that he had made.
And after them, from all the sceptres of Israel, those giving their heart to seek Yahweh the God of Israel, 𝄓 had come to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh the God of their ancestors.
And they encouraged the kingdom of Judah, and they assured Rehoboam child of Solomon three years, 𝄓 for they walked in the way of David and Solomon for three years.
And Rehoboam took for himself a woman, Mahalath the daughter of Yerimoth, child of David, 𝄓 Abihil the daughter of Eliab, child of Jesse.
And she gave birth for him sons, 𝄓 Yeush [Muster] and Shamariah [Dregs of Yah] and Zaham [Found-foul].
And after her, he took Makah the daughter of Absalom, 𝄓 and she gave birth for him Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomit.
And Rehoboam loved Makah the daughter of Absalom more than all his women and his courtesans, (for he bore eighteen women and sixty courtesans, 𝄓 and he had twenty eight sons and sixty daughters).
And Rehoboam installed Abijah child of Makah as head herald from his brothers, 𝄓 (for making him king).

And he was discerning and broke out from all his sons to all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to all the fortified cities, and he gave to them necessities in abundance, 𝄓 and he wished for the tumult of women.
And it happened when Rehoboam had established the kingdom and had encouraged himself, he forsook the instruction of Yahweh, 𝄓 and all Israel with him. P
And it happened in year the fifth of king Rehoboam, Shishaq the king of Egypt came up to Jerusalem, 𝄓 for they had trespassed against Yahweh.
With a thousand two hundred chariot, and sixty thousand cavalry, 𝄓 and there was no count of the people that came with him from Egypt, Lubite, Sukite, and Cushite.
And he conquered the fortified cities that were of Judah, 𝄓 and he came to Jerusalem. S

And Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the chiefs of Judah that were gathered at Jerusalem in the face of Shishaq. 𝄓 And he said to them, Thus says Yahweh, You yourselves have forsaken me and also I myself have forsaken you into the hand of Shishaq.
And they were brought to heel, the chiefs of Israel and the king, 𝄓 and they said, Yahweh is righteous.

And when Yahweh saw that they were brought to heel, the word of Yahweh happened to Shemaiah, saying, They have subdued themselves. I will not destroy them. 𝄓 And I will give them at least a hint of security, and my heat will not be poured forth in Jerusalem by the hand of Shishaq.
For they will be his as servants, 𝄓 and they will know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the lands. S

So Shishaq the king of Egypt came up to Jerusalem and he took the treasuries of the house of Yahweh and the treasuries of the house of the king. He took it all. 𝄓 And he took the golden shields which Solomon had made.
And Rehoboam the king made in their stead shields of brass, 𝄓 and entrusted them to the hand of the chiefs of the racers, the keepers of the door of the house of the king.
And it happened often. The king went into the house of Yahweh. 𝄓 The racers went in and bore them and the racers returned them to the little chamber.
And when he subdued himself, the anger of Yahweh turned from him and did not destroy to consume. 𝄓 And moreover in Judah things were good. S

And the king Rehoboam was encouraged in Jerusalem and reigned. 𝄓 As a child of forty one years, Rehoboam began to reign, and seventeen years he reigned in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh chose to put his name there, out of all the sceptres of Israel. And the name of his mother was Naamah, an Ammonite.
And he did evil, 𝄓 for he did not prepare his heart to search out Yahweh. S

And the words of Rehoboam, the former and the latter, are they not written in the words of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the visionary of genealogies? 𝄓 And there were wars, Rehoboam and Jeroboam, all these days.
And Rehoboam was laid out with his ancestors and was entombed in the city of David, 𝄓 and Abijah his son reigned in his stead. P
In the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam, 𝄓 and Abijah reigned over Judah.
Three years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Michaiah, the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. 𝄓 And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

And Abijah bound the battle with a force of valiant men of battle, four hundred thousand chosen men. 𝄓 And Jeroboam arranged for battle with him, eight hundred thousand chosen men of valour and force. S
And Abijah arose on mount Tsemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, 𝄓 and said, Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel.
Is it not for you to know that Yahweh the God of Israel gave the kingdom to David over Israel forever, 𝄓 for him and for his children, a covenant of salt? P
Yet Jeroboam has arisen, child of Nebat the servant of Solomon child of David, 𝄓 and he has mutinied against his master.

And empty men have collected themselves to him, children of worthlessness, and they assured themselves over Rehoboam child of Solomon, 𝄓 but Rehoboam was a youth and tender of heart, and was not resolute facing them.
And now you say to be resolute before the kingdom of Yahweh by the hand of the children of David, 𝄓 and you, an abundant tumult, and with you calves of gold that Jeroboam has made for you for gods.

Have you not banished the priests of Yahweh, the children of Aaron and the Levites? 𝄓 And have you made priests for yourselves as the people of the lands? Anyone who comes to fill his hand with a young bull of the herd, and seven rams, and he will be a priest to not god. S
But for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not forsaken him. 𝄓 And priests ministering to Yahweh are children of Aaron, and the Levites in the lines of work,

And burning incense to Yahweh, burnt offerings from morning to morning, and evening to evening, and incense of sweet spices, and the arrangement of bread at the clean table, and the gold lamp stand and its lamps for kindling from evening to evening, for we are those watching the watch of Yahweh our God, 𝄓 but you, you have forsaken him.

And behold as head, God is with us, and his priests, and the jubilant trumpeting to raise a shout against you. 𝄓 O children of Israel, do not fight with Yahweh the God of your ancestors, for you will not prosper.
But Jeroboam had surrounded with an ambush to come behind them, 𝄓 and they were before Judah, and from the ambush, behind them.
When Judah faced about, behold for them, the battle was facing and from behind, and they cried out to Yahweh, 𝄓 and the priests trumpeted with the trumpets.
And the men of Judah shouted in triumph. 𝄓 And it was in the jubilation of the men of Judah that God plagued Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
And the children of Israel withdrew in the face of Judah, 𝄓 and God gave them into their hand.
And Abijah and his people struck among them, striking many, 𝄓 and the profaned from Israel fell, five hundred thousand chosen men.
And the children of Israel were brought to heel at that time, 𝄓 and the children of Judah were assured, for they leaned on Yahweh, the God of their ancestors.
And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and he conquered cities from him, Bethel and its built-up areas, and Sleepytown and its built-up areas, 𝄓 and Dusty and its built-up areas.
And Jeroboam did not coerce power any more in the days of Abijah. 𝄓 And Yahweh plagued him and he died. P
And Abijah was resolved and took for himself fourteen women, 𝄓 and he had twenty two sons and sixteen daughters.
And the remaining words of Abijah, and his ways, and his words, 𝄓 are written in the searching out of the prophet Iddo.
And Abijah was laid out with his ancestors and they entombed him in the city of David, 𝄓 and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years. P
And Asa did what is good and what is upright in the eyes of Yahweh his God.
And he turned aside the alien altars, and the high places, 𝄓 and he broke the monuments, and chopped down the fetishes.
And he said to Judah to search out Yahweh, the God of their ancestors, 𝄓 and to do the instruction and the commandment.
And he turned aside, from all the cities of Judah, the high places and the sun-pillars, 𝄓 and the kingdom was quiet before him.
And they built fortified cities in Judah, 𝄓 for the land was quiet and there was no war with him in these years, for Yahweh had given rest to him.

And he said to Judah, Let us build these cities and surrounded with a wall, and towers, gateways, and bars, while the land is before us, for we have searched out Yahweh our God. We have searched him out and he has given us rest on every side. 𝄓 So they built and they prospered. P

And Asa had a force bearing grappling hook and lance from Judah, three hundred thousand, and from Benjamin to bear shield and direct a bow, two hundred and eighty thousand, 𝄓 all these valiant of force.
And Zerach the Cushite came out to them with a force a million, and three hundred chariots, 𝄓 and he came to Mareshah.
So Asa went out before him, 𝄓 and they arranged for battle in the gorge of Tsepatah in Mareshah.

And Asa called to Yahweh his God, and he said, Yahweh, it is nothing with you to help, amid abundance or without power. Help us, Yahweh our God, for on you is our salvation, and in your name we come on this tumult. 𝄓 Yahweh our God you are. No mortal will coerce you. S
And Yahweh plagued the Cushites before Asa and before Judah. 𝄓 And the Cushites withdrew.

And Asa pursued them, and the people who were with him, even to Gerar. And it was such a fall from the Cushites that there was no reviving them, for they were shattered before Yahweh and before their army. 𝄓 And they lifted up very abundant spoil.
And they struck all the cities surrounding Gerar, for the dread of Yahweh was on them. 𝄓 And they despoiled all the cities, for there was lots of loot in them.
And even the tents of livestock they struck, 𝄓 and carried away sheep in abundance and camels. And they returned to Jerusalem. S
And Azariah child of Oded, the spirit of God was upon him.

And he came out before Asa, saying to him, Hear me Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin. 𝄓 Yahweh is with you when you are with him, and if you search him out he will be found of you, and if you forsake him he will forsake you. S
And many days for Israel, 𝄓 there will be no God of truth and no priest instructing and no instruction.
But let him turn in his straits to Yahweh the God of Israel, 𝄓 and let them seek him, and he will be found of them.
And in those times there will be no peace for one to go out or to come in, 𝄓 for much discomfort will be over all the inhabitants of the lands.
And they will beat nation by nation and city by city, 𝄓 for God will confuse them with all trouble.
But you be resolute and do not let your hands slacken, 𝄓 for there is a wage for your work. S

And as Asa heard these words and the prophesy of Oded the prophet, he was resolved, and he was furious at the detestable things from all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and from the cities that he had conquered from mount Ephraim, 𝄓 and he renovated the altar of Yahweh that was before the porch of Yahweh.

And he collected all Judah and Benjamin and those residing with them from Ephraim and Manasseh and from Simeon, 𝄓 for they fell to him from Israel in abundance when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him. P
And they collected themselves at Jerusalem in the third month, 𝄓 of the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
And they sacrificed to Yahweh in that day from the spoil they had brought, 𝄓 oxen, seven hundred, and sheep, seven thousand.
And they entered into a covenant to search out Yahweh the God of their ancestors, 𝄓 with all their heart and with all their integrity.
And anyone that not would search out to Yahweh the God of Israel would be put to death, 𝄓 from the least to the greatest, man or woman.
And they swore to Yahweh with a great voice and with a shout of triumph, 𝄓 and with trumpets and with shophar.
And all Judah was glad over the oath, for with all their heart they swore, and with all acceptance they sought him, and he was found of them, 𝄓 and Yahweh gave rest to them round about.

And even Makah the mother of Asa the king, he put her aside as queen-mother when she made a totem for her fetish, 𝄓 and Asa cut off her totem and ground it finely and incinerated it in the wadi Kidron.
But the high places they did not put aside from Israel, 𝄓 but the heart of Asa was at peace all his days.
And he brought the holy things of his father and his own holy things into the house of God, 𝄓 silver and gold and vessels.
And there was no war, 𝄓 until year thirty five of the reign of Asa. P
In the thirty sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel came up to Judah and built Ramah, 𝄓 so as to prevent going out or coming in to Asa king of Judah.
So Asa brought out silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of Yahweh and the house of the king, 𝄓 and he sent to Benhadad king of Aram who sat in Damascus, saying,
A covenant between me and you and my father and your father: 𝄓 behold I send to you silver and gold. Go, annul your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, and he will go up away from me.

And Benhadad heeded king Asa and he sent the chiefs of the forces that were his to the cities of Israel and they struck Ijon and Dan and Lament of Water, 𝄓 and all the storerooms of the cities of Naphtali.
And it happened as Baasha heard so he refrained from building Ramah, 𝄓 and he ceased his affairs. S
Then Asa the king took all Judah and they lifted up the stones of Ramah and its timber that Baasha had built with, 𝄓 and built with them Geba and Mizpah. S

And at time that Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, 𝄓 and said to him, In that you leaned on the king of Aram and you did not lean on Yahweh your God, therefore the force of the king of Aram escaped from your hand.
Are not the Cushites and the Lubites abundant forces of chariot and very many cavalry, 𝄓 but you let yourself lean on Yahweh, and he gave them into your hands.

For Yahweh, his eyes are roving throughout all the earth to show himself resolute with those whose heart is at peace with him. You have been silly about this, 𝄓 for from now on there will be wars with you.
And Asa was grieved with the seer and he assigned him to a house for delinquents for he was outraged with him over this. 𝄓 And Asa damaged the people at that time.
And behold, the words of Asa, the former and the latter, 𝄓 behold they are written in the record of the kings of Judah and Israel.
And Asa was diseased in the thirty ninth year of his reign in his feet until the ascendancy of his illness. 𝄓 And moreover, in his illness, he did not search out Yahweh for healing.
And Asa was laid out with his ancestors, 𝄓 and he died in the forty first year of his reign.

And they entombed him in his own tombs that he dug for himself in the city of David and they laid him out in the litter which was filled with spices and kinds of perfumes constructed by apothecaries. 𝄓 And they cremated him, a very great incineration. P
And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, 𝄓 and was resolute concerning Israel.
And he positioned force in all the enclosed cities of Judah, 𝄓 and assigned monitors in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim that Asa his father had conquered.
And Yahweh was with Yahweh-judges [Jehoshaphat], 𝄓 for he walked in the ways of David his father, the former times, and not searching out the Baalim.
But searching out to the God of his father, and in his commandments he walked, 𝄓 and not according to the deeds of Israel.
And Yahweh established the kingdom in his hand, and all Judah gave a gift to Jehoshaphat, 𝄓 and there was for him riches and glory in abundance.
His heart was lofty in the ways of Yahweh, 𝄓 and still he put aside the high places and the fetishes from Judah. P

And in the third year of his reign, he sent to his nobility, to Benworthy, and to Obadiah [Servant of Yah], and to Zechariah [Memorial of Yah], and to Netaneel [Given of God], and to Mikayahu [Who is like Yah], 𝄓 to teach the cities of Judah.

And with them, the Levites, Shemaiah, and Nathaniah, and Zebedyah, and Ashael, and Shemiramoth, and Jonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobiah, and good Adonijah, the Levites, 𝄓 and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
And they taught in Judah, and with them the record of the instruction of Yahweh. 𝄓 And they went around in all the cities of Judah, and they taught among the people.
And the dread of Yahweh was on all the kingdoms of the lands that surrounded Judah. 𝄓 And they did not fight with Jehoshaphat.
And from the Philistines came a gift for Jehoshaphat, and bearing silver. 𝄓 Even the Arabians brought him sheep, seven thousand seven hundred rams, and billy-goats, seven thousand seven hundred. P
And Jehoshaphat was ongoing, and grew ever in ascendancy, 𝄓 and he built in Judah castles and cities for storerooms.
And many affairs were his in the cities of Judah. 𝄓 And men of battle, valiant of force, were in Jerusalem.
And this was their census for the house of their ancestors, 𝄓 of Judah, chiefs of thousands, Adnah the chief, and with him, valiant of force, three hundred thousand. S
And by his hand, Yehoxanan, the chief, 𝄓 and with him, two hundred and eighty thousand. S
And by his hand, Amasyah, child of Zikri, who willingly offered himself for Yahweh, 𝄓 and with him, two hundred thousand men of valour and ability. S
And from Benjamin, of valour and ability, Elyada, 𝄓 and with him, equipped with bow and shield, two hundred thousand. S
And by his hand, Yhosabad, 𝄓 and with him, a hundred and eighty thousand, a ready-armed host. S
These ministered to the king, 𝄓 besides those the king positioned in the enclosed cities in all Judah. P
And there were for Jehoshaphat riches and glory in abundance, 𝄓 and he made an alliance with Ahab.

And he went down years after to Ahab in Samaria and Ahab offered for him sheep and oxen in abundance and for the people that were with him. 𝄓 And he persuaded him to go up to the high ground of Gilead.

And Ahab the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Will you go with me to the high ground of Gilead? 𝄓 And he said to him, Like me like you, and as your people my people, and with you into the battle.
And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, 𝄓 Search out, please, according to the day, the word of Yahweh.

And the king of Israel collected the prophets, four hundred such, and he said to them, Should I go to the high ground of Gilead to war, or should I refrain? 𝄓 And they said, Go up and God will give into the hand of the king.
And Jehoshaphat said, Is there no mouth of a prophet of Yahweh still, 𝄓 that we may search out from him?

And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Still one man to search out Yahweh from him, but I hate him, for he has no prophecy over me for good, but all his days for evil. He is Mikayahu child of Yimla, 𝄓 and Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
And the king of Israel called to one eunuch, 𝄓 and he said, Swiftly, Mikayahu, child of Yimla.

And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were seated each on his throne, clothed in their garments, and they were seated at the threshing-floor at the door of the gate of Samaria, 𝄓 and all the prophets were prophesying facing them.
And Zedekiah child of Kenaanah made for himself horns of iron, 𝄓 and he said, Thus says Yahweh, With these you will push back the Aramaeans till you have consumed them.
And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, 𝄓 Go up to the high ground of Gilead and prosper, and Yahweh will give by the hand of the king.
And the messenger who went to call Mikayahu spoke to him, saying, Behold the words of the prophets, one mouth, good for the king. 𝄓 Let be, if you will, your word, as one of them, and speak good.
And Mikayahu said, 𝄓 Yahweh lives. But what my God says, such I will speak.

And he came in to the king and the king said to him, Micah, will we go for the high ground of Gilead to war or should I refrain? 𝄓 And he said, Go up and prosper, and they will be given into your hand.
And the king said to him, For how many times do I adjure you, 𝄓 that you will not speak to me but truth in the name of Yahweh?
And he said, I have seen all Israel dispersed on the hills, like a flock that is without their shepherd, 𝄓 and Yahweh said, No masters for these. Let them return each to its own house in peace.
And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, 𝄓 Did I not say to you, He does not prophesy over me good but rather for evil. S
And he said, Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, 𝄓 I have seen Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the host of the heavens standing at his right hand and at his left.
And Yahweh said, Who will seduce Ahab king of Israel that he will go up and fall on the high ground of Gilead? 𝄓 And said this one, saying, Like thus? And this one said, Like thus?
And the spirit came forth and stood in the presence of Yahweh, and he said, Myself, I will seduce him. 𝄓 And Yahweh said to him, With what?
And he said, I will come out and I will be for the wind, falsehood in the mouth of all his prophets. 𝄓 And he said, You will seduce and moreover, you can go forth and do so.
And now, behold, Yahweh has given a spirit of falsehood in the mouth of these your prophets, 𝄓 but Yahweh has spoken over you evil. S
And Zedekiah child of Kenaanah made overture and struck Mikayahu on the cheek, 𝄓 and he said, How is this for the way the spirit of Yahweh crossed from me to speak with you?
And Mikayahu said, Behold you will see in that day, 𝄓 when you enter the room of the inner room to be camouflaged.
And the king of Israel said, Take Mikayahu and return him to Amon the chief of the city, 𝄓 and to Joash, child of the king.
And you will say, Thus says the king, Set this in place in the house of restraint, 𝄓 and feed him the bread of restriction and the water of restriction until I return in peace.
And Mikayahu said, If returning you return in peace, Yahweh has not spoken in me. 𝄓 And he said, Hear peoples, all of them.
And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah and went up to the high ground of Gilead.

And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself and enter into the battle, but you clothe yourself in your garments. 𝄓 And the king of Israel disguised himself and entered into the battle.
But the king of the Aramaeans had commanded the chiefs of the charioteers that he had, saying, Do not fight the least, the great, 𝄓 but rather the king of Israel alone.

And it happened that when the chief charioteers saw Jehoshaphat, that they, they said, He is the king of Israel. And they turned around against him to fight, 𝄓 but Jehoshaphat appealed, and Yahweh helped him and God diverted them from him.
And it happened that when the chief charioteers saw that he was not the king of Israel, 𝄓 that they turned back from following him.

And someone drew a bow completely, and struck the king of Israel between the appendages and chain mail, 𝄓 and he said to the charioteer, Change your hand, and bring me forth from the camp, for I am ill.
And the battle was upward in that day, and the king of Israel was standing in a chariot opposite the Aramaeans till evening, 𝄓 and he died at the time of the going down of the sun.
And Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem. S

And Jehu child of Hanani the visionary went out to his presence, and he said to king Jehoshaphat, To help the wicked, and those who hate Yahweh, should you love? 𝄓 So in this for you is rage from the presence of Yahweh.
Lamentably, good things were found with you, 𝄓 for you have shriven the fetishes from the land, and have prepared your heart to search out God.
And Jehoshaphat settled in Jerusalem then he returned and he went out among the people from Beer-Sheva to mount Ephraim, 𝄓 so he returned them to Yahweh the God of their ancestors.
And he installed judges in the land in all the enclosed cities of Judah, city by city.
And he said to the judges, See what you do, because not for a human you judge, but for Yahweh, 𝄓 who is with you in the word of judgment.
So now let the dread of Yahweh be over you. 𝄓 Keep and do, because there is with Yahweh our God, no injustice, nor partiality of face, nor receiving of bribes.

And also in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat had installed from the Levites, and the priests, and from the heads of the ancestors of Israel, for the judgment of Yahweh and for dispute. 𝄓 And they sat in Jerusalem.
And he commanded them, saying, 𝄓 Thus you will do in the fear of Yahweh, in faithfulness, and with a heart at peace.

And every contention that comes upon you from your kin inhabiting in their cities, between blood to blood, between instruction to commandment, and to statute, and to judgment, you will admonish them, and they will not bear guilt to Yahweh, and there be rage over you, and over your kin. 𝄓 Thus you will do and you will not bear guilt.

And behold, Amariah, the head priest, is over you for any matter of Yahweh, and Zebedyah child of Yishmaeil, herald to the house of Judah, for any matter of the king, and the Levites will be overseers in your presence. 𝄓 So deal resolutely, and Yahweh will be with what is good. P
And it was after this the children of Moab came, and the children of Ammon, and with them from the Ammonites, against Jehoshaphat to war.
And they came and told Jehoshaphat, saying, An abundant tumult has come against you from beyond the sea, from Aram. 𝄓 And behold, they are in Platoons-of-Palm-Tree. (This is Ein Gedi).
And Jehoshaphat was fearful and gave his presence to search out to Yahweh. 𝄓 And he called a fast over all Judah.
And Judah collected themselves to seek from Yahweh. 𝄓 Even from all the cities of Judah, they came to seek Yahweh.
And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem in the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 facing the new court.

And he said, Yahweh the God of our ancestors, are you not he, God in the heavens? And you govern in all the kingdoms of the nations. 𝄓 And in your hand is power and valour, and with you there is no one to be stationed.
Are you not our God who dispossessed the inhabitants of this land from before your people Israel, 𝄓 and gave it to the seed of Abraham, your love, forever?
And they have inhabited it. 𝄓 And they built for you in it a sanctuary for your name, saying,

If evil will come upon us, sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house and in your presence, for your name is in this house, 𝄓 and we appeal to you in our adversity, then you will hear, and you will save.

And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom you had not permitted Israel to enter when they came from the land of Egypt, 𝄓 but they turned aside from them, and did not exterminate them,
And behold they reward us, 𝄓 to enter to expel us from your possession that you gave us to possess.
Our God, will you not judge in them? For there is no power among us in the face of this abundant tumult that has come over us, 𝄓 and we do not know what we should do, but on you are our eyes.
And all Judah stood facing Yahweh, 𝄓 even their little ones, their wives, and their children. S
And Yaxaziel, child of Zachariah, child of Benaiah, child of Jeiel, child of Mattaniah the Levite, from the children of Asaph, 𝄓 on him was the spirit of Yahweh in the midst of the congregation.

And he said, Attend all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the king Jehoshaphat. 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh to you, Yourselves, do not fear, and do not be in disarray from the presence of this abundant tumult, for not yours is the battle but God's.
Tomorrow, descend against them. Behold, they are going up the ascent of the Blossom. 𝄓 Then you will find them in the reeds of the wadi, before the wilderness of the Instruction of God.

And the dread of God was on all the kingdoms of the lands, 𝄓 when they heard that Yahweh warred with the enemies of Israel.

And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah, 𝄓 a child of thirty five years when he began to reign, and twenty five years he reigned in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Forsaken, the daughter of Shilhi.

And Eliezer, child of Dodavah of Mareshah, prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, 𝄓 Because you have partnered with Achaziah, Yahweh has breached your deeds. And the ships were shattered and could not be coerced to go to Tarshish.
And Jehoshaphat was laid out with his ancestors and was entombed with his ancestors in the city of David, 𝄓 and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
And his kin are the children of Jehoshaphat, Azariah and Jechiel and Zachariah and Azariah and Michael and Shepatyah. 𝄓 All these are the children of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
