When Jehoram arose over the kingdom of his father, he was resolved, and he slew all his brothers by the sword, 𝄓 and also from the nobility of Israel.
A child of thirty two years Jehoram was when he began to reign, 𝄓 and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem.
And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel as the house of Ahab had done, because the daughter of Ahab was his wife. 𝄓 And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh.
But Yahweh did not consent to destroy the house of David on account of the covenant which he cut for David, 𝄓 and in that he promised to give a lamp for him and for his children every day.
In his days Edom transgressed from under the hand of Judah, 𝄓 and they made a king reign over them.
And Jehoram crossed over with his nobles and every charioteer with him, 𝄓 and arose by night and struck Edom round about him and the chief charioteers.

And writing came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, 𝄓 Thus says Yahweh the God of David your father, In that you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

But have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah to play the harlot, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, like the harlotry of the house of Ahab, 𝄓 and moreover, your kin, the house of your father who were better than you, you have slain,
Behold Yahweh will plague a great plague on your people, 𝄓 and on your children, and on your wives, and on all your property.
And you will have much sickness, sickness of your inner parts, 𝄓 until your inner parts go forth from the sickness day by day.
And Yahweh roused against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, the Arabians, who were adjacent to the Cushites.

And they came up into Judah and split her in two, and took captive all the property that was found of the house of the king, and also his sons and his wives, 𝄓 and no son was still there for him but Jehoahaz, the least of his children.
And after all this, 𝄓 Yahweh plagued him in his inner parts of a sickness for which there was no physician.

And it happened regularly, and as time emerged at the end of days stretching to years, his inner parts came out with his illness, and he died of evil diseases, 𝄓 and his people did for him no incineration like the incineration of his ancestors.

A child of thirty two he was when he began to reign and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and he went without being attractive, and they entombed him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Achaziah, his youngest son, king in his stead, for all those first in line, the raiding party that came with the Arabians to the camp, had slain. 𝄓 And Achaziah reigned, child of Jehoram king of Judah. P
A child of forty two years was Achaziah when he began to reign, and one year he reigned in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and the name of his mother was Ataliah, the daughter of Omri.
Also he walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, 𝄓 because his mother was his counselor to do wickedly.
And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh like the house of Ahab, 𝄓 because they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
Also with their counsel he walked, and he went with Jehoram, child of Ahab king of Israel, to war against Hazael king of Aram on the high ground of Gilead, 𝄓 and the Aramaeans struck Joram.

And he returned to be healed in Jezreel for the defeats that struck him on the high ground when they fought with Hazael king of Aram. 𝄓 And Azariah, child of Jehoram king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram child of Ahab in Jezreel, for he was ill.

But from God was the treading down of Achaziah that he came to Joram. 𝄓 And when he had come, he went forth with Jehoram to Jehu child of Nimshi, whom Yahweh had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

And he sought out Achaziah, and they caught him, (he was camouflaged in Samaria), and brought him to Jehu, and they put him to death and entombed him, for they said, Child of Jehoshaphat is he, who searched out Yahweh with all his heart. 𝄓 And there was none of the house of Achaziah to coerce power for his kingdom.

And in the seventh year Jehoiada was encouraged, and he took the chiefs of hundreds, of Azariah child of Jeroham, of Yishmaeil child of Yehoxanan, and of Azariah child of Obed, and Maaseyah child of Adiyah, and Elishaphat child of Zikri, with him into covenant.

And Jehoiada the priest brought forth the chiefs of the hundreds officiating over the force, and he said to them, Have her brought forth from the house and the slats, and who comes following her will be put to death by the sword, 𝄓 because, said the priest, Do not put her to death in the house of Yahweh.
So they laid hands on her, and when she had come to the entry of the gate of the horses, of the house of the king, 𝄓 they put her to death there. P

And Jehoiada set officers over the house of Yahweh by the hand of the priests, the Levites that David divided over the house of Yahweh to offer up the burnt offerings of Yahweh, as it is written in the instruction of Moses, with gladness and with song, 𝄓 by the hands of David.
And he made the gatekeepers stand over the gates of the House of Yahweh, 𝄓 and none could enter defiled for any matter.

A child of seven years, Joash began to reign, and forty years he reigned in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and the name of his mother was Zibiah from Beer-Sheva.

And it was after this, 𝄓 Joash was with heart to renovate the house of Yahweh.

And he collected the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go forth to the cities of Judah, and collect from all Israel, silver to revamp the house of your God, as often as year by year, and you move swiftly for the matter. 𝄓 But the Levites were not swift.

So the king called Jehoiada, the head, and he said to him, For what purpose have you not searched out the Levites to bring from Judah and from Jerusalem the assumed liability of Moses, the servant of Yahweh, and the congregation of Israel, 𝄓 for the tent of witness.

And those doing the lines of work constructed, and they improved longevity by the workmanship of their hands, 𝄓 and they made the house of God stand concerning its stability, and made it sure.

And when they had finished, they brought before the king and Jehoiada the residue of the silver, and with it were made the vessels for the house of Yahweh, the vessels of ministry and the offerings and spoons and vessels of gold and silver. 𝄓 And they were offering up burnt offerings in the house of Yahweh continually all the days of Jehoiada. And Jehoiada aged and was sated of days and died, 𝄓 a child of a hundred and thirty at his death.

And Amaziah said to the man of God, And what is to be done with the hundred talents that I gave to the raiding-party of Israel? 𝄓 And the man of God said, There is more that is Yahweh's to give to you than this.
And Amaziah differentiated the raiding-party that had come to him from Ephraim to go to their place, 𝄓 and their anger burned much against Judah and they returned to their place burning with anger. S
And Amaziah had courage and he drove his people and he went to the salt gorge, 𝄓 and struck the children of Seir, ten thousand.

Then Amaziah, king of Judah, took advice and he sent to Joash, child of Jehoahaz, child of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, 𝄓 Come let us show our faces.

And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thorn that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon and said, Give your daughter to my son as wife, 𝄓 and an animal of the field passed by that was in Lebanon and trampled the thorn.

And Amaziah king of Judah, child of Joash, child of Achaziah, Joash king of Israel arrested in The-House-of-the-sun, 𝄓 and he brought him to Jerusalem and breached the walls of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the gate of the corner, four hundred cubits.

And all the gold and the silver and all the vessels that were found in in the house of God, with the servant of Edom, and the treasuries of the house of the king, and the children as insurance, 𝄓 and he returned to Samaria. P
And Amaziah child of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash child of Jehoahaz king of Israel, 𝄓 fifteen years.
And the remaining words of Amaziah the former and the latter, 𝄓 behold, are they not written in the record of the kings of Judah and Israel.

And from the time that Amaziah turned aside from following Yahweh, they colluded against him collusion in Jerusalem and he withdrew towards Lachish, 𝄓 but they sent after him towards Lachish and put him to death there.

And he went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke through the wall of Gath, and the rampart of Yabneh, and the rampart of Ashdod, 𝄓 and built cities in Ashdod and against the Philistines.
And this God helped him against the Philistines and against the Arabians, those inhabiting in Gur Baal and the Meunim.
And the Ammonites gave a gift to Uzziah, 𝄓 and his name traveled to the entry of Egypt for he was resolute to a great degree.
And Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem, over the gate of the corner, and over the gate of the gorge, and over the cutting, 𝄓 and he revamped them.

And he built towers in the wilderness, hewed many cisterns, for had he much livestock, both in the low place in the level place, 𝄓 farmers and vine-dressers in the hills and in Carmel, for he loved agriculture. S

And Uzziah had ability to make war, a host going out as a raiding party, according to the count of their conscription by the hand of Jeiel, the secretary, and Maaseyah, the overseer, 𝄓 by the hand of Hananiah, the chief of the king.
All the count of the heads of the ancestors for the valiant of force, two thousand six hundred.

And he himself warred with the king of the children of Ammon and was resolute over them, and the children of Ammon gave to him in that year a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cor of wheat and of barley, ten thousand. 𝄓 This the children of Ammon paid in tribute to him, and in the second year and the third.
And Jotham was resolved, 𝄓 for he prepared his ways before Yahweh his God.
And the remaining words of Jotham and all his wars and his ways, 𝄓 behold they are written in the record of the kings of Israel and Judah.
A child of twenty five years he was when he began to reign, 𝄓 and sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem.
And Jotham was laid out with his ancestors and they entombed him in the city of David, 𝄓 and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead. P
A child of twenty years Ahaz was when he began to reign, and sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and he did not do what is upright in the eyes of Yahweh like David his father.
And he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, 𝄓 and moreover, libations he did for the Baalim.

And he was one who burned incense in the gorge of the child of Hinnom, 𝄓 and shrove his children in the fire according to the abominations of the nations, whom Yahweh had dispossessed before the face of the children of Israel.
And he sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places and on the hillocks, 𝄓 and under every green tree.

And Yahweh his God gave him into the hand of the king of Aram, and they struck against him and took captive from him a great captivity, and they came to Damascus. 𝄓 And also into the hand of king of Israel he was given, and he struck against him a great strike. S
And Peqach child of Remalia slew in Judah a hundred and twenty thousand in one day, the whole of the children of wealth, 𝄓 in that they had forsaken Yahweh the God of their ancestors.
And he slew the males of valour of Ephraim, Maaseyah child of the king, and Azriqam, herald of the house, 𝄓 and Elkanah second to the king. S
And the children of Israel took captive from their kin two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and moreover abundant spoil they looted of them, 𝄓 and they brought the spoil to Samaria. S

And there was a prophet of Yahweh, Oded his name, and he came out before the host that came to Samaria, and said to them, Behold Yahweh the God of your ancestors was heated about Judah, and he gave them into your hand, 𝄓 and you have slain them in outrage, touching even to the heavens.
And now you are saying to take the children of Judah and Jerusalem under control as male slaves and as female slaves for you? 𝄓 But are there not with you yourselves, offenses to Yahweh your God?
So now hear me, and return the captives that you have captured from your kin, 𝄓 for the burning of the anger of Yahweh is on you. S

And persons arose from the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah child of Yehoxanan, Berechiah child of Mishlamot, and Yichezekiah child of Shallum, and Amasa child of Xadlai, 𝄓 against those who came from the host.

And they said to them, You will not come with the captives here, for to offend Yahweh is against us. You are saying to add to our sins and to our offenses, 𝄓 for much is our offence and fierce anger against Israel. S
And the ready-armed deferred with the captivity and the loot before the nobility and all the congregation.

And the men arose that were drilled by name, and encouraged the captives, and all that were naked they clothed from the spoil. And they clothed them and put sandals on them, and fed them, and gave them drink, and put makeup on them, and for all who stumbled, refreshed them on the asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, next to their kin, 𝄓 and they returned to Samaria. P
At that time, king Ahaz sent to the kings of Ashur to help him.
For still Edom had come, 𝄓 and had struck in Judah and had carried away captives.

And Philistines pillaged in the cities of the lowly places and of the south to Judah, and they conquered the house of the sun, and Ailon and Gdeirot, and Socoh and its built-up areas, and Timnah and its built-up areas, and Gimzo and its built-up areas, 𝄓 and they settled there.
For Yahweh brought Judah to heel on behalf of Ahaz, king of Israel, 𝄓 for he had made Judah negligent, and he trespassed against Yahweh.
And Tilgath-Pilneser, king of Ashur, came to him, 𝄓 and laid siege for him but did not encourage him.
For Ahaz divided the house of Yahweh and the house of the king and the nobles, 𝄓 and he yielded to the king of Ashur, but he was no help to him.
And at the time of his trouble he added to the trespass against Yahweh. 𝄓 This is king Ahaz.

And he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, who struck against him. And he said, For the gods of the kings of Aram, they help them. To them I will sacrifice, and they will help me. 𝄓 And they became for him a stumbling-block and for all Israel.

And Ahaz gathered the vessels of the house of God, and sundered the vessels of the house of God, and he locked the gateways of the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 and he made altars for him in every corner in Jerusalem.
And in every city by city of Judah, he made high places to burn incense to other gods, 𝄓 and grieved Yahweh the God of his ancestors.
And the remainder of his matters, and all his ways, the former and the latter, 𝄓 behold they are written in the record of the kings of Judah and Israel.

And Ahaz was laid out with his ancestors, and they entombed him in the city, in Jerusalem. But they did not bring him to the tombs of the kings of Israel. 𝄓 And Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead. P
Hezekiah began to reign as a child of twenty five years, and twenty nine years, he reigned in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and the name of his mother was Abijah, the daughter of Zachariah.
And he did what is upright in the eyes of Yahweh, 𝄓 according to everything that David his father had done.
He, in the first year of his reign, in the first new moon, opened the gateways of the house of Yahweh, and he revamped them.
And he brought in the priests and the Levites, 𝄓 and gathered them to the east plaza.
And he said to them, Hear me, Levites. 𝄓 Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of Yahweh, the God of your ancestors, and bring out the segregation from the sanctuary.
For our ancestors trespassed and did evil in the eyes of Yahweh our God, and they forsook him, 𝄓 and they turned round their faces from the dwelling-place of Yahweh, and put forth scruff.
They even locked the gateways of the porch, and quenched the lamps, and they did not burn incense with smoke. 𝄓 And burnt offering they did not bring up in holiness to the God of Israel.
And Yahweh was enraged about Judah and Jerusalem, 𝄓 and gave them to be unnerved, a desolation, and a hissing, as you see with your own eyes.
And behold our ancestors fell by the sword, 𝄓 and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity over this.
Now with my heart is to cut a covenant to Yahweh the God of Israel, 𝄓 that he may turn from us his fierce anger.
My children, do not be at ease, 𝄓 for Yahweh has chosen among you to stand before him, to minister to him, and to be ministering for him and burning incense. P

And the Levites arose, Maxat, child of Amasai, and Joel, child of Azariah, from the children of the Kohathites, and from the children of Merari, Kish, child of Abdi, and Azariah, child of Jehaleleel, 𝄓 and from the Gershonites, Joah, child of Zimmah, and Eden, child of Joah.
And from the children of Elitsaphan, My-Keeper, and Jeiel, 𝄓 and from the children of Asaph, Zachariah and Mattaniah. S
And from the children of Heyman, Yexiel and Shimei, 𝄓 and from the children of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
And they gathered their kin, and sanctified themselves, and came according to the commandment of the king in the words of Yahweh, 𝄓 to cleanse the house of Yahweh.

And the priests entered into the presence of the house of Yahweh to cleanse, and they brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of Yahweh into the court of the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 and the Levites received it to bring forth into the wadi Kidron outside.

And they started on the first of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the porch of Yahweh. So they sanctified the house of Yahweh for eight days. 𝄓 And on the sixteenth day of the first month, they finished. S

And they came before Hezekiah the king, and they said, We have cleansed all the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 the altar of the burnt offering, and all its vessels, and the table of arrangement, and all its vessels.
And all the vessels that the king Ahaz rejected in his kingdom, in his trespass, we have prepared, and sanctified. 𝄓 And behold, they are before the altar of Yahweh. S
And Hezekiah the king rose up early and gathered the chiefs of the city, 𝄓 and he ascended to the house of Yahweh.

And he brought seven young bulls, and seven rams, and seven young lambs, and seven strong he-goats, for the sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. 𝄓 And he said to the children of Aaron the priests to do the burnt offerings on the altar of Yahweh.

And they butchered the oxen, and the priests received the blood, and dashed it toward the altar. 𝄓 And they butchered the rams, and dashed the blood toward the altar, and they butchered the young lambs, and dashed the blood toward the altar.
And they brought close the kids for the sin offering in the presence of the king and the congregation, 𝄓 and they supported their hands over them.

And the priests butchered them, and they did the sin offering with their blood toward the altar, as a cover-price over all Israel, 𝄓 because for all Israel, the king had said the burnt offering and the sin offering would be.

And he installed the Levites of the house of Yahweh with cymbals, with lutes, and with harps, by the commandment of David, and Gad the visionary of the king, and Nathan the prophet. 𝄓 For by the hand of Yahweh was the commandment by the hand of his prophets.
And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests, with the trumpets. P

And Hezekiah said to offer up the burnt offering on the altar. 𝄓 And at the time the burnt offering started, the song of Yahweh and the trumpets started, and by the hands of the instruments of David, king of Israel.
And all the congregation worshiped, and the song singing and the trumpets trumpeting, 𝄓 everything, until the consummation of the burnt offering.
And as the burnt offering was finished, 𝄓 the king and all that were found with him bowed down and they worshiped.

And Hezekiah the king and the nobles said to the Levites to praise Yahweh with the words of David, and Asaph, the visionary, 𝄓 and they praised to gladness, and they bowed their head and they worshiped. P

And Hezekiah answered and said, Now you have filled your hand for Yahweh. Come close and bring offerings and thanksgivings to the house of Yahweh. 𝄓 And the congregation brought offerings and thanksgivings, and all who were willing of heart, burnt offerings.
And this is the count of the burnt offerings that the congregation brought, seventy oxen, a hundred rams, two hundred young lambs, 𝄓 for a burnt offering to Yahweh, all these.
And the holy things, 𝄓 oxen, six hundred, and sheep, three thousand.

But the priests were too few, and were not able to flay all the burnt offerings, but their kin the Levites encouraged them till the consummation of the lines of work, and until the priests sanctified themselves. 𝄓 For the Levites were more upright of the heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
And also, the burnt offering being abundant, with the gross fat of the peace offerings, and the libations for a burnt offering, 𝄓 the service of the house of Yahweh was stabilized.
And Hezekiah was glad and all the people, over God's preparing of the people, 𝄓 for sudden was the thing. P
And Hezekiah sent over all Israel and Judah, and also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, to come to the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem, 𝄓 to do the Passover of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
And the king and his nobility took counsel, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, 𝄓 to do the Passover in the second month.
For they were not able to do it at its time, 𝄓 because the priests had not sanctified themselves enough, and the people were not gathered to Jerusalem.
And the matter was upright in the eyes of the king, 𝄓 and in the eyes of all the congregation.

And they had the matter stand, to have a declaration pass through all Israel, from Beer-Sheva and to Dan, to come to do the Passover of Yahweh the God of Israel in Jerusalem, 𝄓 for they had not done much as it is written.

And racers went with the letters from the hand of the king and his nobility into all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, 𝄓 Children of Israel, return to Yahweh the God of Abraham Yitschaq and Israel, and he will return to those who have been secured, those of you still here from the palm of the kings of Ashur.
And do not be like your ancestors, or like your kin who trespassed against Yahweh, the God of their ancestors, 𝄓 and he consigned them to desolation as you see.

Now, do not harden your scruff, like your ancestors. 𝄓 Yield yourselves to the hand of Yahweh, and enter into his sanctuary that he has sanctified forever, and serve Yahweh your God, and the ferocity of his anger will turn from you.

For if you return to Yahweh, your kin and your children will find compassion in the presence of those who carry them away, and they will return to this land, 𝄓 for gracious and compassionate is Yahweh your God, and will not let presence depart from you, if you return to him. S
So racers passed from city to city in the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and to Zebulun, 𝄓 and they laughed at them and derided them.
But persons from Asher and Manasseh and from Zebulun, 𝄓 were subdued and came to Jerusalem.
Even in Judah, the hand of God was to give them one heart, 𝄓 to do the commandment of the king and the nobles, in the word of Yahweh.
And an abundance of people gathered at Jerusalem to do the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, 𝄓 a congregation of much abundance.
And they arose, and they put aside the altars that were in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and all the incense altars, they put aside and cast into the wadi Kidron.

And they butchered the Passover on the fourteenth of the second month, 𝄓 and the priests and the Levites were humiliated, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings of the house of Yahweh.
And they stood on their standing-places, according to their judgment, according to the instruction of Moses, the man of God, 𝄓 the priests dashing the blood from the hand of the Levites.
But many in the congregation were not sanctified, 𝄓 and the Levites butchered the Passover for all not clean, to sanctify for Yahweh.

For a multitude of the people, many from Ephraim and Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, for they ate the Passover, but not as it is written. 𝄓 But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, Yahweh the good make a cover-price from within,
everyone in their heart who is prepared to search out God, Yahweh the God of their ancestors, 𝄓 though not according to the cleansing of the sanctuary. S
And Yahweh heard Hezekiah, and healed the people. S

And the children of Israel that were found in Jerusalem did the feast of unleavened bread, seven days, with great gladness, 𝄓 and the Levites praised Yahweh day by day, and the priests, with instruments of strength to Yahweh. S

And Hezekiah spoke to the heart of all the Levites, those who give insight, good insight of Yahweh. 𝄓 And they ate endlessly seven days, offering offerings of peace and thanksgiving to Yahweh, the God of their ancestors. S
And all the congregation took counsel to do the following seven days, 𝄓 and they did seven days with gladness.

For Hezekiah, king of Judah, contributed to the congregation a thousand young bulls and seven thousand sheep. And the nobles, they contributed to the congregation, young bulls, a thousand, and sheep, ten thousand. 𝄓 And priests sanctified themselves in abundance.

And they were glad, all the congregation of Judah, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the congregation who came from Israel, 𝄓 and the guests who came from the land of Israel or were settled in Judah.
And there was great gladness in Jerusalem, 𝄓 for from the days of Solomon, child of David, king of Israel, was not such as this in Jerusalem. S
And the priests, the Levites, arose and they blessed the people, 𝄓 and their voice was heard, and their prayer entered the habitation of his holiness of the heavens. P

And as all this was finished, all Israel that were found came forth to the cities of Judah, and they shattered the monuments, and they chopped down the fetishes, and they broke down the high places, and the altars from all Judah and Benjamin, and in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they finished. 𝄓 And all the children of Israel returned, each to its holding, to their own cities. P

And Hezekiah installed the divisions of the priests and the Levites per their divisions, each in proportion to its service. Of the priests and of the Levites, for burnt offering, and for peace offerings, 𝄓 to minister and to give thanks and to render praise in the gates from the camps of Yahweh. S

And the portion of the king from his property, for the burnt offerings. For the burnt offerings of the morning and the evening, and the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and for the appointed times, 𝄓 as are written in the instruction of Yahweh.
And he said to the people, to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, 𝄓 so that they would be encouraged in the instruction of Yahweh.

And as the matter broke out, the children of Israel increased the first-fruits of grain, new wine, and clarified oil, and honey, and all the income of the field. 𝄓 And the tithe of the whole in abundance they brought.

And the children of Israel and Judah, the settlers of the cities of Judah, even they tithed of oxen, and sheep, and the tithe of holy things that are holy to Yahweh their God, 𝄓 they brought and they gave, piles upon piles. S
In the third month, they had commenced the piles for the foundation, 𝄓 and in the seventh month, they finished. S
And Hezekiah and the nobles came and they saw the piles, 𝄓 and they blessed Yahweh and the people of Israel. P
And Hezekiah searched out the priests and the Levites about the piles.

And Azariah the priest the head of the house of Zadok said to him, 𝄓 saying, From the start of bringing the contribution to the house of Yahweh, to eat, and to be satisfied, and to have surplus to abundance. For Yahweh blessed his people and there remains this tumult. S
And Hezekiah said to prepare chambers in the house of Yahweh. And they prepared.
And they brought the contribution and the tithe and the holy things in faithfulness. 𝄓 and over them was herald Konnonyah the Levite, and Shimei his kin, second.

And Jechiel, and Azazyah, and Nachat, and Ashael, and Yerimoth, and Jozebad, and Elyel, and Yismakyah, and Maxat, and Benaiah, 𝄓 were officers under the hand of Konnonyah and Shimei his kin, by the precept of Hezekiah, the king, and Azariah, herald of the house of God.
And Qore, child of Yimnah, the Levite, the gatekeeper toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, 𝄓 to give the contributions of Yahweh and the holy of holy things.
And by his hand, Eden, and Minyamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shekanyah, in the cities of the priests, in faithfulness, 𝄓 to give to their kin by division to the greater or the lesser.

Besides their genealogy of the males from three years and upward for all that entered into the house of Yahweh for the word day by day, 𝄓 for their service in their watches according to their divisions,
And the genealogy of the priests for the house of their ancestors, and the Levites from twenty years and upward, 𝄓 in their watches in their divisions,
And to the genealogy among all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, for all the congregation. 𝄓 For in their faithfulness they sanctified themselves, holy.

And for the children of Aaron, the priests, in the fields of the outlands of their cities, in every city, by city, men that were drilled by name, 𝄓 to give portions to every male among the priests, and to all enrolled by genealogy among the Levites.
And Hezekiah did such as this in all Judah. 𝄓 And he did what is good and what is upright and the truth before Yahweh his God.
And in every deed that he started in the service of the house of God, and in the instruction, and in the commandment to search out to his God, 𝄓 with all his heart he acted, and he prospered. P
After these truthful matters, Senacherib king of Ashur came. 𝄓 And he entered Judah, and encamped against the enclosed cities, and said he would split them for himself.
And Hezekiah saw that Senacherib had come, 𝄓 and his presence was for war against Jerusalem.
And he took counsel with his nobles and his valiant to block the water of the springs that were outside of the city. 𝄓 And they helped him.
And many people collected themselves, and they blocked all the springs, and the wadi that overflowed in the midst of the land, saying, 𝄓 Why should the kings of Ashur come and find many waters?

And he was resolved, and built up all the wall that was breached, and he went up to the towers, and on the outside, the other wall. And he revamped Millo, the city of David, 𝄓 and he made javelin in abundance and shields.
And he assigned the chiefs of battles over the people, 𝄓 and he rallied them to him at the plaza of the gate of the city, and he spoke to their heart, saying,

Be courageous and be assured. Do not fear and do not be in disarray from the presence of the king of Ashur, or from the presence of all the tumult that is with him, 𝄓 because much more is with us than is with him.
With him is an arm of flesh, but with us is Yahweh our God, to help us, and to fight our battles. 𝄓 And the people were supported by the words of Hezekiah, king of Judah. P

Following this, Senacherib king of Ashur sent his servants to Jerusalem, (but he to Lachish and all his governance with him), 𝄓 against Hezekiah, king of Judah, and against all Judah that is in Jerusalem, saying,
Thus says Senacherib king of Ashur, 𝄓 In what are you trusting that you are seated in the siege in Jerusalem?
Does not Hezekiah persuade you to permit yourselves to die hungry and thirsty, saying, 𝄓 Yahweh our God will deliver us from the palm of the king of Ashur?
Has not he Hezekiah put aside his high places and his altars, 𝄓 and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, saying, Before one altar you will worship, and on it you will burn incense?
Do you not know what I have done, I and my ancestors, to all the peoples of the lands? 𝄓 Were they able, the gods of the nations of the lands, to deliver their land from my hands?
Who is among all the gods of these nations, that my ancestors did not utterly destroy, who could deliver his people from my hands, 𝄓 that your God would be able to deliver you from my hands?

So now, do not let Hezekiah lure you nor persuade you such as this, nor should you believe him, for no God is able, of any nation or kingdom, to deliver his people from my hands or from the hand of my ancestors. 𝄓 Indeed for your gods, they will not deliver you from my hands.
And still his servants spoke against Yahweh God, 𝄓 and against Hezekiah his servant.

And he wrote correspondence to reproach Yahweh the God of Israel, 𝄓 and pronouncing against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of the lands that did not deliver their people from my hands, so the God of Hezekiah will not deliver his people from my hands.
And they called with a great voice in Judean against the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to make them fearful and to vex them, 𝄓 so that they might conquer the city.
And they spoke of the God of Jerusalem, 𝄓 as over the gods of the peoples of the land, a deed of the hands of humanity. S
And Hezekiah the king prayed, and Isaiah child of Amoz, the prophet, over this, 𝄓 and they appealed to the heavens. S

And Yahweh sent a messenger, and he concealed all of valour and ability, and herald, and chief in the camp of the king of Ashur. 𝄓 So he returned, ashamed of face, to his land, and he entered the house of his God. And one who had come forth from his inner parts, there felled him by the sword.
So Yahweh saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Senacherib king of Ashur, and from the hand of all. 𝄓 And he refreshed them on every side.
And many brought a gift for Yahweh to Jerusalem, and things of quality to Hezekiah king of Judah. 𝄓 And he was lifted up in the sight of all the nations afterward, thus. P
In those days Hezekiah was ill to the point of death. 𝄓 And he prayed to Yahweh, and he talked to him, and a portent he gave him.
But not according to the reward for him, did Hezekiah restore, for haughty was his heart. 𝄓 And there was against him rage, and against Judah and Jerusalem.
But Hezekiah subdued himself in the haughtiness of his heart, he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem. 𝄓 And the rage of Yahweh did not come upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

And Hezekiah had riches, and very abundant glory. 𝄓 And treasuries he constructed for himself, for silver, and for gold, and for precious stone, and for spices, and for shields, and for all attractive articles,
And storerooms for the income of grain, and new wine, and clarified oil, 𝄓 and corrals for every beast, and cattle, and troops to corral.
And cities he constructed for himself, and acquired sheep and oxen in abundance, 𝄓 for God had given him property in excessive abundance.
And he, Hezekiah, blocked the emerging of the waters of Gihon, the upper part, and brought it straight downward from the westward of the city of David. 𝄓 And Hezekiah prospered in all his deeds.
And thus he gratified the chiefs of Babel who were sent to him to search out the portent that was in the land. God forsook him to prove him, 𝄓 to know all that was in his heart.
And the remaining words of Hezekiah and his kindnesses, 𝄓 behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah, child of Amoz, the prophet, in the record of the kings of Judah and Israel.

And Hezekiah was laid out with his ancestors, and they entombed him in the upper tombs of the children of David, and gloriously they did for him in his death, all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem. 𝄓 And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead. P
A child of twelve years was Manasseh when he began to reign, 𝄓 and fifty five years he reigned in Jerusalem. S
And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh, 𝄓 according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh had dispossessed before the face of the children of Israel.

And he turned and built the high places that Hezekiah his father had broken down, 𝄓 and he raised up altars to the Baalim, and he made fetishes, and he worshiped all the host of the heavens and served them.
And he built altars in the house of Yahweh, 𝄓 of which Yahweh had said, In Jerusalem will be my name forever.
And he built altars for all the host of the heavens, 𝄓 in the two courts of the house of Yahweh.

And himself he made his children pass through in the fire in the gorge of the child of Hinnom, and used fortunetellers and augury and sorcery and dealt with necromancy and wizards. 𝄓 He did much evil in the eyes of Yahweh to grieve him.

And he set up a graven image of a statue that he made, 𝄓 in the house of this God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house and in Jerusalem that I have chosen from all the sceptres of Israel, I will set my name everlastingly.

And not again will I turn aside the foot of Israel from the ground on which I made your ancestors stand, 𝄓 solely if they will keep and do all that I have commanded them, all instruction and the statutes and the judgments by the hand of Moses.
And Manasseh made Judah to wander and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, 𝄓 to do more evil than the nations whom Yahweh exterminated before the face of the children of Israel. P
And Yahweh spoke to Manasseh and to his people and they did not attend.
And Yahweh brought on them the chiefs of the host of the king of Ashur and they caught Manasseh among thorns, 𝄓 and bound him with brass chains and led him into Babel.
And in his trouble, he entreated before Yahweh his God, 𝄓 and much subdued himself before the God of his ancestors.
And he prayed to him and he was petitioned by him and heeded his supplication and he returned him to Jerusalem to his kingdom, 𝄓 so Manasseh knew that Yahweh, he is the God.

And after such, he built a wall outside of the city of David from the westward to the Gihon in the wadi, and to the entrance at the fish gate and he circled to the promontory, very high and lofty, 𝄓 and he set up chiefs of ability in all the enclosed cities in Judah.

And he put aside the alien gods and the statues from the house of Yahweh, and all the altars that he had built on the hill of the house of Yahweh and in Jerusalem, 𝄓 and cast them outside of the city.
